comments:
포르투 여행 동안 머문 숙소 중 정말 정말 만족스러웠습니다.
위치가 너무 좋아서 상벤투역, 볼량시장, 렐루서점 등 주요 관광지를 대부분 걸어서 다닐 수 있었고, 주변에 식당과 카페도 많아서 여행하는 내내 정말 편했습니다.
숙소도 아주 깔끔하고 편안했고, 도착한 날 체크인 시간도 유연하게 조정해 주셔서 첫날부터 기분 좋게 여행을 시작할 수 있었습니다. 직원분들도 친절해서 머무는 동안 불편한 점이 전혀 없었습니다.
무엇보다 위치, 청결, 편안함 모두 만족도가 높아서 포르투에 다시 온다면 고민 없이 다시 머물고 싶은 숙소입니다. 신혼여행 숙소로 선택했는데 정말 잘 선택했다는 생각이 들었습니다.
포르투에서 숙소를 고민하고 있다면 정말 추천합니다. 아주아주 만족스러운 숙박이었습니다.
Appartamento carino, bagno molto piccolo posizione eccellente. L’appartamento richiede maggiore manutenzione ed una più accurata pulizia.

Sandra and Pedro are the consummate hosts! Their beautiful apartment is in the perfect location—within easy walking distance of lovely Porto’s landmarks, bakeries and restaurants. It was bright, perfectly appointed, impeccably clean and comfortably furnished. The air conditioning/temperature control and water pressure were excellent, as well. Despite being centrally located, it was quiet and restful. Sandra and Pedro are kind, thoughtful and communicative; they were accommodating when our arrival time shifted later than expected and provided local recommendations and clear check-in and check-out instructions. We will absolutely recommend their apartment to friends and colleagues who are traveling to Porto. Thank you so much, Sandra and Pedro!

Hôte très accueillant et disponible ! Le logement de Victor est idéalement situé, on peut visiter Porto à pieds. On se sent comme dans un cocon. On y dort bien, c'est très calme. Petit + pour le café, serviettes et savons à disposition ! Je recommande 🌞
Very cute apartment. Clean, comfy bed and great shower! Quiet and private. Highly recommend.
Manque un salon dans l’appartement
Nice place. Great location. No flexibility on check-out
Such a great place
Good location, with close proximity to main attractions and restaurants but providing some privacy. Very pleasant stay and supportive staff.

This apartment was really well located, clean, and had everything we needed for our 3-night stay. Checking in and out was super easy and we had a really great stay overall. 
It’s about 5 minutes from transit, which made it super easy to get around. We walked most places, but having the option of taking transit was nice since it was quite hot while we were there. There was some noise, but nothing crazy. 
The location doesn’t allow for much of a breeze (even with the windows wide open), and there are no fans, but even when it was 32 degrees we never found it unbearable. 
The fridge is mini, and the freezer door was broken, but our stuff stayed cold and Joana assured us she’d have it fixed. 
We really enjoyed our stay!
Great place
Absolutely exceptional view and location!

Fantastic location, very helpful hosts and lovely clean apartment 
Well worth a visit

Beautiful apartment, wonderful view, beach on your doorstep, and plenty of places to eat and drink. Marcos met us on arrival and was very friendly and gave us some good local recommendations. We had an issue with one of the doors and Marcos came out to get it sorted within the hour. Can't fault anything.
Excellente localisation pour découvrir le vieux Porto. Rue animée et très agréable à marcher. Le logement est situé dans la partie arrière de l’édifice donc parfaitement calme.
Lovely little apartment. Wld have liked a toasters but all good.
Great stay and a lot of nature around

We had a great time in Porto/Gaia! The place was super nice and the hosts were great as well. Managed to get a spot near the door to park which was amazing and getting an uber or bolt to get around was easy and affordable since it was so close. Would definitely recommend!
Appartement superbe, propre et correspondant à la description donnée par la propriétaire! Nous étions bien placé dans la ville et tout ou presque se faisait en marchant. Je recommande 100% ❤️

Bernado ist ein sehr höflicher und hilfsbereiter Vermieter. Er hat uns bei allen Fragen die wir hatten weiterhelfen können und hat uns beim Check in auch früher in die Wohnung gelassen, was uns sehr geholfen hat. Die Wohnung hat alles zu bieten, was man für einen Aufenthalt benötigt. Die Wohnung war sehr sauber und aufgeräumt. Man kann mit dem Bus sehr einfach in die Innenstadt gelangen.
Einziger negativer Punkt: Direkt in der Nähe ist eine Baustelle, und die Baustellen Fahrzeuge rasen durch die Straße direkt am Haus vorbei. Dadurch hatten wir ab 6 Uhr keine Ruhe mehr. Man konnte ab dann nur mit geschlossenen Fenstern schlafen. Aber das fanden wir nicht so schlimm.
Die Wohnung und Bernado sind sehr weiter zu empfehlen!
Joli petit logement décoré avec goût et bien équipé.
Really central location with a lot of the main attractions around and really nice restaurants/bars
Wir wurden freundlichst begrüßt und auf uns wurde auch gewartet. Die Wohnung war sauber und aufgeräumt, entsprach den Bildern. In allem kann man sich nicht beschweren.

Nice little apartment with outdoor space. Walkable from Trinidade (uphill) and Faria Guimarães metro stations. Quiet residential area, a few little local shops and restaurants. Apartment is comfortable and has everything you need for a nice stay. Only comments are the kitchen is quite small, not much work surface if you’re preparing a meal. Loads of pots, pans, cutlery etc. Also it was noisy a couple of nights (2am and 5am!) you could hear people in other apartments. Maybe some soundproofing needed. There is a nearby luggage store if needed before or after your stay (Locker in the city, Rua do Dr. Alfredo Magalhães 114). Would definitely stay again if in Porto.

Magnifique et chaleureux appartement rénové avec goût ! On s'y sent directement comme chez soi.
Spacieux et bien équipé. Confort absolu! Et surtout au calme. On mettrait un 6 étoiles sur 5 sans hésiter 😊 Un véritable coup de cœur ❤️
La plage, le métro et les magasins sont proches. Matosinhos est une agréable petite ville balnéaire. 
Ana est prévenante, bienveillante et accommodante. Merci à elle et merci aussi pour la petite attention à notre arrivée.
A conseiller les yeux fermés !!!

Die Wohnung liegt in einem lebendigen Quartier mit vielen Restaurants, Cafés und Bars. Zu Fuss kann man die Sehenswürdigkeiten erkunden- ein spannender Ort! Die Wohnung ist sehr gut beschrieben, der Kontakt mit Henrique ist unkompliziert und präzise. Zudem hat er sehr hilfsbereit eine Anzahl von interessanten Orten und Lokalen mir mitgeteilt. 
Ich komme bei meinem nächsten Besuch in Porto sehr gerne wieder hierhin. ☀️
Lovely decor, plenty of space, close to everything!
Asunnon sijainti oli loistava Portossa lomailuun. Kaikki tarvittava oli kävelymatkan päässä. Vastaanotto oli ystävällinen ja saimme aina vastauksen nopeasti kysymyksiin. Asunto oli puhdas ja siisti.
Super apartment a stones throw from great eateries & shops !

Miejsce noclegowe z wygodnym dużym łóżkiem.
Pokój idealny na jedną noc na szlaku do i z Santiago.
Small apartment, great for short stays. Very clean, great communication. Great location! I would definitely recommend this place!

Le logement était parfait, la literie impeccable de plus la situation de cet appartement est super bien situé dans le centre historique.
Nous avons découvert une ville très belle : PORTO !!
Merci à nos hôtes pour les recommandations et la rapidité des réponses.
Agnès et Félix
Super séjour hote accueillante et de bons conseils . Emplacement idéal pour nos différentes activités. L'appartement est spacieux et bien équipé.

I loved staying at this Airbnb. It was in a great location. Very clean. The bed was comfortable and it was nice having AC. The host was always helpful and responsive. I would stay here again in a heartbeat.

Foi uma estadia imensamente agradável, zona tranquila vizinhos acolhedores apaixonei me pelo o Porto com certeza irei voltar . 
O senhor Alex muito o prestativo e simpático !
Casa impecável, 100% limpa e espaçosa
Thanks to Alice for the warm welcome. Everything was perfect

L'appartamento di Susana è un una posizione comodissima.
Perfetto per chi arriva in aereo e con la metro direttamente nel cuore della città.
Pulizia, ordine e tutto il necessario.
Noi siamo rimaste una sola notte ma l'accoglienza è stata impeccabile.
Assolutamente consigliato.

Très bel appartement, spacieux et lumineux. 
Très bonne literie

We really enjoyed our stay at Jorge’s apartment. We especially liked the interior, with natural elements such as wooden flooring and tasteful furniture. It felt more like a real home than an apartment designed specifically for Airbnb, which made the stay very comfortable. The small balcony was also a lovely touch, having coffee there in the morning was a real pleasure
Jorge was an incredibly kind and helpful host. He responded very quickly to our messages and handled any questions or situations exceptionally well!
The location is fantastic for exploring Porto. A large supermarket is nearby, and the apartment has everything needed for cooking, so we could easily prepare anything from pasta to a steak. We also appreciated being on relatively flat ground, which is especially convenient in hilly Porto
Thank you, Jorge, for everything! We truly enjoyed our stay and would happily return.

Here’s a balanced version that makes the sewage smell clear without sounding overly harsh:
The apartment was very pretty, clean, and well located. It was also quiet at night, which I really appreciated.
Unfortunately, there was a strong sewage smell in the room that significantly affected my stay. I contacted the owners about it, but the recommendation was simply to open a window. While that helped somewhat, it wasn’t an ideal solution, especially since the odor was coming from inside the room.
Overall, the apartment itself is lovely and in a great location, but I do think the sewage odor needs to be properly addressed for future guests.
Pedro and Hugo were great hosts. There was a lot to do around the town and the location is great. The Airbnb was clean and cozy.
Lurdes is very kind and an amazing host, the place was clean and pristine with all proper amenities.. thank you for hosting us !
Amazing Airbnb for a peaceful and central location in Porto. Monica was super helpful and attentive. We a really enjoyed our stay and would definitely come back

Contact met Joaquim was erg makkelijk. De kamer was nog niet klaar dus ik kon m’n rugzak in zijn café achterlaten. De woning van Joaquim (hij verblijft er zelf ook) is goed ingericht. De kamer waar ik verbleef was prettig, het was ‘s nachts erg rustig dus ik kon zelfs met het raam open slapen. Locatie is goed, midden in het centrum, en slechts een paar minuten lopen van de camino route!
Excelente lugar, bem espaçoso. 🩵
Tout était parfait ! Super accueil et très bel emplacement
Great stay!
Excelente vista, e dono extramamente simpático. Ótimas dicas de restaurantes 👌🏻
Super gut gelegene Unterkunft. Sehr sauber. Alles Bestens!

Apartamento demasiado quente devia ter uma climatização bastante melhor tendo em conta o preço. Rua com demasiado barulho de obras. Confusão. Pouco isolamento sonoro, atenção quando reservam. De resto nada acrescentar.

Ich liebe den Ort Gaia und bei Rosa, neben dem absolutem Wohlfühleffekt, tollem Zimmer und dem Bett und alles, ist man ruhig gelegen aber doch sehr schnell im Zentrum! Ich würde Rosa immer wieder buchen! Danke für alles ❤️🫶❤️🫶 
Auch für Pekegrinos sehr gut geeignet, entweder davor, für einen guten erholten Schlaf oder wie ich nachdem Camino ankommen…. 
Buen camino 🥰
Fijn appartement midden in Porto. Fijne plek om Porto te verkennen.
Great apartment, fab location and very quiet.
Schöne große Wohnung mit vielen Möglichkeiten für eine angenehme Übernachtung. Toller Service.

Solide Unterkunft, tolle und zentrale Lage. Gute Anbindung durch die Bahn. 
Sehr netter und zuvorkommender Kontakt.
Leider im Badezimmer etwas schmutzig, einige Haare in der Dusche und unangenehmer Geruch.
Ansonsten jedoch tolle Altbauwohnung mit Charme. Wir würden nochmals kommen.

Excelente espacio, las instrucciones son bastante claras y Göran siempre busca colaborar con la experiencia de los viajeros. Cuenta con servicios de bebidas y snack de pago, pero a muy buen precio, procura llevar cambio para ello. Sin lugar a dudas repetiremos en otros viajes a Porto.
Wonderful spot in the heart of all the action. Great experience at João's place- clean and comfortable.

Apartamento cómo y funcional muy cercal del centro de Porto. 
Ubicado en una de las avenidas principales y a tan solo 5 min. del Mercado de Bolhao y otros puntos de interés.
Great host and stay!
Cumple con la descripción, muy bien ubicado y facil de llegar

Świetny pobyt w tym apartamencie. Komunikacja z gospodarzem była na bardzo wysokim poziomie, szybkie odpowiedzi i konkretne informacje jeszcze przed przyjazdem. Lokalizacja blisko centrum, do którego bez problemu dotarliśmy pieszo, a dodatkowym plusem były lokalne rekomendacje od gospodarza, które ułatwiły zorientowanie się w okolicy. Mieszkanie czyste i zadbane, wyposażone we wszystko, co potrzebne na co dzień. Stosunek jakości do ceny bardzo dobry. Polecam bez wahania.
The Place really is cosy. The location is perfect and the communication was also flawless.

Wonderful place with all the amenities we could wish for! Especially impressed with the kitchenette including espresso, fridge, and water was really good for drinking. A fun mix of old and new style and great shower setup. Walk to metro stops was easy (and flat)!

Sandra’s place is exactly as described. It is an excellent base to explore Porto. She is a great host, quick to respond with lots of information. I would highly recommend this apartment and we will definitely stay there again.
It was great!

6 stars if I could !
Super proactive communication with Paulo and the team including lots of great recommendations for places to eat and things to do. Always quickly responsive to any queries from us.
The place was spotless and fully as described. Location was super and Porto is relatively easy to get around given the size. The apartment was small but has everything and was absolutely perfect for the two of us (staying for 4 days). Super comfy king sized bed. 
They were very flexible on check in and check out which was really helpful. 
Really good value for money given the quality of the place.
Couldn’t recommend it highly enough and will go back which is always the test.
Quarto que figuei não tinha boa ventilação
Lovely place, great location, would recommend!
Great location and space, super quiet and easy walk everywhere!

Très bon accueil et appartement conforme à la description.
Pas trop loin du centre.
Nous recommandons
Bonito sitio

Ne paye pas de mine de l’extérieur mais bien pensé dans la rénovation offrant le petit extérieur en commun qui est cosy. Bonne literie, appartement simple, efficace, propre, calme.
Hôte d’une gentillesse exceptionnelle, très souriant, dynamique, blagueur, réactif et qui parle anglais ce qui a facilité nos échanges. 
Nous ne sommes restés que deux jours mais il y a beaucoup de choses à faire/ voir à Porto. Petits commerces de proximité. Nous avons tout fait à pied. 55 min à pied en étant très chargé de la gare, proche de l’autoroute et 12 min de l’aéroport en Uber.
住得好舒服，屋內感覺好溫馨🧡
Excelente ubicación, cocina equipada y cuarto equipado

Un logement parfait !, très bien situé, pratique et fluide pour profiter de la magnifique ville de Porto! 
Logement très propre et un accueil au top ! 
On reviendra avec grand plaisir !

One of THE best airbnbs we stayed in during our visit to Portugal. A walk downstairs leads you right to center of Porto with the river a few blocks down and you’re surrounded by many amazing restaurants and wine bars. Very close to the night life area also in the Galeiras Paris. We would definitely stay here again.

Place was larger and better than we expected based on the photos. The view from the 7th floor was absolutely stunning, especially around sunset. Very large windows, lots of sunshine and great air flow throughout the apartment. Neighbourhood felt very safe, and everything was within walking distance. Super close to the metro station as well. Would definitely come back!
A spacious apartment within walking distance of town. It is out of the main tourist area so is a little quieter and nicer.

Wir hatten einen schönen Aufenthalt in Porto. Die Unterkunft ist sehr gut gelegen, sodass alles fußläufig erreichbar war. 
Zwei Sterne Abzug, da es sehr hellhörig in dem Haus ist, weshalb wir nicht wirklich gut geschlafen haben. Außerdem riecht es durch die Feuchtigkeit muffig. Ein Entfeuchter ist allerdings aufgestellt.
Zeer goede ligging. Groot balcon. Gemakkelijk binnen te geraken via code. Stoelen en tafel zouden wel goede extra zijn op terras. Zeer goed verblijf!
Heel erg bedankt voor ons verblijf hier. We hebben genoten van de plek :) We voelden ons erg welkom. En zo lief dat je wat had gebakken, het was heerlijk. Dank je wel voor alles :)
Nice quiet location right in city center and convenient to everything. We really enjoyed our stay!

Fantastic place to stay, right in the middle of Porto. Lots of great cafes, bars, and restaurants, as well as landmarks and attractions all within walking distance. 
The apartment was clean and had everything you need for a great stay. 
Would definitely stay here again.

Bonne emplacement 
Près de tout

Alojamiento limpio y cómodo,con un patio amplio donde aparcar ,muy cerca de playas con varios restaurantes,zona muy bonita.
Carlos ,el anfitrión muy amable y servicial.

We really enjoyed our time here. The apartment is in a very ideal location with easy access to multiple local amenities. We particularly appreciated all of the recommendations provided for local things to do. It was also great for a quiet night's sleep. Our hosts were excellent and we would most definitely stay here again and recommend this apartment to our friends. Thank you very much!

The apartment is new, with all the equipment necessary. Easy to access. Some small remarks - the whole building is mostly airbnb, and on friday the guests had a party till late night, so to sleep it was delayed and disturbed. The elevator from some uknown reason announces itself with a loud music to each floor, which you can hear via the whole building. Totally uncecessary. 
Moskito nets are missing on the balcony doors. During our stay, the air was very wet inside, unable to air the whole place.
5* - for the bed, for the landlord, for the location, for the new equipment, for espresso maker with enough tabs, for the large bathroom with great shower and for the TV full with paid channels. Wifi worked well too.

We had a wonderful stay. Walking distance to everything. Great value! Wish we could stay longer. We were planning on cooking from the place at least a few times but there are so many great restaurants within 5 minute walk we choose to eat out. Very clean and safe location. Can’t wait to return
Appartement très propre ,Pedro et très gentil très réactif au message et explique bien les bonne adresse plus un petit cadeau de bienvenue vous pouvais y aller les yeux fermé
Great stay. Convenient location and felt safe.
All good, the hosts are attentive and easy to communicate with, location is great.
Très satisfait, je recommande vivement.
Maria foi muito atenciosa, respondeu rapidamente aos questionamentos e procurou resolver rapidamente

mooi appartement met goede voorzieningen, badkamer, keuken, wasmachine. Vlakbij metro, supermarkt en leuke restaurants. Strand en boulevard op loopafstand. De nabije buurt is wat verouderd maar wordt opgeknapt. Goede plek voor combinatie home office en uitvalsbasis voor dagtrips, b.v. naar Porto. Fijne host, snelle communicatie, proactief.
Amazing place, very good smell, friendly and welcoming host💗

Estadia perfeita em todos sentidos. O apartamento é muito confortável, muito bem equipado e decorado. Ótima localização, perto suficiente do centro histórico pra ir caminhando mas em uma rua tranquila. Os anfitriões são pessoas amáveis que fazem de tudo para você se sentir bem em todos aspectos.

I just spent one week in the appartment. It is well equipped and features a balcony für 4 people accessible from the bedroom and living room.
WiFi is fast and the aircondition also works smooth.
The next metro station is only a 3 minutes walk away.
Nous avons passé un très bon séjour à Porto ! Je recommande ce logement !

We had a wonderful visit to Porto! The place was amazing - huge, clean, bright and absolutely fully equipped - everything you could possibly need to feel right at home. Teresa and Joana were helpful, responsive and provided great information/recommendations. The location is great - not in the center of the hustle and bustle, but in a lovely neighborhood that allowed us to get to all the things - either by foot or Metro (super easy to use, very convenient and efficient). The private garage was also a really nice feature. Highly recommended if you want a stress-free stay in Porto!
Super logement très proche du pont Dom-Luis, hôte réactif, nous avons passons un super séjour!
Maria communicated well prior to our arrival. Gave clear check-in instructions. We stayed at her place for 3 nights and loved the walk ability for sight seeing, restaurants, metro and train station.

リビング、キッチン、ベッドルームが完全に分かれた、とても使いやすい間取りでした。広々としたベランダもあり、そこからの眺めも素晴らしかったです。
立地はPortoの中心部からやや離れていますが、今回の訪問先には近く、すぐ近くにバス停もあるため、移動に不便はありませんでした。室内は清潔で、設備にも特に問題はありません。
ホストとのコミュニケーションもスムーズで、チェックインの際にはPortoについて役立つ情報をたくさん親切に教えていただきました。また、高級住宅街に位置しているため、治安に関する不安もなく、安心して滞在できました。

+ Lage sehr gut (Sehenswürdigkeiten, Restaurants, Bars)
+Küche gut ausgestattet auch für Kochen
+Geräumig auch zu viert geeignet 
+Sauber
-+ Schlafcouch ist okay aber bei längerem Aufenthalt nicht zu empfehlen 
- Hellhörig zum Treppenhaus 
- Tür zum Badezimmer lässt sich nicht richtig schließen / Tür macht laute Knackgeräusche beim Öffnen

- Bei 4 Personen gibt es nicht genug Möglichkeiten die Handtücher aufzuhängen

Sara was friendly, responsive and helpful providing recommendations. Location was perfect for my work.

I really love the room with a piano in tune. I was worried it would be hot, but the owner provided a fan, and when the windows are open, there's wind. So it was a comfortable stay. The owner left us some grapes at the door the night before we left. She was sweet.
Great place to stay, perfect for the metro and also an easy walk to the centre.
숙소 깨끗하고 조리 시설 및 세탁기, 테라스까지 만족스러웠습니다. 포르투 오면 재방문 하고 싶어요

Tivemos uma ótima estadia! 
O alojamento estava limpo, confortável e correspondia às fotografias e à descrição. A localização também era muito boa, numa zona prática e com bons acessos. Os anfitriões foram sempre muito simpáticos, disponíveis e prestáveis, respondendo rapidamente sempre que precisámos. 
Sentimo-nos muito bem recebidos e a experiência foi bastante positiva!!
The flat is located right in the center district and at the top of the bridge. Great access to sunset views and restaurants/shopping. Also steps from the Sao Bento train station
We had a few issues on the cleanliness of the suite however guest ready was willing to send there cleaning team in again to re clean the suite however we just did it ourselves
Very new apartment close to Sao Bento train station and walkable to most attractions

Le logement est très fonctionnel et il est idéalement placé pour visiter Porto.
Excellente communication avec l’hôte.
Jorge was a great host- met me for check in and gave lots of recommendations. I really liked staying a bit out of the hustle and bustle but easy to walk everywhere. Would definitely come back!

Excellent communications and clean apartment. Could have benefited from a starter pack with tea bags or coffee and also the shower gel bottle was empty. These are all very minor points as the apartment organise wqs excellent

Rosas apartment was wonderful and just wanted we needed for a few days in the city! super easy to walk everywhere , loads of lovely restaurants near by and the apartment it’s self was very comfortable ! Definitely recommend to anyone wishing to come to porto 💜
We had a wonderful stay, the apartment is well planned, clean and close to the city center.
Très bon séjour ✨
Merci Amélia pour votre réactivité et vos conseils. Emplacement au centre de porto mais nous n’entendons pas les bruits de la rue. Logement propre et adapté à la description. Merci encore ! :)

Liliana’s place is fabulous…brand new and sparkling clean. The location is perfect, we walked everywhere. Supermarket next door and plenty of bars and restaurants nearby. 
Look no further, highly recommend.

We had an amazing stay! Location was perfect, easily walkable to everything without being too busy. The place itself was cute, clean, and had everything we needed. Francisco was quick to respond and so helpful!

El alojamiento es muy bonito, está decorado con mucho gusto y se nota el cuidado en cada detalle. Está en una zona tranquila y no se oyen ruidos del exterior. Además, la cama es muy cómoda, perfecta para descansar.
Lovely stay, very comfy and host was great. Would recommend highly. Parking was very convenient too.
Muy bien ubicado, gran lugar
일단 위치가 완벽합니다. 포르투 관광를 하기에 더할나위없이 좋은 위치입니다. 그리고 호스트가 너무나도 친절합니다. 멋진 여행을 하기에 더할나위없는 숙소입니다!
Perfect location in the centre of Porto. Great design and very clean!
The location is fantastic, the place is spotless, and it looks just like the pictures showed. We had a wonderful time!

Estacionamento privativo ótimo.
O apartamento é razoável.
Zona tranquila, com tudo acessível.
Our stay was amazing with a great location
Logement très bien placé et parfait pour un week-end à deux !

We stayed at Hava’s place for 5 nights. It was a pleasure- ground floor, air conditioning and a beautiful, private patio. 
We went on several excursions and some walks to the central part of town. Generally we walked down and took a Bolt or cab back. It was very handy having a washing machine and a clothes rack outside on the patio. We highly recommend Hava’s apartment for your stay.
好屋主
très bon logement je recommande 💕

La comunicación fue fluida y amable.
The room is very new and clean.
Fernando and Ana’s flat was a great stay with excellent location in Porto. Communication was spot on, I highly recommend this Airbnb to anybody.
Zoals op de foto’s en makkelijk systeem met de code.

Teresa é uma querida, uma senhora muito simpática que abriu a porta da sua casa para mim e uma amiga.

Great stay right in the hubub of Porto.

Good AC, good amenities overall a great stay
Very nice place in the centre of Porto. We enjoyed our stay a lot and will definitely come back. We much appreciated the quick communication and flexibility with our luggage.
First time visiting Porto. Isabel & Igors’s place was amazing. Great location. Nice and quiet. Hosts very helpful and quick to respond to any questions we had. Highly recommend staying here.
Très bel accueil de Ana. Nous nous sommes senties très à l’aise et en sécurité. Les déjeuners ont été très appréciés.

Had a great time, enjoying the swimming pool and outdoor area. Apartment was very well furnished, clean and homely. Being collected by our host (flight delayed) made it so much easier for us as Daniel kindly showed us over the apartment explaining aspects of the accommodation and his recommendations for tours, places to eat and hidden gems. An enjoyable, relaxing 4 days was had by myself and husband. We would highly recommend this accommodation.

Loved our stay at Toc Toc. Really cute flat with lots of room to be comfortable. Very close to many restaurants and sights. Hugo was quick to respond and accommodated our early arrival luggage. Highly recommend to stay here! Cute little market steps away from the front door!

This apartment was comfortable and had everything you needed. Lovely balcony was a bonus...
Supermarket just around the corner and walkable to all the places we wanted to see...including over the bridge to other side of river and to Infante where we got the tram to a lovely seaside resort. Really close to nice places for food and drinks.
Really enjoyed our stay here
A lovely stay with everything we needed! So central for exploring Porto. Would recommend staying here to anyone considering it. A home from home! Thank you 😊

Hôte exceptionnelle , répondait vite quand nous avions une question. Beau loft tout rénové, bien équipé et très bien situé au centre de tout, tout en étant dans une rue typique et tranquille. Épicerie en face, boulangerie au coin de la rue. A 5 minutes du métro sao bento . Les instructions étaient très clair pour l'arrivée a l'appartement. Vraiment parfait , nous conseillons le logement d' Elena.

The apartment was entirely as described and well located for sightseeing in Porto. The apartment was clean and well equipped with everything we needed. Maria’s communication was fantastic from the time of booking and she answered our questions quickly. We had a wonderful time in Porto made easier knowing we could rest our weary legs with a comfortable night’s sleep 💤.

Paula’s place was amazing. The location is perfect, right on the beach front. You can always hear the sea. 2 close seafront cafes with good food and drinks. Short walk to Granja main train station that gets you into the heart of Porto quickly. 
Paula’s place was perfectly equipped and is better in real life than the photos show. We were with our toddler and there is lots of toys and games, and all the essentials (small bath, cot, plates, cups etc.) - very safe and child friendly environment. Paula was responsive and helpful. Highly recommend! Thank you for a brilliant holiday.

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour, Porto est magnifique avec pleins de ballades à faire et d'autres manifestations.
Notre appartement était au top avec un petit jardin paisible, très bien situé dans la ville, avec des explications très claires tant au niveau transport qu'à l'arrivée.
Je recommande vivement.
J'y retournerai c'est sûr.
Annick

We had a great stay. Location was fantastic and the apartment looked just like the pictures. Loved the washer as well as having an elevator. Balcony was small but nice. Great place and host were kind and responsive.

Cristina, Sandra et Pedro ont été super, accueillants et réactifs. 
Les instructions données au cours de notre séjour étaient claires et précises.
Je recommande ce logement sans hésiter pour passer vos vacances à Porto, il est très bien situé. Rien à dire au top

José received me at the apartment and he was communicative through the entire check in process. He gave me lots of recommendations and suggestions on what to visit around. The apartment was clean, spacious and with great amenities. It is located close to a subway station and 10 min walk to the city center. It has plenty of restaurants and shops around the area. I will recommend this place to anyone visiting Porto.

Upon arrival we were met by Maria & Sergio. They spent nearly an hour giving us advise/info on where to eat, to visit & all local attractions. Their accommodation is absolutely beautiful & the lovely touch of the welcome bottle of wine & homemade port was the icing on the cake. As with previous reviews, we would also give 10 out of 10 if we could. Will definitely stay here again on our next Porto visit.

The studio apartment is located on a park like quiet street with no cars. The bed is comfortable. It is walking distance from all the sights. Liliana is a responsive host and was available when I needed assistance. I would stay here again if I return to Bila do Conde. Thank you Liliana!

Ett enkelt och bra boende med allt som behövs. Rent och fint. Sköna och bekväma sängar. Nära till Metrostationen Trindade som är lätt att ta sig till från flygplatsen. Gångavstånd till många sevärdheter.

Amazing location, close to pedestrian street with restaurants and shops. Parking close by is a real plus! We were able to leave our luggage prior to our check in time and it was much appreciated. Easy communication, very proactive. Thank you

Een geweldig verblijf dat op een perfecte locatie ligt. Je kan alles te voet doen. Wij waren er met 5 vrienden dus dan moesten er 3 personen in de slaapzetel slapen wat iets minder was. Het is een mooie loft en een aanrader als je Porto wilt bezoeken.

Очень уютный небольшой дом. Расположен в 30 минутах ходьбы от старого города. Тихий район. Было очень комфортно спать. Удобные кровать и диван. Elisabete всегда быстро отвечала на возникающие вопросы. Мы остались очень довольны нашим проживанием в этом чудесном месте!
Nice location. Easy to communicate.
A warm welcome, attentive host and we had everything we needed. It is a truly beautiful home and made our trip memorable. Also great cat who’s polite and will greet you!

Great neighborhood-lots of trees and cafés little shops and very few tourists.
Bright and sunny rooms with big windows and lots of fresh air super clean, nice bathroom and kitchen and that free washing machine!!!
Thank you for meeting me at the front door!
Highly recommended

Erg fijn en schoon verblijf op een top locatie in Porto. Veel leuke restaurants en bars in de buurt. De ruimte is exact als op de foto's. Das Appartment liegt sehr zentral, gut als Startpunkt für alle Trips. Sehr geräumig, die Treppen in den 3. Stock schmal und steil. Sehr netter Kontakt zum Vermieter, alles lief reibungslos. Ausstattung war gut und vollständig. Das Bad ist klein, aber für ein paar Tage völlig ok. Wir können die Unterkunft von Joao empfehlen 👍🏻.

One of the best Airbnbs I have ever stayed at! It was immaculately clean, absolutely spotless. Everything was modern/updated and worked well. And there were soo many thoughtful little details and touches that many Airbnbs miss that really made the place feel like home: racks to hang your coats/purses/towels, a shoe rack, complimentary sweets, playing cards, a couple toy trucks if you have kids, a nice book selection, throw blankets on the couch/chairs, body lotion, etc. The beds were super comfortable and the A/C worked great. There are incredible views. It was very spacious. The washing machine worked great and there was a large drying rack and fan available. The hairdryer was super powerful and had the concentrator attachment. The location is amazing and was very safe and close to everything. There were snacks and wine available for purchase like a hotel minibar. The host is very friendly and responsive. Book this one for sure! Only complaint is the door key was finicky/tough to use.

We had such a lovely stay in Porto and really enjoyed our time here. The apartment was very clean and comfortable, and the location was perfect — close to local shops and within easy reach of beautiful areas like Foz do Douro and Ribeira. The bath in the room was such a lovely touch and made the stay feel extra special. We felt very welcome and would definitely love to come back and stay here again!

Just had a lovely stay at Vintage house. Joana was very responsive in her communication and helpful sending lots of local tips and information. A little noise during the day as building work going on behind the house but not Joanas fault. Very easy to use uber to get and about .

Super logement, tout près de la zone touristique de Porto ! Tout est propre, et les prioritaires répondent très vite en cas de problème. Leur rapidité ainsi que leur professionnalisme a été bien apprécié.

Gostamos muito de ficar na casa é pertinho de tudo, a casa tem maquina de lavar e secar o que achamos bastante conveniente, para além de muita loiça. A casa é espaçosa e fica num sítio ótimo para ir passear e perto do mar.
Carla und ihre Familie waren sehr freundlich. Die Unterkunft war makellos. Es war ein wirklich angenehmer Aufenthalt. Vielen Dank!

처음 들어서자마자 넓고 밝은 분위기에 압도 되었습니다. 같이간 일행들 모두 너무너무 만족한 숙소였습니다. 숙소가 너무 마음에 들어서 밖에 나가고 싶지 않을 정도였어요. 솔직히 사진보다 더 좋네요!! 꼭대기층이라 뷰도 좋고, 엘리베이터가 있어서 힘들지 않게 이동할 수 있었습니다. 내부 시설 또한 모두 깔끔하고 넓어서 정말 쾌적했어요. 
동루이스 다리도 걸어서 갈 수 있고요. 근처에 식당들도 많아요. 사람들이 많이 다니는 약간은 복잡할 수 있는 곳인데 방음이 너무 잘 되어서 창문 닫으면 전혀 시끄럽지 않습니다.
웰컴 드링크로 주신 와인도 퀄리티가 꽤 좋은 와인이었어요. 감사합니다. 만약에 지인들이 포르투에 간다면 꼭 추천하고 싶은 숙소 입니다.

Beautiful location!!!

Great great great location! Cute and comfy! Out door space a bonus! Laundry mat next door and superb drying rack at apartment! Plenty of restaurants all around and walkable to all important must see. We enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend the apartment .

Je n’ai pas l’habitude de laisser de mauvais commentaires, mais cette chambre n’était pas pour moi et j’imagine que ça rejoindra peut être d’autres voyageurs. Le plus problématique de l’expérience est le problème d’isolement au bruit. On entend très bien les autres chambres et la rue. C’est un quartier animé donc il faut s’y attendre et savoir que les fenêtres de la chambres tombent sur une rue très passante. Le vrai problème c’est les murs en cartons. La
tuyauterie aussi faisait du bruit.
Autre soucis , la couverture du lit sentait vraiment tres fort le javellisant et le plafond de la douche à des bouts qui écaillent et de la
moisissure. Pour le service, le concierge est réactif mais les services offerts de lockers et taxi pour l’aéroport sont chers. Je n’ai finalement pas dormi de la nuit.

Great place and away from the bustle of Porto.

Would definitely recommend.

This place was adorable and beautiful views! It was very walkable to Riberia and Gaia. Our hot was so responsive and helpful with suggestions for food, sites, and other items. I highly recommend this place.

My husband and I spent 4 nights at Claudia and Mario’s place. It was the perfect location to walk through the city streets and steps away from the Luís bridge. The view from the balcony is as spectacular in person and another option to watch the sunset which we highly suggest. 
We loved our time in Porto and would highly recommend staying at Claudia & Mario’s place!

Hele fijne plek om te verblijven, erg mooi uitzicht en daarnaast fijn dat de huurauto veilig geparkeerd kon worden. Clearly it was a newer apartment with sea views and clean. We felt safe and it’s walkable and peaceful.

Antonio a été d'une gentillesse et disponibilité de tout instant, malgré la distance. Les réponses à nos questions ont été immédiates. La maison de plain-pied est très agréable, au calme, très propre et dispose en plus d'une grande piscine. Je recommande vivement !
Alles in einem war alles Perfekt!!

Henrique’s place was fabulous, spacious, relaxing and with all amenities. The air conditioning was a real bonus on a hot day. Communication was outstanding, including when we were delayed. Completely recommend Henriques apartment.

El apartamento es muy cómodo y está en un buen lugar cerca del barrio histórico, la catedral, el puente y muchos lugares para comer! Hicimos casi todo caminando. La cama muy cómoda y buena la ropa de cama y toallas!!
Hay un pequeño supermercado al lado con todo, incluso fruta y verdura. Las anfitrionas estuvieron siempre a la orden. Muy recomendable
Très bon séjour.
Bel emplacement proche des transports en commun. Magnifique vue sur le Portugal!

I could not find a spotless airbnb with a great view of river so I opted in for this one as there were a lot of reviews about how spotless this place is. I did not think the location would be this great. It’s located only 3 minutes walking distance from Bolhaõ Metro Station so I just took the Metro from the Campanha train station for about 6 minutes to get to the airbnb. You need to go through two coded doors to get in the building, which made me feel very safe as a female traveling by herself. Also, there is an employee during the early afternoon onsite so they are readily available. I will definitely stay here if I visit Porto again!
LeeA is the perfect host. Couldn't ask for better accommodations at this competitive rate for such a great location. Everything as described... and more
Le logement était propre bien rangé et au calme.

Excellent location, we loved the neighborhood. Super easy to get to and from, close to everything, we always walked. Supermarket nearby as well as lots of options to eat, from breakfast to dinner. We also cooked a few simple meals. Great place to explore Porto!

The house is in a great location and beautifully decorated. It was also very cozy and welcoming. Claudia is extremely responsive and helpful throughout my stay, and I really appreciated the thoughtful touches, especially the wine and little cookies provided for me to enjoy.
I had a wonderful stay and would definitely recommend this place!
Sehr schöne Wohnung. Tolle Lage und sehr schöner Ausblick. Angenehme und freundliche Gastgeber/in. Alles top.
Great Airbnb and responsive hosts! Air conditioned rooms too, really positive experience and would recommend :)

Très bel appartement, très propre et conforme à la description avec toutes les commodités. 
L'hôte a été très réactif 
Environnement très proche du centre ville et des lieux touristique
Je recommande !!

Kate e Fernando foram ótimos anfitriões! Tudo estava conforme a descrição. Foram muito atenciosos e prestativos durante toda a estadia.
Só tenho a agradecer e recomendar a hospedagem. Foi uma ótima experiência!
Really nice flat with a river view. Quiet an excellent check-in. Staff gave us good orientation to city.
The appartment was practical, with that was needed. The parking spot was very practical.

The apartment was conveniently located close to the main areas you’ll want to explore when visiting Porto, which made getting around and enjoying our day trips very easy. Nous avons passé un agréable séjour, le logement était propre, facile d’accès et idéalement situé !

Appartamento luminoso e grazioso in zona tranquilla a due passi dal mare. È stato possibile accordarci per un late check out con piccolo sovraprezzo.

Un appartement agréable, avec une terrasse et une véranda vraiment appréciables .

Nous recommandons sans réserve.

Lurdes was fantastic, she helped accomodate an early flight time and effectively explained how everything works in the unit. We only stayed for a night but would come back in the future!

Fantastic stay in Porto - Miguel’s apartment really stands out. Very convenient location, just on the edge of old town, close to cafes and shops where all welcome tourists like they are local. 
Great communication prior to arrival with recommendations, what we should see and do, as well as important information.
Spotless, quiet and truely a home away from home.
Elegant, clean and well appointed city apartment with 2 bathrooms in a peaceful street in a central location.
Logement impeccable et emplacement parfait. Juste assez loin du centre pour être calme et paisible, mais juste assez près pour se rendre au métro à pied facilement.
Très bon séjour à Porto

I had a really good time staying here in Porto. Very close to all the main attractions walking distance, lots of good restaurants near by and a quick walk to the Douro river. Clean and hosts were also always responsive. Would recommend staying here!

Fantastic place to stay, view of the river and close to Castro (the best place for a pastel de nata).
Great location, accessible to all areas. Close to the river to access the Gaia side of the river too.
Overall, great place to stop!

Heel fijn verblijf gehad. Ze antwoorden altijd, soms wel door een AI. Duidelijke instructies en alles wat beschreven was was aanwezig! Heel erg prettig! 
Enige minpunt dat we hadden waren de badmatten die wat vlekken hadden (ze waren wel gewassen). Ook waren er werken in de straat waardoor we heel de dag geluidsoverlast hadden. Hier konden ze natuurlijk helemaal niks aan doen. 
Dankjulliewel voor de leuke ervaring.

Super emplacement, près du marché et près de tout pour visiter Porto à pied. Stationnement hyper pratique. Épicerie juste à cote. Hôte vraiment réactif et qui s’assure que nous ne manquons de rien. C’était confortable quoi qu’un peu bruyant parce que sur la rue. On recommande vraiment et on reviendra lors de notre prochaine visite à Porto.

Uns hat die Unterkunft sehr gut gefallen.
Es ist eine sehr schöne lichtdurchflutete Wohnung mit toller Aussicht auf dem Balkon.
Die Wohnung war insgesamt ordentlich, wenn auch nicht perfekt geputzt, auch ist das Mobiliar teilweise ziemlich abgenutzt.
Dies störte uns jedoch wenig und wir würden die Wohnung bedenkenlos weiterempfehlen.
Muy agradable, los anfitriones geniales y atentos. Puedes ir a cualquier lugar caminando. Lo único difícil son las escaleras cuando llevas maletas grandes.

Sehr schöne Unterkunft und äußerst ruhig. Das einzige was hätte besser sein können ist die Küche ist ziemlich klein und das Badezimmer hat kein Fenster, weshalb man die Tür offen lassen sollte. Das ist jedoch meckern auf hohem Niveau, wir hatten einen sehr angenehmen Aufenthalt und empfehlen die Wohnung weiter! Die Anweisungen und Empfehlungen der Hosts waren sehr hilfreich und haben dafür gesorgt, dass z.b. beim Check-in alles smooth und unmissverständlich abläuft :)

Paula is such a great host. Prompt and helpful communication, a great welcome even though I arrived late at night and then many useful tips on what to see and how to get there. Her home is very clean , a large bedroom and new bathroom . Paula makes herself available to answer any queries as well as expressing genuine interest in her guests , she loves what she does and it shows. Highly recommended especially if you are a solo female traveller.

Ich hatte einen ganz tollen Aufenthalt bei Rosa. Schade, dass es nur für eine Nacht war! Es war alles so sauber und sie war so zuvorkommend und wir hatten ganz tolle Gespräche. Das Zimmer war auch genau richtig, alles was man braucht! Ich würde hier auf jeden Fall wieder buchen :)
Fantastic hosts with a great apartment in a great location..
Amazing clean and luxurious apartment.
Buenos lugares para comer cerca
Buenísima experiencia. Agradecemos mucho la flexibilidad y atención de Joana.

We hebben een geweldig verblijf gehad! Het appartement is erg comfortabel en ligt in een hele rustige omgeving, wat heerlijk was voor de nachtrust. This was such a great stay. The host was extremely friendly and responsive. The place was absolutely beautiful and extremely clean as well. הדירה נעימה מאד, מאובזרת בכל מה שצריך ונוחה. כשהיינו זקוקים למגבות ומצעים נוספים קיבלנו מענה מיידי ויעיל. כל פניה לבעל הנכס או לחברת הניהול (דותן) קיבל מענה מיידי, ידידותי ומקצועי מאד. יש מים חמים תמיד, לחץ המים מעולה והמקלחות מהנות ונעימות. הסלון מעט קטן במידה וגרים בדירה יותר מ-2 אנשים. הדבר המרכזי שמעט מוריד מאיכות החוויה בדירה היא העובדה שהיא ממוקמת בקומת קרקע. הסלון פונה לרחוב ואם פותחים חלון לאיוורור חודר לדירה רעש מאוטובוסים ומכוניות. בצד העורפי היכן שממוקמים חדרי השינה, עלה לפעמים ריח מעט טחוב, יש מעט אור וזה נותן תחושה לא נעימה של סגירות. הפטיו בירכתי הדירה לא באמת משמש לישיבה, הוא חשוך ומוקף בקירות גבוהים. השכונה עצמה לא מאופיינת במקומות מעניינים במיוחד למעט כנסיית Lapa, אבל יש בה מכולות, מסעדות, בתי קפה והרבה מקומות כיפיים לשבת. הרחוב בו נמצאת ההדירה מאד תלול, כל יציאה וחזרה כרוכה בהליכה בעלייה ומי שאינו מורגל בכך, זה עלול להיות קצת קשה.

And Ines’ communication is very clear, responsive and helpful. Totally recommend this place when you’re in Porto.

Excellent appartement, très bien situé, tout ce fait a pied. 
Appartement propre avec tout le nécessaire. 
Je recommande.
While the location is excellent, we felt the interior didn’t reflect the price.

We had a great stay during our time in Portugal. Nice clean accommodations close to many attractions all within walking distance. The hosts were very kind and responsive during our stay. Would highly recommend!

This apartment is in a great location with beautiful views of the river.
Joao met us when we arrived to assist us with our bags and give us a little tour of the apartment and area. 
We were very pleased with our stay and would book this apartment again.

Super-sauberes und freundliches Zimmer, mit viel Liebe zum Detail eingerichtet. Die Gastgeberin ist ausgesprochen freundlich und war per Mail immer erreichbar.
Das Gepäck konnte ich bereits vor dem Check-in unterstellen.
Alles in allem eine tolle Unterkunft. Ich würde sie jederzeit wieder buchen 😊!

We had a lovely stay at Monica’s apartment in Porto. The location was fantastic, super central and convenient for exploring the city, while still being really quiet and peaceful. The apartment itself was very well maintained, comfortable and had everything we needed.
A special mention for how organised Monica was. She shared a really comprehensive document with recommendations for restaurants, cafés, things to do and useful local tips, which made navigating Porto so much easier.
A great base for exploring the city and somewhere I’d happily recommend!
Nice apartment and nice people.

Traveled as a group of six adults and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay! It was on a busy street with lots of traffic throughout out the day but that comes with being in a prime spot. You can see the river from the street and it is a gorgeous view. The beds were very comfortable and the AC was amazing. Each room had its own controller, which made it very nice. The space was clean and overall just an amazing stay. I would definitely come back here again.
Great location and very clean appartment. Easy and smooth check in. Thank you once again

Très beau et lumineux studio sous les toits, au 3ème étage ; magnifiquement rénové, très bien agencé (avec une clim👌), paisible et proche de tout (métro, restaurants, supermarchés, marché couvert, monuments). Bref nous avons passé un très bon séjour 🤗. 
Merci à Pédro et Hugo de nous avoir fait confiance.

Pros: Great location - close to train and very walkable. The hosts were very communicative and the place looks exactly like the photos. Great AC, flexible check in, 
Cons: loud - there sounded like construction above the unit. Since it’s right in the center there’s also lots of city noise until late morning so bring earplugs. 
Smell - there was this strong mildew/musty smell that would not go away even with the windows open to air it out. The place probably needs a very deep clean. The bathroom also looked like there was some mildew or mold in the shower, but the smell wasn’t strongest there surprisingly. I’m sure they would have addressed it but I did not mention it to them since my stay was shorter and I was not in the unit throughout the day.
Goede locatie, dichtbij het station (geen geluidsoverlast), alles dichtbij en een probleem die ik doorgaf aan de beheerder werd binnen enkele uren nog verholpen. Prima voor een paar dagen Porto.

The apartment is exactly as described and the terrace is a nice touch. There were thoughtful amenities in the apartment that we appreciated. The location is very central, so it’s easy to walk anywhere but inside apartment is still very quiet.
Only two things to note are that the WiFi range isn’t great so you have to remain close the router to get a solid connection, and you have to go up a flight of stars to get to the elevator so account for that.
Sehr tolle Unterkunft. Alles war sehr sauber und stilvoll eingerichtet. Die Lage ist sehr zentral, sodass alles fußläufig zu erreichen ist.
Lugar excelente
Excellent location, perfectly clean appartement and a well furnished kitchen. I loved the place!

We absolutely loved our stay here. The apartment is beautiful, comfortable, and in such a fantastic location—we could walk to just about everything we wanted to see, eat, and explore. One of our favorite things was simply sitting out on the balcony and watching the city go by. The people-watching was fantastic, and it was such a great spot to take in the energy of the neighborhood.
The hosts were incredible and clearly put a lot of thought into making guests feel welcome. The amenities were above and beyond what we normally expect from an Airbnb, and all of the little extras, snacks, and thoughtful touches made the stay feel especially generous and cared for. Everything was easy, comfortable, and well considered.
It was the perfect home base for exploring Porto—close to everything while also being a place we genuinely enjoyed coming back to at the end of the day. We would happily stay here again and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend it!
good stay
Had a great stay in Porto, thank you!

Estadia excelente, recomendo.
Grazie Lucia, é stato bello pernottare da voi

Appartemment très cosy et bien agencé. Emplacement parfait, beaucoup plus tranquille qu au centre tout proche à pied et tout se trouve à proximité immédiate ( cafés, restaurants...).
Notre Hôte André a été très amical et plein de bons conseils tout au long du séjour.
Je recommande à 100%

Awesome modern apartment in an old area moments from the beach and esplanade. Easy to get to via public transport with everything you need nearby including amazing restaurants and bars as well as supermarkets and cafes. Tiago was fantastic and very welcoming. Highly recommend.
Ha estado muy bien
It was great…. Easy to find….. near WOW and clean. The bed was comfy and loved how much light there was for facing a courtyard. No complains. Would stay there again

Ich war sehr sehr zufrieden! Für den Preis SUPER! 
Die Lage war für mich top, wenn es auch sehr steil war zu Fuß hinzukommen. Ich hatte mich aber schnell daran gewöhnt. Von der Ufer-Promenade in Gaia war ich ca in 10 Minuten in der Unterkunft. 
Die Unterkunft wurde gefühlt täglich gereinigt, wobei ich es nicht in Anspruch genommen habe. Alles war vorhanden (Küche), wobei ich immer auswärts essen war (das Restaurant "Porto Iberico" ist um die Ecke und sehr zu empfehlen!). Ein kleines Café war direkt um die Ecke für den Cafe am Morgen. 
Alles in allem für mich PERFEKT! 
Der Kontakt zu Claudio&Bruno war easy und diese wirkten wirklich super bemüht und haben mehrfach proaktiv nachgefragt ob ich etwas brauche! Dankeschön dafür! 
Einkaufsmöglichkeiten sind etwas entfernt, WENN man einen größeren Supermarkt sucht, aber dafür gibt's ja Über/Bolt, oder halt einen Fußmarsch von 15 Minuten (kleiner Supermarkt), oder ca 25 Minuten (Riesenmarkt im Arrabida Shopping).
Insgesamt Empfehlung!!!

This Airbnb was beautiful. Everything we needed was supplied by the hosts.
The check-in was very flexible and easy and the hosts met us on time at the door. They gave us ideas for some food shopping and how to reach many attractions. 
The Airbnb is very conveniently located near great public transportation and the city center is easily accessible. It is also located less than 10 minute walk to the beach and nice restaurants. We highly recommend this place.
Thank you.

Wir hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt in Vila Nova de Gaia. Die Unterkunft war sauber, gemütlich und perfekt gelegen, um Porto und Gaia zu erkunden. Die Kommunikation mit Antonio war freundlich und unkompliziert. Wir kommen gerne wieder!

We had a wonderful week in Porto and thoroughly enjoyed our stay. There were incredible views of the river and the town and cathedrals on the hill from the balcony. I will only say that the stairs are not for the faint of heart, as are the hills of Porto!
Great area to stay, close to everything! Little noisy at night but still able to sleep well!
Everything alright
Well maintained, clean, well located, and spacious apartment. The host was responsive.

Wir haben uns in der Unterkunft in Azurara sehr wohlgefühlt. Besonders hervorheben möchten wir die herzliche Begrüßung und die unkomplizierte, sehr gute Kommunikation mit Adriano. Man hat sich von Anfang an willkommen und gut aufgehoben gefühlt.
Die Lage direkt am Meer ist wunderschön und auch Porto ist von hier aus gut zu erreichen. Für Ausflüge in die Umgebung können wir außerdem Braga und Guimarães sehr empfehlen – beide Städte sind sehenswert.
Insgesamt hatten wir eine sehr schöne Zeit. Vielen Dank an Adriano für die herzliche Gastfreundschaft!
We enjoyed our stay here. Great communication with host. Apartment was clean and comfortable.

We hebben een fijn verblijf gehad, de accommodatie was een fijn huisje om naar toe te komen na een drukke dag wandelen en rondracen in Porto.

Wel jammer dat er zoveel bouwactiviteiten in de buurt waren waardoor we vroeg wakker waren en niet lekker rustig op het balkon konden zitten.
Hugo a été très attentionné, a pris le temps de se déplacer pour nous recevoir. Il a été très disponible pour répondre à nos questions. Il communique très bien en anglais. Nous le recommandons.
Clean, bright space with super unique front entrance. Only downside we didnt expect; no soap, shampoo in the home.. perhaps something completely normal here but not what we are used to in an Airbnb

Sehr gemütliche und schöne Wohnung! Wir haben uns direkt wohlgefühlt und konnten sehr gut schlafen. Die Gastgeberin war außerdem mega nett, freundlich und hilfsbereit. Wir haben unseren Aufenthalt sehr genossen und würden die Unterkunft jederzeit weiterempfehlen! :)

Cool tiny “house”/apartment. We loved the design. Helpful check-in until 9 pm. 
Comfy beds. Definitely need people comfortable climbing into the lofts. 
It is a tiny space so for 4 of us for one night it was great. 
Great dinner at Paladir down the street and breakfast pastries and coffee across the street.
Tout était très bien. Seule recommandation peut-être donner les instructions sur la fonctionnement de la climatisation

Wir wurden sehr freundlich in Empfang genommen und unsere Vermieterin war für uns immer ansprechbar. Die Wohnung ist chic, sehr gepflegt und die Lage perfekt, wenn man mit der Metro unterwegs sein möchte. Wir haben uns rundum wohl gefühlt und haben unsere Zeit in Portugal 🇵🇹 genossen. Vielen lieben Dank nochmals an Adriana und Francisca .
Die Wohnung ist wie auf den Bildern und wir haben uns wie zu Hause gefühlt :) José ist ein toller Host und immer erreichbar und sehr hilfsbereit.
The room is quite small but it was clean and tidy. The location is perfect, it’s close to the city center and all main attractions. I recommend

Charles is an amazing host.

The apartment is absolutely stunning and we were floored when we entered.
Charles was more than accommodating (thank you!) And we will definitely be back.

Me and my wife had a wonderful stay at this accommodation, perfect location to walk to all the attractions in Porto, clear instructions for check in / check out, constant communication / check ins from the agents to make sure we were ok and if we needed any assistance. The apartment had everything we needed, it was very clean - spotless. There were plenty of good restaurants/cafes nearby, Bolhao Market is just 1 minute walk away, and we had great ice cream virtually every day from Niva Gelato below. 
I would highly recommend a stay at this accommodation!
We really enjoyed our stay. It’s a great location. Very clean and modern. Loved the art.
We hebben een heerlijk verblijf gehad. Alles was top geregeld. Zeker een aanrader als je naar Porto gaat. Dichtbij het centrum maar toch op een plek waar het rustig is.

Prime location and looks like the pictures. The building itself is misleading but the apartment is beautiful and good quality. Felt very safe, very spacious for a big family and everyone’s comfortable with their own bathrooms. Mattresses also comfortable!

We hebben een hele fijne tijd gehad hier. We verbleven er 1,5 week en hadden dan ook alle tijd om de omgeving te verkennen. Het huis ligt op een rustige plek wat een fijne uitvalsbasis voor ons was om verschillende steden, maar ook het strand en de natuur op te zoeken. We werden hartelijk ontvangen door de host en die stond ook altijd voor ons klaar. Het huis is fijn, ruim en we genoten vooral van de prachtige tuin met fruitbomen en druivenstruiken. Een zekere aanrader!
Departamento muy cómodo, lo mejor su ubicación, el plus del café y aceite y aderezos para ensaladas. Todo perfecto

Mario was so helpful and his instructions are very easy to follow. The apartment was cozy with a beautiful little balcony. We walked everywhere and there was always something new to do just a 10 minute walk away. Would definitely come back and suggest to all my friends visiting Porto!
It was really nice place , with great location, only 5 minutes to metro.

Herzliches Willkommen und Gewährung eines Früh-Check-in. Nettes Häuschen , gut aufgeteilt, schöne Lage. Sogar Badetücher vorhanden!
Etwas mehr Besteck wäre vorteilhaft.
Ein rundum schöner Aufenthalt.
숙소 위치는 주변 관광지 다니기에 최고로 좋았지만 1주일 머무는데 화장실 휴지가 여분없이 1개만 있어서 사용하기에 힘들었으며 숙소 건물이 공사 중이라 오후 6시까지 매우 시끄러웠어요.
Adoramos ficar hospedado neste imóvel! Tudo limpo, bonito e organizado.
Terrasse mit traumhaften Sonnenuntergängen, die Wohnung ist gut ausgestattet, wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt.

Schönes aber kleines Zimmer. Beatriz ist sehr nett und antwortet super schnell auf Nachrichten ☺️

Séjour parfait. L’appartement est bien situé et à distance de marche de plusieurs sites. Le métro est tout juste à coté. Mer ci à Fernando pour toutes les petites attentions présentes lors de notre arrivée. Vraiment super et j’y retournerais sans hésiter.

Muy fácil de llegar, hermoso y bien distribuidor con todas las comodidades que uno necesita en viaje de turismo. El parqueadero privado es muy cómodo y amplio que no es fácil de encontrar en Oporto

We had a lovely time at Luisa’s place. It is beautiful and spacious. The neighbourhood was quiet during our stay. The bed was a more firm mattress than we are used to but still comfortable. Luisa was a wonderful host, very friendly and accommodating! We will definitely rebook this place when we return to Porto.

Alice est une personne très gentille et arrangeante !
Le logement est parfait et dispose de tous les équipements nécessaires !
Je recommande sans hésiter !

We absolutely loved this apartment—in fact, it was our second time staying here. It’s beautiful, comfortable, thoughtfully designed, and had everything we could have wanted (washer/dryer, iron, smart TV, fridge, espresso maker, etc.) 
The location was also incredibly convenient, and the hosts were as wonderful as our first stay.
The only thing we would mention for future guests is that the building is located down a fairly secluded alley, and we felt a little uncomfortable entering and exiting the building, particularly at night. There were often people congregating in the alley, and on a few occasions we didn’t feel entirely safe walking through alone. This didn’t take away from how much we enjoyed the apartment, but it’s something we think solo travelers or women traveling together may want to be aware of.
With that caveat, we had a fantastic stay and would happily recommend the apartment/stay there again!
Wonderful location and nice view from our balcony. Comfortable accommodations.
이런 곳 있다면 언제든 에어비앤비만 이용하겠어요 위치도 훌륭하고 넓고 쾌적하고 에어컨에 모든게 완벽했어요 답변도 신속 정확했어요 감사합니다
Hosts were very responsive, and the apartment was lovely- easy access into Porto.
Rien à dire ! Tout était parfait !
Excellent logement. Tout était parfait. Emplacement calme et les recommandations de l’hôte était pertinentes. Je recommande.

Die Zeit in Porto habe ich unter anderem auch auf Grund des Airbnbs in vollen Zügen genossen. Ich war für einen Monat dort und habe unter anderem von dort gearbeitet. Dafür ist das Airbnb ideal. Das eingerichtete Arbeitszimmer haben wir sehr gut genutzt, aber auch vom Esstisch oder den Patios konnte man gut arbeiten. Manchmal war das Internet / WLAN nicht ganz stabil. 
Ein absolutes Highlight ist die komplette Einrichtung und die Oberlichter im Badezimmer. Man sieht die Liebe zum Detail in der Einrichtung. 
Der Check in war problemlos und wir konnten bis zum Zeitpunkt unsere Koffer im Office unterbringen. Bei Fragen oder auch Problemen (kurzfristiger Stromausfall) war das Team von The Majord Home immer erreichbar. Ebenso wurde die Wohnung einmal die Woche gereinigt. Auch die Absprachen liefen immer gut! 
Die Umgebung des Airbnbs ist im absoluten Umbruch. Viele große Baustellen sind errichtet, die man aber bei geschlossenen Fenstern kaum mitbekommt. Rund um ein tolles Airbnb! DANKE!

I cannot say enough good things about this place! Luisa is so sweet, greeted me, gave lots of recommendations and responded immediately. This apartment is perfectly situated and walkable to everything. The bed was super comfortable and surprisingly quiet for being in the heart of the old town. Everything was spotless and perfect amount of space for me. Thank you Luisa, it was such a pleasure meeting you and thanks for the warm and sincere hospitality!
몇가지 문제가 있었지만 호스트는 이에 대해 설명하고 해결을 위해 노력해주었습니다. 위치가 훌륭합니다.

We had such a wonderful stay at Teresa’s abode. Centrally located and within walking distance to anywhere you want to go! Despite being in the center of everything, it was very quiet. Teresa had all of the amenities and the building was very beautiful. Teresa was exceptionally friendly and helpful and her chocolate cake was absolutely decadent! 💗

Local limpo, agradável e conforme o anúncio. Porém, o check-in foi extremamente complicado. Não estava claro qual era o apartamento em que deveríamos ficar. Todas as mensagens do chat são automáticas geradas por IA. Um outro casal estava com o mesmo problema.

We are so glad we booked Jorge’s place. It was easy to get to off the highway. His place is in a quiet neighbourhood- there was some construction on the road happening while we were there - with enough restaurants nearby. Check-in was fantastic. Jorge was on site for check-in and had so many treats and beverages for us. It was very thoughtful of him to take the time to put it together for us. There are always treats and beverages available in the main entrance area too, so no shortage of cookies. Jorge spent time going through the attractions to see in Porto and giving us lots of tips about getting around without having to endure yet another hill. The apartment was as described and it was very comfortable. The space is well stocked and we didn’t find anything missing. At night the location is quiet for sleeping and the bed was comfortable. The bathrooms are a bit small with not much space for your stuff but we managed. Jorge’s place is lovely and he is a great host.
Très beau logement avec ses hauts plafonds. Même si la rue est passante, on n'entend rien la nuit. Le lit est confortable. Tout le nécessaire pour cuisiner est là. On recommande à 100%
Nous avons passé un très bon sejour dans l'appartement d'Henrique. Tout est accessible à pieds avec de nombreux bars et restaurants à proximité. Je recommande pour n'importe quel séjour à Porto

Overall we had a nice stay here. Metrostation is immediately outside, which is awesome for transportation but also a bit loud. We chose this apartment for the location, and that was definitely great. 
Not necessarily an apartment for cosy nights in (bright lights and uncomfortable couch), but if you're planning on going out much, it might be a great choice for you. The apartment was nice and clean when we arrived and the instructions were clear. Bed was okay, basic utensils and bath towels were there. But some essential stuff like kitchen towels, cutting boards or sink stopper were missing. 
We had some issues with the washing mashine and shower head, but when you contact the organisation, they respond very fast and make sure it gets fixed (enough) very fast. Communication with them was great, technician was a very nice guy. 
Overall it was nice and we were content with our choice, mainly because it was heaps cheaper and the location was great for us. A great budget-friendly option!
Die Wohnung von Charles hat uns super gefallen. Vor allem die Lage war perfekt um Porto zu erkunden und die Aussicht vom Balkon war schön.

good apartment to visit Porto for a few days.
Location is great
Isabel was easy to communicate with
Everything went well

We enjoyed our stay, communication was efficient and clear. The location was great, the room was clean and comfortable and the noise mentioned in other reviews didn’t bother us. The only thing I would say is that the room doesn’t have AC and the fans in the property are pretty useless. This would be fine if the room wasn’t on the ground floor, looking directly onto the street. Unfortunately, it does not feel safe to open the windows unless you are awake and in the room. We got quite hot in the night as a result of this.
Really lovely place! Great public transport system near by, lovely balcony, clean apartment. Would recommend to anyone :)

This location was wonderful, just above the Sao Bento train station and Time Out Market, and steps away from the Se cathedral and 2 blocks or so from the top part of the iconic bridge. There was also a good coffee shop practically across the street. The property feels like luxurious and very large for 1 person. The owner/manager was very responsive.

Ce logement bien équipé et tout à fait moderne est idéalement situé pour rejoindre à pied les points d'intérêt de la ville. Bien qu'il soit situé près de sites très fréquentés en soirée, l'appartement est tout à fait tranquille. Un très bon choix pour visiter Porto.

Any queries were answered very quickly and when we asked for some extra shower/ bath gel and pillows ,it was no trouble .
Accommodation spotless and very quiet and comfortable,would highly recommend .

A lovely place to stay, with everything as described and a smooth, straightforward experience from start to finish. The room was comfortable, and the host was friendly and helpful — I’d happily stay again.

Ich habe mich in der Unterkunft wirklich sehr wohlgefühlt. Besonders positiv fand ich die Kommunikation, selten habe ich auf Airbnb jemanden erlebt, der so schnell und unkompliziert antwortet. 😊
Die Unterkunft war genauso, wie ich sie mir vorgestellt habe: sehr sauber und ordentlich, und das Bett war super bequem. Insgesamt hat einfach alles gepasst und ich war rundum zufrieden mit meinem Aufenthalt.
Ich würde jederzeit wiederkommen und kann die Unterkunft absolut weiterempfehlen!

Wir waren schon öfters in Porto und uns hat diese Unterkunft auch sehr gefallen. Es war eine top Lage und man konnte alles sehr schnell erreichen!

We had a pleasant stay at this property. As others have noted it is located in a very busy corner close to all amenities. There is live music daily in the evening and street noise that is audible. If you like a quiet stay this is not for you. If you like to be in the action, it’s great. The unit is very small. Cooking would be difficult. As the building is very old the stairs leading up to the rooms are slanted backwards and the floors in the unit were also sloped. If you like old building charm this has it! There is a water cooler in the building which is awesome after walking around in the heat all day.

Appartement grand pour 3 personnes juste en face de la gare Sao bento. Cela nous a permis de faire tous le centre de porto tranquillement. A quelques minutes à pied de la cathédrale, du pont Dom Luis et de la place de liberté. Nombreux petits restaurants tout autour. Pour nous qui sommes venus avec le train c'était parfait. Logement propre, Bon échange avec Gloria. Je recommande.

All was wonderful, however I was not aware that the 2 andar was the 3rd floor with no elevator myself and my husband had a bit of hard time going up and down. 
All else was wonderful. Best host ever. 
Thank you for all the information you provided of Porto. Very well decorated. 
 I recommend highly.

We only stayed for two but felt right at home in this beautiful and spacious apartment! Easy to reach, good breakfast and lunch/dinner options right around the corner and very friendly and helpful hosts. Definitely a recommendation!
Great location, clean space. Would recommend.

A lakás nagyon szép volt, minden tökéletes. Azonban sok hangya volt a lakásban (nyilván erről közvetlen nem tehet a szállásadó), illetve a kicheckolás instrukciói nem voltak 100%-ban világosak. Ezeket leszámítva ideális szállás és csak ajánlani tudom!

The place had an absolutely perfect location to access all of Porto. It was clean and comfortable. Much like Porto, the apartment is very old which is part of what makes it wonderful but with age comes some issues at times. The air conditioner had some issues in one bedroom and the elevator was broken for a day. These were minor issues and no fault of the owners. They communicated very well and kept us informed. Overall, it was a great place.

Monolocale molto attrezzato e ben arredato di generose dimensioni. Kit di benvenuto con tisane caffè e snack ma solo per il giorno di arrivo. Posizione buona ma non centralissima. Unica pecca pavimenti non impeccabili, check in solo dalle 16 e nessuna elasticità nel deposito bagagli, con extra soggetti a pagamento eccessivo.
In generale appartamento bello , comodo e buona comunicazione con l' host. Apprezzato
Appartement très bien placé, en plein centre de Porto. Attention accès via une rue très pentue. Dommage que la fenêtre ne puisse pas être ouverte. Sinon très bon Airbnb.

ОТличная квартира с прекрасным расположением. можно далеко не ходить от дома, все в пешей доступности. высокие потолки, удобная кровать, шикарный балкон. единственный момент что квартира является смежной и разделена только стенкой и большой дверью. на площадке 4 квартиры еще. слышимость хорошая, нам попались не шумные соседи, но для кого-то это может стать проблемой если будут шуметь.
The apartment is in a great location, close to a lot of restaurant and walkable to the centre of town. It was very nicely presented.
Gute Lage nah am Strand und Strandcafés, nur der Blick in den Innenhof der Wohnblöcke ist weniger schön.

Logement fidèle aux photos mises en ligne sur le site, belle déco, emplacement idéal pour les visites et les restaurants. Le logement allie le charme de l’ancien avec une rénovation contemporaine de qualité, seul bémol la vue de l’appartement qui donne sur une cour triste et grise, néanmoins cela n’entache pas les prestations de l’appartement.
Todo muy bien

Excelente experiência! 
O espaço estava impecável e exatamente como nas fotografias. A Priscila foi muito simpática e prestável. Recomendo sem dúvida!

The place is exactly as pictured and the location is fantastic. We highly recommend this place and would definitely stay here again!

Gorgeous space, super clean and tidy and spacious, with all amenities you can imagine or may need. The location is great, a bit crowded and in the middle of shops and restaurants but once you are inside, it’s peaceful. Other neighbors are pretty quiet.
Wonderful place! Great location and tons of restaurants around!!!
