I had the best stay at these two! The room was as described and Seba and Gise were super nice, welcoming hosts.

Check-in und out problemlos. Tolle Lage im Zentrum mit Einkaufsmöglichkeit. Schöne moderne Einrichtung. Isolierte Fenster, dadurch ruhige Nächte. Bäder sehr sauber. Große Dachterrasse. Sehr gute, neue Matratzen! Die Teller (luxury!?) sollten erneuert werden; sind alt und zerkratzt. Ein Handlauf an der Treppe (vielleicht eine Kordel zum Festhalten) sollte aus Sicherheitsgründen montiert werden. Leider war der Terrassentisch von den Vormietern noch verschmutzt.

A beautiful spacious apartment in a great part of Porto. A largely residential neighbourhood but only a 10 walk to the edge of the city centre. Relatively hot outside during our stay but the AC worked perfectly and the big wooden shutters blocked out much of the street noise. Communications excellent throughout and it was very helpful to leave the cases downstairs a few hours after checkout.
Good place to stay and very convenient
The place is within the downtown area. It is very near to the significant tourist spots and just a minute walk to the Douro river.
Nice terrace
Muy buena ubicación cerca de muchos restaurantes y de una parada de autobús. Todo fue como estaba en la descripción. Limpio y agradable

Great location as this is right in the centre of the town. Most places are within 15mins walking distance. The flat is tastefully decorated and everything was as described. The hosts were very responsive and always able to answer any questions. As it is quite a touristy area though, the streets get a bit noisy during the day but very quiet at night so never had any problems with sleep.
Marta is an exceptional host, even meeting us at the property with only 15 minutes notice. Her apartment is a unique throwback to the sixties. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

사진에서 본 것보다 훨씬 넓고 훌륭한 집에서 정말 편안하게 머물다 갑니다. 마치 오래된 귀족 저택에 머무는 듯한 특별한 기분을 느낄 수 있었습니다.
체크인과 체크아웃은 모두 비대면으로 진행되지만 안내가 매우 명확해서 전혀 어렵지 않았습니다. 오히려 늦은 시간에 도착하더라도 부담 없이 내 집처럼 편안하게 들어갈 수 있다는 점이 좋았습니다. 호스트 역시 지금까지 만난 어떤 호스트보다도 빠르고 친절하게 소통해주셔서, 머무는 내내 편안하고 든든했습니다.
위치는 더할 나위 없이 좋습니다. 관광하기에 최적의 위치로, 강변과 성당 모두 부담 없이 걸어서 오갈 수 있습니다. 집의 분위기와 공간, 위치, 호스트의 응대까지 모두 만족스러운 숙소였습니다.

A new apartment just a one-minute walk from the ocean! Spotlessly clean! The apartment looks even better than in the photos! The management company is very attentive and cares about its guests—the stay was perfectly organized!
Einfache Kommunikation, netter persönlicher Empfang und ein sehr saubere Unterkunft!

Wir hatte einen tollen Aufenthalt in der Unterkunft. Der Pool ist ein Highlight, gerade für die Lage. Einzig das Badezimmer hatte ein paar Stellen an denen Haare an der wand übersehen wurden, das ist aber nicht so schlimm. Die Klimaanlage kann nachts etwas lauter sein. Alles in allem aber kein Grund hier groß Kritik zu üben. Wir empfehlen es weiter hier einzukehren. Die Gegend ist hervorragend um etwas in Porto zu erleben.
Todo perfecto muy agusto

El departamento es tal cual se ve en las fotos y tiene una vista increíble al río, que realmente se disfruta durante todo el día. La cocina está muy completa y cuenta con todo lo necesario. La ducha tiene excelente presión de agua, algo que se agradece mucho. El anfitrión responde rápidamente y la comunicación fue muy buena. Además, hay posibilidad de estacionar en la calle, lo que resulta práctico si se viaja en auto.
Como aspectos a mejorar, al llegar había un leve olor a cigarrillo dentro del departamento. Además, para una estadía corta puede resultar poco práctico por su ubicación, ya que está algo alejado de los principales centros turísticos y requiere más tiempo de traslado.
En general, tuvimos una buena estadía y la vista es sin duda uno de los puntos destacados del departamento.

A quirky and unique stay in Póvoa! If you're looking for something a little different, staying on Miguel's houseboat is a fun experience. It's located in a peaceful spot on the marina, alongside other boats, yet still within easy walking distance of restaurants and the town. It's also right on the Camino Portuguese Coastal route, so it's well worth considering if you're struggling to find accommodation nearby.
As you'd expect, it is a boat, so it does rock a little, which adds to the experience! The bed was comfortable, and we were pleasantly surprised by the size of the shower.
Miguel was very responsive throughout our stay, and the check-in instructions were excellent, with photos provided to make the unusual arrival process straightforward.
There were a few signs of wear and tear, but Miguel acknowledged these and advised that repairs were planned soon. Overall, a memorable and enjoyable stay that offered something completely different from the usual accommodation options.
Lovely stay! Great location, very central and easy to get around!

We stayed for 8 nights and found it a great space to relax in. Very clean and everything was as decribed. Very responsive hosts. Location was good, close to metro station, and about a 20 min walk (downhill) to get to the river. Showers were great, always a gamble when staying somewhere new! A Couple of points for the owners, the kitchen could do with a few more things like baking trays and a toaster. And be careful in the courtyard shutting the door as the lock must have dropped and we almost got locked out and there wouldnt have been an easy way to get out. Outside space was fine although as expected little way in the sense of a view, feel like more could be made of the upper space outside of the bedroom for a more pleasant outlook. All up though would recommend to anyone who wanted a quiet private space that was comfortable and good value for money.
It's a good place. You can walk everywhere from there and there's a ton of restaurants near by. The only problem we had was the noise from upstairs residents.

The room was nice, good location. My grandma enjoyed her stay. There was not much problems, just with the door at the arrival time. But Lucas (the host) helped. He always replied when needed and he was very nice. Over all the stay was lovely. I enjoyed the city. I recommend
Joana’s space is in a very convenient location. The space is very basic in terms of accommodation but very clean and has a comfy bed - great for a quick stop in Porto.
Localização muito boa e casa muito boa pelo preço que foi pago. A única observação é que é bem aproveitada para 6 pessoas porque possuí 3 camas de casal.

Ab 22 Uhr hört die Musik auf und das Stimmengemurmel ist bei geschlossenen Fenstern leise. Einzig blöd war, dass um 1 Uhr nachts die Straße mit einem Hochdruckreiniger gereinigt wurde und das Haus sehr laut und hellhörig ist, insbesondere die Eingangstür.
Dennoch absolut tolle Unterkunft mitten im Zentrum mit kurzen Wegen überall hin und die Metro ist auch in der Nähe. Ich werde definitiv wiederkommen :)
Wir haben die Zeit in Porto und in der Wohnung sehr genossen! Alles war perfekt!
Alles war sehr schön, super und ordentlich. Gerne wieder!

Very nice loft, pictures and description are accurate. Note there’s no AC (as per ad) and we happened to be there during a heat wave so sleeping was difficult. It’s also in the middle of the city so when you open the windows, it’s quite noisy. The only bathroom is downstairs which can be challenging if late night or limited mobility.

Amazing Airbnb and the host was very communicative. The bedrooms had AC units and the balcony was a vibe. Its really close to the beach and casino too which was great. Very quiet building and the bedrooms have blackout curtains so we got the best sleep ever. Would definitely book again.

The location is amazing and easy to access. The place itself is beautiful and has everything you might need for a comfortable stay.
The cleanliness was excellent! Even the quality of the towels, bedding, and other small details was impressive.
Isabel is lovely, very responsive, and quick to reply.
This place will definitely make your visit to Porto even more special. Highly recommended!
We had a wonderful stay, Fernando was a perfect host

Porto, que experiência linda! 💙
Meu agradecimento por esses dias tão especiais, pela acolhida, pelos momentos vividos e por cada detalhe que tornou essa estadia tão agradável. Foi maravilhoso conhecer, sentir e guardar um pouquinho dessa cidade tão encantadora.
Levo comigo boas lembranças, muitos sorrisos e a certeza de que o Porto deixou uma marca especial na minha memória. ✨

Appartamento perfetto come la descrizione, posizione ottima, tutto pulito.

Auch die hochwertige Ausstattung der Unterkunft hat uns begeistert. Alles ist geschmackvoll eingerichtet, sehr gepflegt und von bester Qualität. Man merkt in jedem Detail, wie viel Wert auf Komfort und Wohlfühlatmosphäre gelegt wird.

Sehr sehr saubere Unterkunft. Das Zimmer war sehr geräumig und alles war, wie angegeben. Wir konnten flexibel ein- und auschecken. Die Kommunikation war sehr einfach und alle sehr freundlich.

Insgesamt ist die Unterkunft sehr zu empfehlen.

This is a space thoughtfully designed by artists. It was just as described and the location is in a very special area of Porto surrounded by so much beauty. The hosts were responsive and helpful. The art on the walls all around the building were unique and inspirational. This Airbnb is full of heart and charm. I’m very glad to have been able to stay here during my time in Porto.

Bel emplacement , secteur tranquille mais proche de tout à la marche.

Was mir nicht gefallen hat war das Badezimmer. Der Klodeckel verliert bereits die Beschichtung, es ist Schimmel auf den oberen Fugen der Duschfliesen und das WC ist locker und hebt sich vom Boden ab wenn man nicht exakt in der Mitte sitzt. Hier muss unbedingt nachgebessert werden. Ansonsten kann ich die Wohnung für einen Kurztrip empfehlen.
Logement très bien situé à proximité de Porto. Le logement est dans un endroit calme et Aurora est très gentille et réactive :)

El alojamiento es aceptable por el precio. Tiene algunos detalles malos, pero la verdad que por el precio está bien.

Si eres una persona que no tiene el sueño pesado o le cuesta dormir con ruidos grandes, no te lo recomiendo, porque a nosotros nos tocaron persona que no paraban de caminar hasta las 2am.
The appartment was perfect and Luís was very helpful and available !

Sehr schöne gemütliche kleine Wohnung, für zwei Personen total ausreichend. Wir waren 2 Nächte und es hat alles super geklappt. Der einzige Nachteil: es war wirklich sehr heiß in der Wohnung. Es sind zwar zwei große Ventilatoren verfügbar, die es definitiv nachts aushaltbar gemacht haben, aber das sollte man wissen. In ca. 20 Minuten fußläufig waren wir im Zentrum. Sonst alles in allem super.

To-do super agradable y una casa super Hermosa y limpia. Solo su ubicacion le drsfavorece pero si logras identificar sistema de Uber o carro particular super bien to-do.

Wir wären sehr gerne noch länger geblieben!
Det er et fantastisk om at leve i. Tæt på alting og også metro tæt hvis du skulle have brug for en tur til stranden.

It was a pleasure to be there, in this beautiful flat. The ocean was so close, so It couldn't be better for me, alsi Itay was so kind and helpful.

Chloe was a very gracious and accommodating host. The apartment was clean and free of clutter. It is on a side street and didn't have a lot of noise aside from the occasional late nighters walking by.

This location is very walkable and close to many of the attractions we wanted to see. We would highly recommend it.

One of the best Airbnb’s I’ve ever stayed at! Perfect location, extremely central but quiet. All of the little details in the Airbnb were thought of. Super luxurious and comfortable, down to the bedding and thermostat. Would definitely stay here again.

We genuinely couldn't have had a better stay. This may well be the perfect Air BnB. Beautifullt decorated and incredibly thoughtful hosts. We especially loved the air conditioning unit and bathroom aesthetic. Notably, from our point of view, this is the best neighbourhood in all of Porto with amazing local establishments on your doorstep.

Wir würden jederzeit wiederkommen und können die Unterkunft absolut weiterempfehlen! 😊
Loved the place and location. Communication with the host perfect. Responsive and kind. Comfy bed, great decor. Central location, however you get peace a quiet, because you are on the top floor.

We loved the location of this place! It was an easy walk down to Ribeira, to the market and other key landmarks. 
After walking and exploring the city, coming back to a quiet accommodation where we could unwind on a unique outdoor terrace was fabulous! 
The place itself was quite comfortable and provided all the amenities we needed. It was cozy and welcoming. I travelled with my parents so I slept in the kid’s room, which was fine. Wouldn’t be suitable for 4 adults as the top bunk may not be ideal. But for us, it worked out great!

The host was super friendly, and the place was really clean. The kitchen was fully equipped with everything you might need for your stay. The location is also very convenient, with public transportation nearby and plenty of supermarkets within walking distance. Overall, a very comfortable and pleasant stay!
Très bon séjour

We had a wonderful stay at Maria’s place in Porto! The location was great - on a busy pedestrian street, but the apartment was very quiet. Everything was very clean. And we appreciated the coffee machine! Maria’s communication and recommendations were great. Would definitely stay here again!

We had a wonderful stay at this apartment in Porto! The apartment is in a great location, with a supermarket nearby and everything we needed within easy reach. It was very clean, comfortable, and well equipped with all the amenities you could wish for during a stay.

The apartment is hugely spacious and well thought out with everything you could need. A nice touch was some chilled water and coffee machine with pods. We would just say that this is very much a city centre apartment so you have to expect quite a lot of noise. Nous avons passé un excellent séjour dans un très charmant appartement très proche de la plage où vous pourrez voir le magnifique coucher de soleil et de toutes commodités, commerces, bus pour aller au centre ville de Porto pour toutes les visites. Je vous conseille de prendre la carte de bus.
Logement idéalement situé, bien équipé et tout commerce à proximité. Émilie à su répondre à presque toutes mes interrogations malgré la barrière de la langue. 8 jours sur place c'était super.
Vše proběhlo v pořádku, ubytování bylo velmi čisté. Velká výhoda byla terasa s pěkným výhledem a parkovací místo na pozemku.
Excelente estadia!

Unser Aufenthalt war sehr gut. Wir haben nichts vermisst. Kontakt mit der Inhaberin war immer einwandfrei und man hatte auch zu 100% Privatsphäre.
Ein paar Kleinigkeiten zur Verbesserung: 
Die Lampen könnten noch ein wärmeres Licht haben, im oberen Bad waren ein paar Haare zu finden und in der Waschmittelschublade der Waschmaschine war ein wenig Schimmel, wir haben aber Pods benutzt, weshalb das nichts ausgemacht hat.

The space itself is lovely, thoughtfully designed, clean, and matches the description. Instructions for check in and check out are simple and helpful. Diogo is a great host — kind, extremely responsive, and communication was clear and easy. There were great local recommendations provided, which we very much appreciated. The neighbourhood itself is quiet and central, and you can easily walk to a shops and the metro. However, some things to note: there is very extensive construction happening right next door during the day. This is fine if you plan to spend most of your time exploring the city, however we were impacted by the noise as we had to spend some days indoors because we were unwell. Secondly, the floors carry sound. We unfortunately had noisy guests in the apartment upstairs whose loud footfall kept us up until past 3am, but from what I understand from the host, this is an anomaly. Overall, I’d recommend this stay for the space, neighbourhood, and wonderful hosts.
Beyond the clean, well-equipped apartment, Miguel was an exceptional host with great local tips for exploring Porto.

Appartement très propre, joli . Facile d accès en venant de l aéroport. Très bonne communication avec Riu qui est fort agréable. Le book sur Porto est très bien fait. J ai découvert la Vallée du Douro et Aveiro.

Rosa place was clean and fully stocked with everything we needed. From the kitchen utensils to towels. Location is great close to the metro and everything you need to close by. Highly recommended and will definitely stay here again.

O apartamento é simplesmente fantástico. Quartos grandes e confortáveis. Possui janelas que abafam o som externo e persianas contra o sol. Está localizado próximos da estação de trem e de td o cento comercial de Porto. A sala de estar comporta uma família grande com mto conforto. E os banheiros tem chuveiros deliciosos.

Uma experiência fantástica! A anfitriã é de uma simpatia e amabilidade incríveis, sempre preocupada com o nosso bem-estar e conforto. A casa, além de linda é muito bem decorada e estava super limpa. Para melhorar tudo, ainda fomos recebidos com uns miminhos muito simpáticos para comer.
O espaço estava limpo, tinha café e cafeteira, próximo do shopping e do metro que nos leva ao centro da cidade. Nuno é bem solícito e atencioso.

Simplesmente maravilhoso. Muito simpática e hospitaleira. Me recebeu muito bem.
Obrigado

Super Lage, gut zu erreichen und ruhig. Restaurants und Zentrum in der Nähe. Alles vorhanden, was man gebrauchen könnte. Voll ausgestattete Küche, modernes Bad. 
Ich fand die Webseite vom Online-Check-in etwas verwirrend und benötigte mehrere Anläufe. Sonst alles top. Würde ich wieder buchen.
El alojamiento está muy bien. Bien equipado en todos los aspectos. La ubicación está bien, porque está cerca del centro y es una zona muy tranquila. Lo recomiendo cien por cien.
Host very responsive, location wise- walkable to metro stations and very accessible from the airport and city centre
Really enjoyed the stay. The house was very well equipped with a beautiful and well maintained garden. Great hosts too. 10/10

Apartamento excelente! Tudo muito novo, bem cuidado e muito bem equipado. A Rafaela foi sempre muito atenciosa, comunicativa e respondeu rapidamente sempre que precisamos. Recomendo muito o apartamento para quem busca uma ótima estadia no Porto!

Miguel's place is super cosy and clean. The location is central and close to the plenty of tourist attractions and to the public transportation. Miguel was tremendously helpful and gave us numerous detailed info concerning travelling in Porto. Tnank you so much Miguel! Highly recommended!

Nuno’s place was exactly as shown in the photos. The location was fantastic, making it quick and easy to reach downtown and the city center. There are also plenty of shopping malls nearby, so we could easily get anything we needed right away. 
And also Nuno was incredibly friendly, kind, and always available whenever we needed anything. He went above and beyond to make sure we felt completely comfortable throughout our stay. If I ever visit Porto again, I would definitely stay at Nuno’s place. Thank you so much, Nuno!
Very convenient location and great hosts!

Wir haben uns hier sehr wohl gefühlt, es ist alles sehr sauber und geschmackvoll eingerichtet, die Lage zum erkunden der Stadt ist hervorragend. Die Kommunikation war sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Ich wusste immer dass ich nachfragen könnte...Klar, die Lautstärke ist da, Ohropax werden bereitgestellt und aufgrund der tollen Lage, gehört es einfach dazu. Danke, wir würden auf jeden Fall wiederkommen.
Lovely clean apartment. Close to everything, but not among all the tourists. Great host.

Absolutely would recommend this place for a solo traveler or couple. It offered plenty of space and places to sit in the apartment. Great location, close to the metro, restaurants, and sites to see. Space was very clean as well. Enjoyed our stay!
The apartment was ok, worth the price. No stuff like coffee at the kitchen, or shampoo at the bathroom, but the basics are there. Anything I've been asking I've been responded immediately.

Nous avons passé une seule nuit dans ce logement, mais tout s’est très bien passé. Le lieu est calme, agréable et bien équipé, avec une piscine et une buanderie, ce qui est vraiment appréciable.
Même si l’arrivée est autonome, nous avons eu le plaisir de croiser l’hôte à notre arrivée. Il nous a très bien accueillis et c’était vraiment agréable de pouvoir échanger avec lui. Il a pris le temps de nous expliquer où se trouvaient la buanderie et les différents équipements du logement.
Nous avons également eu un petit souci avec la climatisation, mais l’hôte s’est montré très réactif et a rapidement répondu à notre message. Ce n’était vraiment pas grand-chose et cela n’a pas gêné notre séjour.
Merci pour l’accueil, nous recommandons ce logement avec plaisir 😊

We had originally booked the larger suite, and the host informed us upon arriving that it was having plumbing issues and we’d need to stay in a room. It was spacious and a nice space, but we do wish we had been informed prior to arrival. Still, our host was friendly and quick to respond, and offered us a partial refund for the change.
Everything was great
As advertised, clean, great area, responsive host!

Wir waren zum ersten Mal in Porto und hatten mit dieser Wohnung wirklich einen perfekten Aufenthalt. Die Wohnung liegt in einer tollen Gegend, und der Strand ist in nur ca. 4 Minuten zu Fuß erreichbar.
Kinga hat auf unsere Fragen sofort reagiert und uns jederzeit mit hilfreichen Tipps unterstützt. Wir haben uns sehr wohlgefühlt und kommen definitiv wieder!
Vielen lieben Dank, Kinga! ❤️
It was nice, very clean and comfortable apartment. It was near seaside with continent shops around. Petrol was very helpful and responsive. We had a great time although it was a short stay.
Impressively renovated apartment - great price/quality ratio. Would be a great place for longer stays, if I’m ever back. Recommend

Fue un placer hospedarnos en la casa de Elisa. Bien comunicado con Porto, mucha tranquilidad y unos atardeceres muy bonitos desde la terraza de la casa.
Elisa estuvo muy pendiente. Recomiendo!
Super zentrale und schöne Wohnung, perfekt für einen Städtetrip nach Porto. Leider war es ein wenig dreckig und es lagen Haare rum, ansonsten würden wir die Wohnung sehr empfehlen!
The apartment provided good walking access to historic Porto and was close to all amenities.
Excellent communication and great location. AC worked very well as it was rather warm out. Coffee was provided which was very much appreciated. Would recommend and would stay again!

We had a great stay here! Loved the location as you’re just steps away from Ribeira and the Douro River. The unit itself was very spacious and comfortable. There were a couple of issues though. First, one half of the bed’s box spring is broken, so there’s a big sag in the bed that gets very uncomfortable and is hard on the back. Second, the shower doesn’t drain properly, so you have to shut the water off every 1-2 minutes so it doesn’t overflow. Other than that, it was an awesome place.

Wir hatten einen großartigen Aufenthalt. Die Unterkunft entsprach in jeder Hinsicht unseren Bedürfnissen – die Ausstattung war vollständig und hochwertig, die Lage perfekt für unsere Unternehmungen. Mit den öffentliche Verkehrsmittel war alles problemlos und schnell zu erreichen, was unsere Planung zusätzlich erleichtert hat.
Besonders hervorheben möchten wir die freundliche und stets angenehme Kommunikation mit der Gastgeberin. Sie war aufmerksam, hilfsbereit und hat unseren Aufenthalt noch angenehmer gemacht.
Wir können die Unterkunft uneingeschränkt weiterempfehlen.
Hôte très accueillante mais chambre assez coûteuse pour ce que c'est
Estuvimos muy cómodos. El barrio es muy agradable y está cerca de muchas atracciones de Porto
Great experience, if I will ever come back to visit Porto, this will be my place of choice.
alles war super!

Im Herzen von Vila Nova de Gaia, einen Sprung (über die Brücke) von Porto entfernt, gut zu Fuss machbar. 
Es hat uns sehr gefallen.

O apartamento é espetacular.
Limpeza impecável e tem tudo que precisa para uma estádia perfeita.
O acesso é fácil e muito próximo a transportes públicos.
Com certeza voltarei.
Very functional and well located place :) happy to recommend!
Parfait
A única coisa ruim, foi a obra em frente.
Super logement très bien situé. Je recommande ! Très jolie et très classe

My friend and I had a great time in Porto while living in PortoBello. The apartment was spacious, clean and cozy. We received detailed instructions on how to arrive and didn’t have any issues. The hosts are very welcoming and prepared some local souvenirs upon our arrival. 
The only issue might have been a loud street at night, but if you close the windows you won’t hear as much noise. Totally recommend this place!

The apartment was excellent - clean, tidy and well presented. It’s in a great location where lots of places are close by, or walkable in 10-15 minutes (just be prepared for some of Porto’s hills!!). We had great meals at a couple of local spots - Cúmplice for an excellent steak, Brasão for local Freschina and Real Taberna for nice cocktails and local cuisine. 
For brunch, Do Norte Cafe and Zenth were stand outs for us. 
Definitely worth a Port tasting - we enjoyed Calem.
Great host, nice apartment in a great location. Easy walk to everything. I would return again.

The perfect place for exploring the city, everything is walkable and the balcony is a great feature. The photos don't do the view from the balcony justice!
The flat was clean and a good size for 2 people, easy to walk into the city despite Porto's significant hills! 
Would recommend and definitely stay again if we came back
Apartamento muito agradável e estava tudo muito bom!
Très beau logement, tranquille! Nous avons beaucoup apprécié notre séjour!

Logement bien situé, pas dans le côté le plus touristique, ce qui était un plus pour moi, j'y ai trouvé tous au niveau commerces et je n'étais pas loin du Pont Louis pour la vue sur le Douro et sur les anciens quartiers de la ville, super séjour, plus de 800 photos réalisées, merci à Balbina pour l'accueil.
It’s mainly ok, but I needed to check the location more accurately, because it was a bit loud around.

It was a wonderful stay. Very comfortable.
Middle of the center town. Great location! Five, ten or 15 minutes away from most of the attractions. 
Cannot say enough good things about how wonderful Pedro and Sandra were. They made checking in and out very easy. 
They were always fast to respond to what ever questions we had.

Die Lage der Wohnung ist sehr gut.
Die Wohnung selber ist sauber und gut ausgestattet.
The room and the common space was clean and aesthetic. The host was easy to communicate with and the instructions he provided were clear. We had a pleasant stay. Thank you 😊
Svært bra, akkurat som beskrevet og likt som på bildene! Fornøyd

Een geweldig verblijf in het hartje van Porto. We hebben enorm genoten van de tuin met BBQ. De woonst is stijlvol ingericht en je hebt alles wat je nodig hebt. Het straalt luxe uit. Je hebt relatief weinig last van nachtlawaai ondanks je tussen alle leuke restaurants en barretjes zit. De hosts zijn zeer vriendelijk en antwoorden snel. Ze lieten ook onze hond zeer welkom voelen. Er is goede wifi. Het huis was zeer schoon.
We raden dit verblijf enorm aan.
Departamento Nuevo, bonito, bondad, decoración, las camas cómodas muy bien ubicado

El departamento es hermoso Como se lo ve en las fotos Todo reluciento Utensillos de cocina modernos y nuevos Limpieza impecable El barrio es muy recomendable A 10 minutos de caminata de zonas turísticas Siendo seguro y tranquilo El anfitrión respondió al momento una sola duda que tuve Sin duda volvería a elegirlo

We had an excellent stay at Porto Velho Apartamentos. The apartment is very well designed, exceptionally clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully equipped with everything we needed. The location is fantastic for exploring Porto, with many of the city’s highlights, restaurants, and cafés within easy walking distance.
The apartment is even more impressive in person—stylish, spacious, and very welcoming. Communication with the host was excellent throughout, and check-in was smooth and easy.
We thoroughly enjoyed our time here and would gladly stay again on our next visit to Porto. Highly recommended!

Rui took amazing care of us for our stay in Porto. He went above in beyond to meet our needs. He was very responsive and helpful in providing suggestions for local eateries and sight-seeing. The space is in a perfect location and it had ample room to make you feel like you’re in a home away from home. I would recommend this place to anyone visiting Porto. Rui is top! One of the best hosts we’ve ever had!
We loved our stay!! The place was beautiful and so cute. It was in such a great location and within walking distance of so much. Highly recommend staying here!

Fully recommended! 
The apartment is located in the city center - walking distance to restaurants, metro / trains, the riverside and bridges. Still it is really calm and quiet - walls and windows and properly sound-proofed. Good view from the windows on rooftops when you fall asleep. Neat private balcony to have a sit at the end of eventful day or to welcome a new day.
Comfortable bed. Two clean and well equipped bathrooms. Good and structured communication with the host. 
Possibility to leave your luggage in a locker on ground floor before or after the stay for a couple of hours.
Be mindful the stairs are quite steep and narrow - with a bigger luggage it may be quite challenging for someone with limited mobility.
If we ever re-visit Porto we would definitely pick the apartment again!
The place is charming. I loved looking out the window in the living room. It was easy and fuss free.
Nuestra estancia en Oporto y en concreto en el apartamento ha sido todo perfecto. Tal como estába descrito
Amazing location and great studio!! Would stay again in a heartbeat!

Adorei o espaço mas o proprietário é uma autêntica aberração, tem uma câmara na entrada que usa para vigiar a vida dos hóspedes,mandou me mensagem a dizer que eu fumava muito e a pedir para deixar a casa limpa quando estava a usar o espaço que é fornecido para isso ou seja senti invadida a minha privacidade e da minha mulher ! Sendo que outros hóspedes usam também do mesmo edifício, no fim da estadia o proprietário mandou me mensagem a dizer para se tivesse tido algo de errado para lhe falar antes de comentar e coloquei esta situação que não acho normal ele logo mudou a versão me tratando mal dizendo que deixei tudo sujo mas o que ele não sabia é que eu tinha filmado na saída com hora do check out para me precaver! Acho vergonhoso esta atitude do proprietário!
The apartment was beautiful, the check-in was easy and it's very well located. Definitely worth the stay!

Hemos pasado dos dias en oporto muy agradables. El apartamento está a unos 20 min del ayuntamiento, y es muy como llegar allí. El parking para dejar el coche estaba enfrente del apartamento, literalmente en la misma calle. Kristina estuvo todo el rato pendientes de nostros, de cómo habíamos llegado, si necesitábamos ayuda o recomendaciones de sitios etc. 
Pudimos estar con nuestra perrita muy cómodos. 
La casa está completamente equipada (toallas, gel, secador, cocina con todo lo necesario...) además disponía de dos torres de ventilación de aire que ayudaron a qué no hiciese tanto calor en el piso, muy silenciosas y que enfriaban muy bien. 
Hemos salido encantados!!!

The perfect base for a lovely few days exploring Porto. Really well situated near plenty of amenities and the city centre, and a really comfortable place to be during our downtime. Would definitely recommend!

El departamento estaba como en las fotos, sin embargo, la zona aunque sea muy céntrica y cerca, es una calle que no da seguridad y está llena de prostitutas, además de ser muy ruidoso todo el tiempo. Recomiendo dejar claro las dificultades del lugar en el anuncio.

✔️ In una posizione comoda per visitare il centro città senza mezzi, gli spazi comuni di cucina e terrazza erano ottimi e ingresso e uscita sono stati facilissimi, si riceve un codice per messaggio da inserire nel buzón per prendere le chiavi. Ho apprezzato che ci fossero degli assorbenti a disposizione, un phon e I prodotti per lavarsi. 
✖️ I cuscini un po' scomodi ma il materasso comodo e per due notti andava bene. Gli spazi sono ristretti, sia in camera sia in bagno, ma il getto d'acqua della doccia è grande e molto meglio di altre docce che ho visto e inoltre la stanza Frida ha l'accesso privato alla terrazza comune.

What a beautiful place to stay. I thought this place was amazing and it had been kept very clean and tidy. 
It’s private and surrounded by a beautiful garden. 
We were only there for one night so didn’t venture too far into town but the first grocery store we came to had everything we needed and the staff / owners were very friendly. 
One word of advice is to not use Apple Maps to find this place as it will most likely send you somewhere else. Google maps worked no problem for me. Thankfully Hugo was very understanding and remained very welcoming despite our delay getting there. 
Over all this was a great place and I’m happy we chose this for our stay. Thank you Hugo!!
Great stay
Highly recommend. Great location! Walkable and close to everything you will need.
Elis was very welcoming and helpful, and her space was lovely, would definitely recommend :)
Central to most things in the city, everywhere is walkable from the location, clean, quiet and also close very close to some affordable restaurants and coffee shops
Great stay! Everything was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was responsive and easy to communicate with. Highly recommend and would definitely stay here again!
We were very pleased with the stay
Un très bel appartement, j’ai pu bien profiter du séjour, très propre, je n’ai pas été déçu bien au contraire ! 😊
Joana Muy atenta, la casa impecable, de seguro que volveremos!

Appartamento che fornisce i servizi della descrizione
Lo consigliamo soprattutto per la posizione che permette di raggiungere il centro città facilmente a piedi
Ci siamo trovati nel complesso bene

The location is fantastic....right in the heart of Porto. The place is as advertised and more...plenty of room. The only drawback is the square the listing overlooks is quite popular for outside dining and entertainment that can go beyond 10:00 pm. We were aware from previous reviews about the noise, but surprised the entertainment lasted until at least 10:30 pm the three nights we stayed. This is not the fault of the owners and when the windows are closed it does help with the noise.
Por tiempo no pude conocerla, pero al llegar me dejo una cesta con desayuno, me vino super bien para la madrugada al aeropuerto.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Kinga and António were most accommodating for our late flight times, there was a cot ready to put our baby into bed as soon as we arrived 
The pool was amazing, So quite and peaceful you wouldn’t even know you were sharing the area with other quest. The Location was perfect for beach days and days out in the city. 
We will definitely be returning again in the future.
Sempre que vou ao Porto para trabalho fico nestes apartamentos e a experiência é sempre impecável, a Maria é uma excelente host!

Excelente todo !! muy agradecidos con Oliver; su estancia de lo mejor 
Superrrr recomendable!!

Muy buen lugar. Tal cual las fotos. Sus anfitriones super atentos. Tiene cerca varios lugares de comida. 
Recomendado

We enjoyed our stay here. Good sleep with a very comfortable bed.
The location is a bit further away from the city center, it’s around 25 minutes to get to city center with 9-min walk to the metro station.
Henrique’s place was nice. Very clean and spacious. We enjoyed the stay. We did find it a bit strange that the check in process was so rigid but overall it’s a great place to stay.
Le séjour chez Joao c'est très bien passé, appartement neuf très confortable et très bien placé. Joao est accueillant et disponible. Je le recommande vivement !

Es un departamento hermoso! Amplio, moderno, ventilado. Con todas las amenidades para tu comodidad. Con aparcamiento gratuito y techado dentro del edificio. Aire acondicionado central, silencioso. 
Llegamos a todos los puntos turísticos caminando. Tiene supermercados cercanos.
Totalmente recomendable 👌🏻
Logement très propre, correspond à la description
We loved the location! Easy check in, very communicative and accommodating. I’d stay here again!
Place was amazing, Kept well and tidy....Loved how it was small brunch spots and cafes great food and as well as small galleries. Def a good rec for folks and its not too busy as well.

Great location and well managed building by the agency. However the quality of the mattresses is really poor. Large springs that can be felted throughout. A shame as the quality of place overall and the management by the agency is really good. We liked the 50s style decoration and how clean it is. Maybe thoses mattresses are also from the 50s?
This is a high spec and spotless place in a central location. We had a great time
Alojamento maravilhoso, tudo limpo e ótima comunicação com Jorge, com certeza voltarei.

Pros: very walkable and convenient neighborhood. Lots of natural light, spacious apartment, effective black out curtains, two bathrooms. Laundry across the street. Elevator (slow but very nice to have with luggages. Luggage storage at the property management office right next door. Easy pickup and drop off for ubers. 
Cons: AC was not effective, bed / pillows uncomfortable, bedroom stuffy. It was particularly hot while we were in Porto and the AC did little to help. Luckily Porto cools down at night and the windows open fully. However you can hear water dripping in the courtyard all night, and construction in the morning which make it hard to leave the bedroom window open, so it gets stuffy and hot.

Mieszkanie w samym centrum zabytkowego Porto, co umożliwiło zwiedzenie całej starówki na piechotę. Romantyczne miejsce i świetne wyposażenie mieszkania, idealnego dla par. Ja wprawdzie podróżowałam z dorosłą córką, lecz dzięki szerokiemu łóżku było nam bardzo wygodnie. Miejsce świetnie skomunikowane z lotniskiem, blisko dworca. Mario umożliwił nam zostawienie bagażu przed godziną zakwaterowania, co było dla nas ważne, bo przyleciałyśmy rano. Bardzo udany pobyt.
Very lovely and warm Airbnb within close range of Porto but in a great calming environment 😊
The communication was great and so was the location. Tastefully furnished. Great deal. Five stars
Easy to check in and out, really good location in a nice neighbourhood. Couldn’t fault the apartment and would stay again on my next visit to Porto

De ligging is top! Middenin een bruisende wijk met veel keus aan (goed) eten en drinken, zowel voor overdag als ‘s avonds. Vijf minuten van Bolhão markt en vlak bij een metrostation. De straat waar de studie aan ligt is wel druk en dat hoor je, maar met oordoppen heb ik prima geslapen. De studio is op de 3e verdieping en bij ons deed de lift het niet. Airco werkte gelukkig wel goed, dus dat is in de warmere tijden erg fijn! Er ontbraken wel een paar geadverteerde dingen zoals de föhn en conditioner en de shampoo was ook de douchegel. Verder zijn er gebruikssporen in de studio zoals krassen op de vloer en meubels en gaan sommige dingen wat stroef, maar dat vonden wij niet storend. Wel was de deur van de douche al een tijd niet echt goed schoongemaakt en dat vonden we wel wat minder.
Al bij al een goede accommodatie met een goede ligging en als een beetje geleefde studio prima is voor jou.

The apartment is spacious, light and comfortable. We particularly liked the terrace for breakfast and evening sunsets. The area was quiet at night and bed comfortable for that all important good night's sleep. 
There is construction around but did not overly worry us. Most of Porto seems to have a crane or two !

Die Wohnung hat eine tolle Aussicht auf den Douro, ist gemütlich und mit allem Nötigen ausgestattet. Für die Erkundung der Stadt zu Fuss ist sie ideal gelegen. Für die Anreise ist ab Flughafen ist ein Taxi/ Uber zu empfehlen. Das Haus hat ca. 12 solche Wohnungen und ist daher eher unpersönlich. Das WC Papier muss nach der ersten Rolle selbst gestellt, also mitgebracht werden.
We were made to feel very welcome by Alaina. The apartment was very comfortable and clean and Alaina went out of her way to make sure we had everything we needed. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

Es un lugar simplemente excepcional, es el mejor lugar de todas mis experiencias, superó todas mis espectativas, mil porciento de veracidad, no dudes en rentarlo, muchos detalles, tiene todo lo que necesitas.
Alloggio comodo per persona singola o coppia perché stanza staccata dalla casa; solo zona poco comoda perché con poche attività vicino ma in 15 min di macchina si arriva in centro
We had a great stay here, Alina was incredibly responsive and helpful. Thank you!
Great location and great communication!
很棒！非常舒適且地點很好
The stay was lovely, and the host was extremely responsive and flexible with our schedule. Highly recommend!
todo perfecto !!

Helena is an amazing host! She was very kind, welcoming and helpful. Even when the situation was a bit difficult she still managed to help us. For example she offered to get a refund for us for metro ticket. She also gave us amazing recommendations on places to eat authentic Portuguese food. The room itself is also very cozy and clean, we had no issues at all with the room, it was very good for the price!
L’alloggio è molto confortevole, ben arredato e completo di tutti gli accessori. La posizione è tranquilla e ben servita dalla metropolitana. Siamo stati molto bene

Location is very central,
on a walkable street and perfect for us.
Fantastiskt utsikt över Porto, Douro-floden och Dom Luis-bron. Vi är verkligen nöjda över lägenheten, utsikten och närheten till must-do things.

La estancia estuvo muy bien. El lugar estaba limpio, cómodo y tal como se mostraba en las fotos. La persona que nos recibió fue muy amable y atenta con nosotras. En general, todo estuvo excelente y tuvimos una muy buena experiencia.

Beautiful modern apartment with lots of light and fresh air. Good amenities, comfortable beds, great shower, lots of closets...overall great vibe for three people. Perfect location.
Highly recommended.

Amazing modern apartment, very well equipped with everything you need, even provided washing machine tablets, coffee pods, tooth brush in case you forgot! 
Fireworks from balcony one our first night l, what a welcome from Porto, marathon on Sunday viewed from balcony. Super efficient hosts, very helpful, elevator and we all slept like a log! 
So close to the Riveira quay, bridge and historic areas, right on our doorstep. 
Best taverna recommendations. 
Fell in love with Porto. 
Thank you. X
Gostei da estadia, muito aconchegante

Sasha's Airbnb was such a beautiful place to spend a couple of weeks. It's exactly as described, is full of light, and the apartment has everything you need. Sasha was always kind, responsive, and helpful with anything I needed, I would/will absolutely stay again on another trip to Porto. Thanks Sasha!
Impecable, diría que mejor que un hotel de 5 estrellas. Todo nuevo, detalles increíbles, con comida abundante, limpio, céntrico, sim duda un lugar para repetir cada vez que vayas a Oporto
A comfortable apartment in a great location and it felt safe in the neighborhood. The apartment is roomy and we'll set up. We enjoyed our stay there. Would recommend.
Clean and spacious house in a great location - thanks for a lovely stay

L’allogio è splendido molto moderno con una cucina bellissima. La casa ha tutto quello che serve ed era pulitissima. Ci siamo resi a Laundos per un matrimonio e l’accessibilità era perfetta. Proprio di fronte alla chiesa molto pratico. Jorge è un host molto simpatico, reattivo con tanta flessibilità. È stato un piacere soggiornare da lui e torneremo di sicuro da lui se dovessimo venire di nuovo.

It is located close to must-do things. The view from the balcony was fantastic. Goran responded promptly and gave us useful information. He was so kind and warm. I felt like I visited my hometown by his warm welcome. However, there were many narrow steps to carry heavy bags. It would have been better if the studio had been air conditioned. 
In general, the place would be wonderful to enjoy the view.

Jaoa was a perfect host, accommodated us with an early bag drop plus many tips. The location is perfect, provided as Jaoa's information clearly states, that you're ok with Porto's stairs in that part of the city. He provided tickets to the elevator connecting to the waterfront, so we felt like locals. There's a fair amount of noise from all the waterfront activity, but that's a small price to pay for the great view and vibe of the location.

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour dans cet appartement ! 😊 Il correspondait parfaitement à nos attentes : très agréable, confortable et idéal pour profiter pleinement de notre séjour à Porto.
Nous avons particulièrement apprécié les petites attentions à notre arrivée, notamment la petite boîte contenant tout le nécessaire pour la cuisine et le séjour. C’est vraiment le genre de détail qui fait plaisir et qui montre que tout est pensé pour que les voyageurs se sentent bien.
Nous nous sommes sentis comme chez nous et garderons un très bon souvenir de notre séjour. Merci encore pour votre accueil et votre attention. Nous reviendrions avec grand plaisir !
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Carolina’s place is the perfect base for Porto, it is clean and tidy and homely. Carolina is responsive and friendly and helped us sort out anything we needed. Highly recommend!
Appartement très propre, spacieux et très chaleureux avec les murs en pierre. Nous avons apprécié la tranquillité des lieux.

Semaine exaltante, beau séjours je dirait même magnifique et reposant.
Un peut sportif pour rentrer au Airbnb le soir après un restaurant et une soirée au bars. 🤣
Mais excellente vacances dans mon beau pays qui me manque cela me donne de plus en plus envie d’y vivre ! 
Ce n’est que le début ! 
Merci à Rosanna qui a été génial pour ce séjours je recommande vraiment beaucoup sont sérieux ca gentillesse et sa bienveillance ❤️

Maria was a fantastic host! She reached out and made sure we felt comfortable arriving and throughout our stay! She provided great recommendations and we would definitely recommend staying here!! Fantastic location!!!!

Wir haben uns in dieser Ferienwohnung von der ersten Minute an pudelwohl gefühlt. Es war für uns der perfekte Ort, um ein paar schöne und erholsame Tage mit der Familie in Portugal zu verbringen. Die Wohnung war gemütlich, sauber und mit allem ausgestattet, was man braucht.
Besonders gut gefallen hat uns die super ruhige Lage in einem angenehmen Wohngebiet. Gleichzeitig ist man schnell auf den größeren Straßen und hat dadurch eine sehr gute Anbindung. Perfekt, wenn man die Umgebung erkunden und verschiedene Ausflüge machen möchte.
Unser persönliches Highlight war natürlich der Pool / Whirlpool. Gerade nach einem Ausflug war es wunderbar, dort noch ein bisschen zu entspannen. Auch die ruhige und angenehme Atmosphäre hat unseren Aufenthalt besonders schön gemacht.
Wir haben die Zeit hier wirklich genossen und würden jederzeit wiederkommen. Vielen Dank für die herzliche Gastfreundschaft und für diesen schönen Aufenthalt!
Great flat, location and communication

What a gem. A perfect location for visiting Porto. The communication with the hosts was exceptional from booking to checkout. Public transport was frequent and reliable to take us from the tranquility of the seaside to the bustling city. Nearby restaurants were plentiful with something for everyone. The apartment was very clean and fresh with a lovely outside area for eating and relaxing. Thanks for such an amazing opportunity to experience Portugal. We will be back.
Property as described in the description. Great location. Host Joao extremely helpful and great with communication.
Super good comunication and nice area ! would definetly stay again
Great location, lots of nearby restaurants. Very clean.
El apartamento está muy bien equipado, la ubicación es muy buena y tener estacionamiento hace la diferencia. La comunicación de entrada y salida es muy detallada. Siempre en comunicación.
Merci de votre accueil, on a beaucoup apprécié notre séjour
Great, spacious apartment close bars and restaurants.
Very comfortable stay. Spacious apartment.

One of the cleanest place where we were hosted. Marcos is a warm and responsive host.
Obrigado,Marcos!

una ubicacion centrica cerca de las atracciones. ubicacion estrategica para conocer. Algo de fiesta en las noches en la calle, para mi no era un problema. es un apto pequeño pero con todo lo necesario. volveria a visitarlo.
Super central location in a very modern and comfortable apartment.
Vraiment tout au top que ce soit le logement tout à proximité et confortable mais également notre hôte vraiment accueillant

We had a fantastic stay in Porto. Miguel was a brilliant host — friendly, helpful and always quick to respond. The apartment was lovely, spotlessly clean, comfortable and had everything we needed for a great stay. We’d happily stay here again and would definitely recommend it!
Honestly perfect! Great price for such a central location and great space. Came here on our honeymoon and wouldn't have changed a thing. Host was super nice and helpful. Would recommend

A great place to stay. You are a few minutes from the heart of the old town. There is a lovely restaurant right beneath the apartment which is convenient. There are also a number of bakeries which serve coffee and pastries. Susanna was very quick to respond to questions and we able to provide recommendations on places to go and see.
Mucho gradito

The location was excellent, with everything very walkable and easy to get to. The host provided clear instructions and all the information we needed, which made both check-in and check-out very easy.
The Airbnb itself was lovely and spacious for four people and having a lift was a great bonus, especially with luggage.
One thing to be aware of is that the bedroom on the lower floor can hear some noise from people walking around in the upstairs bedroom. This wasn’t a major issue for us but it’s worth bearing in mind.
Overall, we really enjoyed our stay and would happily recommend it!

Absolutely amazing stay here. Such responsive hosts and such a walkable and beautiful location, on a lovely quiet street with so many great cafes within walking distance. 2 minute walk from the bus stop that connects to Porto Airport or the Metro station from Campanha. The place is spotless, has everything you need and is very secure. The bed is so comfy and the air conditioning is great, although you do not need to use it so much as there are good shutters that block the light from coming in on the day. Would stay here again 100% it was such a pleasure. Great water pressure, temperature.

Fernada’s place was great. We liked having a seating area and table separate from the bedrooms. We appreciated two bathrooms and all the supplies in the bathroom. 
It’s away from the city center but right next to the bus and metro. 
We ate great dinner at Ezo and breakfast at Ponto2 in walking distance. 
It was a bit warm in the apartment. On the second evening we were able to open all the windows earlier and use fans to cool things down and leave windows open all night.

We had a wonderful stay at Veronica’s apartment in Porto. The apartment is very functional and has everything you need, with an excellent location within easy walking distance of restaurants, shops, and all the main amenities.
There is no elevator and there are a few flights of stairs, but Fatima was always there and more than willing to help with our baggage, which we really appreciated. The main bedroom is very large with a private ensuite, while the second bedroom is also very comfortable. The second bathroom has a slightly unusual setup, located across the hallway with the sink in the hallway, but everything was completely functional and worked very well for our two couples.
Overall, we had a great experience, have nothing but positive things to say, and would highly recommend Veronica’s apartment for a stay in Porto.
What a fabulous apartment, so centrally located & so comfortable. The hosts are so welcoming & it really helped make our time in Porto a special trip. Thank you so much.

This is the perfect location, particularly if you don’t have a lot of time and want to see as much of Porto as possible. The apartment is beautiful and has everything you need. Little special touches make you feel welcome.
All good apart from aircon
Perfect place for us to stay. Easy access to metro, ground was all reasonably level in the environs ( which is rare in somewhere as hilly as Porto ) and people were friendly

We had a wonderful stay at this charming Porto condo. It was very well situated and had so much character and uniqueness. We especially enjoyed relaxing on the balcony with the complimentary bottle of Port - such a lovely touch!
The hosts were incredibly responsive, helpful, and generous with their recommendations and local guides. They made everything easy and welcoming. We would happily stay here again!

Excelente acomodação para desfrutar de tudo o que Porto tem a oferecer. Próximo de vários pontos turísticos, bares, restaurantes e também seguro/ limpo.
Com certeza iremos retornar mais vezes!
Obrigado!
Apartamento precioso, moderno, luminoso, impecable. Super cómodo. Excelente ubicación. Detalles de recepción cómodo cápsulas de café, detergente ,etcétera necesarios. Muy recomendable

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour à Porto! L’appartement est vraiment très bien situé : pratiquement tout peut se faire à pied, ce qui est très agréable pour découvrir la ville.
L’appartement est confortable, très bien équipé et on s’y sent rapidement comme chez soi. Antonella est une hôte exceptionnelle : extrêmement gentille, attentionnée et disponible. La communication avec elle a été facile et agréable, et elle s’est assurée que nous avions tout ce dont nous avions besoin.
Nous recommandons vivement cet appartement et nous y retournerions avec grand plaisir! Une très belle expérience à Porto. 🥰

Not enough words to say how much we loved the apt and the area! As we are in our mid and late 60’s I was a bit concerned about getting our large suitcases up the stairs and had expressed that in my initial inquiry about booking it. Joao remembered this and met us at the apt to help take the luggage upstairs. Joao also checked in with us the next day to make sure everything was ok. The apt is close to everything including Sao Bento station which we used as a navigation hub for using the city transit system which was so easy! It is a great size for a couple. The bed must be a king and the building was secure and quiet. We felt very safe in the area and in Porto in general. Highly recommend
O apartamento é moderno e compatível com o anúncio, muito bem localizado e os anfitriões foram prestativos e gentis, eu recomendo!
Delightful flat in a superb location, in the heart of the UNESCO site.

We had a first rate experience staying at Maria’s apartment; As described , well located and vey clean. Maria was an excellent host with clear and proactive communication. Really enjoyable stay; thank you
The accomodation was great, they provided everthing we could have needed, the rooms are clean and spacious, also sometimes there were cats in the backyard😻
Great location and great place!
Muito bem localizado, espaço muito bom

Spędziliśmy u Juliany w apartamencie kilkanaście bardzo przyjemnych dni. Mieszkanie czyste i doskonale wyposażone we wszystko co potrzeba. Lokalizacja i miejsce bardzo na plus. Bliskość plaży, oceanu i fajne miejsce na wypady w różne części regionu. Polecam Juliane i jej apartament

Great location - near the river but outside of the touristy bits. Keep in mind that you will have to climb a lot of stairs to get in the apartment but the entire city involves a lot of vertical walking thru quaint cobbled streets and alleyways. The apartment is very spacious and was well stocked and has the comfort of A/C (it was quite warm in Porto when we were there so this was really appreciated).
Superschönes Apartment mit einem schönen Innenhof. Sehr geschmackvolle Einrichtung . Die Dachterrasse verspricht einen tollen Sonnenaufgang.
Place was so clean and modern and a comfortable . Was close to everything and walkable . Responsive host . Would stay here again . Great place away from home .

Apartment is in a good location very close to the metro, local amenities and restaurants . Nice clean rooms couldn’t ask for more . Nelson made us feel at home as soon as we arrived. Nelson owns a local restaurant close to the apartment which I highly recommend we had lunch there really good food and felt really authentic . This wasn’t a problem for us but the apartment is on the top floor and is a fair way up stairs so if you’re not very mobile then something to think about.
Prachtig huis, Catarina was heel aardig en antwoordde snel.

This was by far the best Airbnb I have stayed in! It was in the perfect location, extremely easy to check in and out of, very clean, and had a gorgeous overall layout. Everything was thoughtfully put together, and we couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay. We would absolutely stay here again!

Thoroughly enjoyed my stay in Porto at Susana’s. The location is perfect and the apartment has everything you would need. Susana was extremely helpful and offered recommendations as well as allowing me to check in slightly early. I only have a few tiny criticisms that stop it from being 5 stars! (There is no air conditioning, so the apartment gets quite hot). However, the positives far outweigh the negatives. Having my morning coffee on the little balcony was something I won’t forget!

Comfortable apartment in a great location. The rooftop terrace was lovely and the AC in the apartment a welcome bonus. Handy for metro and lots of good restaurants and bars close at hand. Easy to see all the main attractions and the riverside and bridge about a 20 min walk. A great location for a city break to Porto.

We enjoyed our stay here. The location was quiet but still close to popular areas. We found it to be quite warm inside without AC, but we were visiting during high temperatures so it will depend on the season. The brunch across the street was very nice to try. Host was kindly flexible with check in.

A beautiful apartment in a private area, once you get through the public yard. Lots of room, with a great private roof terrace and air-con min the bedrooms. Very convenient for shops, restaurants and sights. Excellent value. Finally, really good and responsive communications from Pedro. Highly recommended

Wir waren 5 Tage in Porto und fanden die Unterkunft bei Luís super. Der Host ist äusserst freundlich, wir wurden persönlich empfangen und Luís hat täglich Empfehlungen zu Restaurants und Aktivitäten gegeben. Auch auf unsere Rückfragen hat er sofort geantwortet und war stets hilfreich! Die Unterkunft ist super gelegen, in einem belebten Quartier mit vielen tollen Restaurants, von wo aus man zu Fuss sofort im Zentrum ist. Wir konnten flexibel ein- und auschecken und erhielten sogar eine Flasche Wein zur Begrüssung!
Nice room as expected
Great apartment, and centrally located. Pedro was very responsive. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend for anyone coming to Porto.

Bonjour Fatima 
Nous avons passés 13 jours dans votre maison avec un grand plaisir, vous nous avez accueilli avec gentillesse tout en répondant à nos questions sur les choses à voir . Helena ist einer super lieber und hilfsbereite Gastgeberin gewesen. Wir haben uns wohlgefühlt :)!

Très beau séjour ! L’appartement était propre et fidèle aux photos! Nous avons été accueillis par la maman d’Emanuel qui était d’une gentillesse incroyable, vraiment parfait pour notre premier séjour à Porto! La station de metro est au coin de la rue ce qui rend les déplacements très facile! Je recommande cet endroit !
El depto es pequeño no hay lugar para las maletas
Very central and lovely apartment

This is my third time in Porto but my first staying outside the pretty main tourist area. The quiet was welcome. We slept well. We came on the heels of a wedding in Istanbul and the apartment served as a welcome retreat plus a well situated home base for exploring even more of Porto. Highly walkable location. Public transport just a few steps away. So too grocery, a fish market, restaurants, etc. THERE is a bakery right across the street! My husband was in heaven. The extra half bath out back was another marital bonus. I was sensitive to the moisture from the enclosed patio off the bedroom, but once it dried, I enjoyed reading & sipping tea & sharing meals there. The hosts were some of the warmest we've ever encountered. It's clear they take pride in their city and the home they share with welcomed guests. Impeccably clean and well stocked.

This is the 2nd time we’ve stayed here. It’s a wonderful location and even though it’s in a very tourist heavy area, it’s quiet and peaceful inside. It’s a fine space for two people. While we didn’t cook, it was equipped if we wanted to do a simple meal. 
Fatima is very communicative & helpful. She offered suggestions as well as the option to check in early if the apartment was available

Het was een zeer aangenaam verblijf. Het zit op loopafstand van winkels, restaurants etc. 
De ruimte was zoals omschreven. Netjes en opgeruimd. 
Opvallendheden: ik vind alleen de badkamer wel wat verouderd (wel schoon) + de ruimte ruikt muf!
Als de eigenaar hier iets aan doet - is het echt helemaal top! 
Verder zou ik de accommodatie wel aanraden. De bedden waren zeer schoon (dun kussen maar is persoonlijke voorkeur)

We had a wonderful stay in Porto! Ricardo was very responsive and gave us a tour of the apartment…leaving us with no questions! We were close to everything we wanted to do. Plenty of delicious restaurants in the area. Highly recommend this location!

Sonia was a great host, extremely responsive and helpful! The accommodation was located in a convenient area (near a big supermarket) and on flat grounds. It was clean and very well-maintained. Sonia even provided extra towels for everyone. Despite not having a dryer, there was a big backyard (with strings and pegs provided!) which allowed us to dry our laundry well.
Superbe séjour, les chambres étaient propres

A truly fantastic place. The furniture and decor was divine, nice and quiet with a lovely out outdoor courtyard. very clean with lots of nice extra touches like shampoo, soap, milk, butter, croissants, rolls and more. Communication was excellent.

We had a wonderful stay. The apartment had everything we could want including high end furnishings, comfortable beds, and a stocked kitchen. It was centrally located and walkable everywhere (pasteis de nata cafe just downstairs!). It was unseasonably warm so we very much appreciated the AC. Parking would be a challenge for anyone driving (luckily we did not). Joana and Valentim were pleasant, knowledgeable and helpful. Would highly recommend.

Wir waren für 3 Tage (zwei Nächte) zu Gast bei Vasco. Er war für uns jederzeit erreichbar und sehr hilfsbereit. Die Unterkunft war genauso wie auf den Fotos und für unseren Trip war es genau richtig. Die Unterkunft war auch leicht zu finden und man fühlte sich direkt wie Zuhause. Tagsüber ist die Straße gut befahren, nachts hört man allerdings nichts. Wir würden hier wieder übernachten.
A terrific location, nice balcony, near many shops and restaurants, right in the middle of town!
Le logement est situé dans un petit village au cœur du centre-ville de Porto. Le quartier est calme.
Location was great and the room had everything we needed. Carolina and her team were very helpful and responsive.

We had a great time in Porto in the appartment! Although it is sourrounded by restaurants, the street itself is very quiet. The hosts were very kind and always answered very fast. Check-in was easy and the appartment was exactly as in the pictures.
Un séjour de trois semaines agréable dans le calme Dans un environnement parfait .

Perfect place to relax after 12 days walking the camino. Great location. Lovely outdoor space to relax. Lots of space inside. Very close to restaurants and the main sites of Porto. Would definitely recommend staying here.
Proper, gezellig en zeker de moeite!
Jeronimo was a wonderful host, provided us with lots of great recommendations for our time in Porto. Such a convenient location which made it very easy to get around :)

La experiencia estuvo muy bien en general. Además nos recomendó varios lugares y restaurantes locales, lo cual estuvo buenísimo. La ubicación nos pareció muy buena y nos sentimos cómodos todo el tiempo. Fuera de eso, una experiencia súper positiva.
We thought the floors and rugs were stained and dirty. The host was very responsive and made an effort to correct this issue.
Grand logement idéalement situé et décoré avec goût. Séjour fantastique je recommande sans hésiter
Logement très bien situé et très pratique ! Maria a été très gentille avec nous. Je recommande ce logement !
Great location, good air conditioning, clean bedrooms and bathrooms. Host was very friendly and responsive and accommodated our requests.

포르투에서 정말 만족스러운 숙박이었어요! 무엇보다 숙소에서 바라보는 포르투 대성당 전경이 너무 아름다워서 매일 아침 눈을 뜨는 순간부터 기분이 좋았습니다.
숙소도 생각보다 훨씬 넓고 깨끗해서 가족이나 여러 명이 함께 지내기에도 정말 좋았어요. 필요한 것들이 잘 갖춰져 있어서 머무는 동안 불편함이 전혀 없었습니다.
무엇보다 호스트가 정말 친절하고 세심했어요. 연락을 드리면 항상 빠르게 답변해 주셨고, 머무는 동안 불편한 점은 없는지 세심하게 신경 써주셔서 정말 감사했습니다. 덕분에 낯선 도시에서도 편안하고 안심하며 지낼 수 있었어요.
포르투에서의 여행을 더욱 특별하게 만들어준 숙소였습니다. 멋진 전망과 넓고 깨끗한 공간, 그리고 따뜻한 호스트까지 모든 것이 정말 만족스러웠어요. 포르투에 다시 방문한다면 꼭 다시 머물고 싶은 곳입니다. 정말 잘 지내다 갑니다!
Had a great time.
Très bon séjour. Je n’ai rien à redire sur la location: propre, efficace bien située ( proche des lignes de bus et métro). Je recommande !
Schöne Wohnung im obersten Stock

We loved our stay at Graciete and João's place! They were so flexible and helpful with our arrival and departure times, their place was very close to the metro station and walkable to many restaurants and sights, and it was a great, clean place on a quiet side street. We would definitely stay there again!
Very good location, right in the downtown area! Close to everything
Très propre, très calme, bien placé. Je recommande à 100%.

Súper cómodo, bien ubicado y decorado con buen gusto.

Great apartment at a great location!
Nice, clean, well designed appartment. Very good communication.
Easy online check-in, the place is cozy and lovely. The area is safe.

Il mio soggiorno nell'alloggio è stato molto soddisfacente. Alojamento perfeito para passar férias em família. Foram três dias muito bem aproveitados e desfrutados.
A piscina estava excelente e foi ótima para aproveitar os dias de descanso.
Os anfitriões são muito simpáticos, atenciosos e prestáveis.
Também tivemos a oportunidade de comprar um vinho muito bom!
Muito obrigada por tudo. Até à próxima! 😊

Estuvimos fantásticamente en casa de José!!! Un barrio cerca de restaurante donde puedes comer buen pescado!! Las vistas desde casa son preciosas y había todo para el día a día. El Uber va de maravilla y es económico así que siendo tres nos salía a cuenta.

We had an absolutely wonderful stay in Porto. The apartment truly went above and beyond our expectations and had everything we could possibly need. The beds were incredibly comfortable, and the amazing Smeg coffee machine was a lovely touch!
The balcony was a real highlight, with fantastic views and the perfect place to relax after exploring the city. The location was excellent, right in the centre and within easy reach of everything.
