We couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay and would happily return. Highly recommended!

The apartment and garden was spacious, which felt great and made our stay very pleasant. Kitchen utensils could get a refreshment. Personally I don’t like coffee machines with capsules and and prefer bialetti cafeteira, a French press or at least a simple filter - everything is better than capsules ;) but that’s just a personal preference.
We loved this place!! So cute, great rooms, great views, easy elevator, and AC in every room
Great place, clean, central and close to a popular sunset spot.

Nossa experiência foi ótima. O apartamento é muito bem cuidado, limpo, os equipamentos são bons, chuveiro quente e ar condicionado.
A localização é ótima, perto do centro mas não em um lugar muito barulhento. Nossa experiência foi maravilhosa, Hugo foi muito claro sobre as instruções e ainda deixou um mapa personalizado de indicações locais. Amamos!
The place was great. Located in city center historic district. Clean and it was easy to relax after a day of exploring.
to be recommended

My friends and I stayed here for a few days whilst we took part in the Porto Half Marathon. José was incredibly helpful before and during our stay, check in was smooth and the apartment was perfect for our group. Couldn’t fault anything with the apartment or the hosting. Definitely a holiday to remember !

Great apartment and very close to the city centre. It had everything we needed for our stay and looked just like the photos. The host very responsive and knowledgeable of the area. 
Only issue we had was the upstairs guest was very loud throughout the nights we were there.

Det var ett super trevligt boende! Perfekt för två och inte alls långt ifrån allt liv på stan! Tog ungefär 12 minuter ner till stora gatorna och 20 min ner till vattnet. Finns en stor matvarubutik 3 minuter ifrån så helt perfekt för oss som ville laga lite mer mat hemma! Så trevligt, kommer absolut tillbaka och rekommenderar denna lägenhet till 100%!
Très bien !
Très bien !

Das Haus war sehr schön und stilvoll eingerichtet, wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Im großen Garten konnte man super entspannen und das Meer ist fußläufig entfernt. Joanna ist ein sehr freundlicher Host und wir kommen gerne wieder!

We absolutely loved our stay in Porto! The apartment was in a great location and had everything we needed. It was very clean, comfortable, and quiet, and the check-in process was easy and hassle-free.
Having a grocery store right across from the apartment was such a convenient bonus, especially during our stay.
We had a wonderful experience and would happily stay here again. Highly recommend! 🇵🇹❤️
Sara’s place was bight, clean and well laid out. To be able to sit out on the balcony and enjoy the sunset after being out all day was priceless.
Very clean apartment in a perfect location. We had a good time
It was a good stay for us

Airbnb le plus propre que je n'ai jamais vu, tout était nickel. L'appartement est également très bien équipé, que ça soit pour faire la cuisine ou se laver. L'hôte est réactive. sympathique et m'a fait parvenir un guide très utile des activités et de la restauration disponible dans le coin. 
Seul petit bémol, j'ai trouvé que l'appartement était un peu bruyant, étant situé dans une rue passante avec un restaurant juste en face, à savoir quand on y est pas habitué. 
Je recommande !

Een zeer mooie accommodatie met heel veel te doen in de buurt. Alles was goed te vinden op wandelafstand! Sara en Hugo waren ook super hosts, ze antwoordden altijd rap en gaven ons ook leuke tips om te doen in de stad.

Beau logement propre, moderne et confortable situé dans un quartier calme et sécuritaire. Il était facile d’entrer en contact avec l’hôte. Elle a été très gentille et nous a aidé rapidement malgré qu’il était tard. Je recommande à 100%!

The apartment was centrally situated and we found it easy to get to the river and local restaurants. 
We had chosen this apartment because we love a terrace and like to sit out with breakfast or a beer before we head out. Unfortunately the air conditioning unit next to the terrace on an adjacent building and bright security light made sitting out very noisy and uncomfortable. from early morning until late in the evening.
Also the terrace was not as nice as the photos, no solar lights or planting and it needed a good sweep and clean before we could use it. The parasol was broken. However the apartment was well equipped, stylish and clean but we found the bed a little lumpy and the mattress protector was stained! 
Once inside the apartment was very quiet and the air conditioning worked very well. Communication was excellent with our hosts and they responded quickly to messages.
Très bon séjour chez Anne ! Appartement propre, agréable et confortable. Anne est accueillante et disponible. Nous recommandons sans hésiter !
Tolles Apartment in guter Lage, sehr gut ausgestattet, alles vorhanden was man für einen Städtetrip in Porto benötigt.

Nuestra estancia en este apartamento de Oporto fue maravillosa. El apartamento es incluso mejor de lo que esperábamos y, tal y como indican las fotos, es precioso y está muy bien cuidado.
La zona de la piscina es genial. Disfrutar de mi café por la mañana allí, con tanta tranquilidad, fue uno de mis momentos favoritos. Además, tuvimos la suerte de coincidir con gente muy simpática durante nuestra estancia, lo que hizo que la experiencia fuera todavía mejor.
Nosotros teníamos coche, así que pudimos disfrutar tanto de Oporto como de Matosinhos, ya que ambos están a muy poca distancia y resulta muy cómodo desplazarse.
En definitiva, fue una estancia perfecta y sin duda volveremos. ¡Muy recomendable!
Very central, spacious, nice host. A bit outdated but well worth the price! Overall I would recommend.

Very clean, spotless and functional apartment, in a vibrant neighborhood. José was responsive, accommodating and gave clear instructions for check in and check out.
Thanks you!!

Great studio within walking distance of Porto's main sights. Can definitely recommend this accomodation to anyone looking for a clean and friendly space in Porto! It is worth noting that the studio is located on the third floor and only accessible by stairs. We very much enjoyed our stay! :)

Tivemos uma excelente experiência nesta acomodação no Porto. O espaço é lindo, autêntico, moderno e muito confortável e amplo, exatamente como nas fotos. Tudo estava impecavelmente limpo e organizado, o que tornou a estadia ainda mais agradável.
Também apreciamos muito a gentileza dos anfitriões em disponibilizar cafés e torradas, um cuidado que fez toda a diferença na nossa chegada.
A localização é excelente, com fácil acesso a diversos pontos turísticos e aos transportes públicos. Além disso, há ótimos restaurantes na praça logo acima, o que tornou muito prático aproveitar a gastronomia local.
Recomendamos esta acomodação sem hesitar e certamente ficaríamos aqui novamente numa próxima visita ao Porto.
This is clean, great location and comfortable
Ai gente se eu pudesse dar 10 estrelas eu daria, tudo perfeito do começo ao fim. Amei ❤️
A great place to stay and to step out from. Easy walk to transport and local eating.
Muy buena ubicación. Al ser un bajo y las ventanas dar a la calle el ruido estaba bastante presente. El olor a humedad es muy intenso.

Appartement dans une petite ruelle agréable et calme , au centre ville de porto 
Je recommande

the place is very well located, everything is walkable. the beds are very comfortable. however for the price, it lacks some basic things that would make it feel more comfortable and personal. eg soap dish for soap in the bathroom, bath mat, proper wine glasses, mirrors in the bedrooms, a proper ironing board. you only get one set of keys which for 4 people is a bit annoying. also they wouldn’t let us leave our bags after checkout for a couple of hours, instead they send you links to luggage storage that they get commission for. but it is owned by a company so you do expect a lack of those little touches you might get from a private owner. it also is surface level clean but the apartment needs a deep clean, under the beds and tables it was really dusty, and the rugs were dirty.

A estadia correu bem e o espaço cumpriu perfeitamente para o que precisávamos. Pelo valor pago e pela época, tem uma excelente relação qualidade/preço. A comunicação com o anfitrião foi simples e correu tudo com tranquilidade. Recomendo para quem procura uma opção prática e acessível.
Lovely place, as described. Very helpful with small questions

Very well equipped apartment and tastefully furnished. Quiet location. Near the metro and supermarket. 
Ana was so accommodating and couldn’t have been more helpful. 
The stay really contributed to a very happy holiday. 
I’d highly recommend Ana’s apartment.

Correspond exactement aux photos et à la description.
C’est parfait pour les personnes qui font un court séjour afin de profiter de Porto et de ceux qui souhaitent juste un endroit où dormir.
L’hôte est très gentil et se montre disponible très rapidement.
Attention à ceux qui ont le sommeil léger, vu qu’il y’a plusieurs chambres il se pourrait que vous tombez avec les mauvaises personnes (ce qui n’a pas été le cas avec moi).
Idéalement situé avec un centre commercial pas loin à pieds et des transports accessibles facilement.

Bardzo dobra lokalizacja, a jednocześnie cisza i spokój. Mieszkanie jest świetnie wyposażone, niezwykle czyste i bardzo komfortowe — można poczuć się w nim jak we własnym domu. Zdecydowanie godne polecenia!Dziekujemy za gościnność

Hôte très réactive, elle nous a très bien accueillie et très gentille
Logement propre et fidèle aux photos
位置很好，离各景点很近，步行两分钟就是超市，房间布置温馨，卫生干净。

Al llegar al apartamento vimos que había hormigas, sobre todo en el baño, y pelos en las fundas de la cama y las almohadas. Lo comunicamos y se solucionó, aunque el último día volvieron a aparecer las hormigas (por lo que imaginamos que es algo frecuente).
El alojamiento está bien equipado y la cama es muy cómoda, sin embargo fallan algunos detalles como la luz en el baño, que es muy escasa, o los muebles desgastados. La falta de aire acondicionado podría ser un problema en pleno verano.
La ubicación es céntrica y está cerca de todos los sitios turísticos, pero es una zona que genera inseguridad pues hay bastante presencia de personas en situación de calle y bebiendo.
Sin duda, uno de los mejores alojamientos de Oporto. Volveremos sin dudarlo!
Merci pour cette semaine à porto. Le logement était comme décrit dans l’annonce. Je recommande !

We had a great stay at Clerigos Tower apartment! The location is really convenient, and the apartment had everything we needed. Miguel was a fantastic host - communication was super easy, he always replied quickly, gave us lots of useful tips, and all the instructions were clear and easy to follow. Everything went smoothly from start to finish, and we truly have nothing to complain about. We really enjoyed our stay!

Acolhedor!
Viajei com a minha mãe e ela apaixonou-se completamente pelo apartamento. Foi a primeira vez dela fora de um hotel e valeu muito a pena. Sentimos-nos em casa. A vista é deslumbrante. No coração do centro histórico. Vários pontos turísticos para ver a apenas poucos minutos a pé. Restaurantes, bares e cafés muito perto. Transportes também bastante perto. As comodidades estão perfeitas, a decoração é de extremo bom gosto. Tinham todos os utensílios que fossem necessários para uma estadia agradável. Tudo bastante limpo e arrumado 👌 a vizinhança foi bastante simpática, com algumas dicas para quem ande meio perdido como foi o nosso caso. Recomendo e adicionei aos favoritos. 💛
Good
Correspondeu às expectativas, recomendo.

We stayed three nights mid September. The apartment met our needs for a short stay. The host was very communicative and helpful. The location suited us - close to the metro and walking distance from the main tourist areas but away from the crowds. It felt safe at night and was very quiet.

Beautiful little house in a quiet but very convenient location. The house has everything you could possibly need. It has some lovely bars and restaurants very close by. Christina was very helpful to us and answered messages very quickly. I can't recommend this lovely house enough. We will be back next time we visit Porto.

Everything was perfect! I had a wonderful stay in this apartment. The location right by the Lapa metro station made it super fast and convenient for me to reach the city center. I’d definitely come back!
Great stay, everything clean and well described. Highly recommend.

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour dans ce logement idéalement situé. Tout peut se faire à pied, le centre ville est à 15 min à pied, ce qui est très pratique pour visiter. Les hôtes sont réactifs et disponibles. Le logement est conforme à la description. 
Il peut y avoir un peu de bruit du fait de la rue passante, mais avec des boules Quies, cela ne nous a pas posé de problème.
Je recommande ce logement !

We had a great stay in this studio. It was clean and had everything we needed. It is located close to many restaurants and shops, as well as the river. It gets a bit warm inside but we were visiting during a hot weekend and it is an old building so that is not unexpected. I would recommend this studio for couples looking to explore downtown Porto!
Appartement bien situé, très propre avec facilité d'accès.
Overall the place was good. Marked it down slightly due to the bathroom needing some fixing but otherwise it’s a good spot.
너무 깔끔하고 넓습니다! 주방도 사용하기 편해서 다시 방문하고 싶습니다.
Die Unterkunft ist in einer Perfekten Lage, um die Unterkunft gibt es viele sehr gute Restaurants und die U-Bahn ist zu Fuß nur 5min entfernt
Great place and staff
Muy centrico. Cerca de todo

Il nous fallait un logement à proximité de l'aéroport de Porto car notre vol était de très bonne heure le lendemain. Celui-ci a parfaitement répondu à nos attentes et je remercie encore notre hôte pour sa réactivité.

This apartment was absolute perfection. The location is unbeatable, you can easily walk to everything in Porto. The space itself is incredibly clean, modern, and features a super comfortable bed. Being situated inside a secure, gated complex added great peace of mind. You'll find fantastic local coffee spots, restaurants, and a supermarket just steps away for any essentials. This will definitely be my go-to spot whenever I return to Porto!
Super Lage, alles vorhanden was man braucht und alles sauber.

We had a great stay and really enjoyed our time here. The apartment was very comfortable, clean, and well located the city center was within walking distance, which made exploring Porto very easy.
We were also traveling with our dog and felt very comfortable throughout our stay, which was especially important for us. Everything went smoothly, communication was easy, and the whole experience was very pleasant.
We would definitely stay here again on our next visit to Porto. Highly recommended!

Fin leilighet. Selv om den lå i en travel gågate var det stille og rolig. Velutstyrt. 
Verten svarte hurtig og var veldig hyggelig.
Increíblemente maravillosoel apartamento. Todo estuvo excelente y bastante agradable la anfitriona
Experiência muito boa, o André disponibilizou se e mostrou interesse em me ajudar a preparar uma surpresa para a namorada tudo 5 estrelas
Fantastic highly recommend. Was perfect for us and young family

Un week end prolongé de 4 jours suffisant pour visiter Porto qui est en plein travaux. Sur le pont Luiz 1er, sur une vue à 360°, 37 grues visibles.
Un appartement plus grand que prévu et bien positionné en centre ville. 
Un endroit tel que la chambre calme.
Dommage pour les travaux de construction à proximité dès 8h le matin qui n'ont pas permis de profiter de la terrasse le matin pour petit déjeuner.
Nous avons utiliser l'appartement que pour dormir donc suffisant.
Merci à Mario pour les échanges très clairs et courtois via le site.

Appartement très bien situé, la porte voisine de Lello la célèbre librairie. Plusieurs restaurants à proximité, un superbe bar extérieur situé juste en face avec un joli parc. Le balcon à été notre endroit préféré du séjour. Le logement est très propre, les lits confortable et nous avons manqué de rien. Rita a eu l'immense gentillesse de nous laisser accéder au logement très tôt le matin. Elle est également très réactive et répond rapidement. Le seul petit point négatif serait que j'aurais aimé avoir une cafetière filtre ou à capsule car il y a seulement une cafetière style italienne Moka et je ne savais pas comment l'utiliser alors on a dû descendre s'acheter un café chaque matin. Sinon tout a été parfait. Merci Rita!
The place was just like described, walkable distance to the city center and good location to get to the airport. Jorge was easy to talk to:)

The apartment was spacious, comfortable, and in a good location. It was basically clean, and there were several advantages, including a pleasant outdoor patio and a functional kitchen equipped with a coffee machine, kettle, and stove. The dining table was worn but clean.
However, the apartment would benefit from better maintenance. Although the bathroom was clean, there were visible mold spots, one of the shower doors was coming off, and the mirror was tilted—clear signs that maintenance needs more attention. The refrigerator was working but barely cooling, and the Wi-Fi was weak and slow.
The apartment layout is also somewhat unusual, with the large bed located in the living room, which may not suit everyone.
Overall, the apartment has many positive features, but addressing the maintenance issues, refrigeration, and Wi-Fi would significantly improve the guest experience.

Excellent location, in a walking distance of simply everything in Porto. Quite big, the two rooms and two baths were appreciated. We paid a good price and even if we had some troubles with the plumbing and the baby bassinet, we enjoyed our stay and were helped by a very responsive host. The stairs are quite something, but we thought it was part of the adventure. Thanks again

Ana’s apartment was beautiful, great location, and well appointed. Gracie did a good job checking us in. 
Standouts:
Ana was super responsive and had great input on local things as well as Porto. 
Location, if you want to wake up to the river view, sleep to a river view or just like water, great location. 
Thanks, Ana.
Great place to stay in Porto! Amazing location
Não tivemos nenhum problema, mas a mesa da cozinha estava suja, e a varanda estava completamente empoeirada, no mais, tudo ótimo!
Great place..very convenient..to town catch the 600bus only 2.50 Euros..there is suprermaket across then road ..it was a great stay..thanks!
Perfecte locatie om de stad te verkennen
Was perfect for what we were looking for. Close to the beach and train station. Brand new and very clean.
We had an amazing stay! Highly recommend this place 🫶

The studio is beautiful and cozy, with great interior decorations and unbeatable views, especially the sunsets from the gorgeous balcony. It also has a dedicated work desk and monitor, which was a huge plus since I needed to work remotely. The location is very convenient, within walking distance of the metro and a supermarket.
The host, Elsa, is very kind and friendly! She provided thorough instructions when we checked in and kindly offered us a late checkout, so we didn’t have to carry our luggage around until we reached our next destination.
I definitely recommend this place if you’re looking for a cozy and relaxing base to explore Porto!

Logement idéalement situé pour visiter Porto
L’appartement est spacieux, propre, calme 
L’hôte est très réactif ☺️
Restaurant et supérette au pied de la résidence

Logement bien situé à proximité du métro.
Commerces alentour
Nice place without anything to complain. AC is missing a bit but still manageable. I would like to commend the team of LovelyStay, responsive and willing to help.
Beau séjour, logement entièrement rénové, belle communication et 15-20 minutes en autobus du centre.

Fred is without a doubt the best host I've ever had in any accomodation! He is kind, helpfull and always ready for you. 
His house is perfect for a week or two of exploring Porto and it's suroundings. The city centre is easily reached from there, transport to highlights is no problem. 
Within the house is everything you need to relax and enjoy the Portugees weather. Our room was cool, well spaced and had everything you could need.
All in all an amazing trip only helped by the amazing tips and stories provided by Fred himself.
Thank you Fred!!

This place was fantastic! Shout out to Joana! Super friendly and helpful! Fernando also quickly resolved a tiny issue I brought to his attention, so I appreciate him for that! :)
Spot has a great view, close to lots of cool spots to eat and hang out, and it’s tucked away in a quiet area. After long days of climbing hills and stairs, it’s a lovely relaxing spot to recharge! Also has everything you need for a short or long stay. 
Definitely recommend this place!

We were very happy with our stay here. The apartment was just as shown in the photos, very clean, tidy, and comfortable. You can tell that the host takes good care of the place. The location was also excellent, making it easy to get around the city and visit the main attractions, while still being quiet enough for a good night’s rest.
The host was very friendly and easy to communicate with, always responding quickly and providing clear instructions for both check-in and check-out. Everything went smoothly and the whole process was very easy.
This was our first stop in Porto, and it gave us such a comfortable and pleasant start to the trip. Overall, we were very satisfied with the cleanliness, location, comfort, and communication. We would happily stay here again and would definitely recommend it to others visiting Porto.

Bel appartement avec une belle vue
Hote réactif
Modern and comfortable apartment in the heart of Porto a short walk to all major attractions.

Beautiful apartment and facilities that were somehow even better than pictured. The host also provided really useful concierge services, with local recommendations and were very responsive to any queries that we had. The apartment and area also felt very safe as the gates to the complex were locked at night requiring a key for entry. I will definitely stay here again if I return to Porto.
위치나 숙소 내부 좋은데 주방에 양념이 전혀 없습니다. 소금과 후추, 오일은 있으면 좋을것 같습니다.
Very happy with the place, thank you!
Nette Unterkunft in Porto. Klein aber Fein :-)

Lovely apartment with a perfect location for exploring the city. Everything is within walking distance from here with plenty of good bars and restaurants nearby. Would definitely stay here again when returning to Porto.

Great apartment next to the city’s most iconic landmark, with a beautiful view of the Douro. The place was clean and tidy and the bed very comfortable. Logistics around parking permits were a bit tricky but easy to sort out in the end. Definitely recommend it
Lovely place, well described, very secure flat , as well as being very clean and had everything we needed. Hosts communication was excellent too. Would 100% recommend!
Es war alles top. Fantastische Lage, schnelle und eindeutige Kommunikation, es war alles sauber und vorbereitet. Der Aufenthalt war sehr angenehm. Lieben Dank!

We really enjoyed our stay at this apartment. It was clean and had everything we needed including a large outdoor space. Communication with the owners was very easy and responsive. 
It’s worth noting that there is construction work going on next door which does get noisy during the daytime hours however this did not really impact our stay

Schöne Unterkunft mit toller Lage um Porto zu erkunden. Die Kommunikation war super und schnell.
Die Terasse ist etwas von den Tauben in Beschlag genommen worden und man hört die Gäste, die durch den Flur kommen sehr, letzteres hat mich persönlich nicht sonderlich gestört. Trotzdem eine schöne Unterkunft.
Neat, tidy and comfortable. Also, very easy walk to the airport, which is exactly what we needed. I highly recommend this accommodation.
Nice place in the center, close to everything. Very clean and easy to find. Only downside is that the mattresses were thin and you could feel the coils through the mattresses.
Un apart amplio, comodo, limpio y con comunicacion fluida
We had a great time, Pedro was a great host, gave us lots of recommendations and the flat was great. Would recommend!
Very nice place in a quiet residential area of Porto
Great central location and lovely apartment would really recommend we really enjoyed staying here
Great location and great value, perfect for a weekend away

Good location in a cool neighbourhood. Nice balcony. Had an issue with towels but the hosts fixed it super quickly and they are very responsive and friendly! As expected, the street noise is very loud so bring earplugs if you’re a light sleeper! Sadly there was a bad drain smell in the apartment which didn’t really clear - probably because it was very hot/old building. All in all good enough as we only used it for sleeping.

Acabei passar cinco dias ali e devo dizer que foi uma otima estadia. A Carla é a família dela são pessoas muito simpáticas e quarto (além dos outros espaços na casa) foram limpos durante toda estadia. O processo do check-in foi muito facil e consegui deixar a minha mala um pouco adiantado. Agradeço a flexibilidade, e se estiver no porto de novo, conferiria esse lugar de novo, porque foi uma otima experiencia. Também o wifi foi estável durante todos os dias, e por isso consegui trabalhar á distancia sem interrupções. Recomendo esse lugar, e até mais!

Wir hatten einen sehr schönen Aufenthalt. Die Unterkunft sah aus wie beschrieben, war in einer Wohngegend und daher sehr ruhig. 
Mit der Metro kam man überall sehr gut hin. Es gab mehrere Metro Stationen in der Nähe die in ein paar Minuten zu Fuß zu erreichen sind. Die Busstation ist auch direkt in der Nähe. Auch ein Supermarkt war nicht weit. 
Leider mussten wir für unsere 1 Woche Urlaub eine Packung Klopapier kaufen wovon wir nur eine Rolle benutzt haben. Es gab 2 Rollen für uns als wir ankamen. Da könnte man bei einer Woche noch eine Rolle dazulegen damit sowas nicht nötig ist. Wir hatten auch Probleme mit der Tür ins Haus. Das könnte besser kommuniziert werden dass man da sehr viel rumprobieren muss um die Tür aufzubekommen. Wenn man den Dreh raus hat klappts und als wir eine Nachricht geschrieben haben dass wir nicht reinkommen wurde sofort geantwortet. 
Und ist manchmal ein leicht „modriger“ Geruch aufgefallen der von der Klimaanlage kommen könnte.

Beautiful city and great place to stay. The apartment location is perfect, We walked everywhere, but anyone going there needs to know the streets are very steep. The beach area is nice as well as the river. If you want a rooftop experience for sunset go early, have some wine and there is probably live music by a street performer.

Lovely apartment in a great location in Porto. Clean, comfortable, and well equipped. The host was friendly and helpful, and communication was excellent. We really enjoyed our stay and would happily return!

Lieben Dank für die tolle Unterkunft! Wir haben uns sofort wohl gefühlt & würden sie sofort ein weiteres Mal erneut buchen. Besonders positiv möchte ich die sehr freundliche & hilfsbereite Kommunikation hervorheben!

Rosario’s place is a little gem in Porto! The apartment itself is adorable and perfect for 2 people. It was spotless and had all the amenities you could think of. The location is fantastic! Walking distance to so many great sights and fantastic restaurants. As far as hosts, Rosario went above and beyond to communicate with us. She offered restaurant suggestions, as well as detailed directions on a beautiful trip to the Douro Valley (a highlight of our trip!). Her communication was excellent in every way. We will definitely be back to Porto and would LOVE to stay here again. ❤️

Terrific spot so close to restaurants and all that Porto has to offer. The accommodation was clean and host was friendly. We stayed on the top floor where it was very quiet. Loved the neighboring restaurants.

We stayed at Pedro’s place for a few days before going on the Camino. Pedro was a very responsive and accommodating host, allowed us to check in early and was helpful throughout. The place itself is in a great location close to everything and very comfortable and clean. Highly recommend.
Lovely place in a great location
No geral, bastante positiva.

La localización es excelente y el anfitrión bueno, pero el alojamiento necesita mejorar bastante en limpieza y mantenimiento. La ducha tenía hongos, encontramos muchos pelos por la casa y en el colchón, además de bastantes hormigas en el baño. Para el precio que pagamos y teniendo en cuenta las instalaciones, consideramos que es demasiado caro y no ofrece una buena relación calidad-precio
Would highly recommend. Beautiful view!

El apartamento estaba impecable, prácticamente nuevo , bien amueblado, tener dos habitaciones y dos baños completos es una gran ventaja!!!! La cocina totalmente equipada , con lavavajillas incluido . El departamento espacioso y los aires acondicionados son imprescindibles en una vista a la bella Oporto durante el verano ! Gran estancia!!

Nice place with a very good location. They had minor damages on the bed and bathroom. Sofa couch was not comfy. 
Easy to get in and clear instructions.

It was great staying for 5 days. Very responsive host. My only thing is that I wished there were screens on the windows as it was so hot and no air conditioning and the fan can’t do the job. But definitely a great location.

Logement impeccable 
Décoré avec du goût 
Tout est propre 
Accessible et restauration très accessible

Alojamiento muy cómodo q se ajustaba a mis necesidades, dotado de todo lo indispensable, limpio y relativamente próximo a los sitios de interés. Me parece acertado en todos sus aspectos, un 10… gracias…
Todo perfecto

Die Unterkunft war wunderbar, genau wie beschrieben. Schöne Gestaltung der Wohnung. Die Lage ist super. Fußläufig sind tolle Bars und Restaurants zu erreichen. 
Ich habe mich sofort wohl und sicher gefühlt. Die Wohnung ist für die nächste Porto Reise aufjedenfall schonmal gespeichert!🫶🏼
We had a lovely stay here. The place was clean and spacious, a 3 minute walk from the metro and the hosts were very helpful and friendly 😊
We had a really great stay- the apartment was clean, spacious and well-located. Guest Ready were communicative and gave us all the check-in and check-out information required.
Renato was wonderful to communicate with, the place was excellent and I’d highly recommend staying here
Super apartamento

You can’t beat the location of this apartment! Walking distance from loads of sights, great food, and tours. Also tucked away enough to be quiet at night for sleep. We discovered a wine bar called Dogma just steps away from the apartment, and the owner, Vasili made our trip so memorable and special — highly recommend.

This truly felt like a luxury getaway. The rock walls of the original stone building, are right there in your modern living room. The area of town was just right. Batalha placa a half block down the street had several restaurants and bars including several Gazela locations (famous puppy hot dogs) as well as the closest parking garage (garagem Iberia) where you can reserve multi-day parking. Walk down the hill to main river frontage was about 12-15 minutes. Definitely worth choosing a bit longer, less sloped route back up the hill rather than the stairs up the cliff like river gorge. But do-able, even for our >65 year old bodies. We loved Porto, doubly because of our stay at this beautiful central apartment

The flat has a lot to recommend it but it's not in the listing. Location is great. Cute street with a lovely tapas restaurant and fab cocktail bar just below flat.
But..there was no house folder (although I found one in the back of the cleaning cupboard on the last day). Nothing useful on arrival, not even a small bottle of water in the fridge. Lots of Yourhost mongrammed stuff...towels, toiletries, dressing gowns trying to give hotel vibes but tatty posters explaining rules and cheap furniture was more hostel vibes. 
Hosts are awful. I told them I was arriving late and they said to call if I needed help but when I did to ask if the air con was only in the kitchen or if there was a fan I got yelled at for thinking they could do anything and for calling so late. They told me to leave if I didn't like it but that I had to go straight away. Single woman, 11.30pm on a Saturday night! Just an awful attitude. 
Great flat for enjoying Porto, just avoid dealing with Yourhost.

Muito melhor que esperado e as fotos não fazem justiça ao espaço. Foram super acolhedores, tanto através dos mimos como da forma como trataram do espaço e até a falar connosco. Certamente voltarei para aproveitar mais este espaço acolhedor no meio de uma bela vista! Muito obrigado por tudo! ❤️
Meets the requirement, though the elevator waa not working many times.
Great location, very cool apartment

It was a nice place 
Indeed the walls are thin but that was not a problem for me the stay was perfect 
Absolutely recommend it!
Ottima posizione, ben arredato, servizi vicini e posteggio incluso. Pulito e accogliente. Grazie!
Impecável! Adorei tudo!
Beautiful Airbnb. Very clean. Responsive hosts. Great restaurants and bakery nearby. Quiet area at night.
Henrique tiene un alojamiento muy amplio y cómodo. Valoramos mucho los dos baños y la calidad del alojamiento.
Merci beaucoup pour ce séjour s'est déroulé parfaitement rien à dire logement impeccable approximité de la ville je recommande fortement

A hospedagem foi ótima! O apartamento estava muito limpo e organizado, e foi muito agradável ficar aqui. A cama era muito macia e os travesseiros eram ótimos, o que deixou a estadia ainda mais confortável. Tivemos uma ótima experiência no Porto!

We had an amazing stay in Porto with my two daughters! Cristiana and Daniel are wonderful, kind, and very responsive hosts. The apartment is in a great location, very clean, and has everything you need to feel at home. It was even better than expected!
We will definitely recommend it to our friends and would love to stay here again. ❤️
Lovely apartment in a great location, everything very walkable. Great base to explore the city, nice and spacious with a lovely balcony.

Great location, we could walk to all attractions. The only minus were the windows, it opens on the opposite part (not the street) and there were ventilations from several restaurants, it smelled fried food. We preferred to keep the windows closed!
Nice apartment , so close to everything, had a bit trouble with the lock , need to be gental, but otherwise all good.

This apartment is exactly how it is described. It is a very good location, only 15-20 minute walk from the riverside area. The host was really responsive and gave detailed instructions and amazing restaurant recommendations. Would go back again
The apartment was in a great location and was very clean. The shared amenities like the kitchen were very convenient and the outdoor space was a very nice cute area to chill.

Très bon séjour .à proximité des restaurants, visite à pied de porto et à 15 mn du Douro.
Petits problèmes d'évacuation de l'eau de la douche à régler. Mais nous avons passé un super moment et reviendrons si l'occasion se présente.
Ótimo apartamento

Primero para las personas que tengan un poco de desconfianza como fue mi caso por las pocas valoraciones que tenían les digo que pueden reservar sin problema. 
Mi experiencia en general fue buena, teniendo en cuenta que el apartamento para mí está en una zona excelente, en 15 minutos o menos estás en el centro, aparte tienes caminando a 2 minutos un tranvía que te deja en el corazón de oporto. Las fotos son exactamente como se anuncia, tuvimos un problema porque el apartamento no abría con la llave que nos dejaron sin embargo respondieron muy rápido a pesar de la hora. Me gustó el ambiente la limpieza y todo espacioso recomendado . 
Puntos negativos : 
1-La cama para mí me parece demasiado incómoda es muy dura al igual que sus almohadas.
2- el apartamento tiene hormigas y aveces se cuelan en la cama y te pican, este fue el punto muy negativo tengo la piel aún con picaduras. 
3 - tiene un pequeño patio pero parece que en la noche no tienen luces ( o no sé si no la conseguí.

Fantastic stay! We stayed here 4 nights and was our favorite spot for our whole trip. All of the amenities were included so we didn’t need to purchase anything except water. The bed and linens were very soft and comfortable. The air conditioning was great. There was some construction going on outside our garage, but the host met us on the street and helped guide us inside upon arrival, which was extremely helpful. The place is slightly out of the city center so the cafe’s & restaurants were more local and less pricy! The host were excellent with communication and quick with responses. Highly recommended this spot!

This was an ideal stop off on the Camino. The host was very helpful and responded instantly and arranged a corkscrew to be dropped off within 5 minutes once it became apparent it had gone missing. Rooms did get warm at night despite the fans but otherwise a comfortable stay and good value for money.
Espaço muito confortável e aconchegante, forma atenciosos na recepção, durante a estadia e ao fim também

A beautiful apartment in a quiet part of town, but still with Porto within easy reach. The bars and restaurants are all walkable and there is a tram right on the doorstep. A lidl is close by for any groceries you might need but we spent most of our time eating out, there are so many places to eat and drink. The apartment is cosy but modern, and yhe shower is huge! Highly recommended if you plan on exploring Porto.
Easy check in, had no problem accomodating a very late arrival (1am) since it is self check in. Great location. Safe. Clear and quick communication. thanks!
Overall a great stay, the place was as described, pretty well equipped. The host was always attentive and responsive to any questions/concerns encountered. The location was great

Es war toll, groß, alles gibt's in der Wohnung, und Waschmaschine Klimaanlage Backofen ...
Vielen Dank
Helena es muy amable, nos ayudó mucho y siempre estuvo al pendiente, el departamento de fácil acceso bien ubicado para moverse a la ciudad

War mit meine Familie in Porto, es hat uns super gefallen, ruhige Lage , alles schnell erreichbar, und der Nähe vom Meer , Metro und tollen fischrestsaurars Fischrestaurants ..
Vielen Dank

This was our favorite stay during our three weeks of traveling through Spain and Portugal! When I tell you this place is worth it, believe me!! 
The apartment was absolutely beautiful and spotless, with incredibly clean and comfortable beds. It’s on the 5th floor, but the lift made getting our luggage up and down so easy. The AC worked perfectly, and despite being on a busy street, it was surprisingly quiet at night with the windows closed.
The location is unbeatable, putting you right in the heart of the best part of the city. Everything about this stay was wonderful, and we genuinely looked forward to coming home every night after exploring.
Nice place to stay in city centre of Porto. We really enjoyed the stay.

"We had a wonderful stay! The apartment was very clean and well-equipped, especially the kitchen which had everything we needed. The AC worked amazing, keeping the space perfectly comfortable.
The location is highly convenient—just a short walk to the metro, grocery stores, and pastry shops. We loved that the area is not touristy, and it was perfectly quiet at night for sleeping. Plus, it is just a short Uber ride to the riverfront or any other spot in the center of town.
The indoor parking space was also convenient for us. 
The host greeted us in person upon arrival and made us feel very welcome. Highly recommend this place!"
A lovely modernised apartment in a superb central location. Situated at rear of building it was very quiet despite location. Host was quick to respondcand assist when required.

What an absolute gem of a place! Right in the heart of the old town; a stone’s throw away from bars, restaurants & shops. 
The apartment itself was lovely & spacious. Perfect for our group of six friends. We all had plenty of space & plenty of bathrooms for us all to use. 
It could be a little noisy on an evening, but that’s what you expect from being in the heart of town. Beds were lovely & comfy & the whole place was spotlessly clean & very well equipped. 
We highly recommend this place and wouldn’t hesitate to use again if we return to Porto. 
Host was super helpful & very responsive to messages. 
All in all, a 10/10 experience!

The views from the place were amazing and the location was excellent. Just a short walk away is the iconic bridge and the start of the beautiful downtown area. The hosts were very accommodating and allowed us to store our luggage while they got the place ready for us. The back room was very spacious but we did find it a little tight for 6 adults with the fold out couch being needed in the front living area. We didn’t find any dish cloths or dish towels to use but we managed. Overall it is an amazing place and would definitely stay there again.

Our stay was very enjoyable Hugo was a super host who met us at the airbnb and explained everything .the airbnb was spacious clean comfortable with use of a swimming pool and very close to the beach .

First and foremost the Host was Amazing!! The accommodations were 10 out of 10! Awesome location. Quiet for sleeping but down the street was outdoor live music. Great water pressure in the shower! The bed was super comfy. Not one complaint. Awesome place, book it now don’t hesitate!
Perfectly located in the heart of Porto. The location was clean and ideal for our weekend away with the boys.

Great apartment in the perfect place to get around Porto. Very clean and communication was great.
We highly recommend
Absolutely incredible location. Apartment was perfect. Communication is spot on and super helpful
Flott leilighet med meget god beliggenhet. Stort pluss for solfylt terrasse og god utsikt. Bra valuta for pengene, anbefales!

Luis was a very attentive host. Always responded promptly and was super helpful. The unit was clean and my husband really appreciated the air conditioning in the bedrooms. The kitchen was pristine and the beds were comfortable. We liked that we could walk to a near by metro station and or uber (bolt) very easily to and from the airport. I would highly recommend Luis’ place when staying in Porto!

Tudo referente ao apartamento foi bom. Boa localização. Boas toalhas. Bons travesseiros e bons lençóis. Estávamos em cinco pessoas e super nos acomodou bem. Único detalhe è um dos banheiros que è muito muito pequeno e se a pessoa estiver acima do peso, terá dificuldades para entrar no box para banho.
Lugar agradável, locaria novamente, com certeza

交通：方便，metro站及巴士站在幾分鐘步程之內。並附有停車位可供使用超。
生活配套：附近有超市，餐廳及咖啡室，非常方便。
單位處於住宅區，並無一般旅遊區的繁囂，可以體驗到真實生活在Porto的感覺。景觀上，面向一大幅草地，睡房有露台，環境優美，令人感到放鬆。
Très belle appartement en plein cœur de Porto , idéal pour visiter les alentours en bus et ou métro je recommande.
Bel appartement avec parking privatif à 2 pas du centre historique de Porto qui est une ville dynamique et belle, très différente de Lisbonne. Je ne peux que recommander.
We loved Porto and staying here was really lovely. A bit of a walk to get to the centre but we enjoyed being in “real Porto” as well as doing the tourist thing!

The apartment was beautiful and in such a great location. Close to the city center with lots to do in the area. The hosts were very friendly and left great recommendations for shops and restaurants in the area. I would love to stay here again!
Really great house, with an amazing garden!! The host reacted very quick and with clear explanation. Near Porto but your own silent, private house! Would advice everyone to go here!

Chambre propre et suffisamment spacieuse avec salle de bain attenante.
Merci à Aurore et Alberto pour leur accueil, leurs conseils et leur disponibilité.
Nous recommandons sans restrictions
Great parent and location.
Todo muy bien. Muchas gracias!

Wir haben uns in der Wohnung wirklich sehr wohlgefühlt! Sie ist super toll und mit viel Liebe zum Detail eingerichtet und vor allem tadellos sauber.
Auch die Ausstattung ist super – es ist wirklich alles vorhanden, von der gut ausgestatteten Küche mit Geschirrspüler bis hin zur Waschmaschine.
Die Gegend ist angenehm ruhig und die Lage trotzdem perfekt, um schnell überall hinzukommen. Christina hat uns ausserdem tolle Tipps für Restaurants und Unternehmungen in Porto und Umgebung gegeben, die wir sehr geschätzt haben.
Wir hatten eine richtig schöne Zeit und würden jederzeit wiederkommen. Vielen Dank für alles! 😊

Vanskelig kommunikation, de kommunikerer på 3 platforme. Både Airbnb, Whatapp og min mail. Alt for meget info og systemer.
Gardiner hang i laser i ene værelse
Ellers super fint med 4 værelser når man er en gruppe

Second time we have chosen yo stay here- good location for exploring the city by metro. As previous reviews lift in the building is well used and noisy however you do seem to get used to it ! Contcted host on a few tbings that were resolved same day whilst we were out - no concerns regarding response / action being taken by host in order to address.

Super location in the Ribeira district.
Easy walking to the waterfront and attractions. Many top quality bars and restaurants nearby.
Great to have underground parking as part of the facility.
Challenging access by car through the pedestrian areas and tight access but don’t be daunted!

Appartement très bien nous étions 6 donc nous avons dormis sur le canapé seul bémol la fenêtre côté rue très très bruyante peu de répit même la nuit. Quartier accessible facilement avec les transports

As a family of 4 we loved the apartment… the photos do not do it justice. Beautiful decor, high quality bed linen and the architecture of the apartment.
The location was quiet with a local neighbourhood feel. Local cafes, supermarket and restaurants yet close to the centre
Would highly recommend for a local stay just outside of the hubbub of the city - thank you!

Le logement était parfaitement situé, nous étions à 3km du départ du semi marathon de Porto et proche du centre ville nous permettant de faire l'ensemble des déplacements à pied. 
Nous avons adoré le logement, qui nous a semblé plus grand que sur les photos et qui a été rénové avec soin
Wir hatten einen wundervollen Aufenthalt. Vom appartment aus konnte man die ganze Stadt entdecken. Der kleine Balkon lud ein sein Frühstück oder Abendessen im urban Altstadt-Feeling zu genießen.

We loved the house, modern but cosy and close to the centre of Porto. Really enjoyed ourselves with all the amenities. We were welcomed with snacks and wine and the hosts went out of their way to help us when we had a little mishap with the Portugese toll-system. If I could more than 5 stars I would. Definitely recommend this place.

Un super séjour chez Antonio !
Le logement est très bien situé, nombreux restaurants à proximité, pont Luis accessible en moins de 5 minutes à pied.
L'appartement est très agréable, propre et bien équipé. Mention spéciale pour les ventilateurs appréciés après les journées chaudes de Porto !
Je recommande à 100%

Een heel fijn en ruim appartement! Voor ons 6en perfect voor een lang weekend Porto. Ook goed te wandelen naar het centrum, lekker dichtbij! Teresa communiceerde vriendelijk en heel vlot. Alles was top!

If you want a lovely apartment, right in the centre of things, this is your place! We loved it. Susana gave us some brilliant tips on where to go and the apartment was spotless and perfect for a girls weekend!

Wonderful stay, exactly what we'd hoped for. The apartment is really central and exactly as it appears in the photos. Joana and Luis communicated proactively so we always knew what to expect. We even got to check-in a little early which was much appreciated after an early morning flight. Lovely weekend thanks!

Wir hatten einen wirklich großartigen Aufenthalt bei Daniel! Das Airbnb liegt in allerbester Lage – mitten in einem tollen Viertel mit sehr guten Restaurants und Cafés, und gleichzeitig ist alles Wichtige bequem zu Fuß erreichbar.
Daniel ist ein unglaublich sympathischer und authentischer Gastgeber. Wir haben seinen angebotenen Flughafentransfer genutzt, der sehr unkompliziert und angenehm war. Auch während unseres Aufenthalts war Daniel jederzeit gut erreichbar und hatte tolle Tipps für Porto und unsere weitere Reise.
Die Wohnung selbst ist super ausgestattet, sehr sauber und hat alles, was man für einen schönen Aufenthalt braucht. Wir haben dort sogar selbst gekocht. Ein besonderes Highlight ist der Pool – perfekt, um sich nach einem Tag Sightseeing zu entspannen.
Wir würden jederzeit wiederkommen und können sowohl die Unterkunft als auch Daniel als Gastgeber absolut empfehlen!

Enjoyed 3 nights at Nuno’s apartment. Internally the property is just as you see in the photos. Very clean with all you might need for a short stay. Also very secure. All the main sights are walkable and generally downhill to get to. Nuno met us personally to check us in and we were able to get early access as we arrived early. Would be happy stay at the property again if in Porto.

We had a great stay at Sara & Hugo's place. Flexible check in & near Metro & all Porto attractions. Air con was v welcome due to hot weather during our stay. Its on a busy street but we had no noise problems during our stay. Several good restaurants less than 5 mins walk from the apartment & also a decent supermarket, so you wont go wrong staying here.
Daniel siempre estuvo atento en todo momento

This is my second time staying in an Airbnb in Porto and my experience was excellent. Cristina and Paula were very responsive, and were there to personally check us in which I thought was really nice. 
Very convenient to main area but slightly off the busy streets which was great. Highly recommend and would absolutely stay here again!
Excellent location in city centre. Good communications, comfy bed and everything we needed.
Recomiendo los apartamentos de VIVA para hospedarse en Oporto, ya sea para cortas o largas estancias.

Incredible stay. Magnificent view. Wonderful host! Everything was amazing. Central to everything, comfortable and enjoyable home with one of a kind view from the balcony with tub was a perfect experience. We saw so much of Porto and loved it all, thank you so much for everything Andrea!

We loved our stay here, the apartment was really comfortable, comfortable beds, lovely bed linen, a really well equipped kitchen, it was absolutely spotless, and we really enjoyed sitting on the very generous balcony. I really can't fault the apartment. It was close to all amenities, some great independent shops, and a brilliant record store. Thank you so much Sara.

Overall we had a great experience with this place. The space is gorgeous and while its location is a bit outside of the core downtown area, it felt like a real neighborhood. The hosts are responsive and helpful - the hair dryer stopped working while we were getting ready for a wedding and Luis brought us a replacement within a half an hour of reaching out to them, which was much appreciated! The coffee shop Bacco next door is also fantastic. The only thing I might note is that the beds are quite firm, which isn’t exactly ideal for side sleepers.

Appartamento in ottima posizione, moderno, pulito e con tutto il necessario per l’alloggio. Check in e check out semplici ed autonomi, possibilità di usufruire dei loro locker all’interno della struttura.

Excelente espaço
Muito bem localizado e equipado
Prático porque fica perto de tudo
Foi incrível
Loved our stay, everything about it was perfect and such a great location. We wished we could have stayed longer 🙌

Ana nous a très bien accueilli, son logement était fonctionnel et très agréable avec ses murs en pierres apparentes, le domaine est particulièrement calme et frais, les jardins parfaitement entretenus et verts, la piscine naturelle parfaite pour se rafraichir et farnienter sur le gazon.
Chaque jour, nous avons pu profité des chemins balisés proposés par Geo Parc. Bref un endroit d'exception idéal pour 2 personnes.

Es war ein sehr schönes Airbnb.
Perfekt für Porto zu erkunden. 
Ist sehr zu empfehlen .

Wir haben Porto für eine Woche besucht und diese Unterkunft war super dafür. Sie ist in einer eher ruhigeren Gegend aber es ist nicht weit bis zur Metro und man kommt auch zu Fuß schnell in belebtere Innenstadt. José hat uns alle Infos immer schnell gegeben und hat uns auch Empfehlungen für Restaurant geschickt. Die Wohnung war sauber und es war alles vorhanden was man so braucht (zur Küche kann ich keine genaueren Angaben machen da wir nur dort gefrühstückt haben, aber die war auch gut ausgestattet finde ich). Man hört es schon, wenn andere aus dem Haus nach Hause kommen, aber das hat uns nicht groß gestört.
Sehr schöne Wohnung, sehr sauber. Gute Zentrale Lage um Porto zu Fuß zu erkunden. Gastgeber sehr bemüht, freundlich und immer erreichbar. Wir waren sehr happy und zufrieden!
Great location, beautiful apartment with spectacular views. Brenda was quick to respond and gave great recommendations. Highly recommend and will definitely stay there again.

Localização fantástica, com a maia valia do Estacionamento. Acesso com algum grau de dificuldade, mas nada de muito especial. Espaço amplo, limpo,.com todas as comodidades.
Só não conseguimos fechar as persianas totalmente, o que ao amanhecer sempre entrava alguma uz no apartamento.
Recomendo

We had a great stay in Porto! The location is perfect, with the city center easily reachable on foot. Luis was a fantastic host, always available, very friendly and easy to communicate with. He also gave us lots of great recommendations for restaurants, bars and sights. Highly recommended!

Christophe à été de bons conseils et très réactif !
Le logement est placé dans une zone pavillonaire et paisible !
Beaucoup de commerces dans les environs environs !

We had a lovely weekend stay at the Look apartments this September. Isabel was very responsive when we had questions and always very friendly. The apartment itself is at the top of the building and there's no noise from the outside or other residents. It was spotless, plenty of extra clean towels and nice extra little things like a TV and books to read, if you want. The air-conditioning is a life-saver, there's one in the bedroom and in the main living area (which is helpful when one of you is always too hot and the other is always too cold)! Kitchen has all the things you might need like a stove, kettle, toaster and a fridge but in Porto we ate all of our meals out anyway. We couldn't store our luggage on check-out day in the apartment, which is understandable, but there is a Bounce location only a few minutes away which you can use. The Look is in the perfect spot in town, we didn't use any buses or taxis, and quick from Lapa train station. Highly recommend The Look for all couples!

Maria was a great host and even met us at the apartment and drew out recommendations on a local map. They left us a bottle of homemade port wine from a friend, a stocked bar, and fresh apples from her garden. The place was cozy and just far enough from the crowded tourist areas along river. Would absolutely recommend staying with Maria!
Un apartamento muy cómodo y luminoso, ubicado a pocos minutos de lo más lindo de la ciudad. Recomendamos sin dudas.
It was a nice stay

The hosts’ communication was top notch. The space was perfectly comfortable for 2 people & was equipped with all we needed. Water pressure was great, towels were soft & generously sized & bed was very comfortable. Location couldn’t be better!
Great stay! Amazing view and nice modern apartment! Very comfortable, highly recommend!

This is a beautiful apartment with everything you need to explore Porto. Fatima’s recommendations were amazing, and she even provided a bag drop for us as we arrived really early. The balcony made it for us…. Sitting with a port listening to the street musicians was a highlight! If you pop across to Portuguese port shop across Road you can take a picture of the balcony from the first floor. I sent my husband across and we got a fab picture and he got a port! Just book it, it is a perfect as it looks.

Nice apartment in very good location - basically in the center, everything in walking distance. The apartment is quite small but has everything needed.
It was nice that it didn't get too hot inside even on very warm days (and there is also air condition if needed).
It can get a bit noisy from the road nearby, with windows opened.
Márcia was very responsive and helpful.
Overall it was a nice and good value stay.

We had a wonderful stay at this apartment. The beds, pillows and bed linen were super comfy. Everything was clean. We had everything we needed in the kitchen too. The size of the rooms was also great. We did have 1 aircon unit that didn’t really work which was a little inconvenient although the host did tell us the day beforehand and provided a fan which was much appreciated. If you are a light sleeper I would recommend not having the front bedroom as there is quite a bit of noise from the street and corridor - cannot be helped but may disturb sleep.
All in all we have a great stay and would recommend this place
Really lovely area. Overlooking a beautiful building. Nice location and lovely hosts

Appartement pour 5 personnes, à 25 mn à pieds du centre 
Un peu éloigné du centre mais au calme 
On entend néanmoins les voitures qui passent dans la rue 
Supermarchés et boulangerie à 7 mn à pieds

Ricardo was excellent at communicating and very accommodating. He showed us all the facilities in the apartment. The location is spot on, directly across the road from our favourite beach bar. The apartment is spacious and light and very well equipped. Having the sea facing balcony was the icing on the top
Sehr zu empfehlen.

Had a lovely stay at Carolina's listing. The flat was clean, tidy and in a great location. Carolina was very responsive and super helpful, communication was clear and timely. Would definitely recommend staying there.

Very pleased with our stay in beautiful Porto. The loft is in a great location to walk everywhere. We really enjoyed the walk down to the riviera. The location is still quiet but close to access all the hustle and bustle if you need. It has a lovely view from the windows. Even though it was quite hot inside because of unseasonable temperatures, Nuno provided a fan which was very helpful! Nuno was very helpful and responsive. Thanks so much for a great stay!
Top!

We have had the best 3 nights staying at this beautiful duplex apartment. From booking to leaving the experience was exceptional. The duplex is really spacious. All amenities thought through and a lovely welcome pack. Jose Luis and Luisa were great hosts and did everything possible to make our stay comfortable. Lots of top tips! As a group of 4 friends we would highly recommend this duplex if you are visiting the beautiful city of Porto.
Lovely little apartment in a good location.
Stunning location as long as you don’t mind a few steps/the hill. Wonderful view, well equipped kitchen

Nous sommes enchanté de notre séjour sur tout les points. Cependant un point particulier est à retenir c'est la gentillesse incroyable de Joachim envers ses vacanciers. Toujours à l'écoute et prêt à rendre service. Tous les matins viennoiseries et gâteau était discrètement accroché à notre porte. Nous avons partagé avec Joachim et son copain Angelo de merveilleux moments d'amitiés et de partage que nous n'oublieront jamais. Sincèrement si vous désirez allez à Porto c'est une adresse incontournable
Very friendly and responsive hosts. Great location close to Sao Bento station, markets and buses
Hôte super réactif et très serviable! L’appartement est très bien équipé et propre.

We had a wonderful stay in Vanessa’s apartment-the location was spot on being close to bars and restaurants but peaceful and quiet at night. Vanessa was the perfect host as she responded quickly to our questions and requests to check out a bit later than planned. We’d highly recommend staying here.

L’appartement est idéalement situé dans une petite rue calme dans le centre ce qui permet de visiter le centre ville à pied. Patricia nous a également donné des conseils pour visiter Porto et a toujours été très réactive.

Great apartment for our weekend away. It’s outside of the city centre so nice and quiet but very close to a lovely park and only a short walk to restaurants etc. Everything was clean and matched the description.
An incredible apartment in a great location. Isabel and Igor were incredibly helpful in preparation for and throughout our stay. Everything was perfect!

Super centraal gelegen appartement, met heel veel op loopafstand. De absolute highlight is de patio met uitzicht: echt waanzinnig. We hebben hier uren gezeten en genoten.
De slaapkamers zijn wat aan de kleine kant, maar daar staat tegenover dat de andere ruimtes juist heel ruim zijn, zoals de hal, woonkamer en keuken. Ook het geluid aan de straatkant viel ons alles mee.
Florinda is ontzettend vriendelijk en enthousiast en reageert heel snel. Het strijkijzer stond bijvoorbeeld wel op de inventarislijst, maar bleek niet aanwezig. Geen probleem: Florinda kwam het meteen brengen.
Enige kleine minpuntje: ons vliegtuig landde pas rond 22.00 uur en voor inchecken na 22.00 uur geldt een toeslag van €25. Gezien de prijs van het appartement vonden we dat wel wat jammer.
Al met al een heel fijn verblijf op een toplocatie, met vooral een patio die we niet snel zullen vergeten.

The apartment was ideal for two friends going away together for the first time. Very clean and spacious with added benefit of beautiful garden to enjoy breakfast and birdsong. Eduardo was there to welcome us and on check out when we returned later on our last day to collect our luggage. Thanks to Helena and Eduardo for being great hosts. Would highly recommend.
