Great location! Very close to a lot of cafes, restaurants, chapels. The apartment had everything you would need - iron, washing machine, towels, dish soap and cutlery. 
Very beautiful windows and cute little balcony overlooking the street. 
Worth booking!
Tudo top!
1인 여행에 적합한 숙소!
Una atención muy buena

While we had issues flying in, the host was very communicative, accommodating and easy to reach. The place was actually very comfortable
For my 2 daughters and I, A/C in every room and in the living room/kitchen. The flat is located 20-minute walk from the main touristic area which made it ideal for us on a 4-day tourist break. Highly recommended.

Séjour très agréable en plein centre de Porto (ou presque). L’appartement est clair, propre, fonctionnel et bien décoré. La Clim a été appréciable. L’accueil est facilité (système de codes) et l’hôte très réactif. Le garage pour la voiture est un vrai plus. 
Le seul bémol est le chant du coq le matin, un son inattendu en ville.
Schöne Unterkunft in Innenstadt Nähe. Alles sauber und flexibler Check in.

Really nice modern apartment. Very large - one of the largest apartments with large bedrooms I’ve seen in all of Europe. 3 bedroom/suites, big living room, nice modern kitchen, and a great varanda. The location is very near the Bolhão market and very convenient overall.
All good!

This apartment was exactly as described by words and photos. It was very close to all the shops and an Auchan for groceries but also felt quiet and safe. There is a washer, fridge, freezer, and two air conditioners. GuestReady provided some laundry detergent, cooking oil, etc for use.
O apartamento está bem localizado. A limpeza é que deixa muito a desejar. Debaixo da cama tinha um pacote de batata frita e a banheira estava negra ☹️
heerlijk en centraal
Una maravilla , súper limpia y la ubicación perfecta . Las camas era súper cómodas
Casa fantástica, espaçosa e com muito estilo

Not-bad but not-great experience here. The location was not in as convenient, especially for an older visitor (e.g. my 70-year-old mother)—a bit of a walk from the main tourist areas (all uphill on the way back). The dumpster outside the entrance and ongoing construction next door was unfortunate, but likely a temporary issue. The apartment itself was fine (clean and comfortable), though a bit smaller than it looked in photos. No car parking (though that was on me for not double-checking explicitly beforehand). The greenhouse terrace was a little disappointing: it’s on a separate floor (though it is private), in full sun all day, and the lock on the door was nearly broken, so we didn’t end up using it at all. The host was communicative and responsive, though, which was helpful…though communication was through a management company, and required using an older, clunky web app for submitting extra info beyond Airbnb’s normal info…which felt a bit impersonal.

Apparemment idéalement placé. 
Je recommande fortement.

Der Aufenthalt bei Lurdes war toll! 
Ich konnte super flexibel einchecken, da ich schon früh in Porto ankam. 
Die Unterkunft war exakt wie auf den Fotos, und super sauber! Tolle Empfehlung :)
Paisible
Excelente ubicación, muy moderno apartamento , con muy lindo jardín,

Ein sehr schönes airbnb mit ruhiger Lage und Umgebung. Man kann sich auf jeden Fall wohlfühlen! Die Wohnung war gut ausgestattet und sauber. Einziger Minuspunkt ist, dass nur ein kleiner Minimarkt zu Fuß erreichbar ist und man für einen größeren Lebensmitteleinkauf besser ein Auto haben sollte. Alles in allem aber tolle Wohnung und sehr netter Gastgeber!

Konaklamamızdan genel olarak çok memnun kaldık. Ev temiz, düzenli ve fotoğraflardaki gibiydi. Konumu da oldukça güzeldi ve ihtiyaç duyduğumuz her şeye rahatça ulaşabildik. Pedro iletişim konusunda yardımcı ve ilgiliydi. Keyifli bir konaklamaydı, tekrar tercih edebiliriz. Teşekkür ederiz!
Heel vriendelijk!!
Todo genial, estaba muy limpio y muy bien ubicado. Tenia dos espacios y era muy amplio. Habia humedades pero es normal estando en oporto, pero volveria sin duda!!

We were in Porto for three days and this apartment was perfect. It was clean, quiet, and full of character. Great access to shops, restaurants, and a beautiful park. Our host was friendly and accommodated an early check-in on very short notice. A very memorable stay :)

O apto do Tiago é simplesmente fantástico..tem tudo o que voce precisa para uma estadia tranquila ..além dele ser uma pessoa acessível em todos os momentos ...nao tenham a menor dúvida em alugar esse imóvel...
Perto de tudo da pra fazer todos os pontos a pé...
Parabéns Tiago voce é 10 como se diz no brasil !!!!
Excellent location very walkable. The apartment is well equipped, with all the basic needs, hot water in the shower, great air conditioning and access to the main things to do in the city.

Great stay right the heart of Porto. The bedrooms are further back in the apartment so we didn’t hear the noise from the Square. We parked our car at a near parking lot and Ubered up to the Airbnb location. Lots of food and coffee options right outside our doorstep.
Résidence très jolie et moderne excellent pour un séjour à porto
Logement très agréable et fonctionnel, propriétaire très arrangeant, merci Maria

We enjoyed our stay in Porto very much. The location of the apartment is perfect with easy access to both Porto and Gaia and a beautiful river view. The apartment was clean and comfortable and Isabel and Igor were responsive hosts. We highly recommend this location!
Appartement très bien placé et très moderne !
Vše hezky připravené čisté určitě doporučuji komunika skvělá Vše zařízeno dobrá dostupnost do centra

Super tolle Unterkunft! 
Man ist super zentral, es gibt Parkmöglichkeiten in der Umgebung und die Unterkunft war sehr sauber. 
Eine absolute Empfehlung.
Tudo muito bom e exatamente igual às fotos.

Abbiamo soggiornato qui solo 2 notti ma se dovessimo tornare a Porto sarà la nostra prima scelta. Appartamento moderno, pulito ordinato e molto ampio per 2 persone. Gli host sono stati sempre precisi e reattivi anche per risolvere un piccolo problema con lo scarico del nostro bagno.
La casa contiene tutto il necessario ed è un una posizione ottima per visitare la città a piedi. La zona è tranquilla e non arrivano rumori molesti dalla strada, ma unica piccola pecca a volte si sentono i vicini e chi soggiorna al piano superiore ( probabilmente il parquet dei pavimenti produce questo suono) ma è per noi mai stato un problema per riuscire a dormire.
Great place! 5 minutes from the madness of the old town.. lots of cafes/restaurants.. fantastic transport links and the apartment is very peaceful.. thanks a lot!
It is a great place cosy comfortable and extremely clean. Lots of convenient small items like at home . Thank you.
Clean and simple apartment, with all things you need including kitchen etc. easy self check-in.
Thank You!
Es un lugar muy cómodo tranquilo y bien ubicado, tiene todo lo necesario, para una estancia agradable.

Foi maravilhosa! Recomendo de olhos fechados. Superou nossa expectativa. Sônia uma pessoa muito simpática no atendimento. Fabia nos recebeu muito bem. Sônia deixou um vinho do porto maravilhoso e uma agua p nós. Obrigada! Ao voltar em Portugual ficarei novamente nesse apto.
Thanks - great place & even better location!
Great location, very clean and welcoming and friendly. Highly recommended especially for the location.

Wir haben uns in der Unterkunft total wohl gefühlt.
José hat uns vom Bahnhof abgeholt, Tipps und Empfehlungen gegeben und war jederzeit erreichbar. 
Danke für die schöne Zeit.
Très bon séjour !! Je recommande

Had a great stay here; cute as a button and just as described. Daniel and Cristiana were very communicative and also helped switch out a Nespresso maker that wasn’t working quite well the same day. There was a loud music festival going on outside the balcony for the 3 nights I was there which wasn’t great timing for me, but no fault of the host. Would definitely stay again. Thanks!
Alles tip top, schöne moderne und ruhige Wohnung direkt am Strand. Je nach Verkehr benötigt man 20-25 min in die Stadt.

Nice appartement. 
Near metro 
Staff very nice.
Just checking time at 4pm is very late.
Apartamento muy limpio y con buena ubicación

Had a lovely time in Porto whilst staying at Alexandra and Pedro's property. The flat was small but had everything we needed for our stay. Hosts communicated well and the property was clean and well equipped. Note that the shower is exposed to the room by just a glass door so if you wanted some privacy when showering, you would need to cover the glass with something.

Carla was a great host. She was very easy to communicate from the very beginning, even considering the time differences between us when I booked. She was always friendly and made me feel like I could reach out to her anytime. The airbnb itself was gorgeous, very clean, I felt right at home. The bed was comfortable. I would stay here again.

Sehr moderne Wohnung, genau wie auf den Bildern. Sauber. Grosszügiger Garagenplatz. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Fussläufig zum Meer. Toller Meerblick und ruhige Umgebung. Wir kommen gerne wieder.

신혼여행 포르투갈 첫 시작 5박을 포르투 이곳에서 머물렀습니다. 밤 늦게 도착하였는데도 자물쇠함의 열쇠로 쉽게 체크인 할수 있었어요. 사진 그대로이고 더 좋아요. 침대도 편안하고 침구도 깨끗하고 수건,휴지,커피캡슐 등 모자름 없이 지내는동안 게스트가 편안할 수 있도록 호스트의 배려심과 따스함이 느껴졌습니다. 큰 창문의 뷰도 너무 좋아요. 매일 아침, 매일 밤 창문에 붙어서 뷰를 보면서 행복했어요. 위치도 좋아요. 바로 옆 볼량시장, pingo doce가 있어서 현지인처럼 장도 보고 너무 편리했어요. 오렌지쥬스, 납작복숭아 매일 사먹었습니다. 지하철역도 가까워서 모루정원까지 쉽게 갈 수 있어요. 한국분들 고민중이라면 도움이 되길 바라요. 너무 행복했습니다.
Peak communication, thanks to Carolina!!

We spent 3 lovely days exploring Porto. Mel's place was a perfect fit- close to all the fun yet nestled in a quiet neighborhood. The place is spotless & comfortable. Highly recommend it. Thanks very much Mel!
Josè e sua madre Maria estremamente cordiali e disponibili. Pulizia impeccabile! Super consigliato!

God beliggenhed i centrum. 
Boligen have alt hvad jeg havde brug for og god stemning.
Very nice room in the city centre. Quiet place but on a walkable distance from everything
Well located place. The host was also very helpful when we requested an extra blanket.
Hermoso alojamiento, con todo lo necesario para una estadía agradable
Excellent apartment, very clean and comfortable, with calming décor and a pleasant atmosphere. The location is also very convenient. We had a very pleasant experience and would happily recommend it.

A lovely spacious place that was very comfortable. We appreciated the fans during the hot weather. The kitchen is well fitted out and the sofa is very comfy. The bathroom shower works well too. Only point to mention is that if you are tallthe upper sleeps mezzanine has low headroom.
The location is very convenient for the metro and supermarkets, it's also walkable to the river.
The hosts are very professional and give clear information.
A comfortable stay in Porto!
Все супер!!!

El apartamento está muy cerca de Casa da Música, con buena combinación de metro y autobús. Está en una 4ª planta, con ascensor desde la 1ª planta. Está bastante bien, con mucha luz. Las camas muy cómodas. Está a menos de media hora andando a Sao Bento. La experiencia ha sido muy buena, aunque hemos tenido la mala suerte de que nos pillase una ola de calor y que unos vecinos decidieron dormir en la azotea de su vivienda y estuvieron charlando hasta altas horas. 
El barrio tiene muchos establecimientos interesantes y de todo tipo. La panaderia Regata está justo debajo y tiene unos productos buenísimos. Y frente de la entrada del metro de Casa da Música está la cafetería Luz da casa. Nos atendieron genial y comimos estupendamente. Y en la calle 5 de octubre, nos sorprendió la pizzeria Strega, con degustación de vinos italianos y portugueses. 
Y los días que comimos en el apartamento, tuvimos todos los utensilios necesarios.
Mn

Great location, nice appartement with an amazing shower and comfortable beds. It’s a bit heary and a lot of place creak when you walk around. Also the airco had trouble keeping the room from becoming too hot.

Le logement de Pedro correspond parfaitement aux photos!
Il est très propre et bien situé! Il nous a autorisé à déposer nos bagages avant le check in. La literie est top, si nous revenons à Porto nous irons à nouveau dans son logement.

Carolina was exactly the kind of host that a guest hopes for with an Airbnb. She was very helpful, responsive and easy to deal with. And of course, its always great when a host like Carolina answers your questions with kindness and patience. Thank you Carolina for making our stay in Port a good one!

Merci à Manuel pour son accueil. 
Le cadre de la maison est exceptionnel et permet vraiment de se reposer et profiter pleinement de la maison et de la piscine. 
Un grand merci aussi à Fatima pour sa gentillesse et les cadeaux apportés, fruits/legumes frais et pain. 
Je recommande fortement pour un groupe d’amis ou en famille.
Appartamento molto pulito e ben fornito, in una posizione comoda e di facile accesso, Joseph è super disponibile e reattivo per rispondere ad ogni domanda, lo consiglio

A lovely two-level apartment, spotlessly clean, modern and well maintained. We wished we could have stayed longer. The hosts were very responsive. The location was perfect for us, as we were taking part in the Porto half marathon, and you could not stay any closer to the start/finish. You can walk along the promenade to the nearby beaches, or get a historic tram or Uber into the city. (Ubers are very cheap in Porto).

Very private,lovely building,felt safe and quiet,plenty towels, modern kitchen.Josè very helpful with local amenities. 
We didn't have to go far for restaurants,cocktail bars,bakery and shop.
Centre so close to walk,
First time in Porto and loved it.
Would stay here again.
Great location, nice apartment and host was informative and helpful. However there were stains on the bed clothes and a dirty sock left behind from previous guest.

The view is fantastic and the place is very conveniently located near Dorru garden. Easy access to attractions in the city, and it is even easier to find a way back to the place. The place is equipped with kitchen and utensils. High ceiling makes the room feels more spaceous. Washing machine works great and 2 detergent blocks were provided. 
There might be few downsides for someone, but the view would make up for any shortcomings. The place worked out great for our 3 night stay.
房間維持的很乾淨，交通也很方便
The best accommodation we’ve experienced in Portugal.
Nice apartment in old part of Porto. Very close to great restaurants and markets.

Great location; however, the apartment smelled like bleach when we arrived, the second bedroom was not set-up with beds side by side as listed. 
The apartment also showed signs of inadequate preparation before arrival, including cleanliness and maintenance issues ... The kitchen and bathroom faucets are loose; the TV channels did not work (maybe it needs written instructions). 
Even though the unit is close to the Douro for some hopeful breeze, I strongly recommend investing in Air Conditioning, since the unit was very hot during our stay. The fans helped, but it was a very hot day!
Overall, a good unit, but not for two couples. A family with 2 children is more appropriate. Consider upgrading the second bedroom beds to larger beds or a full-size bed.
Please take our review as constructive suggestions and consider addressing our concerns.

Showers are very slippery because there is no antislip flooring. There are also no safety handrails to grab onto in shower.
Some Fridge shelving was cracked and fell apart easily with weight put on.
Only 1 shower towel per person for 3 days is not adequate.
Remote controls do not work properly for the air conditioners in the kitchen area.
Quiet apartment, nice view, lots of square footage space and sunlight into the apartment living area.

We thought this apartment was absolutely perfect for 2 people. Super walkable and comfortable. We we really impressed with the cleanliness and the small but well equipped kitchen area. There has been a heatwave while we stayed but the AC coped really well. There isn't a washing machine but we used a local launderette (Speed Queen) very easily and quickly. Loads of shops and restaurants in walking distance and a nice feel to the area.

La bienvenida fue estupenda, Ana fue muy amable. Nos recibieron con varias cosas de comer, frutas y de tomar, se agradece después de un largo viaje. Todo estaba impecable, nuevo y bien decorado.
Solo una cosa nos llamó la atención que el sofá cama era muy incómodo para dormir, se hunde al centro.
Tomamos muchos Uber, pues está un poco lejos del centro y con calor se hace cansador.
Heel fijn en ruim appartement met 3 slaapkamers met dubbele bedden - net wat we nodig hadden.

Amazing location. Just a few meters away from the sky tram that takes you to the water and port houses. Also easy walk down the steps. Terrace great for breakfast and beautiful sunsets. Well appointed kitchen. 2 large bathrooms. Ines very helpful and great communications. Discerning travelers and I highly recommend and would absolutely stay again. Lots of space and airy. If you are driving great to have the large garage. We appreciated our lovely stay.

Wir haben drei Nächte in der grossen Unterkunft mit der ganzen Familie (6Leute) verbracht. Die Badezimmer sind etwas klein und eines nicht sehr gut Beleuchtet. Man muss viele Treppen gehen im Airbnb. Ansonsten war alles super. Die Lage war perfekt. Alles ist zu Fuss sehr gut erreichbar.

Nous avons été ravi de notre séjour à l’appartement d’Elizabeth ! Tout était propre et confortable ! 
L’emplacement est à porter de tout ! Nous avons beaucoup aimé cet appartement . Je vous le recommande , il manque rien !
Excelente alojamiento cerca de todo lo necesario para pasar unos días.

We enjoyed our stay. The apartment itself was great - better than the photos - well equipped and clean. Location was great and very walkable to all the main Porto attractions. Carla was super responsive to any questions and check in was straight forward. Air Con was a bit noisy but worked well enough for us. The rooftop terrace was ideal, and we enjoyed relaxing there.

I absolutely lived the apartment. It was clean, well furnished and stylish. It has everything for comfortable stay. Location is very convenient too! Host was responding quickly and overall our communication was pleasant. 10/10 is stay there again!

Apartment was lovely, thank God for the great air-con ! Loads of places to eat nearby, directly across the road Nicolau serves a great breakfast. Close enough to most of the city sights. Really enjoyed our stay, we hope to return.
Limpieza y orden en un adosado cómodo y acondicionado con mimo. Una pena la falta de aire acondicionado porque hemos tenido días de mucho calor.

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment is beautiful, very well located, and everything was exactly as described. We found it very clean and in excellent condition when we arrived, and we made sure to leave it the same way -clean, tidy, and with everything back in its place.We really enjoyed our stay and would happily come back. Highly recommended.
O espaço é agradável, sossegado e ideal para descansar. Além disso, corresponde às fotos e descrição. O anfitrião mostrou-se bastante atencioso. Voltaremos ao espaço novamente.
Great place, central!
Ótima localização, perto da estação de metro que liga você a diretamente o centro do Porto, apartamento limpo e organizado perfeitamente pra duas pessoas.
Todo muy bien!
Чудові апартаменти в самому центрі міста, зручно дійти до будь-якої точки. Чисто, охайно. Доброзичливий господар!
Our quick stay in porto ended with a comfy bed and good shower. A great spot for a day spent out and about in the city to return to. Filipe was communicative and a great host.

The apartment was lovely and we really enjoyed our stay. The beds were comfortable, the bathrooms clean, and the kitchen sufficiently equipped. 
The hosts were quick to respond and offered some suggestions for places to see and eat. 
Would highly recommend.

Such a great location to stay and easy to walk to most places. 
The team was very responsive. I’d definitely stay there again!

Had a lovely stay in Porto thanks to the best host, Diego, who met us at the door and showed us the suite, shared great local recommendations, and was very responsive. The airbnb itself was perfect - AC, terrace, cool lighting, and plenty of thoughtful features all around. The kids loved the space so much they didn’t want to leave the house. Great neighborhood as well - quiet, but close enough to walk downtown. 
Definitely staying here again next time I’m in Porto!
Excelente servicio, todo de acuerdo a lo prometido, 100 por ciento recomendado

Departamento bastante céntrico del casco antiguo de Oporto. Todo queda a unos minutos a pie. 
El departamento está muy bien equipado, con todo lo necesario para cocinar, lavar la ropa, con armarios amplios. 
Sin embargo no lo recomendaría si hace mucho calor, ya que hay ruido de los restaurantes y de las botellas que tiran ya que el contenedor está justo enfrente. 
De ahí en fuera todo está muy bien, fácil de acceso y perfecto para unas vacaciones. Pero repito, las ventanas tienen que estar abiertas de manera casi continua para ventilar. Y hay un compromiso entre eso y el ruido.

Wir hatten tolle 3 Tage in dieser Unterkunft.
Der Blick auf den Fluss ist unbeschreiblich schön. Die Wohnung ist groß genug für 2 Personen. Supermarkt und Bäcker sind direkt vor der Haustüre. Das Haus ist sehr leise und ruhig.
In ca . 15 min ist man Laufweg ist man im Zentrum. Wir haben uns sehr wohlgefühlt.
Die Kommunikation war sehr schnell. Wir würden diese Wohnung zu 100% weiter empfehlen und wieder buchen wenn wir in Porto sind. Danke, dass wir hier übernachten durften.
Très pratique, Commerce et café à proximité

Wir hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt.
Der Balkon ist sehr groß und bietet einen schönen Ausblick über Porto. 
Carina hat uns sehr nett empfangen und schnell auf alle Nachrichten reagiert.
War eine tolle große Wohnung

Toplocatie! Dit appartement heeft alles om Porto te ontdekken. Op wandelafstand van 2 metrostation van waaruit je heel de stad kan doen. Op wandelafstand zit je ook in een heel bruisend deel van de stad met geweldige restaurants én cafeetjes. Het appartement zelf is ook heel aangenaam. Ruim en rustig. Met alle nodige voorzieningen. Dubbele badkamer is echt geweldig. Ook is het een mooi pand met een indrukwekkende trappenhal en heel rustig. Aanrader!

Estivemos realmente à vontade! A casa é muito confortável e fica mesmo em frente ao mar, dá para ouvir as ondas a partir da sala. A construção é muito recente e está tudo em perfeito estado. Tem estacionamento, fica numa zona tranquila e conta com um passeio pedonal agradável ao longo da costa e do rio. Viajámos com um bebé e disponibilizaram-nos um berço. A comunicação com o Diogo e a Maria foi muito fluida. Apenas como sugestão, as camas e as almofadas poderiam ser um pouco melhores.

Such a cute, clean apartment. We had everything we needed. The bed was comfortable and the air conditioning worked great. The balcony is peaceful! The hosts were helpful as we had a hard time finding the place. Use Google Maps and find it on the walking street. The parking garage is convenient and very close by. The host was so friendly and very kind. The location is within a couple blocks (5 minutes) of the beach to walk to. We had use of beach towels, umbrellas and chairs for the beach. We enjoyed our stay and would recommend it!

Lovely apartment, very clean and well equipped, close to the city center and easily accessible, both by car and public transportation. Alice is a very kind, friendly, and helpful host. Her instructions were clear and both check-in and check-out were easy and straightforward. I will certainly return and I strongly recommend this apartment.
As instalações são muito boas! Me senti em casa. Detalhes importantes: próximo a um mercado (dá para ir a pé), tem garagem e máquinas para lavar e secar roupa que foram muito úteis!

A decent place to stay in a convenient location—close to São Bento station, the metro, and, of course, tourist attractions. The apartment is quite comfortable and has everything you need. The Wi-Fi was a bit spotty, and the shower drain was prone to clogging.

Just back after a wonderful weekend in this vibrant city. Fernando met us at the property and was everything the other reviews describe, helpful and welcoming. His place is again, as the other reviews describe, clean with everything you need, secure and within walking distance of everything!
I’d recommend this place in a heartbeat and when we return it’ll be the first place I’ll look to get booked.
If there is a negative, it’s that the photos don’t do it justice! It’s very well appointed and anyone staying here won’t be disappointed, especially with the messages and assistance from Fernando.

Teresa's place is great for a budget option, Porto is very walkable and it was closely connected to multiple activities. It felt relatively safe as well! Teresa gave many recommendations and I really appreciated it.

The flat was really nice and spacious with the cute balcony. And the communicationwas very easy and helpfull. We asked for a second blanket and they brought it within a few hours. 
Just to be aware that the bedroom does not have a window which was no Problem for us and we did have a Problem with ants in the kitchen, we needed to take out the trash every to avoid them to come.
Muy contentos con la estancia y el trato tan cercano de la anfitriona
Appartamento molto comodo, pulito e vicino a tutti i servizi. Lo consiglio.

We absolutely loved our stay. The apartment is a beautiful, authentic old Portuguese home in a wonderful neighborhood, with so much character and warmth. Every inch of the walls is covered in art, and the whole space feels personal, creative, and genuinely lived-in.
It became such a sweet refuge for us, especially when we needed a little break from the energy of the city. It was a pleasure just to come home, slow down, and spend time in the space.
Maria was lovely, warm, and welcoming, and made the whole experience feel easy. We were very grateful to stay somewhere with so much soul and would happily return.
Nada a apontar, tudo excelente! Voltarei.
very convenient. Walkable to all parts of the city

Súper cute renovated top floor loft like studio a five minute walk to the train station (there are two stations so good to check!) No AC so temperatures may be warm in middle of summer. Host has a fan in the unit and even left us a bottle of chilled bubbly to get the party started.
Hermoso lugar, muy cuidado. Joana siempre esta al pendiente

O local é próximo de tudo pizzaria, cafés, supermercado, jardim do morro, ribeira, fomos andando mesmo minha mãe com 79 anos, o retorno é meio ingrime então optamos por aplicativo que ficou super em conta, para poupar minha mãe.
Fomos com nossos pets de pequeno porte, e o local é super tranquilo.
A casa é fofa, tinha tudo que precisamos para estadia!!
Agradeço a anfitriã por ser tão gentil e empática.
Felicidades!!!

Nous avons passé un super séjour dans le logement de Miguel. 
C'est une hôte a l'écoute, accueillant et très disponible.

Espaço igual às fotos, roupa de cama e banho limpas e perfumadas, cozinha bem equipada. Calmo e silencioso. Espaço agradável.

Nice apartment, clean and good location.

Paulo a été un très bon hôte, très disponible et aidant.

De bons petits restaurants tout près.

El wifi funcionaba a la perfección.

Buena ubicación y zona de restaurantes y supermercado a la vuelta del apartamento. Y Vía Santa Catarina a 4-5 mins andando.

Sin duda, repetiría con ellos.

Recomendo e de certo que se voltar para a zona é local a ser repetido.

Espaço muito agradável, corresponde efetivamente a descrição e fotografias. O António é muito simpático e disponível. Recomendo
Nous y avons trouvé tout ce que nous avions besoin et on pouvait se rendre à plusieurs endroits à pied. Le secteur était tranquille et nous a semblé securitaire.

Bel appartement et bien situé car proche de la plage et proche du centre-ville et métro assez proche pour visiter Porto .

Great location and the apartment was very comfortable and had everything you need including a really big balcony. Really enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend. Communication from Manuela was great too.

Would come back 🌞🩷

Séjour au top ! Cipriano est très accueillant , généreux ! La maison est magnifique et très bien équipée ! La piscine est très belle , un vrai plus ! Nous reviendrons avec grand plaisir ! Merci encore Cipriano et toute sa famille et amie
We had a great stay at Maria’s home with everything we needed - thank you for also being a great host ☀️

Great value, location and spot for a large group. Highly recommend

Super Lage für einen Städtetrip, viele schöne Restaurants und Bars in der Nähe, perfekte Anbindung mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln. Die Wohnung ist sehr schön und gut ausgestattet, aber im Haus etwas hellhörig.

We absolutely enjoyed our stay. The place was very clean and calm. A perfect distance from the center of Porto we were able to do every touristic monument by foot even if the metro was close by.

It is a great place for a couple, well positioned. Nearby the main attractions. If you wake up easily because of a little noise, bring your earplugs. There's a lot of cars/motorcycles that makes some noise. Of course we understand that the owners can't control the noise. We loved the place!

En departamento está situado muy cerca de bares y restaurantes, prácticamente puede uno caminar para conocer Oporto, es limpia y cómoda la propiedad el único inconveniente es que no cuenta con aire acondicionado y al abrir las ventanas para ventilar el lugar, con el ruido no puede uno descansar bien
Apartment was in a great location, close to a lot of restaurants and bars and to the centre. Ana was very responsive and we loved our stay :)

We greatly enjoyed our time in Alex’s place! Lots of room for our family to spread out, and stocked with all of the essentials (linens, towels, appliances, trash bags, etc.). 
Alex was extremely friendly and so helpful upon checkin. Easy to find and met up with Alex and he gave us the rundown of the place. Also there was a parking spot available for us to park all week which was incredible.
The area was so nice. Tons of spots to eat, groceries were readily available, and very peaceful compared to downtown Porto. Easy access to the beach was a hit with our kiddos!
Absolutely would recommend!

Lovely hosts Dino & Ines left us a cake wine cheese, fresh bread, lovely gesture. And another cake on week two, beautiful.
The house was great loved the pictures and all the lovely memories of Dino and Ines’s travels and life. 
The downside was the constant noise of the dogs, if you went on the roof solarium they heard and saw you, barked all the time. So I didn’t use it. 
Every noise they barked this started at 6am most mornings and woke us up. The noise of the road at bottom of the garden because it’s cobbled was awful. 
The other road just round the corner was like a cut through, the motorcycles racing up the road up revving their engines. 
They were doing a building round the corner so noise from there but couldn’t be helped. 
The house is on the flight path so noise was load from planes landing and taking off every 10 mins four days a week. 
Shame I could’t tolerate the 
noise so we went out to get away from it

I fell in love with Porto and especially with Pedro’s apartment. I felt like in a mini designer loft in a jungle, but in Porto. Far away from the tourist magnets but near the city center. We made everything by foot (20-30min walk). 
Pedro was so kind to give us a lot of tips, that actually suits our interests, gave us blankets (because of the colder weather) and equipment for a beautiful day at the beach! 
We had a perfect amount of privacy and we would come definitely back again!

Fantastic experience from beginning to end. Andre is an outstanding host. The place was exactly has shown in photos. Very clean and well equipped with anything you may need. Location was also fantastic. In a quiet neighborhood but within walking distance to the riverfront, many restaurants and shops close by. It was our first time to Porto and Andre made us feel so welcomed and recommended many spots and ideas for our stay. The place is clean, comfortable and well maintained and decorated. We are already planning on a second trip to Porto and will stay at Andre’s again if possible. Thank you Andre for making our time in Porto so special.

De accomodatie ligt op korte afstand van metro station Marques. Heel Porto binnen 30 minuten.
Houd rekening met een wenteltrap naar de slaapkamer, verder zoals geadverteerd. Afgezien van wat verkeersgeluiden een rustige verblijfsplek aan de rand van het centrum, maar ook binnen 5 minuten weer op de snelweg

Convenient location right across the road from Trindade Metro, which links on a direct line to the airport and is two stops or a 15 minute walk to the river. Five minute walk to Mercado do Bolhão. 
Professional hosts were proactive and friendly. 
The apartment was very clean and as photographed. The kitchen is basically equipped with crockery, cutlery and pans, but little else. However, restaurants, cafes, bars and markets are plentiful both locally and within a short stroll.
Overall would highly recommend the apartment.

Grundsätzlich ist die Unterkunft top gelegen und auch die Klimaanlage ist sehr praktisch im Sommer. Leider entsprach sie jedoch kaum den Bildern und war wirklich extrem abgelebt, sodass eine Renovierung auf jeden Fall von Nöten ist (defekte Vorhänge, Schrammen, nur ein kleiner Mülleimer, kleine Schimmelflecken im Bad, etc.) Für 1-2 Nächte ist es jedoch okay gewesen.

This is an old town location so expect stairs and activity nearby. It did quiet down after hours as vehicle traffic on the street is minimal. Some tram noise but not enough to bother us (the modern windows do a great job). The host advertises the apartment as suitable for three people, but (with permission) we had four people and were perfectly comfortable. The smaller bedroom is small, but the couple we were with said that it wasn’t a problem for them. Also the kitchen and living areas are very functional with a kitchen island and good sized refrigerator. I assumed that the place was somewhat small, given the location and suggested occupancy, but it isn’t. To top it off Felipe was very nice/responsive and Cila was a delight greeting us and helping us coordinate our early arrival. Clear to me why this property is so highly rated. We’ll likely stay there again and highly rate it.
Sehr angenehme Lage, die Wohnung war sauber. Das Haus ist hellhörig, das sollte man wissen. Ansonsten super!

Propriété exceptionnelle à tous points de vue !

Je recommande ce logement très spacieux, très bien équipé et entretenu. Rien à redire !

A very charming and well appointed apartment in the heart of Porto - the bedrooms have romantic french windows and Juliette balcony overlooking an historic street. very comfortable beds. we loved the beautiful tiles in the bathroom and great water pressure in the shower, kitchen was spacious and had everything we needed. Near restaurants and bars, a busy and noisy street life at night that is the only drawback- Helpful host Tim communicated well and advised us ahead of time - being central and comfortable was worth a bit of noise.
Het verblijf was helemaal in orde! We hadden een paar problemen met de douche maar die zijn snel en grondig aangepakt! We voelden ons heel erg goed geholpen!

Varzim is gorgeous. We were lucky to be there on a beautiful weekday. The place was clean and lovely. Neighbors were a bit loud at midnight, but that can happen in a shared environment. Otherwise four stars all around. Thanks.

This place was perfect for our group! Two outdoor areas, garden in the back, inside was clean and comfortable. We loved it!
Great location! Very friendly host and very helpful with local recommendations. I recommend this place ;)
A fabulous location, very clean, great response time. Would stay there again!

Beautiful apartment! Close to the Campanha train station which was very convenient for us.

Logement très bien agencé et très agréable niveau décoration. Tout est parfait pour passer un très bon séjour, la place de parking est privative ce qui enlève le stress pour la voiture. Mieszkanie wymaga odświeżenia. Widoczna wilgoć na ścianach w sypialni i w salonie. Okolica nie daje komfortu bezpieczeństwa. Opuszczone budynki mieszkalne, bezdomni w najbliższym parku i pod okolicznymi sklepami. Kamienica w której znajduje się apartament zamieszkana jest przez bardzo głośno zachowujących się lokatorów. Trzaskające drzwi, krzyki na klatce schodowej czy szczekanie psów to codzienność. Nie czuliśmy się z żoną bezpiecznie więc poprosiliśmy właścicieli o klucz do dodatkowego zamku od drzwi. Szybko nam go dostarczyli. Niestety nie zatrzymalibyśmy się ponownie w tym apartamencie. Na plus jedynie szybki kontakt z właściciel i to wszystko.

Un parc magnifique a 200 mètres qui mène jusqu'à la mer ...

Nous avons passé un super séjour dans le logement proposé par Max et Matteo. Ce sont des hôtes à l’écoute, disponibles et très accueillants.

Nous reviendrons sans hésiter ! Merci encore pour ce super séjour. 😊

Súper acogedor departamento, la zona súper céntrica , había restaurantes, bares y cafeterías a menos de 2 cuadras, súper buena seguridad, y gran lugar para llegar a descansar y también hacer home office si lo requieres. Zona súper tranquila y los anfitriones súper amables

Nous avons passé un très beau séjour à Porto et apprécié le logement de Mariana. Il est spacieux, bien décoré, accueillant et propre. We had a wonderful stay! The place was very clean, neat, and comfortable, and everything was well taken care of. The host was extremely proactive, friendly, and clear with all the instructions, which made check-in and our stay very easy.
The location was also great, especially being so close to the train station, which made getting around very convenient. Overall, we really enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this place!
Todo tal cual lo indicaba la publicación. Cerca de los principales puntos de interés turístico.

Graciete and João's apartment was in a fantastic location, very close to transport and the amazing sights of old Porto. We appreciated their recommendations and quick response to any questions we had. The apartment was clean and everything was in good working order. We would happily stay there again! Obrigada!
숙소가 주요 관광지에 가깝고 깔끔하고 모든게 갖추어져 있어 편리했습니다. 호스트는 매우 친절하고 자세한 안내와 질문에 대해 즉각적인 답변을 주어 좋았습니다.
Très beau logement ! Et bien équipée je recommanderait juste des oreillers supplémentaires dans l armoire une c était un peu léger

Manuela fue amable y servicial, disponible para cualquier cosa. El alojamiento está bien situado, al lado de la ribera en donde se encuentran las bodegas, restaurantes, con vistas al Duero. El alojamiento estaba limpio y en buenas condiciones. Tiene tres alturas a las que se accede por escaleras. El coche se estaciona en un parking público de dos alturas, a la de arriba se accede en ascensor.
Buena experiencia, aconsejable.

Très belle maison, tout était parfait, Olivia est une hôte très réactive ainsi que son mari. Encore un grand merci pour toutes ces petites attentions ( notamment la livraison du pain frais le matin, et les délicieux desserts 😁, c était adorable) .
Je reviendrai c est sûr, une expérience formidable.

A grand house, superbly well-equipped but could now do with a refresh in certain areas - we communicated these to the very professional Carla. Comfortable beds, clean kitchen and bathrooms, brilliant aircon. 
Walk to the campsite supermarket next door for essential supplies (3mins) or many excellent supermarkets (10mins drive) - don’t ignore the excellent fish market in Lavra. Lavra restaurants - be smart - and ask Carla; a fish lovers delight but a couple that look not so great. 
The walk to the beach is not beautiful but is safe, and the beach to the north is beautiful and clean. Sunsets with fizz were stunning. We used the bicycles - brilliant with helmets/locks - to cycle halfway to Porto where we watched a Surfing comp. Scenery on this cycle is mixed but the coastal aspect is great. 
We played Padel at Playtomic, took a sunset Douro cruise with Alfonso (fun 2 hours), and visited Cockburns for a tasting. Bolhau market a must. Portuguese so charming as ever - everything good value.

Fatima was an amazing host. She was very responsive and gave us clear instructions on how to enter the apartment. We were fortunate that she was able to accommodate us with an early check in at 11am. I know that is not always possible, but Fatima was very helpful and communicated with us very well. She also had recommendations ready upon our arrival and checked in with us midway through our stay. We are very apprecieative of that. We would definitly recomend staying with Fatima.
This apartment is right in the center of things. The location is perfect. Only a 10 minute walk down to the river front and 10 minutes up to Clerigos church and tower. It is easy to get to from the airport via the metro. Only a couple blocks from Sao Bento subway station (3 min walk; D-Line). This room is set back from the main street. So there was no street noise, only birds from the window. Would absolutely stay in this apartment and with Fatima as a host again. 10/10 would recommend!
We enjoyed this house so much. The location was great! The house was comfortable and had everything we needed! Our host was exceptional!
Pěkné ubytování, byt byl menší ale obsahoval vše potřebné. Lokalita není daleko od centra a nedaleko je zastávka odkud jezdí spoje do centra. Vše v pořádku
Lovely home and good recommendations, very close to a huge super market and a nice bar for the sunset. Perfect location for an easy walk into town

Excellent séjour ! L’appartement correspondait entièrement à nos attentes et était très bien situé.
L’hôte est très réactif et nous a donné beaucoup de renseignements utiles sur les activités à faire ainsi que sur les restaurants à proximité. La communication était excellente.
De plus, André parle français et était sur place pour nous accueillir et nous faire visiter l’appartement. C’était très apprécié !
Je recommande sans hésitation. Nous avons passé un très beau séjour !

The apartment was perfect for our city break in beautiful Porto. 
The square that the aprtment is in is really handy with bars and restaurants and walking distance to lots of sites. It was a little noisy on Friday night until about 3am with lots of youngsters outside, but hey, it was the weekend. I put my ear plugs in and dealt with it. 
Otherwise all great.

Why would you stay anywhere else. This is a fantastic location, easy access and a host who really knows how to look after guests. It’s been a long time since we have been greeted at the apartment. There are so many restaurants within very easy walking distance as well as the tourist spots. The apartment is very comfortable and stylishly furnished. A highly recommended place to stay.

André est un très bon hôte, réactif aux messages. Il m'a attendu plus de 1h30 lors de mon arrivé alors que j'étais en retard.

Very friendly and responsible host, providing their food map for our reference. We love their place, it is very clean.

Very nice area :)

Nous avons malheureusement été assez déçus par notre séjour.
À notre arrivée, les clés avaient été laissées dans la serrure, ce qui nous empêchait d’ouvrir la porte. Nous sommes donc restés plus d’une heure à l’extérieur, avec nos bagages, à attendre le technicien avant de pouvoir accéder au logement. Le fait de devoir passer par une plateforme téléphonique pour joindre l’hôte a également compliqué la gestion de ce problème.
Une fois dans l’appartement, nous avons constaté que le store de la baie vitrée était tombé et cassé, bloquant ainsi l’accès à la terrasse.
La propreté était également décevante : présence de cheveux et de poussière dans la salle de bains, moisissures sur la planche à découper, canapé et tapis tachés… L’appartement est par ailleurs très humide. Enfin, la cuisine manque de plusieurs équipements nécessaires pour pouvoir cuisiner confortablement.
C’est d’autant plus dommage que l’appartement est, en lui-même, très agréable et bénéficie d’un excellent emplacement.
Great location. Very cozy accommodation. We couldn't be any happier. Thank you so much.

Prima verblijf dat dichtbij het centrum ligt. Fijn dat er airco is. Slaapkamers zijn wel aan de kleine kant en niet alles was helemaal schoon toen we aankwamen. Verder ons goed kunnen vermaken in de omgeving.

We absolutely loved our stay in Porto. Our host, Ines, was wonderful from the very beginning. She was quick to respond to all inquiries, incredibly personable, and so helpful throughout the reservation process. Her recommendations for restaurants, sights, and attractions were fantastic and really helped us make the most of our time in Porto. 
The apartment itself is absolutely charming, just as beautiful as the pictures! It was exceptionally clean, the beds were very comfortable, and the modern kitchen and overall decor were lovely. The location couldn’t have been better, with amazing restaurants, grocery stores, and shops just steps away. 
A special thank you to Ines for meeting us for an early check-in. After a long flight, it was so appreciated, and she was absolutely lovely and welcoming.
We would highly recommend this charming apartment to anyone visiting Porto. We truly enjoyed our stay and would definitely come back again.
Geweldig verblijf!

Die Gastgeber waren bei Fragen immer gut erreichbar. Die Terrasse ist super, nur der Blick geradeaus auf die Rückseite eines Kinos ist seltsam, alles andere genau wie auf den Bildern. Die Wendeltreppe ist eine Herausforderung, wir haben den großen Koffer unten gelassen. 😊

Heel vriendelijke host! De communicatie verliep super vlot. Er was steeds antwoord binnen de 5 minuten.

Luis is such a kind, caring, and thoughtful host, he really makes this place worth staying in beyond just its amenities! Very nice place with everything you need - very clean. About 10 minutes walk to subway, thank you for hosting!

직접 지도를 펼쳐 주요 관광지와 가는 방법 그리고 현지인의 다양한 정보도 알려주셨고 오기 전에 이미 리스본에서 포르투 가는 방법과 안단테 카드 등 많은 정보를 주셨습니다. 6박 7일 동안 포르투를 너무 잘 즐겼으며 친구들과 또 오려고 합니다. 빌라노바드 가이아 지역에 있고 숙소 앞 도루강뷰는 정말 끝내줍니다.
포르투와 포르투갈 사람들이 너무 좋습니다♡♡♡

Die Lage, in Nähe einer Metro-Station, ist top.
Das Stadtzentrum, der Hauptbahnhof als auch der Douro sind fußläufig in 5-15min. erreichbar.
Einfach tolle Lage.

Loved our stay at Cristina’s beautiful apartment - the apartment was lovely, and Cristina was incredible as a host, going above and beyond with great recommendations, checking in, and being very flexible and responsive to ensure we had an amazing time in Porto. Would highly recommend, and love to stay again when next in Porto

Perfect stay for our week in Porto. Apt was fantastic and centrally located. We rarely needed a taxi/Bolt and walked nearly everywhere. Check-in was great, responsiveness timely and we could not have asked for a better stay.
Everything was working properly. The only thing I would suggest is to have additional sheets for the sofa bed
Fint, rent, bekvämt i ett genuint och bra område. Värden var fantastisk!
Muito limpo e organizado, corresponde ás fotos. Próximo ao metro e a um Auchan. Fica a poucos minutos do Jardim do Morro. Vale a pena se estiver com família. Acomoda bem 4 pessoas.

Alles war super! Die Wohnung war sauber, gemütlich und genau wie beschrieben. Die Kommunikation mit dem Gastgeber war schnell und unkompliziert, Check-in und Check-out liefen problemlos. Die Lage war ideal, alles gut zu erreichen. Wir haben uns rundum wohlgefühlt und können die Unterkunft nur weiterempfehlen. Vielen Dank!
Die Wohnung war wie beschrieben. Eine nette Begrüssungsüberraschung stand bereit. Fragen wurde schnellsten beantwortet.
Hermoso departamento con todo lo que puedes necesitar! Decorado con muy buen gusto y calidad. Ubicación excelente!

Great location, great stay!

João and Catarina were very responsive hosts. We arrived late and João came to let us in as we were tired and the door was stiff. We found it fine after a good night's sleep! The accommodation was lovely - very clean, fantastic shower, great coffee machine! The location is brilliant both for the beach and only a 15-min walk to the metro for Porto, or a few mins walk for a bus. We would love to return sometime. Highly recommended.
Nice clean comfortable flat and a great location to explore Porto, very close to the centre of the city and the river.
Le séjour était parfait

Ich habe mich in der Wohnung rundum wohlgefühlt und kann sie absolut weiterempfehlen! Die Lage ist wirklich unschlagbar – man ist direkt mitten im Geschehen und kann die Stadt wunderbar zu Fuß erkunden.
Da ich alleine als Frau reise, ist es mir besonders wichtig, dass ich mich sicher fühle. Das war hier absolut der Fall, und ich hatte zu keiner Zeit ein ungutes Gefühl.
Tagsüber ist die Straße vor der Wohnung recht belebt und entsprechend gibt es einiges an Verkehr und „Action“. Nachts war es für mich aber überraschend ruhig und ich habe super geschlafen.
Mit dem Auto hatte ich keine Probleme. Es gibt öffentliche Parkplätze an der Straße und ich habe immer einen Parkplatz in der Nähe der Wohnung gefunden. Ich kann mir allerdings vorstellen, dass das je nach Tageszeit und Situation auch einmal schwieriger sein kann.
Insgesamt war die Wohnung für meinen Aufenthalt perfekt: zentral und trotzdem nachts angenehm ruhig. Ich habe mich sehr wohlgefühlt und würde jederzeit wiederkommen!
Très bien

Fantastic apartment, really spacious and well ventillated. Literally able to step outside and start exploring the beautiful city, and with the market directly opposite, the best food and wine is truly right on your doorstep. Will defo be returning to this exact location on my next visit.
It’s a great place to stay and eurico its nice people For anyone wishing to come to Porto the apartment is a wonderful and quiet place

Great apartment amazing views down the Douro River. Small supermarket across the road. Great restaurant "Porto Iberico" 5 minutes walk. Main restaurants etc of Vila Nova de Gaia just over a klm away downhill going there but a fairly steep climb back.
Estelle a great host quick to reply.

My two sisters and I had the pleasure of staying at Joana's place for three days. We couldn't have picked a better place to stay in Porto. We loved the small balcony, and the space in the bedrooms. The shower is a bit tight but had everything we needed. Johanna was a wonderful host! We appreciated the coffee and water she left in the kitchen for us. She was always accessible, responsive and provided some great restaurant recommendations. She even booked our taxi to the airport at 4:30 in the morning which was such a relief for us. Would highly recommend her place! Thank you for hosting us!

Logement proche de tout commerce (épicerie, boulangerie, boucherie) à 2 pas, accès facile au marché du Bolhão et des 2 gares, metro à quelques minutes.

Hôte très réactif aux messages et donnant de bons conseils !

Everything met my expectations. There were a couple of supermarkets within five minutes walk, and the metro is just 10 minutes walk away.
Schöne Unterkunft. Gutes Preis Leistung Verhältnis.

Apartamento súper agradable, limpio y cómodo. No necesita nada extra, te sientes como en casa. Aunque no está cerca del centro, se accede fácilmente con el autobús. Solamente considerar que es un tercer piso sin ascensor por si traes mucho equipaje.

A nossa estadia foi perfeita! O anfitrião muito atencioso e nos respondia muito rápido. Local muito bem localizado e tudo muito limpo. Amamos e com certeza quando voltarmos vamos nos hospedar de novo.

Appartement propre et spacieux.

Beautiful flat for 3 to 4 people, great amenities, clean, fresh and contemporary with old classic touches

Glimrende plass! Vi angret på at vi kun valgte en natt.

Jane war ein wunderbarer Gastgeber. Sie hat sich bemüht, unseren Aufenthalt so gut wie möglich zu gestalten. Wir würden auf jeden Fall wiederkommen, wenn wir in Porto wären.

The Airbnb was 5 stars! It’s a new looking building and the suite looks new. The accommodations presented very well, bonus of a washer/ dryer. The location was amazing, close to restaurants and the Sao Bento station and timeout market ( where we grab lunch). I would book this suite again.

Logement très propre bien rangé petit point négatif très bruyant du à la route et parfois les chiens du voisin mise à part ça rien à dire et je voulais également les remercier ils ont su que j’avais un bébé et nous on fait un cadeau avec une peluche adapté à son âge ! 🥰
Apartamento bem localizado e com garagem. Deixamos o carro na garagem e fizemos tudo caminhando. Helder foi atencioso e prestativo.

Todo estuvo excelente. Excelente comunicación, respuestas rápidas. La zona del lugar fue perfecta. A 5 minutos del metro, supermercados y lavanderías cercanas. Caminando se ouede llegar a michos lados.
Sin ningún problema con los accesos al departamento. 
Durante la semana hicieron limpieza, también me brindaron servilletas y bolsas para la basura. En geleral todo en orden.

Très tranquille et bien situé. 
C'était parfait !

Perfect location for us. We really enjoyed our visit to Porto - seeing the historical sites, walking along the river, and exploring. Thank you very much for the dining suggestions - Terreiro was very nice.

Location, location, location! Wow – we could walk pretty much everything that we had on our itinerary to see! The apartment is so clean, such a comfortable bed, and it is so fun to be right in the middle of things! It quieted down just perfectly at night and we slept so well in the super comfortable bed! Love the hosts– they got back to us every time we needed anything! Would definitely stay here next time we come through Porto!

Se lo recomiendo a todo el mundo. Ana nos ha dado también muchas indicaciones de qué hacer en Porto y muchas recomendaciones también para poder salir a comer fuera. Entre ellas, Grelados do Candal, que repetimos varias veces ya que la comida era exquisita y a un precio razonable.

Die Unterkunft besticht durch ihre ausgezeichnete Lage und die Einrichtung wurde mit viel Liebe zum Detail gestaltet. Immer wieder gerne

5 stars-

Très belle appartement, nous avons passé un bon moment moi et ma femme, on a profiter aussi de la piscine, calm, airbnb propose aussi, le logement propose aussi un beau balcon, que tu profiter pour un coucher de soleil ou café, très propore, bien équipé,

Perfect stay! The location of the appartment is great. Lot’s of restaurants, bar’s and culture nearby, but very quiet at night. Communication with the host was also really good. My partner and I would highly recommend staying here.

A really great place to stay. The building and apartment were so clean. Air conditioning was so appreciated. The apartment is in a great spot - but as expected in Porto - everything is a bit of a walk!

Der Aufenthalt war wirklich super - wir kommen gerne wieder!
sehr nett danke

Fernanda was great to work with. She met us there to help with checking in and communicating with her was excellent. So glad we chose this Airbnb.

Safety of the premise is top notch with keycards to get in and out of the room as well as the front door. Dining area had everything you need and a sitting area to share. Highly recommend !!

We had a great stay at Mónica's place. After being in a pinch, owing to cancelled accommodation on the day of arrival, we booked this flat last minute. Mónica was extremely responsive, helping us get checked-in ASAP.
Location is fab and it's not too noisy considering the hustle and bustle outside.

Excellent location in a quiet side street and a beautiful view out toward the river out the window. Only few minutes’ convenient walk to so many fun places, as well as Sao Bento station for access to transit. Comfy bed and strong AC units on both sides of the house. Overall great apartment for anyone looking for convenient tourism location and quiet and comfort!
Le logement est très bien situé. Et nous avons pu nous balader facilement dans Porto.

Fatima’s apt was beautiful and she was so easy to communicate with. After a very long International travel with planes and trains, we were exhausted and looking forward to being there. They don’t move well on cobblestone hilly, streets.😔). Fatima was so thoughtful with giving us a welcome bottle of wine when we arrived and there was much needed water in the fridge. 💕
The location was perfect for walking to all of the great sites. There were some amazing restaurants close by as well. 
I would highly recommend Fatima’s apt. 
We would definitely return! 
Porto was beautiful and Fatima’s apt was perfect!

Le logement est chaleureux, accueillant et très bien situé, à proximité des transports en commun (métro et bus). Carlota est de plus très à l’écoute ! Je recommande vivement !

We had a wonderful stay. The pictures looked just like the Vintage Villa. It was very clean and well-maintained. We really liked the outside area to sit.
Hugo and Pedro always got back with us right away and they were so helpful whenever we had a question. We appreciated their driver who picked us up from the airport and took us to their office so that we could store our luggage until check-in time. 
I would definitely recommend staying here. We thoroughly enjoyed it!

Super nett, obwohl ich sehr kurzfristig gesucht habe. Ceila antwortet prompt und ist sehr, sehr nett. Die Lage ist ideal zum Flughafen. Celia hat mir sogar noch am Abend ein kleines Frühstück hingestellt, damit ich morgens um 4 Uhr nicht mir leerem Magen zum Flughafen muss. Toll!

nur zu empfehlen, Sabina

Het appartement zelf was heel mooi en exact wat we verwacht hadden ook was alles aanwezig om ons verblijf zo aangenaam mogelijk te maken. Bij aankomst waren de instructies super duidelijk en het appartement heel proper. De host was super bereikbaar en antwoordde telkens binnen het uur op onze vragen.

Wonderful apartment and hosts. The apartment is very clean and cozy, with everything needed for a comfortable stay. There are plenty of cafes and restaurants nearby, as well as quick access to the city center.
The place was at a very good location. The only bad thing was there was no elevator and the internet was very poor.
Very good location. Very good place. Very good communication. Needs a little more cleaning.

Alloggiare in questa casa è stato davvero un piacere, la posizione è ottima vicino a tutto e facile da raggiungere dall'aeroporto. Great place with all the amenities you need for a short or longer stay in Porto! A bit outside of the core but still incredibly walkable and close to buses and metro. Clean flat and great communication from the host! Would recommend
This place was great - suited our needs perfectly especially the swimming pool

Superbe lieu pour découvrir Porto et ses alentours, tout en profitant du calme et de la magnifique vue sur le Rio Douro. Le logement est aménagé avec confort et beaucoup de goût. Les extérieurs sont très paisibles et la piscine est parfaite pour se rafraîchir. Je recommande !
The apartment was very clean and exactly what we were expecting. The location was perfect, close to everything we needed. I recommend it
Helt ok, väldigt sköna sängar och fin utsikt mot gatan. Trapphuset luktade illa och stökigt.

A very nice and big apartment, near the city center. It had everything we needed. We loved it very much!
Fue util, bien ubicado. Facil todo

Victor's place was perfect for my short stay in Porto! The place was super clean when I arrived. The location is so central it was way to walk everywhere. I also loved the alleyway view from the balcony!

Cristina's apartment was squeaky clean, beautifully decorated, and very comfy. The BR is a bit small but there is great storage and the bed was very comfortable; bathroom attached. Ad esempio non ho capito perché ci fosse l'immagine di un letto matrimoniale se poi in realtà erano due letti singoli attaccati, di cui solo uno pronto per essere usato. Tutto sommato una buona esperienza.

We enjoyed our stay overall. The host was incredibly kind, helpful, and very quick to respond. The apartment was spacious and comfortable for our family of four, and the location was great for exploring Porto, with many restaurants nearby.

Parking was also difficult, as the allocated garage space was too small to use, so we had to pay to park in another garage further away.
Overall, a pleasant stay with a great host and location.

Hem estat molt a gust! L’amfitrió ha estat genial: molt amable, atent i ràpid contestant en tot moment. Ens va donar molt bones instruccions per arribar a l’apartament i ens ho va posar tot molt fàcil.
El pis estava molt net, endreçat i molt ben equipat. La terrasseta també és un punt a favor. Tot i que passen alguns cotxes pel carrer, a nosaltres el soroll no ens va molestar gens, sobretot entre setmana i a la nit.
En general, molt bona estada i un amfitrió de 10. Repetiríem sense dubtar-ho!

Appartement agréable, propre et très bien équipé conformément à l’annonce. La proximité du métro pour rejoindre facilement le centre et le garage sont très appréciables. Excellent séjour, merci Suzana
Beautiful loft studio right next to Clerigos Tower. Amazing view of the city. Host was very helpful and responsive. Would definitely recommend

We had such a lovely stay in Porto, and Marisa was an absolutely wonderful host. Her warmth, friendliness, and hospitality made us feel very welcome from the beginning.
She was very accommodating throughout our stay and kindly allowed us to have a late check-out, which was incredibly helpful for our travel plans. Communication was also easy and pleasant, and she was always happy to help whenever we needed anything.
The place itself was comfortable, clean, and in a great location for exploring Porto. Overall, we had a really pleasant experience and would definitely be happy to stay here again. Thank you so much, Marisa!
Thank you for a lovely stay would definitely recommend it. Thank you both for a wonderful stay

Beautiful, airy, spacious apartment across
From the park. Easily accessible but a little off the main street so quiet and restful. Amazing high end coffee maker and kitchen setup. Thanks for a wonderful stay.

One of the worst customer service experiences I have ever had. The property itself was lovely. We were, however, unfortunately let down by an ant infestation within the flat. We messaged the hosts about this before check out, and received many rude messages from one of the co-hosts, Hugo, about how we were lying to them, trying to get a refund and we had allegedly asked AI chatbots to come up with the best way to go about it. All of his responses were AI generated of course. We escalated this to Airbnb as we felt it was extremely unprofessional and rude, who then requested a refund, not us. He then continued to harass us and send us rude and passive aggressive messages, despite us being nothing but polite towards him. The front door is also quite iffy. It’s a shame that the experience with this particular rude host has let down an otherwise great trip.
Great place, very comfortable and lots of space and daylight. Peaceful place with no noise and well equipped for the stay. Would definitely come back.

Die Wohnung ist wirklich super super schön und blitzsauber. Wir waren zu dritt in der Wohnung von Pedro & Susana und haben uns von Anfang an sehr wohl bei ihnen gefühlt. Wenn wir eine Frage oder ein Problem hatten, haben sie sehr schnell reagiert und waren immer äußerst freundlich. Die Wohnung ist ein bisschen außerhalb von Porto, man kommt aber gut mit dem Uber oder Bus in die Stadt (ca. 10 Minuten Fahrt). Sehr empfehlenswert!!

사진과 설명이 실제 집과 일치하였습니다. 
다리 뷰 포인트와는 거리가 좀 있었지만 포르투 도심 내하고 다리 뷰 포인트의 중간에 위치해서 여행을 계획하기 편했습니다.
Amazing airbnb and responsive host. Great location, connected, walkable, safe

Apartamento super espaçoso , muito confortável , em uma ótima localização, com tudo perto! 
BK, Continente , Mercadona , farmácia e restaurantes. Parabéns , apartamento muito boom , e toda climatizada
地點非常好 環境很棒 設施也很棒

Great stay at Natércias place! Place was in a very central area with lots of amenities around. Perfect view out into the square with music and vibes. Natercia was very responsive and helpful and even let us check in early!

This was one of the best air bnbs i’ve ever stayed in! Claudia’s space is beautiful and made my stay in Porto very special. I also really enjoyed the windows which opened out to a private courtyard.
You can’t beat the location either. It’s incredibly well located and you can walk within 15-30 minutes to most “popular” spots.
Such a gem!!!

Hemos estado muy a gusto,la casa tenía de todo.
Limpio y aseado.
Ottimo alloggio con buon rapporto qualità-prezzo
Beautiful place in a great location with great views. Restaurant and cafe close by. Can walk if you like. Parking outside easy.

Wir wurden von Nuno sehr herzlich empfangen. Er hatte viele Tipps für Porto und Umgebung, so dass wir uns gleich willkommen fühlten und auch direkt Dinge unternehmen konnten. Nuno war jederzeit erreichbar und hatte prima Empfehlungen für traditionelle portugiesische Restaurants. 
Sollten wir nochmals eine Städtereise nach Porto unternehmen, werden wir ganz bestimmt wieder bei Nuno übernachten.
Great stay!!!
Super locatie en prijs, maar minder proper dan op foto’s en keuken werkte niet in de gemeenschappelijke ruimte.
Great location. Pictures of the place are accurate. There are a few steps to climb but the place is a great value for a stay in Porto.

We stayed a few days in this fantastic apartment and could not be happier with our experience, Laísa & Adalberto were extremely responsive and flexible with us as we went through some delays with our flight. The hosts were very helpful and not short of recommendations for us to try and see, adding to our experience!
The apartment is beautiful and tidy, making it a perfect place to call home after a day of exploring, we can’t recommend it enough!
Nice location, nice place
Our stay was comfortable, clean and easily within walking distance to restaurants and sights. The AC worked very well and communications were clear and prompt.
The most central location and modern space. The free parking helped make our Porto trip easy.
Espaço muito agradável
tout ça s'est bien passé ! merci

This apartment was perfect for our stay in Porto. It is walkable to all the main attractions and has lively bars/restaurants nearby. We loved the bakery just a few doors up and had breakfast and coffee there. The apartment is really comfortable and tasteful and being at the back of the building so quiet. Thanks for a great stay.

Does what it says on the tin. Basic Airbnb style apartment, good location and responsive host. Possibly lacks the charm and personal touches of other places we’ve stayed for the same sort of money, but if you’re looking for a hassle free stay, it’s equipped with pretty much everything you need. A/C would have been a bonus as it does get very warm even with shutters down throughout the day. This in combination with the street outside being constantly noisy, with people talking loudly throughout the late evening every night, having windows open may be an issue for light sleepers. 
Our stay with Vítor was great, and we would recommend to others. Thanks
Very nice place. We particularly enjoyed the location of the flat, which was close to basically anything we wanted to visit.

The apartment was beautiful and in a great location. We especially loved the charming little balcony. Communication with Pedro and Hugo was always quick, friendly, and very easy. We felt completely at home and would definitely stay here again on our next visit to Porto!

Le logement proposé par Leonor et Patrícia est impeccable. 
L’endroit est facile d’accès, bien situé entre la plage et le centre-ville. 
Les hôtes sont aimables et donnent des instructions claires.
Nous avons passé un excellent séjour et nous recommandons vivement ce logement !

Beautiful apartment, looked brand new. Kitchen and bathroom had everything we needed and all working perfectly. Bed/sofa beds very comfy and all linen spotlessly clean. Location for us was the main draw and it didn’t disappoint. Very central and under the metro line on the Dom Luis bridge. No noise with shutters closed and you really feel in the centre of things. Good location for Ribiero or back up into town. (Prepare for lots of walking and steps in Porto in general). Fabulous characterful apartment in great location and friendly hosts.
Très bon logement, proche du métro et petits magasins a proximité
Beautiful apartment and great location!

Hugos hus perfekt. Huset ligger mycket centralt, mitt i hjärtat av Porto. Eftersom huset ligger inne på en gård, är det tyst och lugnt. Terrassen är omgiven av massor av blommor. Mamma Maria är mycket vänlig och hjälpsam. Vi uppskattade verkligen vårt boende och rekommenderar det varmt

This quaint but spacious apartment is right in the heart of the city, in an easily walkable distance to a majority of the attractions. Pedro’s place was clean and the master bed was large and comfortable. We were able to come by earlier than the allotted check in time to drop our luggage off which was super helpful. Overall, definitely recommended staying here on your Porto trip!!

Prima host met gemakkelijk contact. 
Er was een foutje gemaakt waardoor er geen toiletpapier en te weinig handdoeken waren maar dit werd direct opgelost. Verder een goed appartement op een fijne locatie.

Lovely confortable little flat, and super easy to walk into town. We arrived late in the eve and found the entrance difficult to find, and then there were issues with the remote lock but despite how late it was, Antonio was there within minutes and fixed the issue, and we were able to use keys for the rest of our stay anyway.
Tolle Lage, hilfsbereite Ansprechpartnerin und gemütliches Ambiente :)

Amazing location and great property BBQ area was amazing for great BBQ dinners . 
Clean property great host .
Fantastic location and (first for me) plenty of toilet paper! Coffee/tea supplies were a nice touch and nice to have washing up supplies too.

Hi Maria, thank you for your help throughout our stay, we’ve had a lovely time. We did our best to leave the property clean, we left a nearly full sunscreen and a volleyball for anyone to take, since we couldn’t take these back with us, hope someone can find use for them, haha:).
Thanks again, have a nice day!
Jan + Nimrit
Sehr schönes Apartment in toller Lage.
Clean, calm and nice accommodation. You can walk right onto the beach and back. Responsive host and easy access to the city.

Great apartment in a less touristy area, while still being very walkable to the main sights and attractions. The apartment itself is lovely and full of light, the bed was very comfortable, and it has a wonderful balcony.
Thelma and Nuno were excellent hosts. They met me at the apartment, gave me a tour of the unit, and provided a map of the area with some great restaurant recommendations. Mill Restaurante, which is just two doors down, is a must visit. They even went above and beyond by gifting me some Port wine and apples from their home garden. Would absolutely recommend.
Excelente acomodação, cama confortável, o necessário para acomodar um casal. O anfitrião deu toda a assistência necessária para a realização do check in e check out. Recomendo.
Very welcoming. Great space and great walking distance to all the top attractions! Will definitely use again when we are back in Porto!

Logement impeccable.
Hôtes réactifs, ils nous ont donné de bonnes recommandations pour les alentours.
Quartier tranquille et tout à proximité 
C’était un très bon prix.
🥇 
Merci pour le beau séjour à Porto!
Good location, clean & friendly host.
Bon logement
Muito bom gostamos muito. Obrigada

Très bon séjour à Porto. L’appartement est très bien situé, proche du centre-ville, et surtout très propre. Nous avons également eu un très bon accueil et une excellente communication avec l’hôte. La petite terrasse est un vrai plus.
Seuls bémols : une odeur très désagréable dans les parties communes, et un bar juste à côté de l’appartement avec de la musique et des personnes qui chantent jusqu’à 2h-3h du matin, ce qui a malheureusement perturbé notre sommeil les deux dernières nuits.
Stort tack för en bra vistelse i er fina och fräscha lägenhet. Vi trivdes mycket bra!
Nice studio close to the river and many awesome restaurants and shops. Would definitely recommend!
Todo muy bien, pero la gente tiene que saber que el departamento esta frente al cementerio y desde la habitación se ven la tumbas y minumentos. A mi no me importo pero puede haber gente impresionable

Lovely stay with great location.
Host really professional, helpful and responsive. Only thing was we did arrive a few minutes before 10pm and we were charged for late check-in. Not a big problem but maybe unnecessary. Only one set of keys which can be tricky if you are not together 100% of the time. 
The apartment was lovely for us with a great location and big terrace. It could use some small refurbishments / improvements to help keep it looking fresh.
Overall, a great place to stay. Thank you.

Excellent location close to the attractions but far enough away to miss the night life, don’t miss the roof top bar at “The Social Hub” on the adjoining apartment block and a late night wind down at “Base” next to Torre dos clerigeos
Lovely accomodation in the heart of porto. Close to everything you need while being quiet and peaceful to come back to. Virginie was easy to communicate with and very accomodating.
추천할 만 합니다. 잘 머물다 갑니다.

Pedro è stato molto gentile e accogliente. C’è una parte comune esterna dell’hotel tipo giardino con poltrone in cui rilassarsi tra piante e pappagalli che cantano. L’hotel si trova in una zona molto tranquilla a pochi passi dal centro, dotata di tutte le comodità. Buon rapporto qualità/prezzo

Logement bien rangé, propre et très bien situé.
En revanche, la grande proximité des bars et rues piétonnes occasionne des nuisances toute la nuit (jusqu’au matin).

Carolina’s apartment was perfectly tidy and beautifully decorated. We had a wonderful stay with our baby. The location was walkable to get to everywhere we wanted to go. There were many good restaurants nearby. We highly recommend staying here to have a quiet, enjoyable trip in Porto away from the main busy streets. Carolina was friendly and ensured our needs were met during our stay.

Le logement est très bien situé et le parking peut aider ceux qui en ont besoin. L'appartement est bien équipé mais le boitier avec les clés n'était pas facile à trouver: les photos envoyées par l'équipe ont bien aidées.
La mamma di José ci ha fatto sentire a casa, ci ritorneremo sicuramente! <3
很好的公寓，布置得很温馨，生活设施齐全，停车方便，开车去波尔图市区游览也不远，我们在这里住得非常舒服。

We arrived in Porto pretty late, around 11:30pm. The host ensured we are welcomed by a staff member even though it was late, communicated with us smoothly with a very quick response time. Location was great, walkable distance to city center and just a 7 minute walk to the river where all the restaurants are. Airbnb was squeaky clean equipped with everything you need. We had a wine bottle waiting for us as a gift which was very thoughtful. Parking was also a must for us and it was easily accessible behind the gate that opens remotely so it was a big plus for convenience and safety. We would most definitely recommend Jose & Maria's place for future guests and stay at their airnbnb for the next visit to Porto!

We had such a wonderful stay! The place was even better than we expected — extremely clean, comfortable, beautifully maintained, and had everything we needed. We truly felt at home from the moment we arrived.
Our host was incredibly kind, attentive, and easy to communicate with throughout our stay, which made the whole experience even better. We also really appreciated how peaceful and welcoming the place felt. It was the perfect setting to relax and enjoy our time away.
Everything was wonderful from beginning to end. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting the area. Thank you so much for making our stay so special!
We had a great experience in Porto thanks to Manuel’s beautiful apartment🤍
The apartment was superb and the service was impeccable! I highly recommend staying here, especially the central location is a huge bonus.
매우 만족스러운 숙소입니다. 주요 관광지까지 도보로 이동 가능한 좋은 위치에 있으며, 4인용 식탁, 넓은 쇼파 베드, 큰 화장실과 베드룸이 있습니다. 사진과 정확히 일치하며, 호스트는 친절하고 소통이 빠릅니다. 다시 방문하고 싶은 숙소입니다.
very lovely apartment, quiet, clean, spacious
Beautiful studio with everything you could need in a great area. Check in and out was easy and the host was very responsive. Thank you !
Estuvimos muy a gusto....está un poco retirado del centro pero bien comunicado con transporte. Muy tranquilo y Fernando y Kate son muy agradables y te hacen sentir como en casa. Gracias pareja
Spettacolo!
