Es hat alles super funktioniert! Anabela stand uns bei Fragen zu Verfügung und hat jeweils schnell geantwortet. Check-in und Check-out verliefen sehr einfach und die Lage war ideal. Ich kann das Airbnb nur weiterempfehlen!

Die Wohnung war genauso wie auf den Bildern. Sie liegt zentral und ist relativ ruhig. Also so ruhig, wie eine Wohnung in der Stadt sein kann. Es gibt Fenster zur relativ lauten Seite - auf den Platz vor der Wohnung - aber die Fenster sind auf dem neuesten Stand und damit bleibt die Wohnung bei geschlossenen Fenstern ruhig. Wenn man Nachts bei offenem Fenster schlafen möchte, kann man einfach die Fenster auf der Seite zur Rua de Tras auflassen. Ich schreibe das so genau, weil recht lärmempfindlich bin.
Das Bett ist eher hart und relativ schmal - vermutlich 150 cm. Ich schlafe gern auf harten Matrazen - mein Partner eher nicht. Ist also Ansichtssache. 
Die Lage ist hervorragend - zentrumsnah, nicht weit zur SuperBock-Arena und auch in der Nähe des doch recht intensiven Nachtlebens - aber ruhig. 
Wir konnten früher einchecken, was uns viel Zeit gespart hat. Es war nur ein Handtuch für jeden da, aber eine kurze Nachricht an Magda hat ausgereicht und das Problem wurde sofort behoben.
Δύσκολο το ανέβασμα στον 4ο όροφο και ειδικά με τις αποσκευές και απαιτειται η αλλαγή του στρώματος, γιατί ο ύπνος γίνεται δυσκολότερος!!!

I loved this Airbnb so much. Having a kitchen and laundry machine midway through my Europe trip was such an added benefit. Great location, walkable to everything. The place was decorated so beautifully, so clean, and genuinely a unique experience. I will be staying here again. 
Only note is that there is construction directly across starting around 9am so it got very loud, but everything else was so wonderful that it didn’t matter to me
Excelente localização. Linda vista do porto, torre dos clérigos. Recomendo demais.

Good location, central to all the main areas in Porto. Comfortable apartment, a few more simple touches such as extra toilet rolls, washing machine tablets or tourist information guides etc would of been helpful especially if youve never been to the area. Street can be noisy at night time into early hours in the morning. Ideal for a short stay. Good host.

The location was unbeatable! It was next to a bunch of restaurants as well the river. It was extremely clean and comfortable. Would 100% recommend it to any friends and family! One note for my fellow Americans who like it cold when they sleep, there is no AC (as noted in the listing details), however multiple fans are provided, making it cooler at night! Great stay!

The house is brand new, nice and clean. Very convenient with several markets around the corner. Easy to get to all the local attractions. 
Several street constructions in the neighborhood during our visits. I got kids and elder traveling with us, and need to be extra cautious walking around.

El alojamiento es acogedor y tiene unas vistas impresionantes, aunque la ubicación es complicada sobre todo por el acceso y el sistema de apertura de la puerta da algunos problemas.
Det var en toppen lägenhet med så fin inredning exakt som i bilderna, mycket bra läge för att ta sig lite överallt och jätte trevligt host, vi älskade våran stay där

Très beau séjour. L’appartement est près de tout, environnement superbe. L’hôte était flexible et répondait bien à nos questions. 
Appartement très propre.
Door lock was a bit tricky but everything was allgood

O preço não justifica, apesar do espaço estar muito bem localizado a apartamento tinha vários problemas. 
Em primeiro, a porta do chuveiro está partida. Quando tentamos abrir a porta, esta desencaixa da dobradiça, o que é perigoso e dificulta tomar banho. Ainda na casa de banho, o autoclismo fica constantemente a correr. 
Em outros aspetos, a casa estava com uma limpeza que deixou a desejar. Teias de aranha, pó e várias manchas pelas superfícies da casa. 
Contudo é um espaço agradável e com pequenas melhoras tornaria a nossa estadia 5 estrelas.
Lovely two level apartment with magic views over Porto.

Home from home very spacious and loved the terrace 
Sergio met us on arrival and was very friendly and helpful 
Paula always available to answer questions definitely recommend and stay again
Clean, great manager.

O alojamento é espaçoso, porque estava sozinha podia ter aproveitado da melhor forma, mas a vizinhança e comida muito com o entra e sai que causa muito ruído, na casa precisa manutenção do exaustor, precisa trocar as toalhas de banho e face, vou só ressalvar a questão da cordialidade devia permanecer 
Teve um imprevisto na hora da saída check out, cumprimentar em primeiro lugare procurar perceber o sucedido é fundamental para quem lida com ser humano
A casa estava limpa, cheirosa
NB: humanizar os serviços

L’appartement était très beau et lumineux comme sur le descriptif. Deux salles de bain sont bien appréciées lorsque vous êtes plusieurs. La plage est immense avec des douches et est à quelques pas. Il y a beaucoup de passerelles en bois pour faire de belles ballades à pied et des pistes cyclables. Vous trouverez egalement plusieurs restaurants le long de la plage. Ivan est très sympathique et réactif. Nous avons passé un très bon séjour !
A very nice flat in Gaia, conveniently located and close to the train station, bus stops and local restaurants. Would happily come back.
Apt lindo, bem localizado e com uma padaria incrível embaixo que perfuma a casa com o aroma de pão fresco delicioso! Aprovado 😉

Everything went smoothly, and Ana responded very quickly. Early check-in was possible, which was very convenient. The apartment itself was very nice, and overall we had a great stay.
The only thing we didn’t like was being asked to dispose of our own rubbish when leaving. We were not given any instructions about where to dispose of it or how the waste disposal system works in Porto. In the end, we left the rubbish in the apartment.
Personally, I don’t think disposing of the rubbish should be the guest’s responsibility, especially without any instructions. We left the apartment clean and tidy, but I felt that this was asking a bit too much.
Apart from that, everything was perfect, and we really enjoyed our stay.

Wir waren sehr zufrieden hier. Wir haben uns wie zuhause gefühlt. Mit etwa 30 min laufen ist man direkt in der stadt, es ist sehr leicht dahin zukommen. Die Unterkunft war sauber und man hat sich sicher gefühlt!
Propre et sécuritaire. Bien situé. Je recommande

100% recomendado!

Tout est super beau, propre, nous avons aimé! Il manque peut-être des verres pour boire de l’eau et les matelas un peu dure, mais très propre!!
Very quiet location away from the crowds but only 20-30 minute walk to sights.
Estadia agradável. Lençóis limpos e tudo conforme. Gostei que não demora para aquecer a água do chuveiro.
Luis 덕분에 편하고 안락한 숙소를 즐길 수 있었습니다! 다음에 포르토를 또 오게된다면 반드시 다시 돌아오고 싶어요! 숙소 근처에 정각마다 종 치던 소리와 발코니 멀리 야경으로 보이던 와이너리 풍경을 잊지 못할 것 같아요! 숙소도 깨끗하고 호스트가 친절하고 주변에 많은 식당과 볼거리들을 추천해줬어요! 정말 즐거운 시간이었습니다!🥰

This is a wonderful flat to see Porto from. It's all within a 15-20 minute walk to the main sights in the old town. There are also lots of restaurants within a few minutes walk, the bakery Ogi by Euskalduna is 2 minutes round the corner and has the best pastries in Porto. The flat itself has everything you need and the bed is very comfy. Would love to stay again, thank you Rita.

We had a fantastic 6-night stay in Porto. The apartment was exactly as shown in the photos and met all our expectations. The beds were super comfortable, and the kitchen was well-equipped with everything we needed. Highly recommend staying here!

Right in the heart of the Riberia district! Great views, top notch AC, comfy bedrooms and a great location. Our party of two enjoyed our stay - would recommend. There is some street noise on the bedroom side (over looking the road) of the apartment. Would recommend!

Grey spot!! Not only is it central to everything the place is so cute and perfect for a stay, from the bed to the kitchen to the amazing outdoor patio it was perfect. Pedro and Mafalda were amazing hosts, responsive and accommodating, provided recommendations and overall great communication. 10/10 would stay here again!
Nice and beatiful apartment with a awesome view!
Excelente alojamiento muy buen ubicado

Phenomenal AirBnb for exactly what we needed - 3 adults and 1 toddler. Both inside and outside were perfect and it’s a lovely walk into town. Henrique was extremely responsive and accommodating and would come back without hesitation.

Pequeña habitación con baño privado y excelente ubicación para visitar la ciudad, ya que está en pleno centro y tiene vistas a la Iglesia de los Clérigos. Hay muy buenos bares locales en la zona, tanto restaurantes como pastelerías.
Aunque se corresponde con las fotos y la descripción, recomiendo ir solo con mochila o maleta pequeña, ya que no hay mucho hueco para abrirla. Mejoraría la presión del agua, es un poco leve, y si tienes el pelo largo (como es mi caso) la ducha te tomará más tiempo jajaja
En cuanto a Adriana, responde muy rápido a los mensajes y nos permitió una entrada flexible, que se agradece. Si volvemos por la zona, repetiremos! Hemos tenido una estancia agradable!

This apartment is in a lovely peaceful end of Porto, with a short walk into the centre. The view over the river is gorgeous and we wish we could have stayed longer! It has everything you could need, with a few really thoughtful touches. We would definitely recommend!
Spent 4 days. Great place: comfortable, centrally located, all the amenities. Host management team was quick and responsive to questions. Would stay again.
Logement agréable et dans un quartier tranquille. Nuno est très réactif avant et pendant notre séjour.
Lovely stay! The place was cozy, welcoming, and really felt like home. I had a great time and would stay again. 😊

We loved it very much. Great place, super walkable and very clean and tidy. Has all ammendities one could ask for. They even kindly acoomodateted us with great parking after a slight miscommunciation. Cannot recommemd this place enough for a stay in Porto.

Le logement est exactement ce que les photos montrent. Les instructions étaient claires, pertinentes et envoyées aux bons moments. 
La localisation est incroyable, tout se fait à pied à proximité. L’hôte vous le dira aussi mais une petite voiture (petit vus maximum) est nécessaire pour le stationnement au garage.

The apartment was in an amazing location and was very comfortable. The host was very kind! Highly recommend!

El apto está en una ubicación excelente, es pequeño, pero tiene todo lo necesario, sin embargo en la entrada al edificio están haciendo arreglos y se ve un poco mal, al igual que la entrada se ve un poco viejo y descuidado, sin embargo el apto parece estar recién remodelado y en muy buenas condiciones

Vielen Dank noch einmal an Antonio und Luisa für die Gastfreundschaft. Alles war liebevoll vorbereitet, und die wichtigsten Utensilien bis zur Wasserflasche waren vor Ort. Neben den detaillierten Standardmails fand auch eine sehr persönlich Kommunikation statt. Ganz besonders gefreut hat es uns, dass durch eure Flexibilität wir auch Antonio persönlich kennen lernen durften. Absolut empfehlenswert!

Abbiamo soggiornato in questo appartamento e ci siamo trovati molto bene! La casa è bella, pulita e dotata di tutto il necessario. La posizione è ottima, abbastanza centrale e comoda per visitare Porto. Il garage privato è stato sicuramente un grande plus, soprattutto considerando la posizione centrale e la difficoltà di trovare parcheggio in zona. Ottima anche la comunicazione con l’host, sempre disponibile e puntuale.

Marilia ist eine sehr freundliche Gastgeberin. 
Der Check In war sehr unkompliziert und flexibel - ebenso der Check Out. 
Die Wohnung ist wie beschrieben. 
Die Lage ist sehr gut. Alles ist fußläufig zu erreichen. 
Der kostenlose Parkplatz ist für die heutigen eher größeren Autos etwas eng aber dennoch sehr praktikabel wenn das Auto nur bis zur Weiterfahrt abgestellt wird. 
Sehr weiterzuempfehlen.

This apartment was perfect for our needs. 
All very clean and everything was in working order. We had all we needed there and wouldn’t hesitate to use this accommodation again. We will definitely recommend it to our friends and family. 
The host is very responsive too! 
Thank you!!!
Zona agradável, muito central. O espaço realmente justifica o preço.

Nous avons passé une très bonne semaine dans ce studio situé tout près du Douro et des restaurants. Le logement est très propre et Sonia très disponible pour nous renseigner.
Nous recommandons ce logement.
El piso estaba muy bien todo limpio súper fresquito,camas muy cómodas súper cerca de todo hemos podido ir andando a todos los sitios Max. 10 min andando volveremos sin duda

Pour un séjour à porto je recommande vivement vanessa. C est une personne accueillante, bienveillante, très amicale. Elle s intéresse aux personnes. Toujours de bons conseils. Malgré la barrière de la langue elle s adapte et la communication est facile. 
Merci pour tout

I really enjoyed my stay at Rosa’s place. Everything was clean and looked exactly like the pictures. The kitchen had a lot of utensils and cooking tools. The bed was really comfortable to sleep in. 
Rosa was really friendly and communicative. I can only recommend staying at this place, it’s really worth the cost.
good location, clean apartment, easy to get in

I had a wonderful stay in Porto!! The hosts were extremely responsive and had a book full of recommendations for the area and the city. It was comfortable and cozy and was exactly what I was looking for!
Ospitalità deliziosa, mi ha accolto la mamma di Jose ed è una donna coi fiocchi! Ti fa sentire a casa..

L'appartamento è ampio e ha una dotazione più che completa. Ottima posizione per visitare Porto a piedi o con i mezzi pubblici (taxi metro e autobus a 2 passi). Nella piazza vicina ci sono negozi e ristoranti. Comodissimo il parcheggio per l'auto che dista appena 30 mt. Abbiamo trovato tutto molto pulito. Ottimo rapporto qualità prezzo, consigliatissimo!

El departamento es encantador, coincide plenamente con las fotos. 
Está en un primer piso de un complejo que tiene locales gastronómicos en planta baja. Está todo como nuevo, volveríamos a hospedarnos en este lugar porque tiene una ubicación fantástica: cerca del Mercado de Bolhão y toda su movida gastronómica como así también del Ayuntamiento. 
La pasamos estupendo!

L’hôte s’est tout de suite assuré que tout était parfait. Il a été proactif sur les échanges. 
Je recommande l’endroit sans réserve. J’y retournerai di je suis de retour à Porto.

Very comfortable studio in quiet neighborhood. No nearby (walkable) shops so come prepared and bring your groceries.
The appartment building is modern, quiet and easy accessible including private parking space.
Be aware that planes to/from Porto airport have their route over this neigborhood, but the appartment is conveniently insulated so it’s not very noisy.
Le logement était très bien situé à distance de marche de la station de métro Sao Bento et de plusieurs point d’intérêts. Nous avons vraiment apprécié notre séjour.

Nous avons passé un agréable séjour dans cet appartement rénové, lumineux et très confortable, avec un plus pour la terrasse côté jardins. Le centre historique est à la fois accessible en transport en commun ou à pieds ce qui est appréciable et on trouve de tout dans le quartier. Je recommande.
Central location, lovely flat
I would highly recommend this beautiful apartment. Wonderful, spacious and so close to many attractions. The host is warm and communicative. I would stay here again when I revisit!
nice location and a nice small studio fast comminication
Foi excelente, bem localizado, apartamento completo, confortável e os anfitriões sempre responderam de imediato, nos explicaram todos os detalhes e tudo correu bem.

Diese Unterkunft ist nur zu empfehlen. 🌸
Das Zimmer (Nr. 4) ist wunderschön, so wie das gesamte Haus, ein renovierter Altbau. Das Bett ist sehr groß und die Wohnung ist super ausgestattet. Im Garten kann man sitzen und genießen & wenn man mag, die Katzen des Hauses begrüßen. Ana ist jederzeit erreichbar und sehr freundlich. 
Zu Fuß läuft man ca. 10-15. Minuten in die Innenstadt. Die Lage ist sehr gut. 
Wir würden immer gerne wiederkommen!

Logement agréable , propre et bien situé.
Idéal pour un séjour en amoureux.
El departamento es amplio con una gran ubicación y fácil acceso. Habitaciones amplias y ventilados
Lovely clean spacious and as shown place to stay central in Porto within walking distance to a lot of attractions. Safe area. Clear details for access for check in and check out.
Had a great time & being right in the heart of everything was incredible.

Thank you for the wonderful place for us to stay. If there was only one comment I could make to make this place even more perfect, would be to add another seat/chair to the couch area. Loved the location. And the bed was very comfy. Would highly recommend and will be back! Great overall!

We have just got home from having the loveliest stay in Monica’s apartment. 
To start with, the location was perfect. The beach was around a 7 minute walk from the apartment and was quiet and hosted a restaurant right on the front. There was also a Lidl around a 10 minute walk too, which had everything we needed. We mostly ubered into Porto itself, which was very reasonable but there was also a train station a 10 minute walk from the apartment which would also take you to Porto. 
The apartment itself was perfect. It was spacious and had every amenity you could think off! We used the beach umbrella and bat and ball, laundry things, and tuppawares to name a few. The bedrooms were great, all with double beds, wardrobes and plenty of natural light. Everything was incredibly clean, and the balcony was a great bonus. 
Monica herself was an incredible host, she honestly couldn’t have done enough for us. She held our bags for us in her own apartment before we could check in, and then worke
Zona tranquila cerca de la playa y aparcamiento muy facil en las inmediaciones.

Although the location in the centre of Porto was great, our stay was unfortunately very disappointing. There was mold in the bathroom. Studio 1 did not have a proper front door. We experienced extreme noise from both the street and the building stairs, making it very difficult to sleep.
Amazing apartment in perfect location!
Excellent, clean, cozy and well-located flat in Porto. Highly recommend!
Logement très bien situé dans la ville, tout était comme affiché sur les photos, la communication avec l'hôte a été excellente!
A casa é muito acolhedora e com tudo o necessário. Os anfitriões foram super cuidadosos em enviar mensagens com tudo explicado e o check in super fácil também. Recomendo! :)

Stayed here for a month with my partner and cannot recommend it enough! Homey, super clean, new, in a neighbourhood that is peaceful and tucked away from all the tourist noise, but still very walkable. Should you need to do groceries or laundry, both are less than 2 mins of walk. Overall, 10/10 recommend!

Een geweldige plek op een perfecte locatie! Je kunt alle kanten van de stad gemakkelijk te voet verkennen, of met de metro in ongeveer 10 minuten bereiken. Het metrostation ligt op slechts 1 minuut lopen van de woning.
In het appartement is alles aanwezig wat je nodig hebt. De hygiëne is van het hoogste niveau en de verhuurders beantwoorden al je vragen meteen en duidelijk.
Ik wil hen beiden ontzettend bedanken voor hun gastvrijheid en de geweldige ervaring!

Appartement trés agręable, bien équipé
Cependant,l établissement peu insonnorisé et le parling proposé est loin et tres cher

I can only recommend: Célia was very kind and picked me up late at the nearby Porto airport on arrival. The garden is super pretty and the big windows give the feeling that it’s literally in the room! For people needing an accommodation close to the airport it’s very convent and comfortable.

Estuvo buena la estadía, respecto al check in no son para nada flexibles siendo que me retiré muchas horas antes, la limpieza estaba correcta. La ducha pierde por la mampara y moja todo. Es agradable salvo a tener en cuenta esos detalles.
Muito bom
Super séjour et un appartement au top pour 3 jours

The apartment is very nice and comfortable. It was very clean, and location is perfect. 
Would definitely come back and recommend.

Mi pareja y yo llegamos a Porto a las 20:30h y Maria nos había dado las instrucciones para la llegada. Al entrar al edificio e intentar abrir la caja de las llaves, no abría. A mi no me quedaba batería en el teléfono ya que llevábamos 5h de viaje en coche usando el GPS y tuvimos que preguntar en un restaurante cercano si lo podíamos cargar ahí (My Chattogram, nos salvaron la noche. Gente encantadora y muy amable). Por suerte, nos ayudaros y escribí a Maria, pero no obtuvimos respuesta. Un buen rato después, casi a las 22:00h, Maria se puso en contacto conmigo y me dijo que estaba lejos y no tenía internet y que se habia equivocado con el código de la caja, me dio el correcto y por fin pudimos entrar. Entiendo que es algo que puede pasar, pero Maria sabía que llegábamos de noche. Me hubiese gustado que hubiese estado más pendiente en nuestra llegada. Por lo demás, el resto del tiempo Maria estuvo muy atenta. El apartamento fiel a las fotos y con muy buena ubicación. La ciudad preciosa.
Lovely place. Great recommendations given by one of the hosts. Check-in time was a bit late for us, but the hosts recommended a bag storage. Overall had a good experience.

We had an enjoyable stay in Pedros apartment. Unfortunately due to a miscommunication the cleaners had not been before we arrived - Pedro met us in person to apologise and allowed us to drop our bags, and the apartment was perfectly clean when we returned. Other than this it was a flawless stay. Spacious apartment, good facilities, an excellent central location and some nice recommendations for things to do. I would certainly stay here again.

Es hat uns sehr gut gefallen , die Wohnung war sehr zentral , super war auch der Parkplatz Tiefgarage. Alles war zu Fuß zu entdecken . In der Wohnung war alles was man braucht .Daniel hat uns per Mail mitgeteilt das die Wohnung früher Bezugs fertig war das war super , sind dann direkt hin gefahren . War ein super schöner Aufenthalt.

Todo perfecto, muy limpio y con todo lo necesario. Camas cómodas. El anfitrión siempre atento a todo y una zona tranquila y bien comunicada. Sin duda, lo recomiendo. Muchas gracias por todo, hemos pasado una días muy agradables!
Excellent stay! The place was very well-equipped, comfortable, and had everything we needed. Highly recommended!

A wonderful flat in a wonderful location. The apartment is just two minutes walk from the nearest metro stop that can get you to the centre of Porto quickly, and is also close by to a number of shops, amenities and landmarks. Alternatively, it's a pleasant, twenty minute walk to downtown Porto.
The flat is great, a good size, well lit and with a great kitchen. The highlight is undoubtedly the balcony with a table and chairs, while shutters on the windows stop the apartment getting too warm in summer. Would happily stay here again.
Very clean, great location and kind host. We felt very welcomed and the host was able to answer all of our questions. We recommend this spot!!
Everything was fine. Accommodation was great and comfortable. Everything you need was there. Location in the city center nearby metro station. You can get to the historical part by walk.

Ticked nearly all the boxes. We were on 4 motorcycles and parked on the street which was fine. Quiet enough area. Easy walk to lots of nice restaurants.
Great price booked on the day.
Had a lovely stay at the apartment. Great location. Very responsive host. 10/10 stay

J’ai passé un excellent séjour dans cet Airbnb ! 🌊☀️
L’emplacement est tout simplement parfait, à deux pas de la plage. La chambre est très bien aménagée, agréable et confortable, avec une mention spéciale pour le lit qui est vraiment très confortable. Le balcon est également un vrai plus, avec une très belle vue sur la mer, parfaite pour profiter d’un petit moment de calme.
L’hôte est super sympa, disponible et toujours prêt à aider si besoin.
J’ai vraiment apprécié mon séjour et je reviendrai avec grand plaisir ! Je recommande vivement cet Airbnb. 😊

Sofia was very responsive and helpful, her recommendations for the area were good, and the rental was clean, conveniently located, and very comfortable/quiet at night. I appreciated the blackout shutters and a/c unit for sleeping in after being out all night. The place felt like a nice hotel at half the price, with the added bonus of being able to wash my clothes half way thru my vacation.

This apartment is in a fantastic location, being easily reached by metro from the airport and is a short walk from the city centre. The apartment is immaculate, spacious, comfortable, beautifully finished; all in all a perfect place to stay for a break in Porto.

Rita’s place was impeccably clean which we appreciated. It looked exactly like the pictures and had all the amenities we needed. Close to everything and the unground parking was walkable with our luggage. Would definitely recommend if you’re looking to stay in the middle of the city. Lots to do. Rita herself was always responsive and helpful. Thank you Rita.

Het verblijf was zoals het geadverteerd werd op de foto's en beschrijving. Ook een zeer goeie ligging dichtbij een metrostation en op wandelafstand van het centrum. Alleen enkele lichten werkten niet maar hier hadden we geen last van doordat andere lichten wel werkten en er lampen waren. En voor te koken was er basisgerief aanwezig en lukte het wel om te koken, zeer uitgebreide of moeilijke gerechten zouden misschien iets lastiger zijn om te maken, maar opnieuw hadden we hier geen last van. Top verblijf en duidelijke instructies!

Appartement propre et très agréable, hôte réactif !
Nous avons passé un merveilleux séjour

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour chez Carlos. C’est un homme très sympathique et agréable.
Nous avons été très bien reçu et le logement est très bien et conforme à sa description.
Merci beaucoup pour ton accueil et nous adressons quelques caresses à ton chien Zeka :)
The location is perfect! It is walkable to all the main sightseeting place. The room is clean and looks the same as in the photo.

L'appartement est trés central a Porto et se situe sur une rue paisible et sans montée... Il se trouve non loin de la ville avec une petite marche pour éviter l'utilisation des transport publics.
Il est en bon état et bien confortable pour 2 personnes ou 3 au max. Il est tres bien équipé en matériel surtout coté cuisine.
L'accés à l'arrivée etait sans probleme et la montée au 3eme étage se fait en ascenseur, le batiment est en tres bon état. Il y a des restau et magasins tout autour pour les nécéssités.
Points négatifs:
- douche bonne mais impropre au bas des parois qui sont couvertes de moisissures.
- manque un aspirateur (tres nécéssaire) mais il y un balai-brosse
- voisins tres bruyants aux sorties et entrées
Léo de "Lovely stay" tres réactif et fait bonne impréssiant...

We had a great 2-day stay at this place. One thing I really liked was that it was on the corner of a wide street so there aren’t many pedestrians walking by when we were bringing our luggage inside. 
The space is nice as well and I appreciated the extra amenities in the bathroom. 
Central and walking distance to everywhere in Porto.

Logement très bien placé, à proximité de la station de métro de Trindade et proche de toutes les activités à faire à Porto ! 
Propre, bien insonorisé et très fonctionnel ! 
Merci encore !

Would definitely recommend and would stay again! Right in the heart of the best street in town so fun to watch Porto from the 2 different balconies but the solid high quality windows and drapes shut out the noise and light completely when it was time to go to sleep. Lots of space and comfortable nice furniture

Wir haben uns wohl gefühlt. Leider war unser Zimmer zur Straße ziemlich laut. Die Ausstattung war zweckmö
zweckmäßig, wunderbar, eine Klimaanlage.
Best air BnB we have stayed as a couple, very responsive, excellent recommendations and comfy bed after a long day of walking
De host verdient een dikke pluim. Hij heeft ons prima geholpen toen we sleutels nodig hadden!
Exactly as expected! Great location as well :)
One of my favorite stays during my entire trip to Portugal — it felt like home right away. Clean, spacious, and filled with great natural light, plus a genuinely convenient location.
OK

Top Aufenthalt! Wer genau in der Stadt seinen Urlaub verbringen möchte ist hier sehr gut aufgehoben! 
Vielen Dank
Bom para dois tres dias..

Ho alloggiato per tre notti in questa struttura, mi sono trovata molto bene. Host gentile e attivo, ha consigliato anche qualche posto da vedere. Ottima pulizia e organizzazione delle cose in cucina e nel bagno. 
Lo consiglio vivamente

Ours was a last minute booking after our flight was cancelled, and Luiz, Dani and Eva were all super responsive and friendly, making the booking process and check in completely stress free! Check in wasn’t until 4pm but they allowed us to leave our luggage so we could explore Porto.
The apartment itself was beautiful, clean, comfortable! An ideal spot to explore Porto, or stay in and relax with a take away!
Super séjour nous reviendrons !

Arrivée compliquée avec la porte du bas qui ne s’ouvre pas mais il faut récupérer la clef dans la boîte à clefs.
Manque de souplesse sur la check in et le check out.
Logement propre et bien situé

The apartment was perfect and in a great central location making it incredibly walkable. The street does not have car access for Ubers but it’s accessible up/down a small incline depending where you are dropped off. It was easy to access the building using the elevators and a small staircase. I would recommend staying here.
Sehr schöne Unterkunft, leichter Check-In und wirklich perfekte Lage. Leider sehr kleines Bad/Dusche und keine Gesichts-/Handhandtücher vorhanden… Sonst aber wirklich alles super👍🏼

Starting from positive aspects: the location was good, near metro station, lots of cafes and restaurants and laundrymat nearby. But the place itself, even tho it was spacious and had potential - was dirty. Veeeery dusty fan in the room (we didn’t use it because it was so dusty), dusty radiator, dirty bathroom walls and stained couch…. on the last day we saw we saw a motle in the kitchen. We get that the place wasn’t expensive but those are the things that should be taken care of even for the price we paid.
Aconchegante
Great location and view… Boa!

Me gustó mucho el piso y coincidía con las imágenes que se ven en airbnb pero tiene que revisar previamente que no haya ningún tipo de fallo en el piso antes de alquilarlo. (Se resolvió con la máxima brevedad)
La ubicación del piso es un poco para mi gusto mala, está bastante lejos de Oporto centro.

Estadia excelente durante o período de trabalho dos nossos colaboradores. O imóvel encontrava-se em excelentes condições, limpo, bem equipado e adequado aos nossos profissionais. Ambiente familiar e confortável. O/A anfitrião/ã demonstrou sempre disponibilidade e profissionalismo, assegurando uma experiência tranquila e sem contratempos. Recomendamos sem hesitação!

Joana’s apartment was fantastic. Beautifully decorated & clean. The beds are very comfortable with quality bed linens. 
Valentím met us on arrival & gave great instructions to make us feel at home. 
Perfect place to stay to explore the city.
Recommend this place
Great place! Loved the peaceful rooftop! The apartment was very comfortable and larger than expected. Served as the perfect home base for a few days in Porto. Would gladly return!

Hôte très accueillant, juste aperçu mais à l’écoute et présent si besoin (pas notre première fois à Porto).
La dame qui nous a accueilli était vraiment exceptionnelle, d’une gentillesse extraordinaire.
Le logement est identique à l’annonce, d’une propreté irréprochable.
Le métro est à 3 minutes à pied, cela permet de visiter Porto et d’avoir des moments paisibles, loin du bruit, en revenant au logement. Et que dire de la piscine ? Un réel plaisir.
Je recommande à 200 % !!!
Excelente lugar

The apartment was beautiful. It was clean and spacious. It was a hidden gem among the busy streets of Porto. We were walking distance to everything we wanted to do while visiting. We felt right at home at Isabel & Igor’s. The hosts communicated well; they were kind and welcoming. Next time I visit Porto, I would not hesitate to stay there again. I will be sure to recommend this AirBnb to family and friends whenever they visit, too! If you aren’t sure if you should book this AirBnb, take this as your sign and do it!!! You will not be disappointed.
The apartment was perfect! Such a great location close to everything in the city and Sara was extremely helpful and thoughtful! We hope to be back one day!! Highly recommend!!!
Great hosts. The location cannot be beat. Clean and efficient stay in a surprisingly quiet part of town that's also in the middle of it all.
We loved our stay here - the location was perfect and the apartment was very clean. Ivo was a great host and provided some excellent recommendations for local restaurants!

Fantastic place to stay and explore Porto. The accommodation is really well equipped, everything you could need for a few days in the city. 
If we return to Porto, we will definitely look to stay here again!
Era come me lo aspettavo e corrispondeva alla descrizione

We had a great stay here for our 3 days in Porto, a great location to visit the city and use the metro to and from the airport. We found the apartment was close to many restaurants and bars but still found the area peaceful in the evenings. 
Obrigada Gustavo and Maia!

Hemos disfrutado mucho en el alojamiento. La llegada fue fácil y Ana estuvo muy atenta a nuestras necesidades. Además fue muy amable contestando nuestras preguntas y también enviándonos sitios y restaurantes de interés para que pudiéramos disfrutar nuestra estancia. 
El apartamento en si, muy limpio, decoración muy bonita y cubrió todas nuestras necesidades. 
Repetiríamos sin duda la experiencia.
Very nice stay, near the center and well equipped. Very easy to access and proactive host!

Gracias por tan hermoso hospedaje! 
es una belleza este lugar!
Los detalles de cada objeto son divinos y te hacen sentir especial y bien recibidos!
sin duda volveremos y lo recomendamos mucho!

Exactly what we needed. Super close to the airport. Our flight got in really late & had another flight out early the next morning. Vitor was super responsive/flexible & met us after midnight to give us the keys & let us into the apt. Super clean, tidy apt. A comfortable night there. Thank you.

We stayed here for 6 nights, the apartment has good value: good location, spacious, has elevator, walking distance to the center. Diana, the co-host replied to all my questions, was helpful and can speak English, which was great, when I called her on the phone to ask for help about getting into the apartment. I am giving 4 stars because it was a very good place to stay, but with sharing more information in advance, having clearer instructions can be excellent.
I recommend it!
Great location in a charming building. Space was bigger than expected.

We had a lovely stay at Liliana's apartment. It's on a bustling street, 2 minutes walk from Metro and train station. Very central and easy to find. Was so nice to be met by host, rather than just using keybox. Liliana gave us a map and numerous tips and recommendations on points of interest and eating out. They were very helpful and we followed almost them all ☺️
The apartment was exactly as described, and nice and clean. The only problem we had was the heat in the apartment. We knew from other reviews and by the clear listing description that the was no air conditioning but there were fans. We had a more comfortable sleep after leaving the windows open. 
We would definitely recommend this apartment to family and friends.
Super Lage mitten in der Stadt.
What a beautiful apartment. Clear instructions and friendly hosts. We were very happy to stay and will definitely come stay again. 5 star for my family and I.

A great location as a base for exploring Porto. A real neighbourhood feel and still within easy walking distance to the old town and river. Plenty of local eateries and bars. The apartment is well fitted out and the terrace was an added bonus.
Very good stay. Easy to find ways to access. Appreciated the AC and the balcony. Walkable location. Safe. Wonderful place to end up after a long day. really perfect overall.
Het was een mooi appartement. Fijne omgeving. Niet in het centrum van een bruisende omgeving, maar wel op wandelafstand ervan. Communicatie met de hosts ging vlot.
Very good
Chaim’s apartment was a great place to stay, clean, modern with all the facilities. Thanks for a great 4 days in Porto

Ne manquez surtout pas le restaurant situé en bas de la résidence aux pieds de l'escalier. Un restaurateur digne de ce noms accueillant bienveillant une cuisine traditionnelle portugaise préparée par sa femme qui cuisine divinement bien et pour un prix tout a fait raisonnable au vue de la qualité des plats servis. Un des rare restaurant ou vous trouverez quasiment que les locaux gage de qualité
No sé me ocurre una mejor ubicación para visitar Oporto. Estás a minutos de cualquier lugar además el departamento es muy bonito.

Muy bonito el apartamento, coincidía con las fotos, instrucciones bastante claras, cómodo. Excelente Ubicación, caminando a 15 min de todas las atracciones y de la estación de metro principal de São beñto.

Эта абсолютно превосходная новая квартира со всем необходимым, включая парковочное место в гараже, просто привела меня в восторг. Продумано все до мелочей, есть все необходимое и практически новое, мне даже показалось что до нас квартира ещё не сдавалась. Каждая деталь дома гармонична начиная с безупречной чистоты и заканчивая всякими приятными мелочами как утренний кофе, приветственное вино и печеньки. Спасибо огромное за предоставленные аппартаменты. Я обязательно вернусь сюда ещё не раз. Определенно рекомендую это место. Локация чудесна, пешком до Моста и Порто 7 минут. Огромные окна и в то же время невероятная тишина района. Очень удобные матрасы, подушки и уютные пледы создают невероятный комфорт. Владельцам больших машин надо учесть что парковочное место квартиры расположено в подземном гараже между двух каменных колонн, возможно будет сложнее запарковаться. מיכאל היה מאוד נחמד, מסביר פנים ונדיב. הייתה הרבה גמישות והתחשבות מצידו עם הצ'ק אין וצ'ק אאוט. הגעתי מוקדם בבוקר אחרי קונקשן ליילי והוא איפשר לי לי להגיע היישר מהשדה כדי שאוכל לנוח, היות וזה התאפשר לו עקב צ'ק אין מוקדם של האורח לפניי. הכל בדירה היה מאוד מסודר, נוח וברור. מטבח נעים עם כל הכלים והציוד שצריך. מארח מקצועי ומומלץ מאוד!
Very nicely decorated apartment. Completely comfortable with all the needed amenities.. close to many sites and shopping. Would definitely come again !

Bonjour, nous vous remercions pour votre logement, très joli et fonctionnel. Si nous devrions apporter une petite remarque, la qualité du Wi-Fi dans la chambre à coucher est décevante. Mais l ensemble de l appartement est impeccable. À recommander
Excelente lugar para estar, tiene aire acondicionado asi que no hay problema en cualquier época del año
Very informative with descriptive instructions. Super fast replies and always friendly. Would recommend.
Wir hatten eine sehr schöne Zeit. Die Wohnung ist gemütlich, wie auf den Fotos. Lage super und die Aussicht vom Balkon sehr schön. Wir waren sehr gerne hier!

My husband and I really enjoyed Ana and Pedro’s apartment. The neighborhood is extremely busy, though. It’s fun too; close to many of the historic places to visit and easy to walk to the Douro River waterfront. It was loud at night, but the hosts provided earplugs and with the ac humming, we were able to sleep. The hosts provided lots of suggestions for places to visit and were super friendly and helpful in every way. We’d love to come back.

The apartment is over two levels and is at the top of the top of this building which is why the views are so good.
Whilst the place is sparse in it’s fit out and could do with a lick of paint, it’s spacious and comfortable for a couple.
The location is excellent and close to exceptional good and very reasonably priced restaurants.
Ani was awesome and very helpful and knowledgeable with places to checkout and restaurants to go to.
I have no hesitation in recommending this apartment as a place to stay in Porto!
Superbe accueil de nos hôtes, tout les détails sont là pour passer un excellent repos. Merci!!!

Séjour de 5 jours parfait pour visiter la ville de Porto et même la rive de Vila Nova de Gaia. Tous les attraits populaires et emblématiques sont à moins de 30 minutes d'un bon pas de marche. Logement parfait pour 2 personnes avec suffisamment d'espace pour être à son aise.

Super appartement, fidèle à la description, très bien situé, proche des transports et avec des commerces a proximité
L'appartement est propre et spacieux avec tout le nécessaire pour passer un bon séjour
Pedro et Hugo sont très réactif avec des instructions clair et le portail des voyageurs et très pratique
Merci a eux pour avoir rendu notre voyage sur porto encore plus agréable

Este espaço foi uma agradável surpresa. Muito limpo, organizado e com todas as comodidades. O bónus de ter uma piscina foi sem duvida uma mais valia e que sem duvida, nos fara voltar em época de verão. Com direito a toalhas para usar na piscina. Deixaram alguns produtos de boas vindas assim como um espumante. A comunicação foi sempre muito rápida. Recomendo muito.

Excellent séjour 
Appartement Propre et très bien situé 
Hôte très réactif 
Petit bémol appartement pas très lumineux
Het was een goeie plek

Belle place!
Très bien placé

Great location. There are several parking garages nearby (5-10 min walk) if you plan on driving. There is resident parking in front of the apartment, but I don't think you are allowed to park there without a resident permit.
Goede host, goede accommodatie, goede locatie. Zeker een aanrader als je porto wilt ontdekken. Dankjewel!

El apartamento está muy bien. 
Buena zona, buena comunicación con Odete y apartamento grande.
Sólo tuvimos un problema, y es que nos salió una cucaracha de un armario, y precisamente en ese armario había comida abierta que seguramente sería del anterior inquilino.
Son cosas que pueden pasar, no le echo la culpa a Odete y no por eso voy a valorar mal el apartamento, porque por el precio pagado no se puede pedir más. Eso sí, nos tocó comprar insecticida y nos condicionó un poco la estancia.
Por lo demás como dije, muy recomandable. 
Odete fue muy amable y nos dejó guardar las maletas después del checkout.
Volvería a repetir.

Francisco created a great first impression by contacting us ahead of the holiday and was there to welcome us and show us around when we arrived late in the evening. 
The gift of an excellent bottle of wine was much appreciated and helped us settle in. Francisco was very responsive in providing advice on supermarkets and restaurants during our stay which was really helpful.
The apartment is as described and very spacious. For two of us it was great and there is more than enough room for two couples.
The bedroom on the street side of the house does pick up some noise but that is the trade off for being in such a central location. 
The views from the balcony and windows of the Dom Luis 1 Bridge and across the River Douro are truly spectacular.
This is a stylish apartment in a great location and Francisco is a welcoming host. I would love to return !
Jättebra location och boende för en vistelse i Porto, rekommenderas!

Nette Wohnung mit guter Aufteilung in zentrumsnaher Lage in ruhiger Seitenstraße. Parken vor der Wohnung ist kostenfrei nur von 19.00 Uhr bis 9.00 Uhr und am Wochenende möglich. Parkhaus centro civico ist zu Fuß 5 Minuten entfernt. Parkgebühr 15 € am Tag.

El apartamento es enorme! Impecable limpieza, tenía todo lo que necesitábamos para sentirnos en casa mientras nos quedamos en Oporto. Además había parking, que fue un gran plus para nosotros. GuestReady nos mandó toda la información sobre el pre-registro, la entrada y otra información útil para nuestra estancia en Oporto. Recomendaríamos este apartamento a todos! Gracias por una estancia increíble!
관광지 가운데에 위치하고 있어서 정말 좋았고 열쇠 사용이 익숙하지 않았는데 친절하게 동영상으로 알려주셔서 감사했습니다.
Great location, beautiful space! Close to food, drinks and shops!

We loved the location of this place, it was a prime spot for walking everywhere we wanted to go. The space was clean and exactly as advertised in the photos. 
That said, we did have a slight delay with checking in. After being told we may be able to check in early or at least drop off our bags early (we arrived in Porto at 9am and couldn’t check in until 4pm), we didn’t end up getting check in information until AFTER 4pm. It was a long day and we felt a little frustrated about that. 
Lastly, the upstairs bedroom area can get quite hot and stuffy, having a fan in that area that works would help to improve that.
Buena

Séjour court mais très agréable Virginie est une hôte accueillante et attentionnée . Nous avons eu le plaisir de partager notamment lors des petits déjeuners . La chambre parfaite, et l’environnement top avec le potager et les animaux . Parfait pour un moment de calme

The apartment was exactly as described and in a great central location near many restaurants, the metro and plenty of sightseeing. The hosts sent detailed instructions on how to enter the apartment - but we did have a little confusion when we first arrived, it was our fault. We initially didn't recognize the keypad (it looks like a nest thermostat, when the screen is dark) and tried to enter the door combo into a lockbox that was also next to the door... once we figured out what the keypad was, we entered without issue. 
Helpful tip - we used the D&S Smart Housing around the corner for luggage storage after check out. It was $4 per bag, the staff were very friendly and it was a very easy process.
Lovely vibey air Bnb in Porto. Great for larger parties. Super cozy vibes in the heart of Porto. Loved staying here

Logement (de plain pied, important à Porto ) très propre, très agréable et avec tout le nécessaire pour notre séjour.
Nous avons bien aimé l'accueil avec bouteilles eau et fruits à disposition pour notre arrivée : c'est très accueillant ! 
Nous avons apprécié les salles de bain attenantes à chaque chambre.
Logement très bien desservi en transport en commun et à 20 minutes de Porto centre.
Merci encore.

Die Lage ist top! Die Wohnung ist auch schön und geräumig, hat aber ein paar Schwachpunkte. Sie ist nicht ganz sauber, das Sofa und der Esstisch weisen Verunreinigungen auf. Insbesondere in den Bädern sind einige Ablagerungen und ein paar Haare zu sehen. Die Wände haben einige Gebrauchsspuren und die Wohnung wirkt sehr unpersönlich und wenig gemütlich, ist sonst aber recht modern. Die Klappe der Klospülung war locker. Es gibt keine Handtücher oder Geschirrhandtücher in der Küche.

Très bon séjour endroit proche de toutes commodités 
Hôte très réactif
Appartement irréprochable
La ubicación es perfecta, la comunicación excelente y la llegada y salida muy fácil y correcta.

We had the best time staying at your apartment in Porto! The location was fantastic, and everything was absolutely perfect. We honestly couldn’t have asked for anything more. We would definitely recommend staying here!

Well what can I say! If you want a 5 star + stay right in the centre of historic old Porto in walking distance of nearly everything look no further. Right from the point of booking & all through our stay Carolina couldn't have been more helpful, informative & quick to reply, she even booked us a superb private transfer car at 4.15am on the Friday to the airport & only at the same price of a standard taxi fare. The apartment itself was exactly how it is described & better, very clean, comfortable & clutter free with great views from the balconies that face the beautiful main square. Entry into the building at ground level is easy through a lovely old door with a keypad entry that takes you into a main marbled hallway straight to the lift that takes you to the 4th floor & the apartment also with a keypad entry. Within minuets walk in any direction there are superb places to eat & drink & the lively historic riverside Ribiera district is only 15 walk away.
I cannot fault this apartment.

Klasse Unterkunft für einen Kurzaufenthalt in Porto. Wir waren für 4 Nächte zu Gast mit 2 Erwachsenen und 2 Kindern. Super freundliche Gastgeber, sehr schnelle Kommunikation und proaktiven Tips für Porto :-) Die Unterkunft ist sehr einfach und schnell vom Flughafen zu erreichen - einfach die Metro nehmen und dann noch 5 Minuten Fussweg. In Porto haben wir dann alles zu Fuß unternommen oder mal noch ein Uber.

Très bel appartement, propre et à quelques pas du centre. La vue est très belle, nous n'aurions pu demander mieux! Nous avons eu un soucis aveca machine à café et rapidement on nous a offert de se rendre sur place pour régulariser la situation. Je recommande l'endroit!

Séjour parfait. Accueillant, réactif et flexible. 
Nous reviendrons !
Perfekt intet mindre.

J’ai passé un très bon séjour dans ce logement idéalement situé. Tout peut se faire à pied et les transports en commun sont juste à côté et très bien desservis. Les hôtes sont réactifs, disponibles et à l’écoute.
L’humidité est tout de même assez présente, un point à garder en tête pour les personnes asthmatiques ou sensibles. Il peut aussi y avoir un peu de bruit, mais avec des boules Quies, cela ne m’a pas posé de problème.
Malgré ces quelques points, mon expérience reste très positive, notamment grâce à l’emplacement idéal et à la qualité des échanges avec les hôtes. Je recommande ce logement !
Super emplacement et bel espace malgré des soucis de propreté dans la douche et au plafond.

We had a great time in Helena’s place, it was spacious and beautiful as described in the listing. It is located super conveniently, right across the metro station, and a big supermarket and in a walking distance to the beach. Easy to navigate the old and lovely city of Porto as it’s half an hour metro ride, and also wonderful location to explore the beach and have a peaceful day roaming around. Helena was also proactive to communicate and always responsive whatever questions I had, which helped us having a wonderful time there. It was great experience and we loved every minute in Matosinhos and Porto, we cannot wait to revisit 😊
Tudo maravilhoso e bem limpo. Localização excelente, fácil acesso! Impecável o apartamento, sempre que for ao Porto será esse local para ficar. Obrigada por tudo.

Super location in the heart of bustling Porto.
Metro network available from Sao Bento (5 min walk)
Restaurants galore - fabulous 👌

I found my host extremely friendly, responsive and flexible. The appartment is lovely and chic, just as described and is located near a metro station, lime bikes, bus circuits and in walking distance of multiple things to do, so I found it a great area to explore Porto from.
There was a small issue with the bathroom which the host explained to us on arrival and was fixed within the first day of our stay, showing his proactivity. The only issue I found was with the AC in one of the rooms being loud and not cooling very much. However we made the host aware of this and hopefully it is being sorted out.
Definitely a positive experience!
Muy buena ubicación, privado, con lo necesario para descansar. Y tener una bonita experiencia en Oporto. Gracias

The apartment was stunning and featured everything that we needed for a short stay in Porto. 
The bed was sooooo comfortable and the kitchen was a useful addition as we cooked breakfast on both days. 
The staff are absolutely lovely and the communication was great. 
Just an FYI, you need to collect and drop off the keys at a nearby location. We had a lot of bags so one of us had to wait outside the apartment with the bags while the other grabbed the keys. Just something to be mindful of if you’re travelling alone and also have lots of bags.
Apartamento enorme ,excelente banheiro e área socia, televisão boa , internet muito boa também.

Nos encantó el apartamento, acogedor y funcional, en una zona tranquila pero muy céntrica, con bares y restaurantes a un minuto pero sin sensación de ser una zona turística. Las camas eran muy cómodas y la luz del apartamento preciosa. Lo hemos disfrutado mucho. Todo fácil y los anfitriones se anticipaban a nuestras necesidades, pendientes pero dándonos flexibilidad.
Kurt was very nice, reactive and helpful. His place was clean, very well situated and a breeze to find. Very comfortable as well. I would recommend for sure!

Emplacement proche de tout, au centre ville, calme
Appartement spacieuse, bien équipée, propre, voisinage calme.
Hote réactif 
Merci
Very good Location and perfect for a two days Trip. Would use it again!
Rafael was wonderful and the home was lovely. Completely recommend if you’re looking to stay in this area of Porto.
Wir haben uns sehr wohl bei der Delfina gefühlt. Sie ist eine tolle Gastgeberin.

Super appartement 
Très bien situé pour visiter 
Très propre

L'appartement est très beau et tranquille. Il se situe près de tout les attractions a voir a Porto ( les plus loin max 20 minutes a pied) . Il a de très bon restaurant tout près et des supermarché. La communication avec Teresa se fesait très facilement. On sait senti à l'aise tout de suite en entrent. Je reviendrai sans hésitation.

Very smooth check-in process and host is being very responsive! (Even though we have no much problems) 
Flat itself is very clean and the view is incredible. A bit distant from the city center but still walkable.
Strongly recommend!

Die Unterkunft war wie beschrieben und top ausgestattet. Sie liegt in der Nähe einer Metrostation, von der aus man schnell und unkompliziert überall hinkommt. Auch zu Fuß erreicht man schnell schöne Gegenden. Wir würden definitiv wiederkommen! :)

Jose was nothing short of an incredible host. He put us in the bigger apartment which I highly recommend trying to get. The ocean view is unbeatable. The decor in the apartment is outstanding and beautiful. We immediately felt at home here. Jose has a warm heart. Everything you need is in this place. You just want to stay here honestly.
I have done alot of travel with air bnb, this experience is easily the number 1 experience we have had. 
Amazing place to stay. If you are reading this review just go book it now.
위치가 완벽하고, 호스트가 매우 친절합니다 :)
Logement propre. Emplacement calme. Hôtel reactif.

We bezochten Porto voor de eerste maal en kwamen onmiddellijk terecht op een toplocatie. Het appartement was zeer praktisch ingericht. Vooral de keuken was functioneel, alles was aanwezig ondanks de kleine oppervlakte. Het appartement was ruim genoeg voor 3 volwassenen. We zouden dit appartement zeker aanraden en vrienden.

Appartement très confortable pour 2 personnes situé dans un quartier tranquille, proche des arrêts d’autobus.
Une place de stationnement privé est un atout important. 
Patricia répond rapidement et avec gentillesse à nos demandes d’information. 
Pour un séjour de quelques jours à Porto, c’est un endroit parfait.
Thank you for welcoming us in your lovely home, will definitely visit again
Appartement très calme situé dans un quartier très agréable, très vivant de Porto.
Great location. Clean. Ideal stay

Very nice accommodation Highly recommend this property 
Great hosts 
Right in the middle of the city so easy to walk everywhere 
You won’t regret booking this apartment
Appartement tranquille, bien situé, chaleureux, d’une qualité et d’une propreté impeccable. La communication a été fluide et facile du début à la fin. Merci 🙏.
As described. Apartment was perfect for our 4night stay. Great location
We had a wonderful stay in the apartment. Highly recommended for a trip to porto!

Wir haben 10 Tage in dieser wunderbaren Wohnung verbracht. Wir waren zu dritt und sind ohne Auto gereist. Die Wohnung ist sehr gemütlich und überhaupt nicht heiß. Nach nur 20 Minuten Fußweg ist man im Stadtzentrum. Man kann auch ein paar Minuten mit dem Bus fahren – die Haltestelle befindet sich direkt vor dem Haus. Genauso schnell gelangt man ans Meer. Die Wohnung ist äußerst gemütlich, die Küche ist hervorragend ausgestattet, es ist alles da, was man braucht. Auch die Kommunikation mit den Vermietern war sehr angenehm, wir haben klare Anweisungen erhalten, wie wir alles finden. Insgesamt war alles wunderbar, wir können diese Wohnung uneingeschränkt weiterempfehlen!
Prima appartement, zeker wanneer je iets zoekt met parkeren van auto ! Ietswat luidruchtig buiten . Maar alles in de stad op loopafstand

Nous avons passé un très agréable séjour chez Daniel, la maison est vraiment pratique. Nous avons profité de la terrasse et du barbecue, très agréable quand il fait beau. La plage est facilement accessible à pied, il y a également un supermarché à 5 min en voiture. La place de parking à l'intérieur de la propriété est vraiment un plus. Je recommande sans hésiter

This place was complete heaven! The peace in the middle of no where , with such beautiful grounds. The pool was amazing and the house was so beautiful done. We had the best time thanks to Ricardo’s Airbnb and communication. He will help you as much as he can which is lovely. We 1000% will be back ! Thank you for making my friends 30th birthday one to remember

We stayed for 10 days and had a great time with our little family. The apartment is located very centrally in Porto, and from there you can easily access the main attractions, public transportation (train, bus, metro), and amazing restaurants and local cafes. 
The place is equipped with all the amenities one needs for a short stay, and Ana was very responsive, helpful, and kind.
Although the apartment is located by one of Porto’s most iconic and lively streets, one still gets a sense of peace and quiet inside at all times.
The only thing one needs to be mindful about is that there is very little storage inside the apartment, which is perfectly fine for short stays of a couple of days, but can get a little inconvenient during longer stays as ours. 
Nevertheless, this is a very minor detail among all the other positive aspects.

Carla ist eine kommunikative und hilfsbereite Gastgeberin, die uns persönlich in Empfang genommen und uns alles gezeigt hat. 
Die Wohnung ist genau so gewesen, wie auf den Bildern und dabei blitzsauber. 
Fußläufig sind alle Dinge des täglichen Bedarfs zu erhalten. 
Das Beste zum Schluss: Die Strandnähe ist der Hammer und Carla stellte einen Sonnenschirm und Windschutz zur Verfügung.

Carla's beautiful spacious apartment is very comfortable, with everything you need if you want to cater for yourself. The bedroom and bathroom are lovely, and the whole apartment is nicely decorated and feels homely and welcoming. The location is great, with two tram stops very near by and great views from the riverfront just a few steps from the apartment. Carla's communication was excellent pre-arrival and during my stay, with lots of helpful advice about parking, the nearest supermarket (very good), restaurants locally and in the town centre... Carla always responded promptly to my messages and was so kind and friendly. I would definitely recommend this accommodation if you want to be somewhere peaceful and a little away from the busy centre of Porto, and still to be within easy reach of all the central sights by tram or bus (or on foot - uphill!).
Great location, great value, and a great host with great communication

Tomás was an excellent host that was very quick to respond and checked in frequently to make sure everything was going well. The place was as pictured (the sofa was slightly different than photos, our apartment didn’t have a sectional), the location was perfect and overall it was a great stay!
Akkurat som beskrevet, aircondition på soverommet gjør det lettere å sove. Anbefales

In der Wohnung ist alles anwesend was man braucht für ein paar Tage Aufenzhalt in Porto. Alles sauber und stilvoll eingerichtet. Man hat einen entspannten Platz auf dem sehr geräumigen Balkon und auch in den Betten kann man sehr gut schlafen. Man ist ein bisschen vom Zentrum entfernt, aber die Bushaltestelle ist ganz nah dran. Eine tolle Unterkunft für Porto und ich würde jederzeit wiederkommen! Danke an Fernando und Team für den schönen Aufenthalt.
Well worth the stay, not that far of a walk to old Porto

Great location, clean and comfortable. Check in and check out was easy too! And quick communication by the bot, which answered most questions (with a contact for a real person if needed). There is a shared kitchen and dining area downstairs which is a useful addition too.
Fernando’s place was clean and exactly what shows. Very easy to communicate with.

This duplex is lovely, beautiful views of the river . Quiet area. Ubers can find it easily . Lovely beds and beautiful towels . Plenty of room for 4 people . Fifteen minute walk to cathedral where most things start from and also to get your bearings. Small supermarket nearby(5 min walk) and 10 minute walk to various cafes and restaurants. If you struggle with walking although the duplex is on the 2nd floor there are 4 flights of stairs and a further 20 steps up into the flat .

Un véritable coup de cœur pour Renata et son logement ❤️
Renata a été avenante, arrangeante, disponible et vraiment à l’écoute. Merci pour sa gentillesse et sa bienveillance tout au long de notre séjour.
L’appartement est idéalement situé, à proximité du métro et de nombreux commerces, tout en étant très agréable et confortable. 
On s’y sent rapidement comme à la maison !
Une adresse que nous recommandons les yeux fermés. Si vous hésitez, foncez ! 😊

Would recommend Ana's place to anybody staying in Porto. Super central location where you can get to the river in less than a 10 minute walk and everything else is within 20-30 minutes walking distance. Very spacious apartment that looks just like the photos. Anna was quick to respond and even held my bags after check-out until I was ready to retrieve them.
Very responsive and helpful host.
A stylish house, very friendly and helpful host who gave some very good local recommendations.

Logement bien placé. Petit mais adapté pour un court séjour.
Literie en mauvais état.

Fantastic apartment. Spacious and comfortable. Amazingly comfortable beds throughout. Lovely central and quiet area. Luisa and Lígia were fantastic hosts. Very helpful and friendly. Would highly recommend.
Super Unterkunft, sehr zu empfehlen.
Excellent séjour pour notre famille qui était sur le même palier que nous. Le lieu est en plein centre de Porto, c'est génial

Wir waren vollkommen zufrieden, die Wohnung war mit allem ausgestattet was man braucht. Alles war sauber und ordentlich. Die Lage der Wohnung ist ein perfekter Ausgangspunkt um Porto zu erkunden. Einkaufsmöglichkeiten sowie Restaurants sind direkt um die Ecke. Wir kommen gerne wieder!

Fab stay and perfect location for everything. Apartment is clean and lovely. Had everything we needed plus a supermarket just across the road! Maria was very friendly and a good host. Will definitely come back and use the apartment, when we come back again!

We had a great time. Lots of recommendations locally. Easy to get to and walk to lots of sights. But pretty noisy at night, which they can't do anything about.
But we still had a lovely time in Porto.
Appartement bien situé pour visiter commerces métro à proximité

Pedro was amazing. He met us outside as we were coming in and was very helpful with getting us comfortable in the Airbnb. The location was perfect and within short walking distance to excellent food and views. The Airbnb was clean and had everything we needed to accommodate our 2 year old child. We would absolutely recommend this location to anyone visiting Porto!

We had a wonderful stay in Porto! The apartment was exceptionally clean, beautifully maintained, and in great shape. The location was fantastic, with many of the major attractions within easy walking distance, making it very convenient for exploring the city.
Our hosts, Inês and Manuel, were excellent. They were very flexible with our check-in time, provided clear and helpful instructions, and were always quick to respond whenever we had a question.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this apartment to friends and colleagues. We would happily stay here again on a future visit to Porto!

My husband and I have been in Porto for 5 days. It was fantastic time. Sandra met us at the front door of the building.She was very nice and friendly host. Sandra gave us a lot of information about old city best destinations and attractions. Apartment was very clean and stylish. We had all we needed to perfect vocational stay. Thank you Sandra for our very positive experience in Porto.

Anne and her son Gil were the perfect hosts — always so helpful, kind, and friendly throughout our stay. Her house was even more beautiful than it looked in the pictures, with a truly stunning panoramic view of the Douro riverside.
The view was honestly just as beautiful as the famous Jardim do Morro, so we had brunch at home to make the most of it. 
The house was also exceptionally clean and well maintained, and everything was thoughtfully prepared to make our stay comfortable. We absolutely loved staying here and would happily come back again. Highly recommended! ❤️

A group of 4 (two couples) staying for 2 nights. As other guests have noted, it's a very spacious place and it was fun having a pool table. Great amenities, and luxurious 5-star hotel-quality beds and linens. 
Downside for us was how noisy the floors are! You won't be quietly sneaking downstairs in the middle of the night for a midnight snack. ;-) Also worth confirming with other reviews that the loft bedroom means if anyone is downstairs, you'll be affected by the lights and noise. 
But these were minor issues for our particular group when compared to all the positives - we would be happy to return again for a few nights!

Sehr gute und zentrale Lage! Von dem gepflegten Apartment aus kann man alle wichtigen Orte zu Fuß erreichen. 
Der Check in war einfach und flexibel.
Kann ich nur empfehlen

Luís made our stay in Porto unforgettable!
The apartment was as described with good amenities, lovely private balcony, and ample space. It was within walkable distance to local restaurants or shops, whilst still being private and quiet. 
Luís was an incredible host who offered us local recommendations each day for meals or attractions to visit. He was friendly, generous, and acted promptly to fix things to make our stay better (like our staircase light).
Our first ever visit to Portugal was made such an easy and pleasurable experience thanks to Luís.

We really enjoyed our stay. The location for us is what made it so perfect. Everything right on your doorstep. The apartment was lovely, comfortable and had everything we needed. Carolina was friendly, great communication and happy to help with any questions and give recommendations.
Tout était parfait. Obrigado!

Es war ein wunderbarer Aufenthalt. Leider ist auf der Straße vor dem Haus viel Verkehr, was je nach Tageszeit etwas stört. Ansonsten hatte das Haus alles was man braucht. Auch der kleine Garten im Innenhof war super. Trotz warmen Wetter, war es hier immer angenehm.

We had a fantastic 4 night stay at Alice's apartment and could have easily stayed longer. The property is quite unique and the garden area is a lovely spot to relax at the end of the day. The location was ideal for us, away from the bustling city centre but near enough to walk down and access and see all the sights. Local buses/ metro are great if you don't fancy the walk back up the hill. Would recommend the 50 minute boat trip on the Douro, € 20 euros or €18 if you walk across the magnificent Luis bridge first, where there is also a fantastic gelato shop to entice you! Bonus was seeing people climb the bridge to jump off into the river. Porto was good value for food and drink making the stay extra enjoyable. Overall a really confortable stay , great base for visiting this lovely city.

Fernando fue muy servicial y atento a nuestras necesidades. El departamento estaba limpio y muy equipado.
Fue muy buena elección su departamento. Lo recomendamos
The photos don’t do this justice, it’s amazing!! The garden terrace space is lovely to sit and the apartment itself is gorgeous. Great for a short stay, so central

הדירה יפה, מבריקה, נוחה ומאובזרת.
מיקום מושלם במרכז העיר עם חניה פרטית ונוחה.
היה מושלם ונשמח לחזור שוב!

What a great Airbnb! Lovely, comfortable and well equipped apartment in a quiet neighbourhood, but within walking distance of the main attractions in Porto. Helena and Eduardo were excellent hosts, quick to respond to any messages and queries, and being flexible over check in and leaving our luggage on the last day was much appreciated. We wish we could have stayed for longer!

We had a wonderful stay in Porto. The apartment was exceptionally clean, with beautiful views over the Douro River and a lovely minimalist design. The location is fantastic — just steps from the bridge and surrounded by excellent restaurants, cafés and wine cellars, making it a perfect base for exploring Porto and Vila Nova de Gaia.
Maria was wonderful: accommodating and always very quick to respond. We especially appreciated her flexibility in granting us a late checkout, which was incredibly helpful on our final day.
One important detail to be aware of is that the bedroom partitions are made of plywood and do not extend all the way to the ceiling, so there is very little acoustic privacy between the rooms. This wasn’t an issue for us as we were four girlfriends traveling together, but it may be worth considering for guests for whom bedroom privacy is important.
Overall, a beautifully located, spotlessly clean apartment with spectacular Douro views and a genuinely lovely host. We t
Wir haben unseren Aufenthalt bei Paula sehr genossen! Die Wohnung hatte alles, was man braucht und war super ausgestattet. Den Ozean als Vorgarten zu haben ist ein Traum!

We had booked the room with the use of a private bathroom. However when we arrived, we were informed that due to unforeseen circumstances we would have to share with 1 other person. This was not communicated prior to our arrival. We only met the 2 hosts separately gor less than 5 minutes. We were expected to keep toilet paper in our rooms rather than it was freely available. We stayed for 9 days. We were never offered replacement sheets or towels. I had to ask the host twice to empty the kitchen bin because it started to smell. I didn't cook or use the kitchen because I didn't like the cooking facilities.

Maria’s place was perfect! Great location, super clean and spacious. The welcome gift was so appreciated. The location was within easy walking distance of sites and public transportation. Be prepared for the hills! Great view of the Dom Luis 1 bridge. Such good restaurants within a few minutes. We highly recommend Bia Lounge, incredible tapas and the staff are truly amazing! 
Maria was extremely attentive and quick to respond even though she was out of the country during our visit. 
Thank you very much for everything, Maria. We would highly recommend your place and would love to stay again.

Wij hebben een aangenaam verblijf gehad. Het appartement ligt in een woonwijk op 20 minuten lopen van het centrum van Porto. Alle voorzieningen zoals bezienswaardigheden, restaurants en winkels zijn op loopafstand.

Notre séjour s’est super bien déroulé le logement avait tout ce dont nous avions besoin et était près du centre ville et du métro. Nous avons eu un super accueil de la part de l’hôte qui nous a même laisser des recommandations et qui nous a même accommodé lors de notre arrivée. Nous y retournerions sans hésiter

What a perfect place right in the heart of Porto! Clean, comfortable, AC was awesome and there’s everything available right outside! We would absolutely stay here again and we appreciated the local recommendations.

Die Unterkunft von Paula und ihrem Mann war einfach fanatisch. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Besonders toll war der wunderschöne blick auf den Douro - Fluss . Noch viel schöner wie auf den Bildern . Das Haus war ein krönender Abschluss unserer Reise . Man hat wirklich Privatsphäre und auch der Pool war groß und hatte eine angenehme Temperatur. Wir waren fast jeden Tag dort baden . Auch der Garten bietet viele Früchte an und ab und zu kam eine Katzen Familie zu Besuch .Die Lage ist perfekt nicht weit von Porto und auch in der Nähe kann man Wassersport betreiben.
Die Ausstattung war mehr als ausreichend und wir danken Paula für die nette Gastfreundschaft . Wie kommen gern wieder :)

We had an amazing stay at Diogos villa for our wedding! We stayed for 10 days and didn’t want to leave! 
He went out of his way to source an extra crib for the unit at the back of the property for our nanny to look after our 6 month old while we were out! 
Everyone that saw the villa couldn’t stop talking about it! An amazing space that we will definitely try and make it back to!
Thanks Diogo & Tomoya! 🙌🏻
Séjour super bien passé, logement bien placé et propre, nickel
Die Wohnung liegt sehr ruhig in einer Seitenstraße, kein Verkehrslärm
Really enjoyed staying here. Very cool apartment and the mezzanine bed was super comfortable. Quiet street, but close to everything. The host was very welcoming.
Es war perfekt für 3 Übernachtungen, das Bett ist bequem und die Metro sehr nahe. Trotzdem ist es nachts ruhig.

Miejsce naszego pobytu znajdowało się w spokojnej okolicy. Mieszkanie było czyste. Wszystko było zgodne z opisem. Minusem był remont za ścianą o czym nie byliśmy uprzedzeni. Reszta była w porządku. Gospodarz był pomocny i starał się.

We hebben een fijn verblijf gehad tijdens onze vakantie in Porto. De locatie heeft een prima verbinding met het centrum via het openbaar vervoer. Het is een redelijk rustige buurt en de slaapkamer was lekker donker en afgelegen. Het matras was redelijk hard, maar dit is persoonlijke voorkeur. 
Er was helaas geen koffiezetapparaat aanwezig tijdens ons verblijf, de verhuurder heeft na contact hierover netjes aangeboden er een te brengen maar dit was overbodig omdat wij al voor een andere oplossing hadden gezorgd. 
Buiten voor het appartement bevonden zich ondergrondse afvalcontainers welke dagelijks laat in de avond door een vrachtwagen werden geleegd, soms meerdere keren per avond en wel tot 02:00. Dit kan zorgen voor overlast wanneer er gasten gebruik maken van de slaapbank in de woonkamer. 
Ook troffen wij veel rioolvliegjes aan. Hier hebben we weinig last van gehad maar de bestrijding en het voorkomen hiervan is iets wat de verhuurder in de toekomst beter kan doen.
Very close to everything.

Loved it, small but had everything you would need, no lift so be warned if you're on the higher floors. We're in our 70s and managed fine. Fantastic location. Bus from airport 2.50 euros to bus terminal in Porto then 5 mins walk to apartment. What is not to love
Eine tolle Wohnung! Carlos ist ein super Gastgeber und wir hatten eine gute Zeit
Gute und einfache Kommunikation mit dem Vermieter. In der Wohnung hat alles soweit gepasst. Würde ich wieder buchen.
Excellent apartment, within easy walking distance of most attractions

Good location, spacious apartment. Very loud though, and the windows are not good. Not a single hook in the whole apartment to hang a towel... Parking garage has a very high curb, no-go for low cars. Otherwise pretty good.

Très bon séjour appartement très propre et très fonctionnel et très bien situé. 
Hote très gentil .
Nous avons passer 5 jours super 
Anne
Una notte a Porto, è stato un soggiorno piacevole, l’appartamento era pulito e in posizione molto centrale, tutto è andato bene, casa comoda e essenziale.

Superbe séjour ! L’appartement est très bien placé à côté de la gare et pleins de commerces. 
Hôte très disponible et très belle vue du haut de l’appartement
Perfect location right in the centre of Porto. The place was spotless and spacious and Sofia was very responsive. Would definitely recommend!

Apartamento ótimo, localização perfeita, na rua do Jardim do Morro. Tive uma ótima estadia com a minha família. 
A comunicação com o anfitrião não foi das melhores, confesso. Ele não me respondeu sobre deixar as malas antes do Check-in, mesmo que a resposta fosse negativa, seria bom ter um retorno. 
Fora isso, o lugar em si é ótimo!

Unser Aufenthalt war von Beginn an perfekt. Cris war sehr freundlich und zuvorkommend und hat uns bestens mit Infos versorgt. Das Apartment ist wirklich schön und die Lage sehr zentral und perfekt. Schräg gegenüber ist ein super schönes Café, wo man gemütlich frühstücken und brunchen kann ;). 
Man sollte wissen, dass die Wendeltreppe schon steil ist und es dadurch etwas schwierig sein kann, nach oben oder unten zu kommen.
Wir haben unseren Aufenthalt sehr genossen, vielen Dank. :)
숙소가 깔끔하고 위치도 너무 좋았습니다.

Hemos estado muy a gusto durante nuestra estancia. El alojamiento estaba muy limpio y cuidado, y se nota que está preparado con mucho mimo para que los huéspedes estén cómodos. Además, es un sitio precioso, con mucho encanto y mucho más bonito en persona.
La atención también ha sido excelente desde el primer momento, siempre muy amables y pendientes de que todo estuviera bien. Nos hemos sentido muy cómodos y la experiencia ha sido de diez.
Sin duda, es un alojamiento al que volveríamos encantados y que recomendamos totalmente. ¡Muchas gracias por todo!
What an amazing apartment. Perfect for our trip to Porto. Everything you would need is at hand and the space felt high spec and thought about. The outdoor space is fantastic. High recommend!
Excellent accommodation right in the heart of Porto. Thoughtful touches that made us feel very welcome.
Ein super zentrale Wohnung, zweckmäßig eingerichtet und einfach klasse!

We absolutely loved our stay in Porto! Marisa was incredibly kind and accommodating. She went out of her way to accommodate our luggage early, which made things so much easier for our group. Her son was also the sweetest and such a lovely part of our experience!
The house was beautifully curated, with such a cool, unique concept. It was incredibly spacious and comfortable for all 13 of us. We especially loved the terrace, which was a great space for our group to enjoy together.
The location was fantastic, right in Cedofeita with restaurants, cafés, and shops nearby. It was also about a 15-minute walk to the waterfront, making it easy to explore Porto on foot.
We truly appreciated the hospitality and thoughtful touches throughout the home. We would absolutely stay here again!

Our group of six absolutely loved this property. The location was fabulous and the views of Porto were lovely! We loved all of the windows and the cool evening air. The living space was so lovely and we enjoyed sharing bottles of wine with the nearby sites and sounds of the city. 
The host was rapidly responsive to any inquiries and they were very helpful. Check-in was clear and easy and they were even able to accommodate a slightly earlier check-in which was very much appreciated!
We would love to return to Porto and would love to stay here again!
