Appartement très propre, conforme aux descriptifs et photos, proche des zones touristiques. Un excellent restaurant, Quai 44 à 2 pas de l appartement. Petit plus, à l arrivée 2 pasteis et 2 petits verres de porto en guise de bienvenue.

Nuestra estadía por Oporto en el alojamiento de Elsa y Rubina fue muy agradable, tal cual se ve en las fotos, todo limpio y en buenas condiciones, la ubicación es un 10/10!! Súper recomendable! Sin duda volvería!!!!

Estuve una sola noche de paso, encontré la habitación de Bárbara a buen precio por ser reserva de ultima hora, 8pm, no sabía si me aceptaría y me contestó al instante. Lo recomendaría 100%, me ayudó en todo lo que necesité
The stay was fine, but there were a quite a few things that were janky, wasn't working - such as the air conditioning, the door lock to the terrace, the coffee machine, the toilet seat is broken etc.

Logement bien situé à approximativement 25 mins à pied du centre historique. C’était très calme comme endroit. L’hôte nous a envoyé plusieurs recommandations de points à visiter c’était très utile. 
Petits points négatifs ; le logement a besoin d’entretien puisque certains tiroirs sont brisés dans les salles de bain. Également, nous croyons avoir vu que les douches avaient été réparées mais ce n’est pas le cas donc lorsque l’on prend notre douche, cela laisse une grande quantité d’eau sur le sol de la salle de bain. 
Très interessant pour un bref séjour !
Thank you Susana, it was a pleasure staying at your place🙏🏼

Uma casa bem iluminada , bem completa com tudo o que precisamos. 
Perto da praia e de vários estabelecimentos. 
Adorei. Recomendo.

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour chez Vanessa, l'appartement était idéalement situé pour visiter Porto, très calme et agréable, confortable, propre et fonctionnel. A noter tout de même l'absence de porte entre la cuisine et la chambre, pour nous qui avions un bébé ce n’était pas idéal mais tout de même ok. Vanessa a été extrêmement disponible pour l’ensemble de l'organisation, nous recommandons vivement !

Fantastic modern flat, very secure, very clean. Bus stops a few metres away means you can get to lots of places very easily. The bakery on the corner is a must - their pastel de natas and coffee are perfect for breakfast, and their bread is lovely too. The host is very friendly and helpful, and we have had a wonderful holiday

Studio en plein cœur du centre historique de Porto. Peu de mètres carrés mais bien disposé et aménagé un peu bruyant la nuit, mais ceci est le pendant de la localisation très bien placé en centre. Le logement correspond parfaitement au descriptif fourni. Enfin nous a eu la chance d’arriver dans un logement qui avait été refait très récemment.

Sehr gute Lage, alles fussläufig erreichbar. Die Spüle war verstopft aber es ist am nächsten Tag direkt jemand gekommen um es zu richten, es gab eine sehr gute Kommunikation vom Gastgeber. Die Handtücher und das Bad könnten ein wenig mehr Sorgfalt beim Saubermachen benötigen. Insgesamt ein schöner Aufenthalt.

My husband and I recently stayed at Nuno and friends beautiful home in Porto. The apartment is large, extremely clean, cheerful with well appointed bedrooms and bathrooms. The views and the balcony were amazing. We appreciated the washing machine as we had been traveling for a bit. The location is excellent not far from the river with easy access to restaurants, stores and transportation. We were greeted with a bottle of port and the apartment was well stocked with all the essentials you need in place when traveling. Nuno and friends responded quickly to any questions and the communication was excellent. We have stayed in many Airbnb‘s and this one truly qualifies as a five star experience from beginning to end. Thanks for making our first visit to Porto a great one!
Schöne Wohnung, zentral gelegen, bequemes Bett, schönes Bad, alles blitzblank. Durften unser Gepäck vorab abstellen. Gab etwas Obst und Wein. Würde wieder dort einchecken.

I stayed on the 4th floor, and the internet connection was terrible, almost nonexistent. When I arrived, the bathroom already smelled really bad, and the smell got worse and worse over the following days. Overall, the bathroom felt quite unsanitary.
Also, be aware that there are no mosquito nets on the windows.
If you’re just looking for a place to sleep, it’s okay. Otherwise, I wouldn’t recommend staying here.

The location is perfect! 
Everything was nearby, all walking distance and felt the place was very safe. The room we stayed was clean and the bed was also very comfortable. It was very easy to communicate with Eugenia and Luis because they responded promptly.
 We really enjoyed staying at the Mouzinho 134!
P.S the wine they had for us waiting when we checked in was very thoughtful!

Séjour absolument parfait ! Le logement est impeccable et magnifiquement décoré, on s'y sent chez soi dès les premières minutes. Tout est propre, bien équipé et pensé pour le confort des voyageurs. L'emplacement est un vrai atout : transports, commerces et restaurants sont à deux pas, ce qui rend les déplacements très faciles et permet de profiter pleinement du séjour. Côté hôte, la communication a été irréprochable du début à la fin. Réponses rapides, consignes claires et toujours disponible en cas de question. Je recommande sans hésiter, et j'y retournerai avec plaisir !
Vale a pena. A varanda tem uma vista linda, só achamos que podiam investir um pouco mais na privacidade.

Apartamento muito espaçoso, limpo e com uma vista muito bonita para o rio.
Tudo 5 estrelas.

This apartment was well equipped with coffee for our mornings, dishwasher pods laundry pods and super clean with very comfortable setting to chill and relax outside on the terrace. True to description and Alexandra was very responsive and helpful with maps and points of interest in the stunning city of Porto and surroundings. Highly recommended to anyone wanting a comfortable stay in this enchanted city.

L'appartement est très propre, parfaitement situé pour visiter Porto et ses environs et bénéficie d'une très jolie vue.
La proximité du métro est un vrai plus car cela reste le mode de locomotion à privilégier pour aller au centre de Porto mais également sur les bords du Douro côté Vila Nova de Gaia.
Great place, it was too big for one person 😉 would come back
Excelente ubicación. Dto muy raro, con poca luz artificial y si bien está en buen estado, le faltan detalles de cuidado. No reciben el equipaje anticipado como se anuncia.
Rigtig godt til prisen. Der er en del støj fra opgangen og køleskabet, så kan anbefale at tage ørepropper med.
Great place to stay, very close to the center and right by the metro stop.

Beste Pedro en Hugo ,
dank voor jullie fijne informatieve mails. 
Het appartement (hele gebouw) was spik en span kan je niets op aan te merken hebben.
Geen last van verbouwing geluiden gehad.
De check in van 15 uur was wat aan de late kant maar gelukkig mocht ik een uurtje eerder er al in.
Dank en wie weet tot ziens 🤗
위치도 정말좋고 숙소도 정말좋아요
Beautiful place in a nice area!! Easy check in👍🏼

It is a great place to be, very near to the sea side, and there the neighborhood is really peaceful. There is a great beach in front, and with the great view of the sea on the balcony.
The owner of the house is really helpful and friendly. Making sure that everything is good for us. And we visited two of the restaurants he recommended, both are delight and welcoming.
An excellent apartment in the city center. Well located and very cozy. Totally recommended. The host is kind and helpful. Everything was perfect and as expected. Thanks a lot José.

My boyfriend and I stayed here for 6 nights. It was lovely. 
The bed was big and comfy, the kitchen was spacious and came with a lot of utensils/pots, and the lounge and balcony were perfect for relaxing in the evenings.
The surrounding area is very beautiful and there is lots to do.
Also, the hosts were all very communicative and helpful, responding to any questions we asked quickly.

La verdad es que considero que el alojamiento no estuvo a la altura de lo que pagamos. La primera noche no pudimos dormir bien porque el sillón tenía pulgas, especialmente quienes nos recostamos allí. Si bien dormimos en el dormitorio pero ya estábamos ronchados por las pulgas 
Además, el horno no tenía bandeja, algo que echamos en falta porque durante las tres noches cocinamos en el apartamento. Al momento de limpiar, barrimos el suelo pero tampoco había una pala para poder recoger la basura.
Si bien en general el resto del alojamiento estaba bien y coincidía con lo anunciado, creo que estos pequeños detalles hacen una gran diferencia en la experiencia y en relación con el precio que pagamos.
Por estos motivos, lo siento, pero no volvería a elegir este mismo alojamiento. Espero que puedan tener estos aspectos en cuenta para mejorar la experiencia de futuros huéspedes.

Apartment is nice. It was well put together. 
Location was convenient to everything.
Many thanks for a great stay in a lovely apartment. Perfect location for all the sites, station and restaurants etc. The apartment was beautiful and hosts were extremely helpful.
It's a terrific location, near Porto's beautiful sights and boulevards. There are great places to eat nearby. Easy walk to the river.

We loved our stay in this beautiful little Apartment. The bed was super comfortable and it was quiet at night which isn’t easy to find in a busy city. We loved the patio area for morning breakfast and evening drinks. Nice touch of welcome Port drinks. It was a little oasis of calm in the busy city of Porto. There were several little coffee shops and bars local to us. We especially liked the Cork Wine bar on our road for a night cap. Bolhau Market was a 10 minute walk away and well worth a visit.
Great
Lovely apartment with everything we needed. Carolina was a great host

El alojamiento coincide exhaustivamente con las especificaciones. Para moverse en el centro está perfecto, a nosotros como nos gusta el puerto, hemos tenido que movernos en coche. La atención de la anfitriona fue inmediata e inmejorable.
Great apt in good location. Lovely stay.
Good location. Close to city centre and the promenade.

A fantastic stay. Jorge met us on arrival, left a lovely welcome gift, and walked us through Porto on a map… restaurants, neighborhoods, the whole thing. We followed those recommendations all week.
The apartment is beautiful and genuinely private, and the location is just outside the main part of Porto and hard to beat for getting around on foot. Clean, easy communication, no surprises. Highly recommend.
Le propriétaire est très réactif et flexible, petit b-mol sur le mobilier (moisissure dans les tiroirs, volet scotché). Patricia nous a superbement bien accueilli. Logement correcte pour une nuit

Wir hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt in der Wohnung und haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Wenige Gehminuten von Restaurants und vom Zentrum entfernt. Die Kommunikation war jederzeit freundlich und unkompliziert. Die Wohnung ist schön eingerichtet, sauber und sehr gut ausgestattet, es fehlt einem an nichts. Gerne wieder wenn es uns nach Porto verschlägt!
Sehr freundlicher Gastgeber und schöne, helle Unterkunft mit allem Wichtigem, was man benötigt.

Rodrigo’s place is lovely with all equipment we need, and the experience was even better than we expected. The photos and descriptions are accurate but the hosts are amazing. 
The location is good, quiet, and safe. We usually walked down to the CBD, taking about 20 mins.
Afonso always provided efficient responses and support during our visit, and Rodrigo was so kind to help us when we needed their support. Highly recommending this accommodation. 
Rodrigo的房間和設備跟照片描述的一樣，有廚房、冷氣和洗衣機，房間很乾淨，關上窗戶很安靜。有點可惜冰箱好像沒有冷凍庫。
地點不錯，離地鐵站非常近但我們基本上都是走路或是搭Uber到市中心，走路大概15-20分鐘。
Rodrigo跟Afonso人都超親切好溝通，回應迅速盡力幫忙，感謝他們！

Our stay at Luis’ apartment was lovely, Luis was very responsive to all of our queries and was flexible with us on our final day which was very much appreciated! A perfect area for a short stay in Porto, the surrounding neighbourhood had lots of nice coffee shops and restaurants. Luis was also kind enough to provide local recommendations
Schöne ruhige Lage, alles für mehrere Tage vorhanden was man braucht und gerne wieder.
Logement impeccable très bien situé

Très bon séjour dans ce joli petit appartement excentré.
À la fois proche de la plage et de plusieurs lignes de bus permettant de se déplacer dans tout Porto, c’était le parfait compromis entre accessibilité et environnement paisible. 
Petit supermarché juste à côté avec tout ce dont vous avez besoin (sauf options végétariens).

Wir haben für unseren Aufenthalt in Porto die ruhigere Flussseite des Douro gewählt. Über die Brücke war es ein ca. 20 minütiger Spaziergang. Von der gemeinsam genutzten Dachterrasse hat man einen phantastischen Blick auf den Douro und Porto.

Es un sitio espectacular y unas instalaciones de película muy agradable el trato y literalmente se sentía en casa hasta en el desayuno ya que nos juntábamos todos los que residíamos y compartíamos ese momento
Good place and nice location. The room was good and house also. Worth the stay.

We had a great stay. Hosts were responsive. Apartment is located a little out of the way from the main attractions but it does allow you to get good rest since there isn’t a lot of noise, and Ubers are reasonably priced in Portugal. 
Beds were comfortable. Great having AC. It is worth mentioning that There is no lift so you do have to carry luggage up stairs but it was manageable. 
Would definitely stay here again!
Geweldige accomodatie, gezellig ingericht en super proper. Bezit alles wat je nodig hebt voor een verblijf in Porto!
Nice and clean

Charming space- very large common area, good light, good shower- very hot! Kitchen was well appointed-could use basic salt, pepper and oil but otherwise easy to use. Very central location- a bit touristy for me but easy to get everywhere and surprisingly very quiet!
Lovely location. Great spot as a homebase.

In der Wohnung fühlt man sich wie zu Hause. Sehr schön und sauber. 
Uns fiel es schwer abzureisen 😉🤗.
Wonderful place in a great location
Great stay :) Nice area.

This flat is brand new and the facilities are impeccable. The whole flat is quite airy with loads of sun light and the neighborhood is calm though quite close to everything one needs: supermarket, cafes, beach, public services, restaurants and transportation. We had a wonderful time there. A gem!

We hebben een heel leuke ervaring gehad. Rodrigo is echt een top host, staat altijd klaar en is zeer vriendelijk. Ook was hij zeer flexibel over de aankomst en vertrektijd. De accomodatie is ook top, het was zelf beter dan we ons konden inbeelden. Ook mochten we de leuke strandspullen gebruiken voor aan het strand net zoals de fietsen en skateboards, waarvoor dank!!de locatie is ook super, je hebt het beste van twee werelden. Je hebt het rustige vissersdorp waar het huis gelegen is maar je bent ook dichtbij de stad die heel makkelijk te bereiken is met de trein of Uber. Ideaal voor gezinnen of vrienden. We hebben een zeer leuke tijd gehad en komen graag terug!
All good. A but noisy but as expected for the location. Good deal

テラスからの景色は唯一無二の絶景です
宿までの道のりは急な石畳の坂なのでスーツケースなどを持って行く際には注意が必要です
Our family had a wonderful stay. The location was absolutely perfect, the apartment was spotless, and the host was super responsive. I'd love to stay here again if I ever return to Porto.
Todo fantástico

We lived the place, it was very comfortable, excellent use of space.
Pros: Excellent location, clean, very comfortable, AC in each room worked great, modern look, hosts very responsive, elevator to get to apartment 
Cons: bedrooms upstairs (difficult for anyone difficulties with stairs), limited outside light (no windows in bedrooms or kitchen).

Our stay was great, the location was close to many things that we wanted to explore! The ladder to the loft is a little steep but the space is wonderful, we thoroughly enjoyed the balcony and gorgeous sunset!
Wonderful location and rooftop space. Raul was excellent at communication and overall helpfulness.

The apartment was absolutely wonderful, even better than it looked in the pictures! It offers an impressive and beautiful view of the river and the large bridge. The parking was very convenient and extremely helpful for us. The hosts were incredibly nice, quick to respond, and always eager to help. We had a truly perfect stay!
Great location and very welcoming host! Such a lovely visit. Thank you Maria!

Lovely place with an absolutely perfect location.
Walking distance to all the sights and attractions we wanted to explore. 
Mónica and Victor were quick to answer any questions we had and supply valuable information about Porto through their tourist guides. 
Would recommend!

Um excelente apartamento, limpo e organizado. 
Para quem tem família é óptimo, senti-me em casa.
Great place, great location, lovely and clean would defo stay again

¡Nuestra estancia en el alojamiento de María fue fantástica! Desde el primer momento la comunicación fue rapidísima y muy amable. Además, fueron súper flexibles con nuestro horario de entrada, lo cual nos facilitó mucho las cosas. El piso estaba impecable, súper limpio, y las instrucciones para la llegada resultaron clarísimas y fáciles de seguir. Nos sentimos como en casa desde el primer minuto. ¡Sin duda repetiríamos y 100% recomendable!
Parfait

Magnifique séjour. L'emplacement est idéal et à proximité des endroits clés pour un arrêt de trois jours. La communication a été excellente et les hôtes nous ont aidé et recommandé des endroits sympas dans un délai éclair à chaque fois. Merci pour tout !!
Superlocatie om Porto te verkennen. Kleine, maar hele fijne studio waar niets ontbreekt. Bovendien schoon en goede service.
Perfect Stay and must visit

This space in the heart of the Ribeiria was absolutely perfect. Super walkable to everything you need and a quiet street as night. The team was incredibly responsive which was great. We loved Porto and the space so much that we stayed longer than expected! Would surely stay again on our next visit.
Perfect
Beautiful place, would recommend staying here if you are travelling in the area.

Super Wohnung, super Lage.
Würde ich wieder buchen.

Nous avons passé un super séjour à Porto 
Très bien accueillis et plein de bons conseils pour profiter de la ville
L’appartement est très agréable et bien équipé :)

Very nice and beautiful plus quiet location. Walking distance to a lovely river beach. We stayed for 5 days and the place was left for us very neat and clean. No complaints. Very helpful and responsive host.

large apartment close to the metro towards the centre of porto.
clean and well organised reception.
Bardzo fajny apartament. Przyjemny i czysty. Gospodarz pomocny. Polecam!
Very nice place to stay, friendly hosts

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour tout est à proximité 
Nous reviendrons nous avons adoré l’appartement avec ces hauts plafonds 
Tout est à proximité surtout le marché dé balhoa
Je recommande ce logement! Il est très bien situé et la vue de la fenêtre est superbe ! ☺️

Un magnifique séjour à Porto pour laquelle nous avons eu un véritable coup de cœur. Le logement de Sonia est magnifique, on s'y sent très bien. C'est chaleureux et très bien équipé. Merci à Sonia pour son accueil, c'est une personne très sympathique et qui partage ses adresses et son amour pour sa ville. A bientôt Porto, j'espère.
Great location!

Die Unterkunft war sehr schön, sauber und man merkt wie viel Mühe sich Elis und ihre Familie geben. Wir haben uns sehr willkommen gefühlt, uns wurde alles erklärt und wir haben viele Empfehlungen für die Stadt bekommen.
Die Küche und das Zimmer waren sehr gut ausgestattet, man hat alles was man brauchen kann.
Insgesamt gibt es keine Kritikpunkte. Die Unterkunft von Elis ist sehr zu empfehlen!
O apartamento é incrível. Muito limpo, organizado, bem decorado e novo. A localização permite fazer tudo a pé no centro da cidade. Definitivamente voltarei a me hospedar lá quando for ao Porto.

The location was great, could walk around to so many different places. The place in itself was clean and I felt very comfortable sleeping there. 
All kitchen amenities were complete alongside a few other things. If I had to nitpick, the water pressure isn't great but other than that amazing place to stay!
Parfait, bel appartement propre et spacieux. Hôte très réactif, je recommande !
Aardige behulpzame host, kamer werd goed schoongemaakt. Plafond slaapruimte en douche waren erg laag. Desondanks heerlijk geslapen. Goed schoon bed. En lekkere koffie

A great location indeed, everything is literally reachable by walking. The checkij was smooth -it would have been good though to mention the floor, i just knew it since i read the reviews in advance. On the first there was a strong parfume/detergent smell in the room. Other than that everything was really good. There are bars and restaurants nearby - so it can get a bit too loud, but after closing the windows everything was fine.
Best location and cute restaurants right on the street!! Well worth the value and very cute.

Helaas viel ons verblijf in Happy Mountains T2 behoorlijk tegen. Bij aankomst waren de sleutels niet aanwezig in het kluisje. Daarnaast waren meerdere deurklinken kapot of vielen ze eraf en was het rolluik van de slaapkamer met balkon al defect. De grote badkamer lekte tijdens het douchen door slecht gemonteerd/gekit glas. In de kleine badkamer hing een sterke rioollucht vanuit het putje. Ook waren de snijplanken vettig en roken onaangenaam en zaten de pannen vol krassen. De lamp in de slaapkamer werkte niet goed en gaf soms elektrische schokken, wat wij een ernstig veiligheidsprobleem vonden. Positief waren de airco, koelkast en comfortabele bedden. Al met al is er duidelijk onderhoud en controle nodig.
Uiteindelijk was het deurklink & rolluik probleem wel opgelost!

Virkelig hyggelig lejlighed som ligger meget centralt, tæt på gode restauranter, barer mm. 
Vi nød virkelig vores ophold. 
Tak til de rigtig dygtige og professionelle værter.

Great place to stay and great value for money! The apartment is very beautiful and cosy. The only downsides I can think of are that the balconies only really accommodate one person at a time, which can be something to think about if you’re going with your partner like I did. I also found the drainage of the shower to be quite slow and the water pressure quite high. This made it difficult to keep all of the water actually inside of the shower, causing you to have to lower the pressure and wait for it to drain or turn the shower off completely at times. Aside from that, we found it very easy to explore what the city has to offer, with some great restaurants and supermarkets close by. Would definitely recommend to anyone traveling and looking for a good place to stay!

Que agradável surpresa! 
É notório o cuidado extremo em cada detalhe deste espaço!
Tudo impecavelmente limpo, um espaço muito acolhedor! 
Anfitriões muito simpáticos e disponíveis, ainda tivemos direito a uns miminhos surpresa!
Obrigada Mariana e João
Vamos voltar!

2층집을 전세낸것처럼 쓸수 있어서 너무 좋았어요. 숙소 컨디션은 사진과 완전 동일하게 깨끗하고, 채광좋고, 한쪽 창으로는 강이 그대로 보입니다. 
일단 호스트인 dos guindais님이 진짜 친절합니다. 숙소에서 기다리다가 맞아주시고 숙소 소개랑 포르투 지도 펴놓고 맛집이랑 커피숍, 마트 등 다 알려주십니다. 숙소 코앞에(계단내려가서) 자전거 대여소 있다는거 처음 들어서, 덕분에 여행중에 대서양 바다도 한번 보고 왔어요.
상벤투 역에서 숙소갈때 8분쯤 걸리는데 약간의 오르막 언덕과 계단이 있어요. 그때 캐리어 끄는게 살짝 힘들수 있지만 포르투갈에서 이정도 이컨디션 이가격이면 충분히 감수 가능한 수준이에요. 동루이스 다리까지 7분정도 걸립니다. 추천합니다.

The place was really good comfortable and clean, but in front was a construction I think that will be necessary to mentioned, they work the whole day making a big noise so was completely impossible to rest during that time, I know it doesn’t depend of the place but mentioned as a thing it’s necessary.

The view from this apartment is phenomenal. It was lovely in the mornings and evenings at sunset to drink coffee and wine overlooking the Douro River. 
The location is a bit far (15+ minutes walking) from the main city center but the walk felt safe at night.

Very good apartment in a central location. Quiet at night despite the location. Lots of stairs to climb if youre not fit and healthy like us ! Could be good to have a guide book with useful local information inside the apartment. Also a visitors book so that guests can write their own recommendations. 
Definitley worth visiting the beach areas at Matosihnos and Foz do Douro ( walk down the prom from Matosihnos) for a complete get away from the busy city 
Overall a very good place to stay in Porto.
Great place with a parking spot! Yummy coffee not too far. Enjoyed our time there
Tudo 5 estrelas! Ótima localização, espaço impecável, funcional e com um processo de check-in super simples e prático.
Tout était conforme au concept. Attention à l'humidité qui commence à ranger tout le mobilier.
Rien à redire: logement très bien, Porto a été accessible à pied, l'hôte a tjs été là en cas de besoin et le logement était à bon prix.
Bel appartement et très bon emplacement, l'essentiel est disponible dans le logement. Bon lit, idéal pour les déplacements autour de Porto grâce à la proximité à la gare de Sao Bento+ metro
Great place! Would recommend staying here when in Porto. There are tons of places to eat and attractions within walking distance

I had such a lovely stay at Maria’s apartment. From the very beginning, Maria was exceptionally kind, warm and accommodating. I needed to arrive a little earlier than planned, and she went completely out of her way to make that possible, even preparing and cleaning the apartment herself so that I could settle in sooner. I was incredibly grateful!
The apartment itself is in a fantastic location in Porto and, more importantly, it really feels like a home rather than just another Airbnb. It’s bright, comfortable, simply but thoughtfully decorated, and was full of little touches that make a difference: spices and olive oil in the kitchen, something to drink in the fridge, even a rubber duck by the bathtub. :) There are heaters, fans, everything you might need, and the Wi-Fi worked perfectly throughout my stay.. Thank you!

Uma Ótima Opção no Porto.
Voltaremos sem dúvida alguma

The place was amazing. Easy to find, very clean, tidy, spacious and an amazing view of the city.
The location in Gaia makes you walk across the beautiful bridge every day towards the city.
I can only recommend this place!
Très bien, merci pour la réactivité. Attention à la douche qui passe du chaud au froid très rapidement.

We had a great stay in Porto! The apartment was very clean, modern, comfortable, and really pleasant. The location was perfect and allowed us to explore the city entirely on foot. There are also restaurants and a bakery right nearby, which was very convenient.
Our host, Amir, was very kind, helpful, and always responded very quickly whenever we had a question. Thank you, Amir!
A great place to stay for 3 or 4 days in Porto. Highly recommended!

Nos ha encantado hospedarnos en este sitio. El lugar es precipso, muy cómodo y el espacio muy bien aprovechado, nos gustó mucho la decoración y el jardin es un remanso de paz. La piscina climatizada y daba gusto darte un baño ahí. Los anfitriones fueron muy amables y se mostraron disponibles en todo momento. 
Si estas buscando unsitio ubicado muy cerca de la playa, donde descansar y disfrutar de la zona y con una buena decoración, este es un muy buen lugar. Nos encantaria volver a repetir.
O sitio é calmo e bonito, porem as fotos dão a perceção de uma espaco maior e mais limpo. O Itay foi muito prestável dando sempre as devidas indicações e informações.
very clean and spacious home. jose‘s mom was very lovely. she didn‘t speak english at all but somehow we were still able to communicate :))

C’était un plaisir de passer ces jours dans ce studio agréable. Il y a tout le nécessaire pour se sentir comme chez soit. 
La décoration, le soin apporté au ménage et les attentions contribuent à ce sentiment.
J’étais heureuse,après mes journées de découverte, de profiter du patio privatif en toute intimité.
C’est un appartement où je reviendrai sans hésiter.

Muy buen departamento, la ubicación estaba muy buena, todo se podía realizar caminando e igual la opción de bus/metro quedan relativamente cerca. A pocos metros del departamento está el supermercado lo cual queda muy práctico y rápido de llegar ya que literalmente el supermercado es al frente del departamento.
Lugar bastante cómodo, limpio, e igual bastante amplio, también el balcón es amplio.
Pequeños detalles a mejorar aunque no quita lo grandioso del lugar es quizás un cambio de cubiertos ya que los cuchillos sentíamos que no tenían filo. Uno de los asientos de la cocina sentíamos tambaleaba cuando uno se sienta. 
Pequeño detalle de la secadora de ropa que decía secado en 50 minutos lo realizó en una hora y media pero aún así salió con un poco de humedad. Algunas veces decía 40 minutos y bajaba luego a 15 minutos. Solo cuando hay apuro puede ser un poco problemático pero nada del otro mundo son detalles pequeños.
A parte de todo eso, con gusto regresaría nuevamente.
Great place to stay for our two nights in Porto! Highly recommend
Nice play as advertised. Great location.

Lovely, well equipped apartment in a great location, close to main attractions and yet a really peaceful place to stay. Francisco was a great host, provided lots of local recommendations and was always quick to respond to any queries. A fabulous place to stay for a Porto break.
Studio gelegen op perfecte afstand om Porto te voet te ontdekken. Zeer vriendelijke host die snel reageerde en ook proactief informeerde of alles naar wens was.
Parfait
O apartamento fica muito bem localizado e atende bem a um casal. É bastante organizado e limpo.

Todo perfecto, la ubicación buenísima, muy cerca de Gaia y Oporto, playas cerca, restaurantes, tiendas de alimentación…zona muy tranquila. Indicaciones sencillas, equipo magnífico, con fácil comunicación, atentos y amables, nos resolvieron las dudas al momento y muy dispuestos, ha sido una experiencia fantástica! Repetiremos sin duda! Muchas gracias
Tim fue muy amable y claro con las indicaciones, nos dejó tapones ya que al ser una zona transitable de noche puede haber algo de ruido pero la ubicación es excelente

Nuno fue súper atento, el apartamento es tal cual las fotos y tenía todas las comodidad. La zona super tranquila.
Volveremos seguro!! 🫰
Ubytování bylo příjemné, skvělá lokalita a hladký proces ubytovaní. Pokyny byly přesné a dobře popsané. Apartmán byl čistý a vybavený. Moc hezké zázemí na týden v Portu. Určitě doporučuji☺️.
Prima appartement met ideale locatie
Great apartment in a perfect location
Muito bom e satisfatório

Appartement agréable, joyeux très fonctionnel,aéré avec une vue magnifique sur la ville de Porto. L’ascenseur fut un Plus pour notre couple. Le concierge du bâtiment a été très agréable. Nous recommandons cet appartement.

L’appartement est bien meublé et équipé et se trouve très bien localisé. Tout a été bien pensé avec soin et d’éducation.
Shelly a été disponible et toujours prêt à assister.
La famille a vraiment apprécié le confort et convivialité de l’appartement. Il est sans doute recommandable.

Had a great stay at this accommodation for 3 nights in Porto which is just a must visit when going to Portugal. After a hectic visit in Lisbon which I really didn't like , we had a fix of heart in VIVA . The room was clean and organized, felt like a hotel. The ocean is a 1 min walk and the center of the city is a 20 mins ride in line 500 which is a double decker strolling the river which has this amazing view. The host Pedro was so nice and responsive, made sure we always get the best of this vacation and made sure we felt comfortable. Just one thing I'd like to mention, the main door for the room and the bathroom door are a bit hard to understand at first but you get used to it. 
Overall thinking about the price we paid in comparison to a hotel room, we were more than surprised at the facilities given to us at this accommodation. 
Thank you Pedro!

Great stay would use again if came back to Porto.
Cristina was very helpful and responsive.
O apartamento é fantástico, extremamente bem localizado, limpo, organizado.. recomendamos demais!!

Die Wohnung war tatsächlich wie auf den Fotos. Etwas klein für 3-4 Personen, aber ausreichend für einen Städtetrip. Alles war sauber (nur unsere Socken waren sehr grau nach dem Rumlaufen in der Wohnung). Die Küche war sehr gut ausgestattet und wir hatten alles was wir brauchten. Die Kommunikation mit dem Gastgeber war wirklich unkompliziert und sehr nett. Wir konnten schreiben oder auch einfach kurz über die Straße ins Büro laufen. Die Wohnung liegt direkt im Zentrum von Porto - man kann alles zu Fuß erreichen! Nur Freitags und Samstags Abends kann es laut werden, dann findet direkt nebenan ein DJ Set statt - aber dieser war auch bereits um 23 Uhr zuende - also aushaltbar. Insgesamt waren wir zufrieden mit der Unterkunft.
Great appartment, about a 30 min walk to the historic centre. Communication with Luís was easy and clear.

A localização é ótima, próxima de bares, lojas e restaurantes. Achamos fácil check-in e check-out, quarto grande para casal. Quarto e banheiro limpos e com estrutura completa. O anfitrião sempre responde rápido. 
Vale muito a pena, recomendamos. 
Ficamos no primeiro quarto da frente, que dá a vista à igreja, tem escada pequena nada que atrapalhe. Tenho sono leve, A noite houve um pequeno barulho de pedestres e pessoas nos restaurantes. Recomendo usar fone ou protetores de ouvido. 
Gostamos bastante!

We found the accommodation to be clean and cosy. It’s situated just outside the town centre in quite a green area. Unfortunately, you can still hear a road very loudly, mainly due to noisy motorbikes. The mattress is extremely comfortable (we’ve never had such a comfortable mattress in any accommodation before) and the size is perfect for two people. The kitchen is generally well-equipped, though there could be a few more bowls and some items are due for replacement. The bathroom was spotlessly clean, apart from a bit of mould in the shower, and there was a slight smell of drains. Overall, we were very happy during our stay there; Miguel and the neighbours are very friendly.
If we could ask for anything for our next stay, it would be mosquito nets on the windows and the door, a clothes rack and a parasol (for our days at the beach). 
Thank you for hosting us! 🙂

Insgesamt waren wir sehr zufrieden und hatten eine tolle Zeit in der Unterkunft. 
Das Apartment ist stilvoll eingerichtet und sehr sauber. 
Die Lage ist sehr zentral, man erreicht fußläufig vieles, aber dementsprechend ist es nachts auch etwas lauter. 
(Dafür können die Gastgeber natürlich nichts, aber wenn man es nicht gewohnt ist, sollte man sich vielleicht Ohrstöpsel mitnehmen😊)
Insgesamt 5/5 ⭐️ Wir würden jederzeit wiederkommen. Vielen Dank!
Everything was great, we really enjoyed our venue !
Excelente localização, perto da maioria dos pontos turísticos, apartamento exatamente como descrito nas fotos, com uma vista incrível! Recomendo

This was one of our favorite Airbnb’s we’ve been to in Europe. The place was clean and super spacious for me and my friend. The location was also really nice. It was less than a 10 minute walk to the train station that was only a few stops away from major places. The neighborhood is really quiet and we felt safe walking to and from the train station any time of day. The only “con” would be that one of the rooms doesn’t have AC. There is a window that opens and lets in nice breeze but it faces other balconies so you may want to keep the blinds closed. We will def stay here again!

Correu tudo bem! Anúncio bem próximo da realidade 
Tudo o que precisamos, fomos rapidamente atendidos!

Olá, aqui vai minhas sinceras palavras de agradecimento para Carla, que cuidou com carinho minha chegada, bem atenciosa com quem está do outro lado, cheguei bem cansado e no outro dia estava novo para mas um dia depois de uma ótima noite de sono em um espaço de família e acolhedor, obrigado!

Nous avons passé un très bon sejour, le cadre est magnifique et très paisible.
Suite a un petit désagrément qui a ete résolu rapidement, notre hôte a ete d une compréhension et d une bienveillance.
Qualité rare de nos jours.
Encore merci !

We had a great stay in the apt. We arrived late and Raul had sent us some good spots for late night eats. The instructions for getting in were very detailed and super helpful. The location is great--you walk past a wide variety of cafes, bars and restaurants heading toward the river. Also not as noisy as some reviews noted.
Ótimo apartamento, com cozinha equipada, boa cama, ótimo chuveiro, perto da praia e supermercado, silencioso e bem ventilado.

Evde herşey düşünülmüş sadece saç kurutma makinesi yok yanınıza almalısınız. Gezebilinecek heryere yürüme mesafesinde. Ev içi yenilenmiş fotoğraflardaki gibi. Yerel Porto mahallesinin içinde. 6 yetişkin hatta çocuk alabilir.

L'appartement, proche du métro et des bus, est un peu sombre mais la décoration et la terrasse sont vraiment un plus, ainsi qu'un centre commercial et de nombreux restaurants à proximité. Joao était prévenant et s'est rendu disponible quand nécessaire. Relation très cordiale. Je recommande ce bien
위치가 최고예요. 모루정원까지 도보 5분정도 밖에 안 걸려서 일몰 보러가기 좋았어요. 호스트와의 소통도 잘 되었어요.
Beautiful design / space. Well thought out space

We had a lovely week here. The apartment is much bigger than we expected, spotlessly clean, comfortable and very well equipped. We particularly liked the location — close enough to walk into central areas like Clérigos and Ribeira, but in a quieter neighbourhood with plenty of good restaurants, cafés and shops nearby. There are also lots of interesting art galleries in the area. It was a great base for exploring Porto and a really nice place to come back to at the end of the day. We’d definitely recommend it.
Great location and amenities! Would love to stay here again for my next Porto trip

Filipe's place is wonderful! Very clean, comfortable and makes you feel at home. Filipe is very nice, responsive and proactive. The location is perfect, close to everything in Porto and easy to access! We stayed here with a 9 month old baby and he accommodated the crib and everything for us. We want to come back, we highly recommend this lovely place to stay in Porto
Appartement impeccable avec extérieur très appréciable, idéalement situé
Great place to stay in Porto, very walkable to everything, be prepared for up and down hill walking as Porto is hilly. Great location, lots of washrooms.

Heel fijn appartement, met zorg onderhouden. Fijne slaapkamer en heerlijk bed aan de achterzijde. Super goed geslapen. Luiken aan de voorzijde ivm ligging in de stad heel erg fijn! Goede airconditioning. Eco vriendelijk slaat af als het koel is en slaat weer aan als het weer warm wordt, in de nacht even wennen maar is juist beter. Net als in Amsterdam in de huizen hoor je de bovenburen lopen maar dat hoort erbij. Een heel leuke plek om te verblijven dicht bij veel. De hosts reageren heel snel en zijn welwillend om je bij te staan en zoeken naar oplossing als je een vraag hebt. Volgende keer zou ik hier weer verblijven.

We had an excellent stay here and wish we could have stayed even longer! The location couldn’t have been better. It was centrally located and had many nice stores and restaurants nearby. Isabel & Igor gave thorough instructions, making it very easy to locate and enter the unit. Don’t hesitate booking this!

Elsa foi muito cordial e receptiva. Apartamento bem localizado, com muitos restaurantes e supermercados perto. Elsa deixou mimos, ficamos muito agradecidos. Apartamento bem montado e limpo. Recomendamos de olhos fechados.

Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit zu zweit in der Unterkunft! Die Lage war optimal in Zentrumsnähe (10 min zu Fuß) und mit Aussicht auf den Douro vor der Haustür. Unsere Ansprechpartnerin Tatiana hat sehr schnell auf unsere Nachrichten reagiert und uns noch einen Föhn besorgt, der in der Unterkunft gefehlt hat. Top Service! :)
Leider war das Bad nicht sauber und im Flur und Nebenraum (Garderobe) ging das Licht nicht. 
Alles in allem war es aber gut und wir waren zufrieden!
It was really great 😊

Parking on the street in front of the house. Big room, good bed. Convenient access to a common kitchen and mini-fridge in the room. Paid coffee pods in the dispenser. Unpleasant persistent chemical smell in the room, maybe from AC unit. It wasn’t present in the rest of the house. Overall good value if you have activities in the area.

A few things other travelers may find helpful - this apartment is truly luxurious! It’s beautifully decorated and well appointed with everything you might need for your stay. There is ample parking should you have a car. But with parking comes additional security to ensure you can come and go through the garage. Rui (host) spent 45 minutes walking us through the various keys, cards, codes and fobs needed to access the garage and building. You will absolutely feel safe and secure here. Rui made us feel welcome with beverages and snacks upon arrival, which was very nice and unexpected. I advise being extremely clear in communicating your arrival time to ensure Rui can prepare for your arrival.
Super séjour sur porto avec le métro à proximité et logement parfait,
Alojamiento bien ubicado, limpio y el anfitrion muy atento y respondió rápido. Lo recomendaría.
Een geweldig stukje Porto, precies wat we zochten!
Locatie super, apartment is klein, maar van alle gemakken voorzien. Rustige omgeving, zonder geluidsoverlast. Helaas was het matras erg hard en waren de veren voelbaar.

Le logement de Sylvio était super équipé moderne et tout était super propre ! One thing that could be improved would be a more automated check-in process, as we had to message the host and wait for her to come and meet us. That said, it was nice to have the personal welcome and tour.
The location isn’t super close to public transport, especially as it was uphill from everything, but Ubers were very affordable and made getting around easy. One thing to be aware of is that the toilet isn’t on the same level as the bedroom, and there are slippery stone floors, so it may not be the most suitable option for guests with mobility difficulties.
Overall, we really enjoyed our stay and would recommend it!
Loved it! Wonderful location and super nice space ☺️
This Airbnb was very nice and clean! The host is very helpful and responsive. It’s also in the best location! 100% recommend staying here if you’re visiting Porto!
Alles wie beschrieben, sauber, gute Lage, mit dem bus kommt man gut ins zentrum. Empfehlenswert.
Foram dias agradáveis
Cozy apartment in perfect location. I loved the convenience of being in the middle of everything but could sleep peacefully

Very clean apartment in a walkable area! It was a great amount of space for 2 people compared to other places we’ve stayed. The location close to the train station and metro was very convenient when arriving/leaving the city, and besides that we walked everywhere. Apartment had a great vibe!
Super enjoyable hosts!! Will repeat for next time I visit!
깨끗하게 잘 정돈되어있는 방을 보고 기분좋게 포르투여행을 시작하게 되어 아주 좋았어요,, 관광지 다 걸어서 다닐 수 있을 정도로 위치도 너무 좋고 체크아웃 하는 날이 아쉬울 정도로 너무 행복한 여행하고 떠났네요
Nice Apartment where we could have stayed even longer, I would recommend staying here :)
Très bel appartement, bien situé, équipé, propre, lieu tranquille et sécurisé, je recommande pour un agréable séjour
Ubytování je spíše pro mladší - strmé schodiště. V domě je cítit vyšší vylhkost v domě, která je pro tyto typy domů běžná. Jinak plně funkční a útulné ubytování.
Lovely stay thank you

The place was great, if not better than described, in a very convenient location. We loved how cosy it was and check in was very easy. It has a very conveniently placed lift and was very close to bolhao market and Bolhao metro, so it was very easy travelling round the city. Any problems were resolved instantly without question. We loved this apartment and were very sad to be leaving. 🩷

Fácil acceso, comodidad de disponer de parking privado. Zona muy bonita, muy cerda del río. Dispone de supermercados muy cercanos para hacer compras y muy cerca también del centro de la ciudad. Sin duda, recomendable.

친절한 호스트를 만나 즐거웠습니다. 특히나 방의 전망이 사진과 같아서 너무 좋았습니다.
모로정원과 가깝고 포르투 시내는 걸어다닐수 있어서 여행에 불편함이 전혀 없는 위치였습니다.
인덕션이나 하이라이터 가스레인지는 없었습니다.

Beautiful location, everything was cleaned and as described, minus a couple of lights that didn’t work…
I got a voucher for this location, so I feel I paid a reasonable price, but when quoted an additional night for late check out it was quite expensive…
Defo worth it if you have the funds though, beautiful and hosts are super duper responsive!
very good
굉장히 만족스럽고 좋았던 숙소입니다. 분위기도 좋고 숙소가 굉장히 깔끔했어요. 포르토에 또 가게된다면 예약하고싶어요. 호스트 또한 친절해서 감사했습니다.

This is a great little apartment, it’s in a lovely area and it’s really easy to get around Porto on foot or close to the metro/buses if you don’t like the hills. The hosts were very helpful and gave lots of recommendations of things to do. I would definitely stay here again
everything was smooth and comfortable, obrigada!

Très bonne adresse, situé idéalement à 5 minutes d'une station de métro et à 10 minutes d'une autre station de métro avec toutes les connexions ou à 20 minutes à pied des quartiers touristiques. Très bonne prestations pour ce logement, situé au 3eme étage avec vue rue rue très passante, cafés restaurants et épicerie de quartier à proximité. La literie mériterait d'être revue.

Wonderful stay wonderful location. We were very happy that we stayed there instead of in Porto on the other side of the river. We felt like there was more of a local vibe which we really enjoyed. The listing was true to its description but since we were traveling, it was lacking a few items that we wish we had. I’m not complaining about it, the description was clear and I knew the items weren’t going to be there, but just an FYI to future patrons. 
There was not a hairdryer, fans, iron, or dish washing soap. 
We did purchase an iron and a fan which we left at the property, so hopefully they will be there in the future for others. But overall, a great day a great host and a great location. I definitely recommend it and we would stay there again.

We had a great time at the studio and stayed for two nights. The hosts were very kind and even let us check in early, which was really appreciated.
They were also very helpful throughout our trip and always active in the chat whenever we had questions. That was a big help for us as foreigners, especially when it came to getting around and knowing more about the area.
The studio had enough space for us and everything was as described. Just a small thing to keep in mind: the stairs to the third floor are quite narrow, so carrying heavy luggage up can be a bit challenging. You can also hear some footsteps from the people walking above, but this wasn't a problem for us. We knew about it beforehand and brought earplugs, so we slept just fine.
The location is excellent if you want to explore Porto on foot, and Uber/Bolt are also easily available when needed.
Overall, we really enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this place.

El abanico de techo está sucio, es un poco pequeño pero esta bien localizado. La cuesta esta fuerte y las escaleras también.
En general todo bien!!

Jose was a great host and the apartment is lovely and very well situated. The sofa bed was also very comfy. Everything is walkable and there are lots of lovely restaurants and bars around - good recommendations from Jose. 
The only thing to note is that there is not great soundproofing between the apartments in the building and there is also building work going on next door, although this is only during in the day in the week. It did not spoil our stay which we very much enjoyed.
Everything perfect!

El apartamento genial tal y como muestran las fotos todo muy bonito y cuidado...y lo mejor la ubicación y disponer de parking ya q dejamos el coche y nos movimos a pie por el centro de la ciudad. Experiencia par repetir sin duda. Gracias.
Small room but private wirh private bathroom, needs refurbishment. Vwry polite, friendly welcome, which is most appreciated ! Thank you
Good location and the room is good
Great location. Centralized location, near to public transportation and easily walkable to points of touristic interest.

Die Wohnung war wirklich sehr schön, sauber und gemütlich. Wir haben uns dort sehr wohlgefühlt und insgesamt war alles super. 
Der einzige Nachteil war leider der Lärm in der Nacht. Unter der Wohnung scheint sich eine Kneipe bzw. ein Lokal zu befinden, vor dem sich teilweise bis etwa 01:30 Uhr nachts einige Menschen aufgehalten und sehr laut unterhalten haben. Da es während unseres Aufenthalts sehr warm war und wir mit offenem Fenster schlafen mussten, war der Lärm leider besonders störend und wir konnten an einigen Nächten erst sehr spät einschlafen. 
Abgesehen davon war die Unterkunft wirklich toll und wir haben unseren Aufenthalt sehr genossen. Ich kann die Wohnung auf jeden Fall weiterempfehlen und würde sie auch wieder buchen.

Todo genial, los responsables muy atentos, con ganas de ayudar, de ver que todo estaba bien. Todo muy limpio, tal y como indicaba en el anuncio. Una zona perfecta para los visitantes de la ciudad. Recomendable, 10/10

Muy buena atención y predisposición para los huéspedes.
David excelente, super servicial y buena onda

Me and my family had a great time in Porto.
Ana Sofia’s place was in a beautiful location with lots of great places to eat close by.She had some great recommendations with what to do and see while in Porto.
We did feel our stay was short and we would have loved to have few more days to explore this charming town.
Thank you Ana Sofia

We were so impressed with how clean Marcia’s place was and how attentive she was to being a standout host. Marcia went above and beyond to make us feel welcome and helped us out with lots of local recommendations. The apartment is spacious for bigger groups, we felt very well accommodated. Marcia also graciously helped us drop off our luggage (even though we had many) to the train station. We would all highly recommend this stay.
Great location with public parking across the street. The view was excellent.

Die Unterkunft war sehr schön eingerichtet und sauber. Die Küche war zudem sehr gut ausgetattet. Der Check-In ist problemlos verlaufen, obwohl wir früher dran waren hat José Carlos uns vorher in Empfang genommen. Gut gefallen hat uns, dass sich ein Einkaufszentrum, Supermarkt und eine Foodhall in unmittelbarer Nähe befinden. Ein Besuch in der Foodhall kann man empfehlen. Der einzige Verbesserungsvorschlag den wir machen würden ist dass bei Ankuft etwas Wasser bereitgestellt werden könnte. Ansonsten würden wir diese Unterkunft auf jeden Fall weiterempfehlen!
amazing place, super walkable to get around to both shopping and food.

Wonderful apartment in a excellent location, metro nearby and walkable to all the touristy spots. Shower pressure and heat was great. Lots of natural light and the fan was great. Some things we thought could have improved our stay: an extra stool for the balcony (even instead of the table altogether), comfier pillows on the bed (they were very tall and firm) or two on each side. The body wash bottle in the shower was completely empty so we had to buy some. The kitchen drawer knobs were hard to open. The sink area connected to the bedroom was filled with drying towels and therefore not usable, not a problem for us as we shared the bathroom but would have been useful at times. The road the living area looked onto was very noisy with a lot of traffic passing through and some yelling at night (I think there are a few hostels nearby) but with the windows closed not bad, the bedroom was very quit. Don’t expect wine and water bottles despite them being shown in the pictures. All in all a most
It's a beautiful villa. Everything described on the website was absolutely true. Everything was there. Communication between Bart and me went very smoothly and quickly. I highly recommend it.

Dulce und Mario sind ganz wunderbare Gastgeber und wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Es ist sehr einfach von dort aus nach Porto mit dem Zug zu fahren, am Besten löst man die Tickets im Internet da die Automaten nicht so einfach zu bedienen sind. Man ist direkt über die wenig befahrene Straße gleich am Strand und wir haben das Rauschen der Wellen sehr genossen. Parken kann man direkt vor dem Haus und man kann von dort aus wunderbare Ausflüge machen. Es war ganz wunderbar und nur zu empfehlen.

Ce séjour reste à classer dans les meilleurs.
Nuno est très réactif et communicatif. Il nous a emmené le premier soir sur les bords du Duro et a pris soins de nous détailler chaque quartier et intéressé. Nous recommandons ce lieu en ++++

The property was nice and looks like it does in the images. It's centrally located so you can walk through the old town which is really good. The only concern was it was pretty noisy either from the road or from the dog that was barking across the street. Additionally the bed was not that comfortable because it was a bit crooked so my wife and I didn't get great sleep. Everything else was fine.
Our dog was able to stay with us, which was very helpful.
Muy bonito y muy bien ubicado

Nous avons beaucoup apprécié l'emplacement, la propriété et la qualité du studio.
Nous avons cependant été un peu dérangé par le bruit dans la quartier le matin. Le logement est petit mais fonctionnel.
Merci pour la qualité des informations transmises. Je recommande.

Wir hatten einen wirklich schönen, kurzen Aufenthalt bei Catarina. Die Zimmer sind – genau wie in der Anzeige beschrieben – eher klein, aber total süß und mit viel Liebe zum Detail eingerichtet. Man fühlt sich direkt wohl. Die Lage ist gut, wenn auch nicht direkt super zentral, für uns hat es aber wunderbar gepasst. Die Kommunikation war vollkommen unkompliziert. Eine klare Empfehlung für alle, die eine gemütliche Bleibe suchen!
Place is cozy, comfortable and peaceful, the view is beautiful, it has also a few cats on the territory
Danke war toll
We really enjoyed our time in Porto! The location of the apartment is excellent for walking thought the main sightseeings of the city. We’ll definitely come back!🥳❤️
Estaba bien en el alojamiento y no hay quejas ninguna

Das Apartment liegt in einem sehr gepflegtem Komplex mit vielen weiteren Ferienwohnungen. Die Einrichtung, war die schönste, die wir je in einem AirBnB hatten. Wir hatten einen schönen Aufenthalt und kommen gerne wieder!
Really great place, the stained glass windows was what sold it for me and the view of the Praca da Batalha’s Church, Would come again if back in Portugal.

Large spacious 2 bedroom apartment in a great location, less than a 10 min walk to the beach (there's a shortcut!). We enjoyed a coffee every morning at the café around the corner. Josmary was responsive and great. The only thing missing was coffee pods for the machine which can be bought at the nearby supermarket. Single bed is a little worn in and creaks and squeaks a lot when you move but other than that this was great! 2 adult women were able to get ready at the same sink in the bathroom, and the entire apartment worked perfectly for 4 adults! Would stay again.
This location is a 10/10. Beautiful, spacious, clean, great location, amazing hosts…..I could go on and on. Perhaps one of the best AirBnb’s I’ve stayed in. Very highly recommended!!
Excelente apartamento, com ótima localização. Estávamos com dois idosos 80+ e o prédio tem algumas escadas até o elevador, mas não tivemos problemas de acessibilidade. Recomendo.

We had a nice stay, it was a great location to explore the city from (walkable). The pool was clean and we loved the outside space. Communication with the host was easy. The apartment was nice and comfortable, AC was on when we arrived. 
Some noticable noise from our street-side apartment. Might have bothered some light sleepers, but we did not mind.
Great location and suitable stay for a short city break

Great apartment, very convenient location.
Clean
Comfy beds with good linen
Absolutely brilliant communication with the host who went out of his way to help us out
Also thank you for the bottle of port, much appreciated!
Everything was perfect, we enjoyed the time here. Perfect for exploring Porto by foot.

We absolutely loved our stay. Joana was so responsive and was kind enough to allow us to check in earlier than planned. We loved the location, it was walkable to practically everything. There was a restaurant right beneath us (which I recommend) but we weren’t bothered by sounds. We loved the view from the windows. We appreciated the fans as it got hot some nights. Washing machine was also useful as well as the coffee machine. No complaints honestly

Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Tolle, authentische Umgebung mit leckeren Restaurants.
Die Dachterrasse ist ein klares Plus. Wir würden auf jeden Fall wieder kommen, auch wenn die Betten etwas bequemer sein könnten.

La barrière de la langue n'est pas un handicap, tout ce que nous avions programmé c'est réalisé.
Logement bien pour découvrir la ville et ses charmes. Nous le recommandons.
Wonderful location!
Es war sehr schön in der Unterkunft, wir hatten alles, was wir benötigt haben. Zusätzlich hatten wir die Möglichkeit unser Surfbrett unterzustellen.

The apartment was beautiful and clean and was in a convenient, walkable location. The host was very kind and communicative and accommodated an earlier check-in time for us. It was also a nice bonus that the unit has AC!
The shower did run out of hot water after about 10 minutes of back-to-back use, but this wasn’t a big problem for us.
Amazing location, very responsive, and has everything you could truly need! I will always recommend this place

Die Wohnung lag sehr zentral, sodass wir alles super zu Fuß erreichen konnten. Der Parkplatz war für uns ideal 😊 Die Ausstattung und die schnelle Kommunikation mit Daniel haben uns sehr gefallen. Nach Betätigen der Klospühlung gab es im Badezimmer einen Abwassergeruch aus der Leitung, der sich aber nach einer gewissen Zeit wieder gelegt hat. Es waren angenehme zwei Nächte!
Klein en knus appartement, alles is aanwezig wat je nodig zou kunnen hebben! Door de praktische inrichting voelde het zeker nooit te klein! Zeker een aanrader!

Wir waren für drei Nächte in der Wohnung und haben uns sehr wohlgefühlt. Die Wohnung war sauber, gemütlich und genau wie beschrieben. Die Lage war ebenfalls sehr gut und die Kommunikation mit dem Gastgeber war unkompliziert und freundlich.
Insgesamt hatten wir einen sehr angenehmen Aufenthalt und würden die Unterkunft gerne weiterempfehlen. Vielen Dank! 😊

This place is amazingly quiet in such a compact city. It felt like a refuge. Lovely layout, very comfy beds, nice lighting, and easy to walk to many central things. We arrived later than planned with a delayed flight and we weren’t shown how to use a few things inside, but Victor came over to help us the following day.

Great apartment and location in Porto, close to supermarkets and a short walk from attractions. The apartment was even bigger than we expected and well decorated. Mario arranged to meet us at check-in time to hand over the keys and provided some excellent recommendations for restaurants and sites. Thank you!

my partner and i stayed for about 6
days and absolutely loved it. perfect location, a great size and amenities, overall couldn’t have asked for more. would 100% book again.
Beautiful apartment.
Casa acolhedora, confortável e uma piscina simplesmente maravilhosa, aconselho este local

Staying with Alvaro was great, very clear instructions on getting in and where to find everything 
The accommodations were immaculate and cozy. Kitchen and bathroom were well stocked with the essentials.
Neighbourhood was quiet but accessible to local amenities, bring your walking shoes!
The host was kind and friendly, and the location was very convenient.
Great hosts in a great location in Porto. Would strongly encourage for families with little ones.
Ótima localização! Bem movimentado e com muito comércio e restaurantes!

We really enjoyed our stay here. I especially loved how much natural light the apartment had during the day, while at night we could close all the shutters and make the rooms wonderfully dark for sleeping.
I also loved seeing trees from every room, and the master bedroom in particular faced a very calm and serene courtyard. There was some construction happening nearby during our stay, but I was pleasantly surprised by how little of it we could hear from inside the apartment.
The apartment is very tastefully furnished, and I quickly felt at home there. I would happily stay here again on a future visit to Porto.

Horacio ha sido muy amable y pendiente en todo momento de nuestras necesidades. Respondía muy muy rápido. Apartamento limpio y bien ubicado con todo lo necesario. Éramos un grupo de 8 personas y tener 3 baños ha sido un lujazo. Moltes gràcies Per tot Horacio .💪💪
Loved the area fantastic beach and boardwalk. Sunset was amazing. Rui and his wife and kids were wonderful!
We had a very pleasant stay. The host was very helpful and accommodating, we enjoyed the city of Porto!

Filipe’s place was perfect for my week-long stay. It’s very spacious, modern, and quiet, plus has everything you need for a comfortable stay. If you can’t find a household item in his place, it’s probably because you haven’t looked in the right drawer or cabinet!
Filipe is also a very friendly and enthusiastic host. He had great local recommendations and made sure I had all the info I needed for a great stay. Highly recommended!

The apartment was absolutely spotless and beautifully maintained. Everything was clean, comfortable, and just as described. The host was also very responsive and helpful throughout our stay. Would happily stay here again!
Very good location on Ave da Republica. Very clean, quiet, well equipped for 4 adults.

This apartment was in a beautiful historic building and I just loved it. Keep in mind the place is on the second floor and there’s a total of 50 stairs to climb with luggage. There is no elevator. For reference I’m a 60 year old woman with a jam packed carry on and an overstuffed backpack and I managed the climb up and down with no issues!

The owner was very polite, helpful and responded very quickly. The place was clean and comfy. It's a small studio, suitable for a small family - just be careful with the glassware. Very convenient location, easy access to the station and shopping centre, and the best part is the big supermarket just across the road. Walkable to all the main highlights. Highly recommended!
Overall a lovely stay, great location, excellent communication with the hosts.

Nous avons passé un agréable séjour dans le studio de Christina. Le logement, très bien équipé, est bien placé pour découvrir les nombreux sites à visiter.
Nous remercions Christina de ses délicates attentions pour notre arrivée: une petite bouteille de Porto avec des biscuits apéritif ainsi qu' une bouteille d'eau fraîche.

L'hôte et son conjoint son super accueillant et chaleureux.
Nous nous sommes directement senti à l'aise dès l'arrivée.
Je recommande vivement les yeux fermés même.
top

Wir wurden herzlich empfangen und haben uns insgesamt sehr wohl gefühlt. Die Gastgeber waren bei Fragen immer ansprechbar und haben uns Tipps für Porto gegeben. Im Restaurant kann man sicher sehr lecker essen, was uns aber leider nicht gelungen ist, weil wir abends immer noch unterwegs waren.

Le logement est impeccable, le lit est très confortable et Barbara est très gentille. 
La rue piétonne est un plus, il y a de nombreux restaurants a proximité et c'est agréable de s'y balader. 
Nous recommandons sans hésiter.
Comfy beds! Great location! Honestly want to bring the apartment home with me! The unit had everything we needed and more; if I came back to Porto I would want the same exact space.

We hit the bull's eye by choosing Andre's place. The place was great: clean and tastefully decorated. The apartment was conveniently located and close to transit, grocery stores, and the city center. We highly recommend it.
Easy to find, close to grocery store and also to good restaurants.
A wonderful stay! Perfectly placed for exploring Porto! Thank you ☺️

The Botica Guesthouse is located right on the main pedestrian street of Espinho. It is a 5-minute walk from the beach promenade and is surrounded by shops, mercados, restaurants, the train station, etc. 
The Guesthouse itself is immaculate – it is beautifully and tastefully furnished, the kitchen and bathroom are outfitted with everything you need. Parasols, foldable beach chairs and beach towels are available for trips to the beach.
Communication with the Guesthouse was flawless, and the manager was in fact present every day to answer any questions and to offer tips. The rooms were cleaned every two days, the cleaning personnel was very friendly and helpful. 
All in all it was just about perfect in every way. Espinho is a charming little town and well situated for day trips to Porto or Aveiro if you so choose. The Botica Guesthouse is highly recommended and we would definitely return.

Million dollar view from the deck and every bedroom. Every bedroom had their own private bath. 
Paulo was extremely easy to communicate with and the place is simply lovely.

Sfeervolle ruimte, leuk uitzicht en locatie. Héérlijk om je even terug te trekken. Koffie en Port staan klaar. Alleen even wennen aan de kleine kuil aan de linkerkant van het tweepersoonsbed. Maar eenmaal in slaap; zoete dromen gehad ;)

Great apartment with a beautiful terrrace overlooking the valley - Sunset drinks were a great way to wind down for the afternoon. Kids loved the pool area and had so much fun diving in! Laundry was an added bonus to make the place 5 star

Appartamento molto carino e comodo per la posizione, è facile raggiungere i punti di interesse da visitare.
Cucina attrezzata con tutto il necessario. Comunicazione chiara e precisa, sia per il check in che per le informazioni utili al soggiorno a Porto.
Alloggio molto consigliato
This Airbnb was clean and in the perfect location for my girls trip to Porto!!! Having a sea was also a huge plus for us. I recommend staying here.

Het appartement ligt heel centraal en is ‘s nachts toch rustig. De inrichting is zoals geadverteerd, gloednieuw en comfortabel.
Olinda is heel goed bereikbaar en reageert meteen op vragen of komt met suggesties over bezienswaardigheden. De instructies vooraf waren perfect.
Een aanrader voor wie Porto wil bezoeken!!
Merci pour votre hospitalité et de votre aide. Tout était parfait
This is an incredible place to stay in Porto! Centrally located & well maintained. I would stay here again!

Very comfortable accommodation for two. Kitchen had everything needed for cooking. It was great to have a dining table for eating and cards! Local area is not too touristy but has some good local restaurants. Best coffee shop we found nearby (we love good coffee) - Combi Coffee. Great place to stay to explore Porto but also escape the crowds.

Superbe appartement bien situé à côté du métro.l appartement était conforme aux photos.tres propre spacieux pour 2 couples.le propriétaire était sympa.on avait a disposition une buanderie avec les produits.Nous avons été très content.
We had such a fabulous stay at Carolina’s place! The flat is in an amazing location and is really clean, bright and well equipped (plus a lovely balcony!). I would definitely recommend staying here.

A estadia foi ótima! Apartamento limpo, novo e bem completo.. fomos informados de início que a rua era bem movimentada (então já fomos preparados para o barulho) mas fora isso, tudo ocorreu maravilhosamente!

We enjoyed our visit to Porto and David's place was perfect. It was super cute and had everything we needed. Great location walkable to many stores, restaurants, and sights to see. Daniel was very responsive and kind. Can't wait to come back for another visit.
와 진짜 포르투 최고의 숙소였어요. 사정상 방을 업그레이드 해주셨는데 뷰도 좋고 음식도 해먹고 더좋았어요. 가까운곳에 계시면서 바로바로 피드백해주시고, 머무는 동안 불편하지 않게 준비해주셔서 감사했습니다. 최고❤️❤️

Es ist fußläufig alles erreichbar, was man in Porto sehen sollte, ein paar Restaurants und Tavernen direkt um die Ecke. Die Wohnung selbst war für die Tage mehr als ausreichend, wir haben uns wohl gefühlt!
웬만한 호텔보다 친절하고 편하고 깨끗해요 정말로!!!!!!!!
We really enjoyed our short stay and would definitely book this suite again. Thank you Ricardo & Vinciane.

In der Unterkunft von Teresa haben wir uns direkt sehr wohl gefühlt. Alles war wie beschrieben und in sehr gutem Zustand. In der Küche war vom Toaster bis zum Airfryer alles vorhanden. 
Alles in allem ist die Unterkunft absolut empfehlenswert.
Heel mooi schoon en groot appartement

Wat een fijne plek! Binnen is alles aanwezig en super netjes. Een volledig uitgeruste keuken, een lekker (maar tikkie smal) bed en een goede badkamer. Er was zowel een eettafel, een bank én een buiten zitje, dus genoeg zitplekken. De locatie is ook top, genoeg restaurantjes in de buurt en je loopt zo de stad in. We hebben erg genoten van ons verblijf! Mocht je licht slapen, neem dan oordoppen mee, je hoort de bovenbuurman lopen.

We loved the location! Right next to the main train station and a short walk to the town square. There are supermarkets within 10 minute walk. Great communication and clean space. The perfect amount of space for two couples.

The apartment looked exactly like the photos - great amount of space, good size bed and spotlessly clean. Grateful for the 2 fans provided too! 
Instructions to access the building/apartment were really clear and Marisa was a fantastic host - checking in after our first night and letting us check out a little later today. 
The apartment is on a busy road but Mariza explains that in her description and we got used to it so don’t let that put you off - would recommend this place for sure. 
Thanks for a great stay in Porto!

We had a great time staying in Porto. The location was great, near many great restaurants and not too far from the river and the more "touristy" area if we were interested in going there. Hosts were very responsive during our stay and we liked our unit a lot. The A/C was a very welcomed addition considering the heatwave.

This is our second time staying in Aurora’s place. We absolutely love the location. We are literally in the heart of Porto and love every minute of the vibrant life happening around us. We will be back.
Un lugar muy bonito y tranquilo

This Airbnb is in a perfect location for seeing the city. The road it is on is quite noisy, but we are used to country living! Modern & spacious with traditional stone dotted throughout the apartment. Great for 3 couples with 3 ensuite bathrooms.
sehr gute Lage und saubere Unterkunft
Wat een geweldige plek aan het strand! Wat een fijn huisje dichtbij allerlei barretjes en restaurantjes. Echt heerlijk! Heel erg aanbevolen!

Logement comme sur les photos! Très propre, bien équipé et bien situé. La literie était très confortable. Comme l’appartement est dans un quartier vivant, il y a un peu de bruit de la rue. Merci aux hôtes qui étaient vraiment sympathiques et qui ont répondu à toutes nos demandes!

Very assessable and very good location,but no uber excess .
But will get it again if needed.

Thank you so much for hosting my family! We had a wedding in town and the Airbnb was so well resourced and had everything needed. We loved the proximity and convenience of the location and appreciate how friendly and helpful Luis was. Highly recommend!
Petit séjour parfait. Appartement petit mais très bien pour deux personnes et à proximité de tout.
Eurico siempre estuvo pendiente contesto rapido

Ligger väldig centralt i Porto. Många trappor i boendet, men det visste vi om. Rent och fräscht.
Det enda vi saknade var glas, det fanns bara 3 vinglas och boendet är för 10, vi var 8 så det vore toppen att komplettera med.
Celest hat mich sehr nett empfangen und war eine sehr herzliche Gastgeberin. Schönes kleines Apartment, gute Anbindung an Bus & Metro. Einkaufsmöglichkeiten in direkter Umgebung.

We had a lovely stay at Brenda’s apartment. The location was excellent and close by to all the attractions. 
The photos don’t do the apartment justice - it’s much more spacious than it looks and the decor was really nice. There were 3 balconies so you could enjoy the sun at any time of the day. 
The cleanliness was immaculate. 
We were grateful to be provided recommendations by Brenda and we enjoyed Grahams port tasting/tour, Mistu (for fine dining) and Arco iris (Portuguese).
We will definitely be back!
Great place to stay in Porto. Apartment is spacious and super easy to find.
Nice charming appartement in the middle of the ancient city. Great to do many smaller excursions per day and relaxing in between.
We had a super comfortable stay at this AirBnB. The location is convenient. Everything is clean, spacious and beautiful. The host responds quickly. I‘d highly recommend.

Sehr gute und zentrale Lage.
Die Wohnung ist gut über einen Aufzug erreichbar.
Die Küche ist ausreichend ausgestattet, das Bad ausreichend groß.
Wohn- und Schlafzimmer sind ebenfalls geräumig und sauber.

Un séjour absolument parfait chez Judite ! Le logement était impeccable, très confortable et décoré avec beaucoup de goût. Mention spéciale pour le jacuzzi, un vrai bonheur pour se détendre après une journée de découverte. 🥰
L’emplacement est également idéal, parfaitement situé pour profiter des alentours et découvrir Porto.
Judite est une hôte adorable et disponible. Nous avons passé un excellent séjour et nous reviendrons avec grand plaisir ! Je recommande ce logement les yeux fermés. ❤️
Camille et Jérémy

The apartment was so spacious and perfectly positioned in the historic part of town, right next to the cathedral and bridge.
He was very attentive to our needs, checking in periodically to see if she could make our stay more enjoyable.
Highly recommended!

Maison magnifique, tout était impeccable, propre et Julia était toujours disponible, donne des bon conseils et très très gentille. Je la recommande vivement et on a passé de très belles vacances en famille, on a profité de la piscine et beaucoup rigolé.
Perfectly decorated and well thought out. Host was very responsive. We enjoyed our stay. It was safe, quiet, clean and secure. Strongly recommend this quaint little cottage.

Great location very clean .the apartment was really big with 2 spacious rooms. There was a spacious bathroom also very clean. I gave this place a 5 star because I cant give a 6. I would defenetly refer to friends and family.

Bem localizado, próximo do metrô e do centro. Flexibilidade para guardar as malas antecipadamente. Café e frutas disponibilizadas. Padaria, mercado, shopping e restaurantes próximos. Ótima estadia. Fomos recebidos muito bem.

Il nostro soggiorno è stato semplicemente fantastico! L'alloggio era pulitissimo, accogliente e curato in ogni minimo dettaglio, esattamente come appare in foto. Ottima la presenza del giardino interno per trascorrere alcuni momenti del soggiorno.Sergio è stato di una gentilezza e disponibilità uniche, accogliendoci con calore e dandoci ottimi consigli per vivere al meglio la zona. La posizione è ideale,market nella zona e fermata dell'autobus per raggiungere tutti i luoghi di interesse. Non ci è davvero mancato nulla per sentirci come a casa. Consigliatissimo, torneremo sicuramente!
This is a great find and close to walking all over PORTO! I would stay here again
It was centrally located and very walkable. Laundry and air conditioning were a great to have. Hosts were very responsive. Was a great place for 2 couples. Would recommend.

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment was spacious, modern and exceptionally clean — the perfect place to come home to and relax after a big day exploring. It was also lovely and quiet at night, which made for a great night’s sleep.
The supermarket was only a few minutes away, which was very convenient. Marina’s check-in was detailed and extremely helpful, and her local knowledge was much appreciated.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend this apartment! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Very kind man with much help for me and even helping with bus schedules. 
Stunning view from the 3rd floor room.

Die Lage der Unterkunft ist wirklich schön - man kann aus einem Schlafzimmer heraus nachts das Meer hören! 😍 In ein paar Schritten ist man direkt am Strand und kann auch diverse Restaurants fußläufig erreichen. Eine Bushaltestelle ist nicht weit, um bequem nach Porto zu gelangen.
Die Unterkunft ist mit allem ausgestattet, was man braucht und der Check In war kinderleicht - wir durften sogar viel früher in die Wohnung, was uns die Ankunft sehr erleichtert hat! Dankeschön 🙏

Dear Ana, 
I had a wonderful stay in your apartment. Despite the fact it’s in the busy old town part, it was peaceful inside. Of course I could hear some neighbours, but that’s absolutely normal for city …
Close to the river, close to the bus stop, close to Sao Bento and metro.
I was on my own, but felt safe. 
Thank you for your kindess and support during my stay. I hope to see Porto again.
All the best,
Magdalena
Excellent location, comfortable bed. Definitely wouldn’t describe as Lux but good enough
Der Aufenthalt im Apartment hat unseren Erwartungen entsprochen. Viele Haltestellen in der Nähe.
Fin lägenhet för 2 personer. Nära till Metro som också tog oss till flygplatsen. Vi bodde en vecka och ingenting fattades i lägenheten

Déception : emplacement parfait mais logement assez degrade
Le seul point fort de ce logement est sa situation face à la plage et la présence de consommables de base. Pour le reste, la prestation n'est pas au niveau et les photos ne reflètent pas tellement la réalité 
L'appartement est vétuste et manque clairement d'entretien :
 Propreté et mobilier : le mobilier est vieillot et sale, notamment le canapé taché dissimulé sous un plaid. Le sol est fortement abîmé.
 Fenêtres et isolation : les fenêtres ne ferment pas complètement, ce qui dégrade considérablement l'isolation, particulièrement inconfortable en cas de forte chaleur.
 Parking : bien qu'un parking en sous-sol soit annoncé, son accès est tellement étroit et difficile qu'il est impraticable pour une grosse voiture. J'ai dû me garer dans la rue.
En résumé, la localisation ne fait pas tout. Cet appartement nécessite de lourds travaux de rénovation et une remise en état complète 
Clairement je ne recommande pas en état
Très bon séjour dans un lieu agréable et proche du centre. Nous recommandons

Nous avons séjourné 2 nuits dans cet agréable appartement où il y a tout le confort et le nécessaire. La maison est propre et bien équipée.
C'est situé proche de tout, 
Il y a des transports dans la rue.
Wir waren zu viert 8 Tage da und haben uns sofort wohl gefühlt. Wir wurden persönlich begrüßt und haben alles nötige gezeigt bekommen. Kommen gerne wieder.
Danke für den Aufenthalt! Wir haben es sehr genossen.

I can’t even begin to express how much I loved staying at Christina’s, her place is so cute, cozy, she is a very sweet and hospitable person, her place is right in the heart of Porto, you can walk everywhere, all the main sites are near, the street is a pedestrian street, you can hear people at night but that did not bother me it all. I hope to come back and stay here again.
