Great place, very peaceful and quiet while still being close to everything you need, Porto's city centre and Vila Nova de Gaia. It's not big but has everything you need. Rui was also a perfect host, always there to help, proactive, and gave us nice recommendations.

Couch war zwar etwas durchgelesen aber machbar
TreppenStufe für mein Geschmack zu locker
Aber sonst alles bestens

Una estancia cómoda, tranquila y agradable. 
Luis muy atento y amable. 
Sin duda un lugar para alojarse
Amazing view and walkable to all the hotspots

Die Lage der Unterkunft ist ruhig aber dennoch zentral. Die Wohnung war sehr sauber und die Ausstattung neu. Die Kommunikation mit Filipa & Bryan war super schnell, unkompliziert und total nett! Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und können die Unterkunft für einen Porto-Städtetrip wärmstens weiter empfehlen!

Es gibt wirklich kaum etwas Negatives zu berichten. Die Unterkunft hat ihren ganz eigenen Charme und entspricht genau der Beschreibung des sehr freundlichen Gastgebers. Wir haben uns hier wohlgefühlt und es war alles vorhanden, was man für einen angenehmen Aufenthalt braucht – es hat uns an nichts gefehlt.
Wenn man überhaupt etwas anmerken möchte, dann vielleicht den etwas intensiveren Geruch der alten Holzmöbel. Auch das Bett könnte bei Gelegenheit einmal erneuert werden – und wenn man schon dabei ist, darf es dann auch gerne ein kleines bisschen größer sein 🤭😉
Danke Nuno
Insgesamt aber eine schöne, charmante Unterkunft mit einem sehr netten Gastgeber, die wir gerne weiterempfehlen.

Had a very nice stay at the property. Things were as-described. It was very quiet on the grounds. We picked this one because of the unit size and available parking. The unit was very comfortable. Great living room to hang out in with the two couples on our trip.

Nos cambiaron de apartamento unos días antes.
Llegamos y un primero sin ascensor( yo tengo problemas de salud y me cuesta mucho subir y bajar escaleras) nos dio la opción de cancelar, pero a las 5:30 quien se arriesga a buscar otro sitio? Estábamos deseando llegar y cansados del viaje.
Por otro lado, tenía muchísima humedades, mi hijo todos los días con antiestaminicos.

We had a wonderful time. This Airbnb is in a great location close to the train station (5 min walk) and walkable to sights and restaurants. It was true to photos. There is a slight musty in the building and bedroom, which was not a problem for us but might be for others that are sensitive. Bring shampoo if that matters to you. There was a very basic body soap/shampoo combo available. Loved the small Port gift. Would recommend.

Our stay was exactly what we expected. Really good location, close to the Duoro River and all the restaurants surrounding it. Even if the streets were bustling, if you close the windows and panes, it is silent and you can sleep well. We received a lot of good recommendations from Pedro before our arrival.

Location is great, and the hosts were very responsive. Good details in the apartment. the only drawback is the Stink in the apartment. We took a book by mistake mixed up with my daughter’s book, but the host was very understanding. If it wasn’t about the stink and smell I would’ve stayed there again..
Très joli appartement et super localisation
A great place to stay

My stay in Porto was splendid. The location is perfect if you want to walk to all the main landmarks and key tourist spots. It's also right near some great coffee shops. The host was wonderful and even left us some wine and water, which was a really thoughtful touch.
The apartment itself is cozy and located right across from a historical street, yet it is very quiet with no noise at all. The bed is comfortable and the shower is great. The bedroom and bathroom are upstairs, so if you are traveling with an elderly person, keep in mind they will need to use the stairs. My only suggestion to make it perfect would be to install a door in the shower area so the surrounding floor doesn't get wet. I would easily come back to stay here again!

José was a great host always responding promptly to any queries. He had a guide in both Portuguese and English recommending local things to do and how to get round the city. The place was secluded but well connected via public transport, we did walk to the main city centre but this would take around 30/35 minutes so did get the tram some days which was no issue as it was very cheap! The place was just described and a perfect little base for what we needed - even had a coffee machine! For two people it was a good size but I can see how if you were a bigger group it may be a bit squashed. Overall we were impressed, thank you for a lovely time José!
An amazing stay in Porto that I would return to and will be recommending to all my friends who visit the area.

We thoroughly enjoyed our 2 night stay and we will be back. This apartment was perfect for our needs and Luis was a fantastic host who was very responsive to texts and gave great recommendations on food venues and things to do.

Super accueil de Fernando, avec quelques produits locaux à déguster. Très belle attention. Logement très propre et fonctionnel. Très bien situé. Nous recommandons sans hésiter. Garage très pratique.Merci Fernando pour tout.

Beau logement propre et bien situé dans porto. Métro accessible facilement. Marco est très réactif. Nous avons passé un agréable séjour. Seul petit bémol : la musique tardive dans le bar accolé à l'immeuble. Sinon tout était parfait.
Appartement très agréable à vivre et bien placé pour arpenter la ville de Porto.

Mooie airbnb en net, maar heel klein voor 6 en de wc sjas viel meteen uit elkaar. Ook stonk het "terras" vanachter en kwam er een twijfelachtige geur uit de airco. Verluchten zit er ook niet in met kleine raampjes.

We thought the fan would be enough to keep the unit cold but we were wrong. We went in September and the unit was hot, muggy, and we decided to buy a new Airbnb somewhere else. We probably stayed for a total of 6 hours. We couldn’t get comfortable even after opening the windows, letting the fan run, and taking cold showers. We shouldn’t’ve assumed the fan would keep us cool when booking, that was our fault. Personally, I wouldn’t recommend if you’re staying during hot months. Even semi hot months. I genuinely wish I could rate it higher but the fan was just too small to stay.
Great place, so quiet and close to city :) clean, spacious and a delight. We had a great time, totally recommend.

Wir waren 4 Tage in Porto und im Apartement; es ist alles fussläufig zu erreichen, der Mietwagen stand sicher! Es war sehr angenehm und komfortabel, schön geschnitten und sehr geräumig . Wir hatten einen sehr sympathischen persönlichen Empfang!
Great stay in a perfect location
Great location. Close to everything. Air conditioning worked great. 100% return.

We had an amazing stay! It was very clean and spacious for 2 people. 
Ac worked great, elevator was perfect, apartment had a lot of sunlight, & the terrace was beautiful. 
It was in such an amazing location & was very central. The place felt very safe with a gate to the property that would lock at night.
Another big reason we chose this place was the option to store our luggage at their office. This was super helpful with checking in and out! 
The communication was always very attentive even during off hours. 
I would 100% recommend this stay to a friend!

L'hébergement correspond à la description. Une chambre sans fenêtre n'est pas très confortable, mais c'est bon marché. Pour une raison inconnue, il n'y avait qu'une seule serviette, un oreiller vraiment inconfortable et un matelas qui grinçait. Dans l'ensemble, tout était propre et confortable. Merci.

Great location and overall a really nice apartment. You are right in the middle of everything and just minutes from the train station. 
However, the place could benefit from some maintenance. The bathroom in the double bedroom was not fit for purpose. The shower tray leaked all over the floor and the sink was not properly connected to the wall. In the other bedroom, there was a large damp patch on the roof. 
There was also construction work on the building next door which meant we were woken early by drilling. Nobody’s fault but would have appreciated being told in advance. 
Overall, hosts were very attentive and would recommend but needs some work to bring it to full potential.
Amazing apartment in a beautiful part of the city

Wir können die Wohnung überhaupt Nicht weiter empfehlen: es ist dort sehr schmutzig gewesen und überall, selbst in der Küche waren viele Fliegen 🪰 🪰 🪰 
Es muss hier dringend eine komplette und professionelle Grundreinigung durchgeführt werden, bevor man diese Wohnung an andere Gäste weiter vermietet.
Mein Aufenthalt in Porto und die Wohnung waren top. Nicht weit vom Zentrum oder Sehenswürdigkeiten entfernt. Ich konnte alles fussläufig erreichen
Muito bom

Für unseren Aufenthalt in Porto war die Wohnung perfekt 
Sie liegt fußläufig nahe an allen wichtigen Sehenswürdigkeiten 
Einzig die vor dem Haus verlaufende Straße ist bei geöffneten Fenstern sehr laut. Die Fenster sind jedoch sehr gut gedämmt so ist es wenn diese geschlossen sind kein Problem 
Wir würden wieder kommen ganz sicher !
Claudia was a great host! She was responsive the whole time we were staying in Porto. Her place is amazing and in a great location. Would recommend this to anyone traveling to Porto!

Maria’s apartment is beautiful, extremely clean and in a great location. Best of all, Maria was very responsive and enthusiastic. Emilia helped us with our laundry and always greeted us with a smile and hospitality that made us feel right at home. 
We got to have a lovely lunch in the garden and pick some lemons. Maria even came down to greet us and bring some fresh watermelon. 
Highly recommend, thanks so much !

Everything was perfect. Location, cleanliness, communication. I was not bothered by any street noise or buses at all. I am only addressing it because mentioned in other comments but otherwise I would not even have noticed it.

Wir hatten wirklich eine richtig schöne Zeit hier! Die Wohnung sieht genau so aus wie auf den Fotos, war super sauber und total gemütlich eingerichtet.
Ein riesiges Dankeschön auch an die Gastgeber: Die Kommunikation war mega entspannt, Antworten kamen immer blitzschnell und der Check-in lief völlig problemlos.
Man hat sich ab Minute eins direkt wohlgefühlt. Danke für die tolle Gastfreundschaft!

Excellent place to stay - easily walkable to the main areas of Porto
Clean and tidy - really nice to have the balcony space as well
And air conditioning goes a long way
Ubicación ideal en una de las zonas más céntricas de Porto 👍
War alles super :)

Loved our stay at this beautiful flat. You are right in the heart of the action and surrounded by restaurants/bars. You can see the Douro River right out of your window. Great place to explore the heart of Porto.

A nice, modern apartment in a great location, tucked away from the main tourist spots but still easy enough to explore it all on foot. The street will filled with little local bars and restaurants. 
Ana was a wonderful host and we would definitely stay here again - highly recommend!
Ótima estadia! Recomendo
Entsprach voll und ganz unseren Erwartungen
Muito boa supera a expectativa de mais. Muito obrigada!!!

What an absolutely spacious and gorgeous apartment. Right next to the supermarket and FC Porto. The Metro is just the other side of the ground. The apartment had got everything you need and the black out blinds were a brilliant bonus. Anytime I contacted the host, they were straight back to me and really helpful. If we are in Porto again, I hope this apartment is available. Thank you 😊

As acomodações são exatamente como nas fotos, é possivel caminhar até a ponte, local tranquilo, facil para solicitar transporte por aplicativo, todos os eletrodomesticos funcionam, tudo limpo e organizado.

My husband and I went to Porto to celebrate our 30th anniversary and wanted a place that was centrally located, quiet, and comfortable. Tiago's place exceeded our expectations.
Location, location, location — we couldn't have asked for better. Just a block and a half away is Cais da Ribeira, a picturesque riverside quay along the Douro River with views across the Dom Luís Bridge and the Port wine cellars. It was also walking distance to most of the historical spots on our list, and we spent hours exploring and making new memories.
Tiago was an awesome host, offering great recommendations on restaurants and places to visit. Between the location and his hospitality, this stay made our anniversary trip memorable. We'd happily stay again and recommend it to anyone visiting Porto.
Really enjoyed our stay in the apartment. Close by to the metro or a short walk into town. Thanks for hosting us
Excelente ubicación, con el plus de tener aparcamiento propio.
Great apartment out of the way in a quiet area for relaxing and using as a base to visit Porto.
Cozy place in a great location! The city center is within walking distance, and there’s also a metro station nearby.

Ruca's place was a tranquil oasis just outside of Porto. From start to finish she was easy to communicate with and very friendly. She put us in touch with a very helpful taxi driver who shuttled us from the airport to the AirBnb and back again.
The location of the house is perfect for those looking for a more remote getaway, but the convenience of close public transport if needed. The station is a 5 minute walk for a 20 minute journey right into Porto city centre.
The actual house itself is amazing and beautifully furnished with many essentials for a long week away. Ruca even left us some bread, milk and other bits to get us started. We were left to our own devices to discover the area with access to the beach available to the rear of the property. You couldn't help but relax in the house. 
Would love to stay again, thank you Ruca.

We had a wonderful stay with Manuela! She was very kind, responsive, and helpful as a host. The apartment is beautiful and very clean, perfect for two people. The location was very central to the city and convenient for shopping. We enjoyed our time and would absolutely recommend!

Nous avons été super bien accueilli, hôtes arrangeants et pleins de conseils . Chambre conforme aux photos et l’emplacement super pour se déplacer dans Porto grâce à sa proximité avec le métro jaune qui permet de se rendre au centre historique et le bus directement à Foz . Nous recommandons ☺️

The location is unbeatable, walking distance to everything. Sao Bento station is just across the street and if you get hungry, time out market and local authentic restos are just there, cafe is literally on the first floor. The apartment is clean, perfect for two people. Thought it will be noisy but not at all. Andre has been a responsive host and friendly too! I think the stairs are worth it :)
Excelente apartamento si vas a visitar Portugal. Está cerca del transporte público y es muy fácil llegar al centro. Lo recomiendo totalmente. Las instalaciones también son impecables.
Due Unterkunft war wunderschön, wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt!

L’hôte est très gentil, disponible et réactif. Parking privé parfait. 
L’appartement donne sur une rue très passante donc on entend beaucoup les voitures même la nuit côté des chambres. L’appartement nécessite des travaux pas de Clim ni VMC donc fortes odeur d’humidité moisissures et poussières des tapis le parquet de la cuisine salon est carrément décollé. Mon fils asthmatique et moi sensible niveau respiratoire nous avons du partir plus tôt que prévue. L’hôte encore une fois est très sympathique je n’ai rien à lui reprocher et il a été très conciliant.
My room was in 3rd floor. They didn’t mention No Elevator!
Als eerste reis met onze vriendengroep direct een leuke ervaring gehad. Zowel de host als het huis waren top en het zwembad was een leuke toevoeging.
Excelente ubicación, todo muy limpio tal como las fotos.

The room was very nice and clean. Exactly as shown on the pictures. The location was great, it was near everything. You do hear sounds from the city but that is to be expected in the inner-city, so it did not bother us. All in all we had a great time.

The house is very spacious and comfortable. Check-in and check-out were very easy and convenient. There were plenty of cafés and restaurants within walking distance of the house. The only issue was that the beds were a little squeaky.
Petro and Susanna provided us with all the information we needed in great detail beforehand. We were happy with our stay.

Shai’s place was available at very short notice and I’m talking less than an hour! He was very responsive, accommodating and made the check in so easy! The property is very easy to find, secure, very central and clean. I would definitely come stay in this apartment again next time I’m in Porto, I highly recommend it. Short walk from a vegan bakery and a cute matcha place as well as many other places such as the main shopping strip. Thank you Shai, see you again I’m sure!
Vi var två vuxna och ett barn som stannade en natt. Allt fungerade bra och vi var nöjda.

We absolutely loved our stay, the place was so clean and comfortable for us 4 women. We felt safe and secure and the area was super walkable with easy access to everywhere we wanted to go. Although we didn't spend much time in the room because we were mostly traversing the city, the AC was cold and the beds were perfect for an after lunch nap or simply to return and take a break from shopping to drop our bags. Having an elevator was also a huge plus. If I ever get the chance to stay here again, I most certainly will.

The location was really good, nice and central. The bathroom and kitchen were clean. Some of the pans were a bit worse for wear and not all of the cutlery was clean. No washing machine but did have a dishwasher. A large amount of the furniture was fabric, the rest wooden, noticeable dust on cupboards and felt heavy in the chest if you have asthma etc. Sink drawer had fabric in the bottom which had lots of hair attached that was unfortunate. Staircase to apartment had a terrible smell, unsure as to the source but hopefully can be rectified. The place looked very nice but the diner details weren’t there. Bed was extremely comfortable however and a good amount of wardrobe space.

Very nice place and the response was quick everytime.
Thanks for making our stay nice.
Espaço agradável e bonito, bastante confortável e acolhedor, numa zona calma, e de fácil acesso.

La estancia ha sido muy buena, el apartamento está en excelente estado, la zona es perfecta muy tranquila y cerca de los sitios turísticos y de restaurantes y supermercados.El anfitrión estuvo muy atento en todo momento para que tuviéramos una excelente estancia.
Excellent stay. All as described in the ad. Very good if you are planning to explore the city by foot.
Hat alles gut geklappt, vielen Dank.

I don’t have enough good things to say about this place. It was so wonderful. I would like to have stayed for longer. We were so busy in our time in Porto that we didn’t get enough time in the apartment, but we surely would have enjoyed the facilities had we stayed longer. I recommend this place highly. It was clean. It was centrally located. It had all the amenities that we required. We were very, very comfortable.

Tolle Unterkunft und ein fantastischer Gastgeber! Die Kommunikation lief absolut reibungslos: Bei Fragen hat er immer schnell geantwortet und sofort weitergeholfen. Besonders klasse war, dass wir unser Gepäck sowohl vor dem Check-in als auch nach dem Check-out flexibel abstellen durften – das hat uns einiges an Schlepperei erspart. Vielen Dank für die tolle Gastfreundschaft!
Amazing location, wonderful apartment couldn’t fault our stay at all would be happy to return in the future!

All the previous reviews are right, this beautiful apartment is a real gem! We had everything we needed, a beautiful welcome and adorable host. I couldn’t recommend more , thank you for everything. We had the perfect stay.
What a beautiful apartment right in the heart of the city, but peaceful, comfortable, and quiet at night. We had the best time and would love to return!

Sehr freundlicher Empfang. Gastgeber haben sich um alles gekümmert. Tolle Wohnung mit allem was man benötigt. Das Parkhaus an der Wohnung ist wirklich sehr kein, aber Fernanda hat uns einen Stellplatz in einer nahen Tiefgarage organisiert. 
Absolut zu empfehlen. Mit den Fahrdiensten ist man schnell und günstig direkt in der Stadt.
Great location-walkable to all the local shopping and restaurants. Quiet building with a great and responsive host.
Wonderful stay in this little green nook!!
Logement propre et très bien situé pour visiter la ville à pieds. Hôtes réactifs et à l’écoute.
Beautiful spot and location
Ótima localização, o apartamento é idêntico as fotos, checkin super tranquilo e prático. Recomendo, fica no coração de Porto! Voltaremos :)
رائع

La limpieza perfecta, la localización muy buena, en zona céntrica. Las instrucciones tanto de llegada como de salidas geniales, el apartamento está tal y como se muestra en fotos y sin duda las comunicación con ellas era muy rápida y sencilla.
Würden immer wieder diese Unterkunft auswählen. 🫶 Es war einfach toll. Entspannen (wirklich entspannen) im sehr gemütlichen Garten und die Wohnung ist sehr gemütlich und schön 🤩

Vriendelijke host, propere kamer en badkamer. Alles was zoals beschreven. Snelle reageertijd via bericht. 
Enkel de keuken lag er rommelig bij toen we toekwamen... maar dit werd na een bericht meteen opgeruimd. 
Over het algemeen een aangenaam verblijf gehad.

José's place is outstanding. The attention to detail is magnificent. Extremely clean and well equipped with everything that you could wish for. Excellent bed and shower, quiet, beautifully and thoughtfully furnished. It looked like it was brand new and that we were the first guests. José was very helpful giving us loads of information about Porto. We recommend his place without reservation and would definitely stay here again.

We had a lovely visit to Porto staying in Alexandra and Pedro's flat. The place was tidy and had everything we needed. It was the perfect size for the two of us and the kitchen was useful to have as eating out was on the pricier side. The building's lighting didn't work during our stay, but the hosts provided extra lamps so this did not affect us too much, and the window provided enough natural light during the day.

Ana was a wonderful host who welcomed us at the door. She went over all the details of the apartment and answered all questions promptly. She left us with a wonderful assortment of
foods to make breakfast and tea.

Et veldig hyggelig sted som har alt man trenger for et komfortabelt opphold. Beliggenheten er topp med kort vei til alt. Det er noe lytt mellom leilighetene, men jeg bodde heldigvis med andre gjester som respekterte husreglene, så det var ikke et problem. Anbefales!
Recomendo sem dúvida.
Appartement agréable pour passer quelques nuits à Porto

We enjoyed nine lovely days in Porto and in Diana’s apartment. There was a lot of space both inside and outside-and it was clean and comfortable.
There was some noise from a building project nearby but we were mostly sightseeing during daytime and after 6pm and during nighttime it was a very quiet area. 
We often walked to the historic center and to Gaia-opposite the beautiful river Douro. A very good exercise!!
Muito bom, correspondeu as expectativas 👍🏻

Overall, we had a fantastic stay! Maria was an excellent host—super responsive and helpful months before arrival, even leaving rose petals for our wedding anniversary.
The apartment is in a great, safe location right by Jardim do Morro. Having the tram stop opposite made getting around effortless, and the nearby coffee shops are absolute gems. 
The flat was quiet, peaceful, and well-equipped with extra bedding and towels.
A few quick notes: the apartment differed slightly from the listing photos (no bath, different sofa bed, no lamp), and adding an AC unit would help in hotter months. 
Our main issue was dog hair found on the floors, bedding, and shower tray.
Despite those details, we were very happy with our stay!
Thank you for your lovely place. Apartment was great, spacious, clean, bed was so comfortable. Everything was at its place. Thank you and see you in the future.
Het verblijf was precies zoals op de foto’s. Heel netjes en schoon en op een prima locatie.

Belle appartement comme sur la description! 
Rien a redire

The space was really cool, location is perfect… short walk down the cobblestone road and your right on a popular road to walk for shops and restaurants. Lots of space inside great little patio out back only issue was the air conditioning seemed to not be working, even though the remotes and thermostats were set to cooling and on 16-18 degree settings, there was no visible unit in the space unless it was hidden above the closet. But there was no cold air coming out of anywhere. Found it difficult to sleep with it being that warm, the dehumidifier runs non stop next to the bed and needs to be emptied a few times a day but still feels humid due to the warmth. Trying to contact the host and ask specific questions about where the A/C was and the replies seem like they are from an AI bot… they did not resolve anything. Also the shower had some mould in the corners.
Lovely apartment in an amazing location, perfect walking distance to everything we wanted to do! Joana is a friendly and responsive host too. Would recommend :)

Sehr schöne und saubere Wohnung. Die Lage ist super – Restaurants, Cafes und Sehenswürdigkeiten sind zu Fuss erreichbar. Besonders toll waren die hilfreichen Tipps der Gastgeber und die schnelle Antworten. Wir haben uns sehr wohlgefühlt und würden jederzeit wiederkommen!

Lea House was lovely! 
Centrally located, we walked or ubered everywhere. 
The accommodation was in a unique old Portuguese building. Our suite had a balcony/patio off of it and two big doors to let in fresh air. It was clean, comfortable and well decorated.
The bed wasn’t as comfortable as we had hoped. Quite hard, with springs digging in a bit but for a short stay it was fine. 
Catarinas communication was great.
We are downstairs in the restaurant on our last day, which was also delicious, and well ran. Great job Catarina! Definitely recommend this Airbnb.

This was the perfect location for our three nights in Porto. It was so easy to walk to everything in Porto as well as down to the water and over to Gaia. The Airbnb was exactly as pictured and described and had everything the two of us needed. We would definitely stay here again and will recommend to others.

The apartment was spotless and as pictured. The location is wonderful: many sites and restaurants very close by: you can get pretty much anywhere quickly on foot. I was surprised and grateful for how quiet it was, for being on a busy square: the apartment was off the road and absolutely silent (and if you shut the window/shutters completely dark as well)! The bed was comfortable--not too hard, not too soft--and there was everything I need in a kitchen (fridge, microwave, electric kettle). Also, Miguel was very flexible w/check-in which I appreciated so much, and also patient, as my arrival plans (which depended on the friend driving me) changed a few times. Highly recommend!

This three bedroom apartment is filled with natural light and is fully renovated except some of the original features like the beautiful wood floors. There is air conditioning in every room and a washing machine in the kitchen (no dryer). The kitchen is fully equipped for cooking meals and has a full size fridge and stove so we cooked breakfast and some dinners at home. There is an elevator in the building and we were able to get in and out with our stroller. Great view of trees and the sky outside the living room window, we loved opening the kitchen window in the morning to let in fresh air. All bedroom windows can be ‘blacked out’ with the shutters which was great for nap time. 
The downside of this apartment is that the bedrooms are on a busy street which means lots of street noise (cars, truck, emergency vehicles) but it didn’t keep us from sleeping at night. On weekdays, the building across the street was under construction which means daytime noise. 
Overall a great stay!
Very nice

Отличное уютное жилье. Особенно удивило дружелюбное и отзывчивое желание хозяина, который помог нам с нашим обустройством в новом для нас городе. Он выслал список рекомендаций мест и ресторанов, которыми мы пользовались на протяжении нашей поездки. Единственный минус-расположение было в некоторой удаленности от центральных мест. Пешком можно было легко спуститься за 15-20 минут. А вот подняться мы не поднимались. Всегда такси брали. Так как к гостинице вел крутой склон и после насыщенного дня мы не в состоянии были подниматься 20 мин в гору😅 и еще небольшой минус- это матрас. Он был не очень удобен. Если человек один спит то нормально. А вдвоем неудобно-постоянно скатывались в центр.
All good 👌

Luiza's apartment is in a great location and has a unique atmosphere that sets it apart from the standard-furnished apartments found on Airbnb. It was a very pleasant place to stay. Very comfortable and well equipped. I recommend it very much!
Minha estadia foi perfeita, lugar limpo e agradável para um descanso a dois, localização perfeita perto de tudo, fizemos tudo a pé.
Tres réactif, l’appartement est situé à 10min à pied de la librairie Lello et de la rue où il y a les bar et boites de nuit et 20 min du pont construit par Eiffel
Lugar bem perto de restaurantes, bares, vida noturna porém muito silencioso. Indico com tranquilidade. Parabéns pelo trabalho!
A lovely stay for myself in a quiet and private area. Matched the description and perfect t for myself. Slightly away from the city centre but an easy walk. Would definitely recommend!

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour en famille .
L'emplacement est impeccable au centre de Porto et à proximité de tout .
L'hôte est très réactif et répondais rapidement à toutes nos demandes. 
Je recommande vivement
Super
Eine schöne, kleine Wohnung in einem rundum geschmackvoll renovierten und sehr schön gestalteten Haus. Wir haben uns sehr wohlgefühlt.
Highly recommend! Super convenient location. Comfy beds. Most wonderful shower with great water pressure and heat — best shower of my life.Air conditioning excellent. Excellent value!!
Bom espaço para qualidade-preço
Lovely house, clean, everything you needed for a base to explore Porto, close to metro and easy access to Porto centre

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour à Porto. L'appartement est très bien, et surtout il est idéalement situé et la vue est superbe.
Maria est très sympatique et disponible.
C'était parfait !

Das Studio ist sehr schön, absolut sauber und super ausgestattet. Sofia war sehr hilfsbereit und hat immer schnell geantwortet. Nur die Lage war etwas weiter weg vom Zentrum, mit dem Bus kommt man allerdings schnell in die Innenstadt. Wir haben die Zeit in Porto sehr genossen :)

The apartment is truly exceptional, with great attention paid to every detail. Everything is beautifully designed, stylish and finished to a very high standard, while still retaining a warm and unique atmosphere. We had a wonderful stay and would happily return. Highly recommended!

Muy lindo el departamento de Rogerio, todo limpio y organizado. Se agradece que él mismo te reciba cuando llegas a hacer el check in y que siempre está disponible para realizar consultas. Queda muy bien ubicado, caminando llegas a la mayoría de lugares, nosotros a veces de vuelta ocupamos bus por nuestro bebé pequeño, pero está ubicado excelentemente. Lo único que creo que falta, es algo para climatizar en verano, hubo días muy calurosos en septiembre y a ratos el calor era demasiado. De todas maneras hay ventiladores, pero no es suficiente al menos para nosotros que íbamos con un bebé pequeño. Muchas gracias por alojarnos.

Wohnung war wie beschrieben und die Lage ideal um zu Fuß in die Altstadt zu gelangen. Auch als Familie mit Kleinkind war die Wohnung gut geeignet. Nur ein paar Kommoden für die Kleidung zusätzlich zu den vorhandenen Kleiderständern wären noch hilfreich
Einfach perfekt

We really enjoyed our stay. The apartment is very spacious, light and airy, with everything you need for a very comfortable stay. The location could not be more central - across the street from the main station and on one of Porto's main streets. It was perfect for exploring Bolhao, Ribiera, Gaia, Boa Vista and other Porto neighbourhoods within just a short few minutes of walking. The bedroom is set back from the street so you cannot hear a thing at night, despite the busy location. Henrique was also a great host, check-in was made very easy and he messaged during our stay to make sure we had everything we needed. We will certainly come back :)

Recomiendo encarecidamente alojarse aquí. Julia es una anfitriona de 10 que se preocupa por todo en caso de que algo falle (como con el wifi en nuestro caso). Es muy atenta y hace buenas recomendaciones.
Al lado del alojamiento está el metro con el que puedes ir a porto en 10 min y además hay un parking gratuito.
Volveríamos sin dudas!!
genoten van onze dagen in Porto. Appartement was een heerlijke uitvalsbasis. Met rechtstreekse bus naar de binnenstad.

Starting from the moment you walk in you find yourself in a dark hallway with a closet door that is broken with junk inside. Then you go up to the apartment and you have a tiny place that needs maintenance. The showers don’t drain well. One shower overflows and the other only drain when you turn off the water, also you have no where to place your toiletries so you better have someone that can hand them to you since leaving them on the shower floor is impossible as it floods. To top it off the sinks and shower have black mold. I did message the host they told me they were going to fix it but nothing came of it. I honestly could not wait to leave.
Definitely, we recommend.

Ótimo espaço, ótima localização, limpo, organizado, tudo conforme descrito. 
Quando eu retornar a Porto de certeza que ficaria novamente neste local.
Clean we enjoyed it

We loved our stay. It’s a great and peaceful neighborhood but still walkable to the action. The Douro river viewpoint is a short distance away. The apartment itself is furnished just like in the pics and had all that we needed to feel right at home.

Abbiamo soggiornato una sole notte a casa di Jorge. Vicino alla stazione, pulito e dotato del necessario. È stato perfetto per le nostre esigenze. Jorge è stato estremamente gentile e accogliente. Assolutamente consigliato.
Logement propre et conforme au descriptif. idéalement placé en proximité de l'hyper centre, nous avons pus découvrir Porto à pied.

Gorgeous apartment lovely location. Only two of us which was great, the other bed was up steps which would not have been accessible. Also the lift was broken but that didn’t affect us. The flat was very clean with lovely fluffy towels and complimentary coffee which was great.
Everything was good!
Pobyt był fantastyczny. Żałujemy jedynie, że nie można go było przedłużyć. Dziękujemy gospodarzom i gorąco polecamy!
숙소 위치가 아주 좋습니다. 강과도 성벤투역과도 가깝고 기타 다른 명소의 거의 한가운데에 있습니다.

We absolutely loved our stay at Daniel and Diego’s apartment and will definitely be back when we next visit Porto!
The neighbourhood was great for us, as it was slightly out of the busy centre of Porto, but very walkable so you could be in the centre within 10 minutes. There are lots of great cafes, bakeries, restaurants and even a Lidl very close to this apartment. We went to these daily as they felt much more local than the ones in the centre of Porto (and also much cheaper too!) 
This is the perfect apartment to stay if you need some peace and quiet after a busy day exploring the city. We loved sitting in the garden balcony and sunbathing to relax in the afternoons.
Daniel and Diego were very helpful before and during our stay. They sent us local recommendations and were great letting us check in an hour early. They left us some shampoo and coffee pods, which were very much appreciated! Very clean & homely apartment.
Highly recommend staying here and we will be back! Thank you!

We absolutely loved our stay here! The apartment was beautiful, romantic and genuinely perfect for couples. We felt so at home from the moment we arrived, and the location was perfect for exploring Porto.
The garden at the back was incredible, with the most beautiful views and such a lovely atmosphere. It was a great place to relax and enjoy the surroundings.
Alaina was a brilliant host — so friendly, helpful and welcoming throughout our stay, which made the whole experience even better.
We really couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay in Porto and would definitely stay here again if we ever come back. We would highly recommend it!

This is an extremely nice apartment in a good location. In spite of the busy location, it is quiet. It has good kitchen facilities and a washer-dryer. The hosts promptly and patiently answered my questions about their induction cooktop, something I've never had a chance to use before. I did not find an air conditioner but ceiling fans in the living room and bedroom kept the apartment cool on a warm day. The apartment building has two doors I never got the hang of the front door lock. Fortunately my keys worked easily in the back door which is next to the elevator. The elevator also worked well all the time. I enthusiastically recommend this Airbnb to a couple or a solo traveler.

Tres jolie maison, extrêmement propre , top.
La maman de jose est un ange sur terre, 
Merci jose

Apartamento muy limpio y ordenado, decorado con muy buen gusto! Todo tipo de comodidades: barbacoa, lavavajillas, lavadora, secadora… hemos utilizado todo. Bienvenida con un bollo casero y una botella de vino, súper amables! Hemos estado muy a gusto! Volveríamos sin dudarlo! :)

A estadia no apartamento foi excepcional! O imóvel tem tudo que é necessário para uma hospedagem tranquila, com disponibilidade de itens de cozinha, limpeza e arrumação impecáveis, e ar condicionado. Fica em uma ótima localização, com muitos restaurantes, cafés e bares nos arredores. Fez nossa visita em Porto bem mais feliz!

Es un alojamiento súper cómodo con buena relación precio/calidad y bien ubicado. Está en un barrio tranquilo y con el metro súper cerca para acercarse al centro aunque también puedes ir caminando en 15-20 minutos. Recomendable!
Had a great stay! The place was wonderful for a one week stay and within close proximity to transport links.

Die Unterkunft war einfach zu finden. Als wir ankamen war die Wohnung leider nicht gereinigt und vom Vormieter sehr verdreckt. 
Allerdings wurde hier auf unsere Anmerkung sehr schnell reagiert und innerhalb von 15 Minuten stand eine Reinigungskraft da und während wir etwas essen gegangen sind wurde die Wohnung sehr gründlich gereinigt. 
Die Lage war schön zentral und hat super Anbindung zu Bus und Metro. Der Ausblick aus dem Wohnzimmerbalkon über die Däche von Porto hat uns gut gefallen. Die Ausstattung der Küche war sehr umfangreich und für ein Airbnb außergewöhnlich gut.

Great location, close to local food favourites and sites. Easy acess to wine tour pick up & drop off. Hosts are friendly, communicative, and left a personal touch of port wine as a welcome gesture. We loved our Porto experience!

Die Unterkunft ist sehr schön und geschmackvoll eingerichtet. Sie lässt sich vom Flughafen aus bequem mit der Bahn erreichen, und alle wichtigen Sehenswürdigkeiten konnten wir problemlos zu Fuß erreichen.
Die Kommunikation mit dem Hosty-Team war jederzeit schnell und unkompliziert. Für Menschen mit leichtem Schlaf könnte die Lage direkt an einer Straße möglicherweise etwas herausfordernd sein, wenn die Fenster geöffnet sind.
Insgesamt ist die Unterkunft sehr empfehlenswert. Wir haben uns hier sehr wohlgefühlt.

Flavio’s apartment is very clean, bright, and comfortable. The location is excellent, and we were able to do everything on foot. It’s a great choice for a short stay. I loved my stay and would definitely recommend it!
******************
L’appartement de Flavio est très propre, lumineux et confortable. Il est très bien situé, ce qui nous a permis de tout faire à pied. C’est un excellent choix pour un court séjour. J’ai beaucoup aimé mon séjour et je le recommande vivement !
*****************
O apartamento do Flavio é limpo, claro e confortável. A localização é ótima, e conseguimos fazer tudo a pé. É uma boa opção para uma estadia curta. Gostei e recomendo !
We really enjoyed our stay in Porto!:) Such friendly hosts, looking to make your days in Portugal a great experience. Thanks again.
Everything was in order and had good communication with the host

Had a great time at the apartment, it was very pleasant and spacious, greatly decorated, the kitchen had all the necessities that you would need and more, the bedroom offered a very comfy resting space with plenty of room for two people, the balcony created a very cosy eating place that me and my partner enjoyed and the second bathroom was very convenient, Maria was a great host with quick responses and on-hands solution solving if we needed anything, the cleaner Emilia was extra helpful always asking if we needed anything and always providing great conversation, and I was surprised how good the location was, from both the main bits of the town, shops and the metro. Overall had a great time the only thing I regret not doing is spending more time in the beatiful garden outside. 10/10 would come again.

Had a pleasant stay over Casa Maya! Will definitely recommend it 10/10, the room is really nice , clean and quiet during my stay. Close to all the tourist spot l’ve been to by foot, and the nearest metro station’s only 50m away, several supermarkets nearby and even a self laundry shop. Zac’s really friendly and checking if l need anything several times and gave clear instructions of all the stuff over this place:). Highly recommended to all the female solo travelers over Porto!

Tivemos uma ótima estadia no Porto, pelo GuestReady! O apartamento era exatamente como os anúncios, muito espaçoso, bonito e confortável (especialmente em uma família de 5 pessoas). Infelizmente não li o anuncio falando sobre o prédio não ter elevador, o que atrapalhou um pouco a gente, mas foi erro nosso. 
O apartamento foi entregue com insumos para lavar roupas, louças, sabonetes no banheiro, etc. A região que estávamos era bem localizada, ficava perto do Marques, dos Aliados, da Trindade, tudo pertinho…
Recomendo demais!

Absolutely amazing experience! We booked this unit after realizing our current Airbnb had no AC on our vacation. The host was incredibly friendly, helpful, and flexible, getting us in their unit as soon as we reached out. They made our vacation enjoyable and truly saved our Porto experience. Beautiful place, great location, amazing host, I couldn’t have asked for more. Highly recommend.

This penthouse apartment is spectacular!! We are a family of four adults and it was perfect for us! Centrally located, views for days, AC that was perfect and furnishings that were lovely! We’d definitely come back again!!

Sousa is een vriendelijk persoon. Reageert zeer snel op berichten. 
Door de veranderde aankomst tijd was ze niet in staat om ons te ontvangen, maar zorgde dat een vervanger aanwezig.
De accommodatie werd voor ons geopend. Waarna elke ruimte werd door gesproken. Apparatuur uitgelegd voor gebruik. 
Heel leuk dat er een boekje gemaakt is met interessante plekken om te bezoeken. En een selecte keuze van restaurants. 
Accommodatie voldoet aan alle eisen en is gelegen dichtbij het historische centrum. 
Zeker de moeite waard wanneer men Porto bezoekt.

Die Wohnung liegt sehr ruhig, tolle Lage, nur 20 Min. zu Fuß zur Altstadt von Porto. 
Sie ist modern eingerichtet und hat ein komfortables Bett.
António ist immer erreichbar, und die Kommunikation ist sehr freundlich.
Check in-out ist sehr unkompliziert.
appart parfait et l’emplacement incroyable 😍
Amazing place and location. Best view in Porto is literally 10 second walk away. Host gives the best recommendations and is so knowledgeable about the best things.
En general todo excelente

The space was cute and comfortable, but shower was moldy/dirty with soap dispenser broken off the wall and perched on the faucet handle instead. Glass door on shower was not secure on the rollers when we got there. Extra fees for more towels and toilet paper.

We loved our stay here in Porto - the apartment was in the perfect central location and had everything we needed. Ani was an amazing host - she was kind and helpful and even provided a guide of where to go and what to do in Porto. We followed her recommendations for some spots for food and coffee and all were amazing! Would definitely come stay here again

Casa bonita e muito confortável, com todas as comodidades necessárias.
A localização é óptima: perto de cafés, restaurantes, um supermercado e a uma curta distância da marginal e praias.
O Francisco enviou-nos uma descrição muito clara da localização e de como entrar na casa. Foi muito simpático enviando recomendações e sempre responsivo.

Fantastic location, light and airy space with an amazing view over the Douro. A quiet area, but easy access by foot, bus or tram into the very centre and a decent no frills bar downstairs, again with a great little view ! Genuinely have no complaints.
We had a slight difficulty getting in, other than that a great apartment in a good location.
Perfect in every way, thick towels and complimentary bathrobes were a plus :)
Súper céntrico, cerca de todo andando. Muy ordenada y acogedora.

Die Unterkunft ist sehr schön und liebevoll eingerichtet. Sie liegt super. In der Nähe gibt es alles was man braucht, inklusive Strand. Die Gastgeber waren sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Einziger Abzug ist der Geruch, weil die Unterkunft sehr feucht sind.
War alles super! Danke

El alojamiento olia a tabaco y el olor nunca se fue. El sofá y los cojines olían demasiado, además de tener un sofá incomodo en el que no puedes estar agusto descansando.
La limpieza general del apartamento era buena, bien equipada pero con piezas como las mesillas que se desmontaban y no se podían utilizar. 
Faltan armarios o cómodas, para dejar la maleta. Cuenta con perchas en percheros vistos pero sigue faltando un espacio para dejar el equipaje 
Una falta muy grave del propietario no avisar de que había una obra en el apartamento de al lado y nos ha despertado todos los días a las 8 de la mañana a martillazos.
Es un edificio de oficinas que está siendo rehabilitado para hacer viviendas vacacionales.
El portal estaba muy sucio.
Las camas no tenían sábanas, solo una bajera y un edredón por lo que según la época del año puede dar mucho calor.
Buenas zona, alejada del centro pero con mucho aparcamiento. Barrio tranquilo con lugares cercanos para desayuno.

I couldn’t recommend this Airbnb enough! Carolina is super kind and sends the most clear instructions which made the check-in super easy. The apartment is absolutely gorgeous and exactly like in the pictures, the mezzanine is huge and wonderful. The parking in the courthouse is super practical and easy to get into. Overall we had a super stay and would 200% come back!! Thank you😊
Very fgood stay! Friendly staff communicating fast. We liked the more quiet street. Recommend!
Helena is a wonderful hostess - kind, friendly and always extremely helpful and thoughtful. I wish I could have stayed longer!
Lovely and clean location and close to Ribeira which made going for activities really easy. Responsive hosts and a good price, can’t argue with the deal

Sonia est quelqu'un d'extrêmement gentille, avenante et de très bonne conseils.
On est vraiment pas loin de la plage et à proximité des petites commerces très utiles (Boulangerie, petites commerces de proximité, boucherie) Y a tous ce qu'il faut juste à coté.
A recommander fortement et je reviendrai volontiers.
Amicalement,
Freddy
La casa era ordinatissina ed estremamente pulita. Molto fornita. Ideale per un soggiorno di due persone, come essere a casa

Roberto's home overall was very nice, but needs a couple of changes to make it 5 stars. 
Positive : The room is just perfect for 1 or 2 people, it is had all the kitchen necessities. The little patio doors/windows are good quality and when closed really block the noise from the street below. There is all sorts of padaria's and places to eat close by, my favorite, Restaurante Martins is across the street and serve Omlettes. Negative: I wish people were a bit more honest with the reviews on the bed quality. Ein Heimflug kurz nach 6 Uhr morgens bedeutet vor allem für eine Familie mit kleinem Kind eine besondere Strategie. Deshalb haben wir die Unterkunft von Vitor gewählt, nur ein paar Autominuten vom Flughafen Porto entfernt. Die Lage an einem stark befahrenen Kreisverkehr ist nicht wirklich malerisch, aber für eine Nacht auch kein Problem. Die gegenüberliegende Mall war für uns perfekt, um uns noch mit Reiseproviant einzudecken. Vitor Wohnung selbst befindet sich im ersten Stock vis-a-vis. Es ist alles da, was man braucht, um noch schnell zu kochen, viel Platz um die Koffer zu packen und ausreichend Zimmer, um das Kind schon ins Bett zu bringen, während die Eltern noch die letzten Reisevorbereitungen treffen. Die Wohnung ist landestypisch zum großen Teil gefliest, die Möbel aus Holz, die Betten groß und bequem, das Bad sauber. Vitor selbst ist ein sehr netter Gastgeber, hatte viele Tipps und ihn persönlich kennen gelernt zu haben, hat das Ganze nochmal besonders gemacht! Empfehlenswert!

One of the attractions of an Airbnb is that you can cook the odd breakfast etc. You would struggle to do that here without having to do a large supermarket shop.
很温馨的公寓。 位置绝佳，干净便捷。 Isa 很热情。 强烈推荐

A entrada não foi tão facil, mas consegui. 
É pena que a senhora que recebe as hospedes não sabe falar Português, temos que utilizar o tradutor. 
Limpeza está tudo ok, pelo preço é mesmo bom. 
A localização estava ótima para mim.
Condomínio do edificio novo. 
Ouvi o barulho fora mas isso é comum. 
Pontos menos positivos ; toalha de banho, só havia uma. 
Para cima da cama, só um lençol deitado, havia uma cobertura disponível mas não dá vontade de utilizar para uma questão de higiene.
O quarto tem ar condicionado mas sem comando para aproveitar. 
Obrigada !!
Warm welcome to Portugal, Paulo is the best, will stay here again!
Espinho is a beautiful little town, quiet, safe, and has some amazing restaurants. Ana's place is easy walking distance to all you need, and a quiet peaceful sunburb at the end of a busy day.

Was a nice stay as a family of 3 with a toddler.
It was greatly located, 2 mins from the metro, a few cafes and shops around, and actually much bigger than the pictures made it seem, with floor to ceiling wardrobes and cabinets. 
There were a few imperfections - stained sofa, cracked walls, slightly damaged table, but this didn’t impact our stay. 
It did lack a few things like a suitable cooking knife, not enough cooking utensils, only one teaspoon. Pots and pans need improving. It was also in need of cleaning products, there was no bleach or surface cleaner spray, or surface wipes 
The duvet in the main room was smelly and could have done with either being replaced or washed thoroughly. When I changed the sheets, there were long hairs from previous guests.

Excellent séjour, le logement correspond à la description. 
Le quartier est calme et proche du centre , environ 15 à 20 min de marche, ce n’est pas loin de la station de métro ce qui facilite l’arrivée de l’aéroport. 
Obrigado.
Great spot! We felt safe and comfortable
Would definitely recommend this Airbnb. Very clean and spacious with two floors and a kitchen. Great location for our two days in Porto and hosts were very responsive and helpful!
Logement agréable,nous avons passé un très bon séjour.

The place is great.
The Apartment is very confortable, we have everything that we needed for a confortable stay. It is very big. The balcony was very well appreciated. No issues. Very quiet place. Living room and bedroom with air con. 
The building has elevator, which is a big plus.
The area is wonderful. Away from the caos, but with many restaurants and supermarkets.
Raúl is an incredible host. Always responsive and helpful.
The only side back that we’ve got is the parking, but that’s nothing that Raul can do. Our rented car was a C4 and parking was difficult. We were lucky that most of the car spaces were empty so we have lot of space to manouver.
10/10! L'emplacement est PARFAIT! Super grand appartement avec une petite terrasse. Je ne pouvais pas demandé mieux. Merci pour le stay !
Agréable séjour dans son appartement, idéalement situé

My mom and I had a lovely time staying here while in Porto! The tiles on the floors are absolutely beautiful and the apartment is very spacious! It was about a 15 minute walk to the city center so we felt out of the busy area, but still close. The building was very secure and there are multiple locks on the door so we felt very safe staying here! Overall, highly recommend!
Nice unit, easy walk to city center, and has bakeries near by.
Amazing apaetmant. Exellent location and a great host. I was very happy with my stay. Highly recommended!!

Le logement correspond parfaitement à la description annoncée. J'ai rencontré un petit souci au moment du check-in, mais les échanges avec le propriétaire ont été très réactifs, ce qui a permis de régler la situation rapidement.
Le secteur est idéal : à environ 30 minutes à pied du centre-ville, avec des transports en commun très accessibles à proximité (bus/métro). L'appartement se trouve dans une rue passante, mais il est très bien isolé, donc aucune nuisance sonore à signaler.
Je recommande ce logement sans hésiter !
Foi uma muito boa estadia, recomendo imenso!!
100 out of 10, the place was amazing, the host was amazing, absolutely recommend.
Very nice apartment in the central location. Very spacious and had a great view from the balcony. Would recommend👍
Uma casa muito agradável

Great choice if you want to stay central. It was a very smooth experience and we enjoyed it a lot. 
We have nothing to complain about!

Vraiment top 👌👍👌 
Je recommande
Es ist eine sehr gute Wohnung mit allem Comfort in hervorragender Lage mit sehr guter Anbindung nach Porto. Der Bus hält vor der Türe.

Tive uma ótima estadia! Fui recebido à chegada e permitiram-me fazer o check-in um pouco mais cedo, o que agradeci muito. O quarto era espaçoso, confortável e tinha uma varanda muito agradável, com uma bela vista. A cozinha também estava disponível para utilização, o que foi bastante conveniente.
O anfitrião foi sempre muito simpático, acolhedor e atencioso. Senti-me muito bem recebido durante toda a estadia. Recomendo sem dúvida e voltaria a ficar aqui numa próxima visita ao Porto!
Great value for the location, walkable to the major parts of the city and easily picked up by uber.

Das Apartment ist einfach perfekt für einen Besuch der wunderschönen Stadt Porto. Mitten im historischen Zentrum aber durch die super isolierten Fenster völlig ruhig. Die Aussicht über die Dächer der Stadt ist einzigartig. Einrichtung ist sehr geschmackvoll und modern, die Betten sehr bequem. Es gibt wirklich nichts zu bemängeln. 100% Weiterempfehlung!

My friends and I were super happy with this Airbnb. For starters, it’s in an amazing location, super walkable and close to so many shops and restaurants. The space itself was clean, spacious and honestly a bit larger than we expected! Loved the little balcony too. Beds weren’t very comfy but that was most places in Portugal honestly. Would have loved if the host left a paper towel roll. Note that there’s no elevator so you do have to go up about 20 steps with your luggage! All in all would recommend even though it was initially a bit hard to locate and you get check in instructions 20 mins before your arrival (which wasn’t ideal). Would stay here again for sure.

Stayed 2 nights. Prompt communication from the host on all fronts. Great spacious, comfortable apartment in a quiet street. The supermarket around the corner enabled us to make a meal or two in the fully functioning kitchen. . 
The washing machine enabled us to leave with clean dry clothes. 
I would definitely book again.
Excelente opción de alojamiento

Fijne Airbnb op een top locatie. Alles zit dichtbij en op loopafstand. Kamer was erg schoon. Op de begane grond zit een erg fijn koffie/ontbijttentje waar we bijna dagelijks zaten. Al met al een goed verblijf voor een paar dagen in Porto!
Very clean and comfortable stay in a very convenient and beautiful location that we enjoyed walking around!

Merci Pedro pour ce séjour, le logements est conforme aux photos, lumineux, spacieux et très propre. Proche des commodités, station de métro proche sinon à 30 min max du centre de Porto à pied.
Je recommande fortement ce logement
Awesome stay here! Highly recommend

Elisabethe ist eine sehr freundliche Gastgeberin, die Kommunikation war reibungslos. Die Unterkunft war sehr sauber. Parkplätze gibt es kostenlos direkt an der Straße. 
Leider ist die Wohnung sehr hellhörig. Da sie direkt an der Straße und in unmittelbarer Nähe zur Autobahn liegt, hört man den Straßenlärm doch sehr laut. Da bei dem Bett zwei Füße unten nicht richtig stehen, hat es leider sehr laut geknarzt, sobald man sich im Bett gedreht hat. An Schlaf war leider nicht groß zu denken, da nebenan anscheinend ein Gebäude renoviert wurde. Hier wurde von abends um 8 bis nachts um 4 gehämmert, was man sehr laut gehört hat. Dafür kann die Gastgeberin jedoch nichts.

Muy buena ubicación,al lado de la torre de los clérigos, muy cerca de liberdades. El apartamento es muy bonito como las fotos, pero a usos prácticos , la cocina muy pequeña (el microondas ocupa un espacio necesario) se podría colocar en otro lugar. Se escucha todo. La cama es muy cómoda.encontramos a faltar un armario o más colgadores para la ropa. La entrada y salida muy fácil.El barrio muy auténtico

Great apartment in a perfect location. The beach is directly across the street. The bakery was a minutes walk away and was great for sandwiches, bread and pasties . Andreia was a great host, goon communicator and always willing to provide advice.
Great location, great interior and a great value for money
O local tal e qual como nas fotos! Muito aconchegante.
The location is amazing so as the host, the bed could use a new matress and the bed is a bit old

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Theresa‘s place. It was comfortable, clean and peaceful and a short distance from whatever we wanted to do. When traveling we appreciate coming home to a place that is relaxing and this space fit the bill. Thank you Theresa for a terrific oasis in Porto. We would be happy to return. ❤️

Marta und Cesar sind tolle Gastgeber, die antworten augenblicklich auf die Fragen. Die Tipps sind sehr nützlich und wertvoll und kommen als Bonus einfach dazu. 
Die Wohnung liegt perfekt in einer Gegend, die etwas ruhiger ist als das Zentrum, die Restaurants und Cafés sind gehobener, es ist alles fußläufig erreichbar oder man nimmt das Metro, Trindade und Lapa sind 7-10 Min entfernt. 
Check-in ist einfach Dank der klaren Anweisung. 
Die Wohnung ist gut ausgestattet, es ist alles vorhanden. Danke für den Kaffee 😊! 2 Badezimmer sind luxus! Anfangs erschien uns die Treppe in der Wohnung sehr steil, aber wir haben uns schnell daran gewöhnt. Die Dachterrasse ist fantastisch! Der Straßenlärm ist zu hören, auch nachts, aber in der Stadt gehört es einfach dazu.
Wir haben uns wohl gefühlt und die Zeit in Porto genossen! 
Vielen Dank für alles ❤️💜💙

This Airbnb was in the most perfect area in Porto (in our opinion)! Everything was within walking distance, and we felt very comfortable there. Everything was really clean and free of clutter. It’s a little small for sure with a balcony that is tiny but that’s Europe for you! Thank you for an incredible trip!! :-)
Maravilhosa estadia, a casa é linda e bem localizada, um verdadeiro descanso

Daniel tiene todo lo necesario en el apartamento para pasar unos días estupendos. Limpieza de diez, comunicación, ubicación, indicaciones,…
El apartamento y Matosinhos son una opción ideal para pasar unos días en familia geniales.

Super emplacement 👍
Petite maison très agréable

Abbiamo visitato Porto per la prima volta e la casa di Claudia è stata un'ottima base per i nostri itinerari. Centralissima, in una via che offre un'ampia scelta di locali e buoni ristoranti. Vicina alla bellissima stazione, al caratteristico mercato e a gran parte dei monumenti e luoghi di interesse presenti a Porto.
La casa è adeguata per 2 persone, molto luminosa, arredata con cura e ogni ambiente molto curato e pulito. Nonostante sia ubicata al terzo piano, le scale sono ampie e facili da salire.
Claudia ha sempre risposto tempestivamente ad ogni nostra richiesta ed il check in e il check out sono stati estremamente semplici. Grazie di tutto. E' stato un viaggio da ricordare!

Un apartamento fantástico, muy grande y cómodo para 5 personas. La ubicación no podría haber sido mejor. 
La comunicación era muy sencilla y rápida. 
La única pega que encontramos fue la cantidad de mosquitos que había en el piso, ya que nos dificultaban conciliar el sueño.
C’était top !
Really good place. Will definitely book again! Thanks Mariana

Excellent rapport qualité-prix, l'hôte est accueillant, agréable et nous a donné pleins de bonnes recommandations. Les attentions gustatives d'arrivées étaient très plaisantes. L'appartement qui est conforme aux photos, est très bien desservi, très mignon et bien optimisé. Je recommande vivement. Un grand merci

Fantastiskt boende med rymliga ytor och alla faciliteter som man behövde. Vi var ett sällskap på 6 vuxna och två små barn och poolen var mycket uppskattad av alla resenärer. Nära till havet och vacker havsutsikt från boendet. Kändes som ett tryggt och säkert område. Nära till en välutrustad matvarubutik .
Bra kommunikation med trevlig värd.
Vi kan starkt rekommendera detta boende.

Eu adorei, infelizmente os dias que fiquei choveu e não consegui aproveitar muito a piscina mas em relação a limpeza do quarto, aos utensílios disponíveis, comodidades, atenção do responsável (no caso foi a Luna e ela foi uma querida) e a localização não tenho do que reclamar, cada detalhe foi pensando com carinho, teve até um agrado quando entrei no quarto 🤭 
Não tenho palavras, recomendo de olhos fechados 💕

Postcode does not take you near the address, it is very hard to locate & we found ourselves walking around in the dark early hours trying to locate. The building was very loud & a very strong smell a marijuana throughout, people coming in & out all through the night, apartment untidy & now sending photos of a single beer bottle left on the side labelling me ‘disrespectful’, will purposely make issues to claim money from you. Avoid at all costs.

Die Unterkunft war absolut wie beschrieben, top sauber und sehr schön eingerichtet. Die Wohnung ist recht groß mit allem was man braucht. Leider ist die Wohnung sehr hellhörig und befindet sich in einem großen Gebäude mit vielen Büros & Apartments. Es kann also schon auch mal lauter werden.
Der Check-in war super einfach, Afonso war sehr freundlich & hilfsbereit. Wir konnten auch früher einchecken und später auschecken, ohne Probleme & Aufpreis.
Die Lage ist etwas entfernt vom Zentrum, fußläufig sind aber sowohl Cafés & Restaurants als auch das Zentrum erreichbar. Wenn man mit dem Zug oder Flugzeug anreist, muss man damit rechnen, einen ziemlichen Berg hochzuladen.
Wir würden jederzeit wieder kommen und konnten unseren Aufenthalt in Porto sehr genießen.

Lovely place. Great kitchen with lots of utilities. Amazing location for walking everywhere; very central. Only thing was there wasn’t hand soap or enough bin bags, but other than that there was everything we needed. Check in was not entirely smooth because I didn’t get the access code (despite doing the online check in) until right before we arrived (after calling LovelyStay). Overall the place is very good and I highly recommend.
Excelente, nada apontar.

The apartment is nice and has everything you could need. It is clean, well located, and very safe.
The hosts are responsive if you need anything.

MERVEILLEUX!
Nous avons adoré notre séjour dans le logement. Tout était confortable, du lit aux serviettes de bain. Toutes les commodités y étaient et le logement était très près de tout. Les instructions étaient claires et l’hôte répondait rapidement et s’assurait que nous ne manquions de rien. Notre logement était au 3e étage alors petit exercice avec les bagages mais ça se faisait bien (surtout quand c’est le mari qui les monte, hihihi). Je recommande fortement les logements Astoundinn ! :D

Logement rénové haut de gamme grand confort 
Très bien équipé 
Très calme 
Très bien situé 
Nous recommandons

Excellent séjour à Porto dans ce logement très bien situé avec une vue magnifique. En effet, la pente est raide pour y accéder mais cela valait l’effort physique :) Logement très bien insonorisé, très calme de jour comme de nuit. En revanche, prudence car il n’y a pas de verrou dans la salle de bain et les toilettes.

We had a wonderful time in Porto and highly recommend your place! The apartment was very comfortable and in a fantastic location. We especially loved having so many great restaurants within walking distance.
Even with the lively nightlife nearby, the apartment was surprisingly quiet and well soundproofed, which we really appreciated.
We truly enjoyed our stay and would definitely come back!
All excellent thank you!

Lovely apartment, had everything we needed for our stay. The location was excellent and was within walking distance to all the main sights. The apartment was clean and the brilliant hosts were friendly and responsive

Très bel appartement 😀il ne donne pas sur la rue,il donne sur une cour arrière et est très calme même en journée 👍👍 incroyable,alors que vous êtes très bien situé dans cette belle ville de porto 😁de très bons restaurants a côté dont a casa viuva.cuisine traditionnelle portugaise vraiment délicieuse sans chichis😋merci a Hugo pour ses conseils 😀tout était parfait 👌
La maison est très propre
Logement très propre, un accès très simple et proche des transports.
Très bel endroit pour séjourner à Porto ! L’appartement est idéalement situé pour découvrir la ville et profiter de son ambiance.
Amelia est très serviable et très arrangeante. Elle communique énormément de choses très utiles et c'est un hôte très agréable. Merci beaucoup
The apartment is beautiful and very clean! We loved the outdoor space. Very walkable to all the city sights, restaurants, metro, and grocery store. Highly recommend!

the space was great in the middle of a long trip - relief after hotel rooms to have space to ourself. its small but has what you need. the washer / dryer combo didn't work very well so we had to still hang dry our clothes. also found it odd that for a 4 day stay for 2 people they only provided a 4 pods for the coffee machine (when i asked if there were more somewhere they replied it would be a fee for housekeeping to bring more???) the self check in process was easy and the location was walking distance to the middle of the area but don't be deceived by the map - its a LONG downhill steep walk to the river and uphill back. def check out Balta across the street for the best breakfast of our trip!!!!

A really nice comfortable apartment. Everything was clean, lovely bathrooms and bedrooms, a well equipped kitchen and laundry. The lounge was very comfortable too. 
The location worked well for me too. There’s a supermarket nearby and if you walk or use the tram to go further into the town there are a number of good cafes and restaurants and the beach area too. 
Sarcol kept me informed with very responsive good communication.

Appartamento nuovo completamente ristrutturato situato a pochi passi dalla Igreja do Carmo e dai principali mezzi di trasporto. Mobilio nuovo e intonso con tutto il necessario per un soggiorno prolungato. L’host è stato gentile e molto professionale sempre pronto a rispondere a qualsiasi ora. 
appartamento nel complesso molto buono, unico grande difetto la pulizia della lavastoviglie, oltre che inutilizzabile emanava un odore nauseante così come le tubature del lavandino della cucina. Con pochi accorgimenti l’appartamento diventerà perfetto! Grazie ancora per l’ospitalità, nonostante tutto torneremo!
Absolutely wonderful stay in Porto—beautiful place, perfect location, and an amazing host who was incredibly helpful and responsive.
Great stay. The place was clean, comfortable, and as described. The host was friendly and responsive.

Tudo incrível o espaço é lindo e acolhedor! Sem duvidas que me senti em casa!
Obrigada Pedro
Tidy studio apartment reasonable walk away from the busiest streets, yet close enough to reach many attractions in the city by foot.
We stayed for a whole full week and everything was prestine, lovely place to stay and would definitely stay again and recommend.

Adoramos nossa estadia! A casa é muito aconchegante e confortável, e a localização é simplesmente perfeita, super central e pertinho de tudo. Fizemos vários passeios a pé, o que facilitou muito a viagem.
A casa tem tudo o que precisamos para uma estadia confortável, além de ser muito bem cuidada. Os anfitriões foram muito gentis e solícitos, sempre disponíveis para ajudar quando precisamos.
Foi uma experiência muito boa e, com certeza, voltaríamos a ficar aqui em uma próxima! ❤️

Really can’t fault this apartment at all. We travelled with my elderly parents, so the lift up was a big plus. Also both bedrooms each having a bathroom gave us lots of privacy.
The street/area is full of bars/shops/coffee shops and restaurants, yet is still super quiet.
Highly recommend this apartment and Jose as a host.
Un beau voyage pour 3 couples

We zaten net buiten het centrum van Porto wat zorgde voor rust binnen de accomodatie. Op het terras kan je niet echt zitten, dat is wat te klein en de straat is te druk. Je bent heel snel in het centrum. De host was super bereikbaar en enorm vriendelijk.

Appartamento posizionato bene. Pulito ed ordinato. 
Peccato per la presenza di poche finestre. Nonostante sia una casa piccola, ha tutto l'indispensabile

Ein wunderschönes Haus 
Mit einer tollen Lage in Strandnähe. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt.

Un magnifique appartement, idealement situé : plage sublime restaurants, supermarchés, promenades et le pont Dom Luis a 1h a pied. 
Un hôte chaleureux, accueillant et tres réactif a nos demandes d'informations et interrogations. 
Un agreable premier sejour au Portugal qui donne envie d'y retourner!
great apartment just like the photos, location is amazing we were able to walk everywhere from the apartment

Très beau logement! Très propre et assez grand pour 3-4 personnes. On s’y sentait en sécurité. La cuisine manque légèrement d’ustensiles pour cuisiner (ex: pas de ciseau), mais dans l’ensemble c’était très très bien! L’hôte était réactive et très conciliante. Je recommande ce logement!
Wir waren 3 Nächte in dieser wunderschönen Unterkunft . Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und es total genossen so zentral zu wohnen . Wir kommen gerne wieder!
Esperienza più che ottima. Casa pulita, hosting molto gentile e reattivo, zona tranquilla, rapporto qualità prezzo top
Tudo nos conformes, próximo de transportes e mercados

Great location! Plenty of space. Terrific patiio. While a bit dated it was charming nonetheless. Fans in the bedrooms pretty much useless so no a/c on a humid night could be a challenge. There was a rather powerful fan in the living room which circulated air well enough with doors open. Would definitely stay again in what shiuld be cooler weather.
El mejor lugar para quedarse en en centro de Oporto y además trato de 10 de los anfitriones!!

Super Haus mit sehr großem Grundstück. Sehr ruhig gelegen mit vielen Bäumen und 2 Hängematten mitendrinnen. Für die kleinen Kinder gab es sogar unerwartet einen aufblasbaren Pool. Das Haus bietet alles was man benötigt. Der Grill im Garten war auch in Ordnung aber leider schon länger nicht genutzt worden und nicht direkt am Haus. Ansonsten nichts zu bemängeln.

Die Einrichtung im Hausboot war modern und gut gepflegt. Die Umgebung leider nicht sehr ansprechend, aber der tägliche Gänsebesuch war äußerst nett. Insgesamt war der Aufenthalt am Hausboot etwas Besonderes und deshalb haben wir uns wohl gefühlt.

Inês’s place is in a great location and perfect for a shorter or longer trip to Porto. The neighborhood is fantastic with lots of food and coffee options - there’s also a grocery store nearby. Inês is very responsive and thoughtful about guest needs. She always replied in a timely manner and gave great local recommendations. Altogether, it’s a great stay - totally worth the price.

사진과 똑같이 매우 감성적인 곳이었어요. 
상벤투역에서 가까워서 도보로 충분히 이동할 수 있었어요. 포르투에 또 방문한다면 이 숙소에 다시 머물고 싶답니다. 좋은 시간 보낼 수 있도록 좋은 숙소를 제공해준 호스트에게 감사를 표합니다!
Amazing spot!

The place was great!
Helena came and gave us instructions for everything we wanted. Also she gave us traditional food and wine as a welcome gift.
Her place was clean and near metro station (300m walking). 
Clean towels and bedsheets.
Also she let us leave our bags after check-out and pick them up later. 
5/5 stars totally worth visiting
Centrally located to have access to anything you may be interested in.

The accommodation was excellent and very comfortable, very homely. The facilities and cleanliness were outstanding. 
It was a pleasure to stay and the arrangements for entry are the best we have ever had, guidance and instructions were very clear. 
We will certainly be returning. My only small issue is it would benefit from having a small freezer.
Bel appartement très propre et fonctionnel, clim bien venu. Dommage situé dans une rue très passante et en cote qui dessert la ville.

This apartment was so gorgeous. We loved our stay. The apartment is clean and very aesthetically pleasing with a gorgeous balcony that was great for taking photos and enjoying a glass of wine to people watch down below. It overlooks Rua das Flores which is a very touristy pedestrian street with lovely shops and restaurants. It was loud in the mornings/evenings as the other reviews mention but we didn't mind as we are from a busy city as well and love to be in the action.
Great stay in a great location.

Het was echt super. Het was schoon, het had alles wat we nodig hadden en het lag op een top locatie. Het zwembad was heerlijk om even de drukte van de stad ontvluchten en om even lekker af te koelen en te relaxen. Het contact met Daniël was heel goed, hij is heel betrokken en reageert snel. Super host!
Bij een volgend verblijf zullen we zeker terug komen en we zullen het ook zeker aanraden aan familie en vrienden!❤️

Good description. The description explains the apartment is up 5 flights of stairs (on the third floor not the 5th). That didn’t phase me until I had to carry my suitcase up in the heat. The stairwell is not airconditoned and there is a skylight at the top that makes it very hot. And the apartment airconditioning could not get the apartment below 25°C. The bed is in a loft upstairs. There is a great fan up there but it definitely doesn’t feel cool. So I had to keep taking cold showers to cool off. But it was also extremely well priced (presumably to reflect this) so was good value for money.
Place was clean, quite. location was perfect.
Marcia’s place was lovely, great location! Quick to respond.
Beautiful apartment. Amazing location right in front of the beach. Great restaurants in the area. Loved it!
Had a great stay, excellent location! We had 2 young children and the toys were a nice touch. Rute was super accommodating and made our stay very pleasant!
Skøn lejlighed til to par, og Pedro mødte os og gennemgik lejligheden, hvor vi også fik gode info om byen.

Elegant, well appointed mezzanine apartment for two, very clean and comfortable with memory foam mattress, practical kitchen area, shower & efficient air on. Located upstairs in a beautiful traditional tiled building, on the corner of two tree lined streets in the Bonfim area of Porto. Only 6 minutes walk to Metro Station 24 de Agosto, and easy walk to the Douro river and central Porto.

This is a great house, myself and my friends thoroughly enjoyed our stay. The host Francisca was very helpful and accomodated our early check-in in and late check-out requests with no problem at all. Highly recommended!

We liked that the place was affordable, still some things didn‘t really meet our expectations. 
- Terrace would have been really nice if it wouldn‘t be so noisy (air conditioning, some kind of ventilation) 
- the air in the appartment and the bathroom was really bad (moist and bad smell)
+ the communication with the host was uncomplicated and friendly
+ free parking at nearby streets (3-5min walk) was no problem in September

Wunderschöne Unterkunft mit Blick auf den Douro! 
Küche und Terrasse sind ebenfalls nutzbar. 
Uns hat es sehr gut gefallen. Bruno ist sehr freundlich, ehrlich und aufmerksam. 
Wir würden jederzeit wieder dort übernachten.

Una dintre cele mai bune cazari pe care le-am avut, foarte curata, echipata cu tot ce aveai nevoie pentru a te simți ca acasă. Foarte aproape de centru și cu multe restaurante aproape. Mulțumim și dacă vom reveni în Porto, cu siguranță tot aici m-aș caza.
Sehr schönes Appartement, sogar mit Waschmaschine. In direkter Umgebung gibt es Restaurants, Cafés und Einkaufsmöglichkeiten.

Had a great stay here, everything we needed. It reminded my wife of her grandmother's old countryside house in Portugal. Very nice space and in a pretty good location. Not far from Porto if you're a tourist. Parking can be a little tricky if you're renting a car so keep that in mind.

A thoughtful and extremely comfortable flat in a lovely area. Me and my wife visited the city of Porto for couple of days and booked this place for our accommodation. The apartment met our expectations since it was exactly as described along with its amenities. Place is located right in the historical center of Porto. That makes it perfect to explore the city by walking. Although the apartment is in the center of city, it was also very quiet and peaceful which was very important to us, so we can rest after long days being out. Check in and out was made easy by the host with very clear instructions about everything. Local recommendations given by the host were also pretty helpful. Overall was a very good experience and given the chance to visit Porto again we would definitely book there again.

This loft is perfect for exploring Porto. The Metro is close by, as are bus stops and it is close to the bridge for venturing over to Nova de Gaia. Sao Bento is about a 5 min walk so if fancied a trip to Braga or Aveiro the trains are easily accessible. Plenty of restaurants near and a couple of wee shops too that hold groceries.
Excellent! The entire place is very new and clean, exactly as described in the photos. The location is convenient. Highly recommended
