Really great apartment. Easy walking distance to centre of town and sights etc. Lovely having a balcony.
Logement très confortable, facile d’accès. Le stationnement était super. Très facile de se rendre aux différents sites de Porto.
Die Lage ist hervorragend mitten im Zentrum von Porto. Die Wohnung ist genau wie beschrieben und Patricia antwortet immer schnell wenn man eine Frage hat oder eine Empfehlung braucht.

Wir hatten einen richtig tollen Aufenthalt in dieser schönen Wohnung!

Gode faciliteter og et godt sted til en forlænget weekend i Porto. Vi lavede ikke mad, men var glade for kaffekapslerne og kaffemaskinen🤗

Great place to stay with tasteful decor. Close to river bank with the amazing views of Porto over the water - will be back

Huge thanks to our host Paulo for having us in such an amazing apartment — it blew every expectation we had, several times over. Gorgeous place, unreal sunset views, and the ocean was basically right outside. Honestly had everything you could possibly need, and it felt more like staying with close friends than renting a place. Every little detail was thought through — stylish but still super cozy. The balcony is huge (like, ridiculously huge). If we could, we'd go back in a heartbeat. Beautiful beach just steps away, plus a pool for residents.
We highly recommend this place!

We really enjoyed our stay in Fatima’s apartment. The apartment is bright, pretty, and clean. Location was great for walking everywhere. We enjoyed sitting on the balcony in the evening listening to the buskers and watching everyone wander by.

We had an amazing 5 days in Casa Flores. The location is absolutely amazing - quiet yet central to restaurants, shopping and main Porto streets. Definitely check out the pizza place located next door! The space is clean, well kept and practical. A few things to know: there is no full length mirror (none that I could find at least); the washing machine/dryer works great but you are provided 2 pods so if you plan on doing more frequent loads, bring extras with you; the apartment is located up a somewhat steep incline but wasn't too much of a challenge with luggage and completely doable without luggage; it is best to have your Uber or driver drop you off at the nearby Starbucks, then a short walk to the unit. Judit is very responsive to questions and sent images of the outside of the property so that we had an easy time finding it. She let us use the apartment earlier than 3pm check in as we arrived a bit early. A/c unit works amazing. 10/10 would stay here again!

We had a wonderful stay at this apartment in Porto. The location was excellent, making it very easy to explore the city and enjoy everything Porto has to offer. The apartment was comfortable, clean, and had everything we needed for a pleasant stay.
A special mention goes to the host, who was absolutely fantastic — very kind, helpful, responsive, and welcoming. We truly appreciated the hospitality and the care they showed throughout our stay.
Overall, it was a great experience, and we would happily stay here again. Highly recommended! ❤️
Schöne Wohnung. Alles wie beschrieben.

En relación calidad - precio, este alojamiento es una muy buena opción. Sobretodo en temporada alta.

Ich hatte einen sehr flexibel Check-in. Elis war von Anfang an sehr herzlich und hat mir viele Tipps zum erkunden der Stadt gegeben. Es war alles wie beschrieben. Ihre Eltern sind auch sehr, sehr nett gewesen.
Appartamento spazioso, elegante e ben fornito a pochi passi dal centro storico di Porto. Torneremo sicuramente!

Great location!
A wonderful Airbnb with the city not far away and plenty to do. The beds were super comfy and the back garden space was great for dinners outside.

We really enjoyed our stay in Arcozelo. The Airbnb was exactly as shown in the photos and was a good choice for the price. It is about a 20 to 25 minute walk to the beach and there is a beautiful boardwalk/trail that makes the walk much more enjoyable than taking the streets. Aguda Station is about a 25 minute walk away and the Pingo grocery store is less than 15 minutes away on foot.
Artur and Florinda were a lovely couple and showed us true Portuguese hospitality. They were kind and helpful throughout our stay and even gave us a ride to our next location, which was incredibly kind.
A few reviews mentioned that the bed was very firm. It was, but that was actually perfect for me and I slept very well. We kept the windows open at night and were comfortable.
This is a great place to stay if you have a car, with free street parking. We really appreciated the kindness of our hosts and enjoyed our time in Arcozelo. Thank you Artur and Florinda.
Excelente servicio y lugar para quedarse !

Ein sehr schickes und top ausgestattetes Studio. Auch für unsere Hündin wurde alles vorbereitet. Es ist zentral gelegen und alles ist gut zu Fuß erreichbar. Die Gastgeber sind sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit.
Wir kommen gerne nochmal wieder.

Muito obrigada Maria! You have a great unit, high ceilings, comfortable space for two or three, modern design and unique furnishings, excellent art and design book collection to peruse. We had everything we needed here, with a lot of special touches. The in-suite wash machine was a bonus. Nicely located near cafes and steps from Rua das Flores and Douro River.
Logement très bien situé et correspond à la description 👍🏼

Great apartment, comfy bed and powerful shower. Only disappointment was the noisy neighbour below us 1 night but that's not the apartments owners fault. Great location and fab restaurants just around the corner. I would stay there again.

Lovely, tasteful Parisian style apartment in a lively area with many close options for good bars and restaurants. It’s on a pedestrian street ( taxis allowed ) and the street noise from the restaurant/bar/street performers etc in the evening adds to the atmosphere. The window insulation is good for those times when one seeks the quiet. The balcony is great for street watching, but it’s very narrow in keeping with the style of all apartments in the area. Overall a great apartment for a couple
The place has everything you need! She was so wonderful and let us check in early. She was also super fast at responding. Well worth the price.
Incredibly clean, large and well-located apartment walking distance to most of Porto's attractions. Would highly recommend!
Excellent séjour chez Miguel, le logement est bien placé, propre et à proximité des commerces. Pour les activités le point de rassemblement n'est pas loin du logement.

Great host. Very helpful and responsive. The place has a few quarks but nothing that impacts the stay. The space is great for 2 people and has all the essentials. The location is as good as gets. Can’t recommend the host enough. All of our questions were answered.
Unschlagbar war die Terrasse mit der Markise und dem großen Baum im Garten. Der nahe gelegene Bäcker ist toll, der nahe Supermarkt hilfreich.
Un endroit très tranquille. Le quartier est sécuritaire.

Everything worked exactly as described—smooth check-in, clean apartment, no surprises. Would book again. It was a fantastic stay! Communication with the host was excellent from booking to checkout, and the apartment was spotless, well-equipped, and true to the photos. The vibe of this place is magical. From the welcome note to the thoughtful touches throughout, we felt genuinely cared for. The apartment was spotless, in a great location, and filled with beautiful, tasteful furniture. The views from the apartment are unique and espectacular 😍

Thank you very much Diogo for helping make our stay in Porto so fantastic! You are an excellent host, responsive, helpful, made us feel at home and provided great references through out our stay. 
Diogo set us up with the Welcome Chef team and Chef Mario and Suzanne for a fantastic dinner prepared at the property for us. Highlights included the Oysters, Octopus, Veal and vegetable soup. We loved the interactive experience and presentation. Best meal of our entire trip! 
We had such an amazing time at your Airbnb! The property and views were absolutely beautiful, and it was the perfect place to relax, spend time with our family, and make some great memories. We would definitely stay here again!

Le logement était très propre, très proche de Porto et des restaurants ce qui nous permet d’y aller à pied sans prendre le métro. Le seul point négatif est qu’il manquait sel/poivre/huile pour cuisiner et que nous entendons les voisins du haut mais dans l’ensemble il est très bien

Logement parfait, en tout point identique aux photos. L'emplacement est top ! A proximité de 2 gares et de points d'intérêts, il est facile de se déplacer à pied ou avec les transports. L'appartement est au calme et très bien équipé, l'ascenseur est agréable après une journée à gravir les côtes de Porto. La clim est un vrai plus ! Tout était très propre et la literie est de bonne qualité. Antonella a laissé des petites attentions pour notre arrivée, que nous avons beaucoup appréciées. Les nombreuses recommandations nous ont bien aidées. La communication avec Antonella était très fluide. On s'est senties comme chez nous !

Perfect place for our quick stay in Porto! We were a group of 4 (two couples) and fit comfortably. Apartment had everything we needed and location was great! We were able to walk pretty much everywhere we wanted to go and the hosts were super friendly and responsive. Being able to do laundry was also a huge plus. Highly recommend!

The apartment was exactly as expected from the photos. It was very clean and the location was perfect. The host communicated very well, ensured that we had everything we needed, and offered many recommendations.
J'ai passé un très bon séjour à Porto :) Le logement d'Eduardo était idéalement situé (tout était à proximité) et il est bien conforme à la description :)

Wunderschöne geräumige Wohnung in sehr guter Lage. Alles sehr gepflegt und tatsächlich so wie auf den Fotos. Wir haben sehr wohl gefühlt. 🙏

Virkelig lækker lejlighed med den skønneste udsigt til floden.. kæmpe terrasse og gå afstand til lokale restauranter og de fine portvinshuse
Great location, nice and clean apartment in the middle of everything. Very safe

This apartment suited our needs perfectly. Great location, walkable to everything. On a side street so not noisy. It was clean and newly renovated. The owners had very good communication, checking in and out was very easy. The only thing to note, it is on the second floor and you would need to be fine getting bags up and back down … of course Porto is a steep city so no surprises here. We would definitely book this apartment again.

We found this a fabulous spot to stay in Porto. The central position meant it was easily walkable to everything, but high up with great views so light and peaceful! Really enjoyed watching Porto life go on from the balcony. Beautifully decorated, spotlessly clean and very tasteful furniture. Thank you!

Spacious apartment in a brilliant location just over the road from Bolhao market. Can hear some noise from outside but it wasn't excessive. Entry to the apartment is via a website/electronic code which made it easy for us to all come and go as we wanted. Excellent blackout blinds.
Très bel appartement, propre et accueillant ! On a passé un excellent séjour.

I wanted to love this place but, we had an unfortunate incident occur. We checked in around 8pm and quickly realized the AC was not on. That is normal to have it off while not at the place. But, we turned it on and left for the evening. Upon returning around 11:30 we realized it was not on again. We called the support line and they could not help us. The room was 80 degrees the entire night. We could not keep the windows open due to the street noise was very very loud. The next morning the host did not offer a solution. They said a technician cannot come out to fix the issue. When we asked to cancel and receive a refund, they offered only 20%. It was extremely frustrating to spend our only 2 days in Porto trying to find a new place and lug out things around. The hosts were not responsive or very helpful. Airbnb had to call them and discuss the issue due to them not being responsive. It was a nice place but not helpful in this situation.
Beautiful space, very clean, host was very nice and communicative, and you couldn’t be in a better location! Would definitely stay here again!

Thank you again Teresa for another wonderful stay in Porto! The apartment is conveniently located to see the sites of Porto and the good a/c and comfortable bed allows for quiet evening at night. We look forward to another visit to Porto and staying at Teresa's lovely apartment.
Fantastic location and the flat was spotless. Really enjoyed the garden space in the mornings. Would stay again

Rui ist ein sehr hilfsbereiter Gastgeber, der sich viel Zeit genommen hat, um uns alle Informationen und Erklärungen bei der Anreise zu geben. Auch tolle Tipps zu Restaurants, Ausflug nach Porto (mit Bahn oder Auto), Sehenswertes in der Nähe. 
Das Haus ist sehr schön, stilvoll, der Garten sehr angenehm. 
Ich kann es nur empfehlen. 
Der Strand von Mindelo ist toll. Man kann lange Spaziergänge an der Küste machen.

Das AirBnB von Pedro ist schön eingerichtet und absolut sauber. 
Die Kommunikation davor und während des Aufenthalts war sehr gut. Pedro war sehr hilfsbereit und entgegenkommend. 
Jederzeit wieder! Für alle Portobesucher absolut das Geld wert 👍

Rafe’s place is in a very central location - a short walk to the sites and the river. Porto is rather hilly but it’s good exercise after going to one of the many great tapas restaurants!
The apartment is beautiful, quiet and high spec (the best Nespresso machine money can buy!). We had a fabulous time and would very happily go back again and, in fact, hope that we do soon. 😊

Wir wurden super lieb von Pedro empfangen und haben hilfreiche Tipps bekommen.

This was a great option in Porto! Just 10 minutes walking distance from the city center, and the path is really enjoyable. The place was spotless and everything matched with the pictures. Exceptional place! The apartment looks exactly like the photos and is very comfortable and well maintained. Thiago was very responsive, helpful, and always willing to assist whenever we needed anything. We really enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend it!
L' appartamento era molto pulito e proprio come nella descrizione. È vicino al centro e in una zona tranquilla. Per un soggiorno a Porto perfetto!

Die Unterkunft ist insgesamt nur bedingt zu empfehlen. Sie verfügt über eine sehr gute Lage. Allerdings befinden sich in der Straße Prostitution und zwei Bordelle. Die Küche ist spärlich ausgestattet, der Ofengriff fehlt und einige Töpfe sind beschädigt. Die Klimaanlage funktioniert nicht und heizt den Raum eher zusätzlich auf.
Insgesamt besteht vor allem bei der Sauberkeit deutlicher Verbesserungsbedarf.

We had a wonderful stay! Carolina and Luis were fantastic hosts, super friendly, helpful, and very accommodating with letting us check in early. Lugar super centrico, cómodo para ir al centro, metros, bus. Recomiendo 100%.

O espaço é exatamente como está descrito, com tudo o que é necessário, confortável e numa ótima localização, perto o suficiente para andar para o centro mas também super perto do metro.
O Luís esteve sempre disponível, muito simpático, prestável, deu ótimas recomendações, e até deixou uns presentes para aproveitarmos.
Quando voltar ao Porto já sei onde marcarei a minha estadia!
완벽한 숙소였습니다. 매우 쾌적하고 넓고 조용했으며, 주변에 마트가 가까워 식료품을 사기 유용했습니다. 공항에서는 우버를 타는것이 좋으며 시내를 다닐때는 버스 지하철 모두 편리했습니다. 특히, 호스트와 그 가족들이 매우 친절했습니다.

Carlos, vous êtes un hôte remarquable. We loved our stay in the apartment which was ideally located near the Bolhao food market, local shops, metro station and bus connections and within easy walking distance of Porto’s historic city centre and tourist sights. The flat was very clean and comfortable, stylishly furnished with everything we needed for a week’s stay. The bed was comfortable, and having working shutters that darkened the bedroom was a bonus. I would definitely come back here for another stay.

Een heerlijk plekje midden in het centrum met een verbazend grote prive buitenruimte.

Paulo was a great host, very responsive to messages and met us at the apartment to show us around. The apartment was perfect, very clean and we had a midweek clean half way through our stay. Very walkable to get to town and the river, about 25 minutes.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and felt very comfortable! The apartment is clean and bright but the electric window shades and air conditioning make for a wonderful night of sleep. The bed is also quite comfortable which can be an issue for many Airbnb. I was impressed that the loft and bathroom were actually a bit larger than they appeared in the photos. There is quite a bit of storage space as well so your luggage isn’t in the way during your stay. The hosts were also extremely kind and responsive—we were able to check in early and they left a delicious welcome wine in the fridge from their family’s vineyard which we thought was a lovely touch. You cannot beat the location and the apartment is in a lovely, walkable area with many nearby shops and restaurants. We would definitely stay here again when visiting Porto!
Stayed for a night and everything was perfect!

Joana was wonderful, she proactively sent us recommendations for the area and met us out front when we accidentally went to the wrong house. Her stay was comfortable and clean. Would definitely stay again, thanks!

Bon séjour somme toute dans le logement de Jorge. Le logement était propre, spacieux et lumineux. Le climatiseur fonctionnait bien pour refroidir tout l'espace. Il faut avoir recours au ventilateur fournit pour pousser l'air frais vers la mezzanine sinon il y fait très chaud. Il y avait ce qu'il fallait pour cuisiner, beaucoup d'espace pour circuler et mettre les valises et l'emplacement est plutôt bien. Comme mentionné dans plusieurs commentaires, le logement est situé au 3e étage, donc il y a beaucoup de marches à monter. Au moins elle sont plutôt larges, donc amplement pour le valises.
Quelques points qui font qu'on ne peut laisser une note parfaite. La pression de l'eau est plutôt faible, pas idéal pour les douches. On a manqué de papier de toilette et ça a pris 2 jours pour en avoir plus. On a dû en acheter. Il n'y a qu'un seul miroir dans le logement et il est dans la salle de bains, donc pour se préparer c'est difficile. Surtout pour un logement qui peut accueillir 5 personnes.
Logement assez spacieux et propre - la petite véranda est un plus pour le petit dej - calme et correct je recommande !

El departamento impecable, muy bien ubicado y súper cómodo. Éramos 4 y estuvo todo perfecto. También estaba limpio y con todas las amenities. Está muy bien que tenga su cochera. La atención de los Host sobresaliente, siempre responden rápido, con amabilidad y resolutivos.

Lovely space!!! Very clean , tidy and the AC in the room was already On for us..we felt relaxed as we walked in ( Summer Time) . Self-check in was very smooth..TV works good..especially the breakfast buffet organized was excellent..definitely will stay here again! thank you❤️

O experiență minunată! Cazarea a fost foarte curată, confortabilă și exact ca în fotografii. Gazda a fost amabilă, atentă și comunicarea a decurs excelent. Ne-am simțit foarte bine și am reveni cu siguranță. Mulțumesc pentru cadou!
Recomand cu drag!

Una estancia excelente. El alojamiento es mucho mejor que en las fotos, con todo lo que necesitas para tu estancia, una decoración elegante y muy cuidada, y en una zona tranquila con el metro justo al lado para poder moverte sin necesidad de sacar el coche, para el que hay una plaza de garaje con acceso al alojamiento desde el ascensor. Uno de los mejores lugares en los que me he quedado, sin duda. Recomendable 100%.

We had an amazing stay at José’s place. There should honestly be a rating higher than Superhost for hosts like José. He provided so many suggestions to help us enjoy the city and was very helpful at check-in. 
The apartment was the cleanest Airbnb I have ever rented and was very well appointed. The parking was easy to access and we had no problem finding the apartment from the highway. 
The neighbourhood had a great market (Mercado Bom Sucesso) two blocks away that had a wide variety of exceptional food vendors. There were also several full service grocery stores within a few blocks. We do not mind walking and chose to walk to and from the historic downtown centre several times. We also caught several ride shares into the city centre (Bolt and Uber) and the prices seemed very reasonable. 
We would happily rent from José on a future trip to Porto.

This is one of my favorite places to stay in Porto, roomy with a great view, great location with easy access from the highway and easy parking. Great spot if you want somewhere just outside the noisy areas of Porto but still close enough to walk to everything the city has to offer.

Uma estadia excelente🌼🍀! O anfitrião foi extremamente simpático e atencioso. Cheguei bastante tarde, já de noite, e mesmo assim fez questão de esperar para me receber pessoalmente, o que agradeço muito.
A acomodação é lindíssima, muito confortável e acolhedora. Aliás, toda a moradia está decorada com muito bom gosto, com o azul do mar presente nos vários detalhes, dando-lhe uma identidade muito especial. A localização é excelente, mesmo no centro da Póvoa de Varzim e perto de tudo, permitindo fazer muita coisa a pé.
Senti-me muito bem durante toda a estadia e voltarei, sem dúvida. Recomendo!🌿

Très bel appartement avec de nombreux restaurants, café et bar a proximité 
Marta a été très réactive et sympathique 
Je recommande vivement !

We had a lovely stay at Eduardo E Elisabete’s flat, it was clean and tidy and check in/ checkout was smooth and easy. They also provided us with a list of local recommendations! We had such a lovely weekend!

Una estancia fantástica en Oporto. El apartamento es muy acogedor, limpio y con una iluminación perfecta que hace que te sientas como en casa. El anfitrión André fue muy amable y cercano, respondiendo siempre a todas nuestras preguntas y ayudándonos en todo momento. Sin duda, repetiremos. ¡Muy recomendable!
Amazing
The appartement is very accessible by various public transportation modes. Though the room is a little tiny, it is structured and is suitable for short trips
Very good stay, cosy bright apparments in good location
El piso muy cómodo y limpio está bonito.

Was not a great experience!
Communication was not good.
The place was OK.
The location was OK.

Die Wohnung ist schön eingerichtet und die Lage zur Nähe der Metro (ca. 5-10 min. Fussweg) prima, um in die Innenstadt von Porto oder in die Umgebung zu fahren. Ein Auto ist nicht nötig. Abseits des Touristentrubels und doch zentral genug. Die Wohnung ist komplett ausgestattet und hat eine Klimaanlage im Wohnzimmer. Alles sauber und unkompliziert.

A beautiful, spacious apartment. Super walkable location and a literal stones throw from the outdoor market, which is fantastic! Communication and instructions for check-in/check-out were top notch. We cooked one night and the kitchen had basically everything we needed. We would happily stay here on our next visit to Porto!
We had a great stay here! Host was very responsible and helpful in finding us a place to store our luggage before check in. Great AC, cute view, and great location!!

La ubicación está muy bien, por la noche aunque habiendo muchos bares al lado de la casa pero es bastante tranquilo y muy bonita. Solo que nos encontrábamos unas machas en la mesa, y la ducha se sale agua por los lados. Pero en general ha sido muy buen alojamiento ;)
Very good stay. I recommend. Sweet people. Cozy home:))

El lugar es más grande de lo que se ve en las fotos. Impecablemente limpio y tiene todo lo necesario en la cocina, para estancias largas.
La cama muy cómoda, descansamos muy a gusto.
Los anfitriones fueron muy atentos y nos ayudaron a resolver nuestras dudas y problemas de equipaje.
100% recomendable !

My parents and I had a great stay. 
The apartment is exactly as described on photos. 
Although we could not do an early check in , we were allowed to leave our luggage at the flat while we walked around Porto, which was helpful. 
The flat is located around 25min walk distance to the main attractions. I enjoy walking so that wasn’t a problem for me. 
There’s a lot of constructions going around but we didn’t hear any noise and it didn’t disturb us. 
At arrival, we noticed few things needed a better clean, the host promptly sent someone to do the extra clean and made sure we were happy with it. He left us a bottle of wine to apologize which was very sweet. 
The flat is comfortable, there’s AC units in all rooms, and the showers are great. 
Another great thing is that the building has a lift! Great help with luggage. 
Overall we had a great experience

Zeer tevreden! 
Proper en gezellig appartementje. Host was bereid mee na te denken en deed proactief enkele suggesties.
Très bel appartement de standing où on se sent comme chez soi. Emplacement idéal au centre de Porto où l'on peut garer une grosse voiture ce qui était un vrai plus :)
Impressive surroundings with good facilities, in easy reach of local attractions. We enjoyed our stay and can recommend 100%

We had a fantastic stay, which was largely due to what a great host Augusto was. When we arrived Augusto gave us lots of helpful tips, and showed us around the accommodation, so we felt at home. The apartment was spotlessly clean, the most immaculate airbnb I have ever stayed in. The location is also great, just slightly out of the main centre, but still walkable (albeit you'll need to get comfortable with hills in Porto!!). To top it off, our flight was cancelled and Augusto let us stay for an extra night. All round, cannot recommend this airbnb enough.

Perfect stay in the heart of the city… however because you are in the heart, it is a little noisy. I sleep like a rock so it was not a problem for me, but if you wake easily… maybe bring some earplugs… other than that no complaints. Fantastic. Stay.
Great location amazing host. No elevator

Location is better than Porto old town, because it’s perfect for watching sunsets, and everyone comes here from central city, also 5 minutes from the main bridge to the old town Porto. Great apartment for the price.

This home was a lovely extension of my own and offered a perfect balance of refined surroundings inside and out without being overstated, in other words, comfortable and relaxed. For a business traveler, the amenities and location were efficiently and perfectly situated, and I would choose this unit again without hesitation. Thank you for the stay!

소통도 빠르고 위치도 좋습니다. 도보로 편하게 이동할 수 있습니다. 4층(한국으로는 5층)이라 캐리어를 가지고 오면 많이 힘들 것 같습니다. 방도 넓고 깨끗합니다. 화장실도 상태 좋습니다. 냉장고에 작은 냉동고도 있고 물 1.5L짜리가 웰컴드링크로 제공됩니다. 주변에 마트도(21시에 문 닫는 걸로 기억합니다) 있습니다. 하지만 방음이 잘 되지 않고 큰 차가 지내갈 때 방이 흔들립니다. 귀마개 필수입니다.
O alojamento estava impecável, tudo em ordem e as indicações para o acceso foram fáceis. Foi como estar em casa. Obrigado

I had a really lovely stay in Porto. The apartment was comfortable, clean, and had everything I needed for a few days in the city. The location was also very convenient, making it easy to explore Porto and get around.
The hosts were very kind, responsive, and helpful throughout my stay. I really appreciated the clear communication and the thoughtful hospitality.
Overall, it was a great experience and I’d happily stay here again when I’m back in Porto. Thank you for having me! 🇵🇹✨
Très bel appartement avec une localisation parfaite! Nous avons adoré!
Great apartment right in the heart of Porto, easy to get to, instructions easy to follow, great comments from host, definitely recommend, great value for money.
Great location with spectacular views! Enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend this location and host!
Great stay!! Location is really good and the apartment looks just like the photos. Rossana provided really clear instructions which made it super easy to check in. Overall we had an amazing trip!
Ótimo apartamento, correspondente a descrição ! Localização perfeita !

​Como anfitrión de Airbnb, valoro muchísimo los detalles que hacen que un viaje sea perfecto, y esta estancia lo ha sido. 
La ubicación es sencillamente inmejorable, en pleno corazón de Oporto y super accesible con paradas de metro muy cercanas.
​El apartamento destaca por una limpieza impecable, una climatización estupenda que mantiene el espacio superconfortable y una cama comodísima donde se descansa de maravilla. 
Además, la conexión Wi-Fi funciona rápida y estable. 
Mención especial a los detalles de bienvenida (las cápsulas de café, las galletas... un gesto que se agradece enormemente al llegar).
​Comunicación excelente y máxima atención al huésped.
​Por poner un único "pero", el techo cruje bastante cuando andan los inquilinos del piso de arriba, aunque entiendo que son cosas inevitables de la propia estructura del edificio.
¡Totalmente recomendable, volvería sin dudarlo!

Das Airbnb liegt sehr zentral, sodass die Stadt zu Fuss gut erreichbar ist. Die Wohnung hat alles was man braucht und es sieht genau so aus wie auf den Fotos. Es ist sauber und die Wohnung ist cool eingerichtet. Pedro gibt sehr viele Tipps für Restaurants, Shopping und Kultur.
Danke, dass wir bei dir bleiben durften :)

Prachtig historisch appartement, mooie kunst (inclusief kunst door familie zelf gemaakt), zeker een van de meest bijzondere Airbnb appartementen waar wij hebben verbleven. De straat is best luid maar in de slaapkamer aan de achterkant hebben we heerlijk geslapen! Al met al, top ervaring.

Très bonne expérience ! Superbe appartement avec un balcon offrant une très belle vue. L’appartement est impeccable. Facile à trouver, accueil chaleureux.
Je recommande vivement !

Die Unterkunft war großartig, modern und sehr stylisch, zugleich mitten drin in Porto. Alles ist zu Fuß machbar. Die Betten sind sehr bequem und es gibt Schränke ohne Ende. Wir wären gerne länger belieben, auch weil Joana eine vorzügliche Gastgeberin ist.
Sehr schöne Wohnung und Location
María muy amable, estuvo pendiente de cualquier comentario y de qué llegáramos bien. El apartamento acogedor y muy bien ubicado, a 10-15 minutos de mercados, estaciones y del puente Don Luis.
Jose’s place was beautiful and he was so responsive as a host. Not too far from Porto and super spacious :)

This airbnb far exceeded my expectations! I LOVED my stay here for several reasons. The location is great - a quiet street and the windows are completely soundproof and the a/c is incredible. It was just a short walk to many areas I wanted to visit, and also to the nearest metro. The design of the space inside is super efficient. There was plenty of storage space for my things, the kitchen was super well-equipped, there are black out shutters, the pool is a super great addition (to be able to plunge and then relax after a long day of walking), and even the two single beds are excellent (I was a solo traveller and it felt like a queen bed). I really loved my stay in Porto and this airbnb was a huge part of that as it really was a place that felt like home and a great place to reboot and relax in order to maximize the rest of my vacation. Would definitely stay here again!

Wij verbleven 3 nachten in deze b&b en het was super! De studio bevindt zich in een rustige wijk op loopafstand van het toeristische centrum. De studio is heel sfeervol ingericht en was mooi schoon. Het tuintje was fijn om in de ochtend rustig te ontbijten. Een van de buren heeft (denken we) kippetjes en soms hoorde je in de ochtend een haan. Dit vonden wij heel grappig zo midden in een grote stad. We hebben in deze studio een heerlijk verblijf gehad in Porto!😁

Emplacement super
Mais il ne vaut pas le prix malgré quelques attentions comme capsule de café et gel douche (pas suffisant pour 2 personnes et 4 jours,mieux mettre un distributeur dans la douche par exemple que des échantillons trop petit)
Good location, safe, bus stop at corner, responsive host, no a/c in room so it can feel really warm, fan provided

Very cosy place, neat, with everything you need, perfect for 2 people. Metro station 3min away on foot. Pedro gave us many useful recommendations including a festival that was the best night of the trip ! Can't wait to comeback :)

This is a nice place - it’s big and centrally located. 
Three things worth noting: (1) the street outside is one of the busiest streets in Porto and can be quite noisy (this is not the hosts fault, and you should know before booking); (2) there are many hallway doors that lead to additional units in the building - these are heavy and slam very loudly, so if any of your neighbors are leaving in the night / early morning a slamming door will wake you; (3) the shower towels and bed pillows are extremely thin. 
Overall this was a big, nice place. I’d stay again if the price was right.

We stayed 3 nights at this nicely designed duplex apartment at the end of an alley, beds are really comfortable and big. I did feel that during self check-in, the communication was automated but we exchanged more than once during our stay and they’re really reactive. The place is really clean and location is great.

Gracious Hosts + Exceptional Property = Memorable Experience
That's the ultimate formula for any trip– and Jorge and Antonio have mastered it in Porto! 
Indeed, the property itself is a masterpiece of both comfort and design– immaculately clean, stunningly beautiful, and equipped with everything you could need to feel right at home. It was also loaded with thoughtful touches like fresh fruits, yummy sweets and savories, and an array of delicious wines– port and sparkling!
I could go on and on; however, with a strict character limit– what truly elevated our stay into an unforgettable experience was the impeccable hospitality of our hosts. They were incredibly welcoming and kind, and they conveyed a level of genuine care and attention to detail that is priceless! 
We truly cannot wait to return and plan on staying longer next time, too!

El apartamento está muy bien situado ,el aparcamiento es un plus ....y el apartamento está bien en general ,quizás el baño necesitaría un arreglillo ....la comunicación con los anfitriones maravillosa .experiencia genial

Excelente experiencia . Está perfectamente equipado, en una zona llena de restaurantes y con todo lo que podrías necesitar. Tiago es muy amable y disponible. Sin duda volvería a quedarme acá y lo recomiendo al 100%.
The location was nearby a lot of popular places. It was easy to find a late night snack and drink.
Tolle Unterkunft in zentraler Lage! Wir hatten einen schönen Aufenthalt!

Super ausgestattete Unterkunft in perfekter Lage! Die Kommunikation war von Anfang an unkompliziert und sehr freundlich. Besonders toll waren die vielen hilfreichen Informationen und Empfehlungen. Ich habe mich rundum wohlgefühlt und komme sehr gerne wieder!

I do NOT recommend staying at this place.
The first night we woke up around 2 and 4am with nasal congestion and a sore throat due to a strong plastic/chemical-like smell. We had to isolate the source, a box, in the bathroom and sleep with the windows open to ventilate the place, dealing with mosquitoes and street noise. We had to continue ventilating it after waking up. This suggests the host did not check the place before letting us in.
The host only provides automated corporate ChatGPT-like responses, with a condescending and dismissive tone.
The place is extremely dark unless it's daytime and all windows are open. Depressingly so at night.
While our reservation was still active and we had simply gone out to buy our tickets home, the host apparently observed us leaving, decided we had checked out, and sent someone into the apartment without our knowledge or permission.
We ultimately left 3 nights early due to all the issues, cutting our vacation short and ruining our time off.
Kleine aber sehr nette Unterkunft in Porto. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt!

We really enjoyed our stay in Porto. The location was the biggest highlight—we could walk almost everywhere, making it an excellent base for exploring the city. We also loved the nearby restaurants, especially Blade, just up the street. 
The apartment was clean, functional and had almost everything we needed. Its minimalist style could benefit from a few extra touches, such as additional towels, scissors, a better corkscrew and small stools or chairs for the balcony. We especially enjoyed opening the doors and standing outside with a glass of wine, watching the street come to life. 
A small neighbourhood guide with recommendations for restaurants, coffee shops, grocery stores and other essentials would also be helpful.
Our host was very responsive and helpful throughout our stay. These are only minor suggestions—the apartment worked well for us, and its fantastic location made it easy to experience Porto. We had a wonderful time exploring the city on foot.
Muito bom , espaço excelente

Perfect stay in Porto. This apt is so very convenient to everything Porto has to offer- livraria lello, the river and so many restaurants and shops. Joana and Fernando have several excellent suggestions. There are some steep steps to the apartment but we did not mind this at all.

Adorámos a estadia! O alojamento estava muito limpo, cuidado e acolhedor. A anfitriã foi super generosa, simpática e muito atenciosa connosco. Sentimo-nos muito bem recebidos e foi tudo impecável. Sem dúvida, recomendamos e esperamos voltar! 😊
Top locatie, in het hart van het centrum.
Fueron muy amables en anticiparnos la llegada, y todo el tiempo estuvieron pendientes de nuestra estadía.

We had a wonderful stay. The studio was exceptionally clean, modern and very well equipped, with everything we needed. The fresh white towels and bed linen were lovely, and we really appreciated the thoughtful touches, including two bottles of water, coffee, sugar, biscuits and sweets.
The location was perfect—right in the centre of Porto, surrounded by supermarkets, restaurants, bars and cafés, and within walking distance of everywhere we wanted to visit. Despite being so central, the studio was incredibly quiet, and we couldn’t hear any outside noise. The air conditioning was also a real bonus.
The only small issue for me was that the pillows were quite firm and high, which caused me some neck discomfort, but this is, of course, a personal preference. Apart from that, everything was perfect.
The hosts also provided useful online recommendations for places to eat and things to do, although we only noticed these later as we had already spent our holiday exploring and discovering som

Todo estupendo y muy limpio, y el unico inconveniente tal vez es que no conectaban los canales de la tele pero por por lo demas todo perfecto, esta ubicado en un buen sitio y el bar de al lado perfecto si quieres ambiente.

Hemos pasado unos días muy a gusto en este apartamento. La ubicación es muy buena, muy cerca del Mercado do Bolhão y se puede ir andando prácticamente a todos los sitios importantes de Oporto. Hasta la Ribeira, por ejemplo, son poco más de 15 minutos a pie.
El apartamento es además muy tranquilo y silencioso, perfecto para descansar después de estar todo el día recorriendo la ciudad.
La entrada puede dar un poco de impresión al principio porque se accede por una especie de callejón donde vimos alguna persona sin hogar, pero nosotros no tuvimos ningún problema en ningún momento.
Como pequeñas cosas a mejorar, sí echamos en falta algún armario o espacio en la habitación para poder dejar la ropa y no tener que tenerla siempre en la maleta. También vendría bien algún sitio en el baño donde colgar las toallas de mano.
Por lo demás, hemos estado muy bien y nos ha parecido una opción estupenda para alojarse unos días en Oporto.

The place was centrally located with shops and restaurants seconds away and the train station was less than a 5 min walk.
The place was clean and VERY SPACIOUS. It was nice having door and lock codes instead of a key because it allows people to wander around separate from each other instead of trying to coordinate who has the key.
The hosts were friendly, helpful, and responsive if you needed anything.
We would definitely stay here again if our travels bring us back to Porto.

The apartment was the perfect base for our long weekend in Porto. It was within walking distance of all the main areas, but obviously involves going uphill and downhill - Porto is a hilly city after all. 
The bed was very comfortable with a firm mattress, good water pressure in the shower, and the compact kitchen was well equipped (not that we did any cooking). The aircon was great too - kept the apartment nice and cool during the very hot nights.

This location was great to easily walk around anywhere you need to go such as markets, shops, food. Everything inside the apartment was clean and mostly well taken care of. 
The best benefit of this property we found was the keypads to get in. Most homes give you one key where here our whole family could come as go as they pleased without juggling the key. That was super convenient. 
One thing to be aware of is that the outdoor hanging chair has had some water damage from the elements.
Great place! Thank you!

Ilidia is an amazing host, and her apartment is also. We felt right at home, everything that was needed was there. Ilidia was full of helpful recommendations. We would definitely stay again if we returned, don’t hesitate to book.
Very lovely house. Beds are comfortable and everthing were clean
Thank you so much for a wonderful stay! The apartment is exactly how described, the location is definitely the selling point above other features, but all round, a great place to stay!
A nice appartment in a lovely area - great links into Porto.
Pernottamento fantastico, i proprietari super accoglienti e disponibili ci hanno addirittura offerto una bottiglia di vino. Alloggio super consigliato
Apartamento muy céntrico. La comunicación ha sido muy buena

The check in was smooth and the host was responsive and accommodating. He provided us with the baby cot within hours of requesting it. 
Very courteous and polite. 
The apartment was clean and rooms just like the pictures. 
We enjoyed the apartment however one inconvenience is the neighborhood: there are drunk homeless wandering the streets at night and being very noisy. Being on the first floor, we felt and heard every commotion whether of cars and/or people outside. If you are a light sleeper, I would not recommend unless the host changes the windows to sound proof.

Très beau logement, tranquille, bien décoré et aménagé. Assez spacieux pour quatre personnes, et pratique avec les deux salles de bain. On a aussi beaucoup aimé la terrasse pour les déjeuners et les soirées. À 30 minutes à pied des principaux attraits touristiques. On le recommande!

Ein sehr besonderes Haus mit einem ausgewöhnlich gut ausgestatteten Fitnessraum und einem wunderbaren beheizten Swimmingpool. Der Strand liegt ca. 10 Gehminuten auf der anderen Seite der Bahngleise. Mit dem Auto sind es ca. 15 bis 20 Minuten nach Porto. Das Haus ist sehr besonders, da an den Wänden fast überall wandgroße Spiegel angebracht sind. Dies lässt einen großen Raumeindruck entstehen und man sieht sich permanent. Das Haus besteht im wesentlichen aus zwei Gebäuden, die in der Mitte durch einen Whirlpool verbunden sind. Nicht so gut hat uns gefallen, dass zwei der Schlafzimmer kein Fenster ins Freie haben, sondern nur Glastüren zum Whirlpoolraum, die wenn sie geschlossen sind stark feucht werden. Wenn sie offen sind ist die Sprudelung des Whirlpools deutlich zu hören. Auch die beiden Badezimmer haben kein Aussenfenster. Eines hat ein Fenster zum Wohnzimmer. Wir bedanken uns für die freundliche und hilfsbereite Betreuung vor Ort und hatten eine tolle Zeit.
The location is perfect and everything is walkable from the apartment. The windows and the balcony definitely improve the Portuguese experience. Definitely recommend for a couple

We had an amazing stay. The location was perfect and the apartment was beautiful. We will definitely keep in mind if we revisit, as Porto was beautiful and we’d definitely love to come back!! Amazing hospitality and Pedro & Hugo were always there to help when we needed! Everything was exactly as it was described, we couldn’t have asked for better hosts. Thank you! ☺️
Lovely apartment tall ceilings big garden and good value for the price however there only salt in all the cabinets so we have to buy everything from toilet paper to soap
Zeer goede ligging en leuk appartementje. Goede communicatie met de host. Zeker een aanrader!
숙소가 깔끔하고 감성이 느껴져서 좋았어요! 위치도 너무 좋았습니다!

L'appartement correspond tout à fait aux photos et à la description. 
Petit bémol : l'équipe de ménage c'est mal coordonné avec l'agence et ils sont rentrer dans l'appartement le premier matin après mon arrivée. Je n'ai donc pas très bien dormi en sachant que d'autres personnes pouvaient entrer dans l'appartement.
Great stay! The flat was clean, comfortable, and perfectly located in the center, close to everything. The host was also great and very helpful. Highly recommended!

De ruimte zelf was beter dan we hadden verwacht. Helaas hadden we de video hoe we moesten binnenkomen niet gekregen, waardoor we buiten de deur moesten wachten. Natuurlijk kan zoiets gebeuren, maar we waren ontzettend moe na de busreis en het creëerden helaas wel wat ongewilde stress. Felipe heeft geholpen zo goed hij kon en gebeld om het probleem op te lossen. Het was schoon en ruim, maar we misten een ventilator of iets dergelijks omdat het ontzetten warm was 's nachts. De ruimte is op de begane grond in een tuin en we voelden ons niet zo veilig om het raam open te laten dus daardoor was er bijna geen tocht in het huis terwijl we sliepen. Dit zijn gewoon tips, over het algemeen is het een hele fijne plek en als we weer via Porto vliegen zal ik Felipe wel proberen te contacten.
Toller Aufenthalt von 4 Tagen. Die Lage ist zentral und dennoch ruhig mit schönem Blick vom Balkon ins Grüne. Moderne Ausstattung und sehr sauber! Jederzeit empfehlenswert.
Estancia increíble! El acceso y la zona del edificio inmejorable, ya que sales y lo tienes todo al lado, y por si es poco, Mario te dice restaurantes, bares sitios que ver por si no lo tienes claro.
Our stay at Casaporto was an amazing experience. Monica was very easy to communicate with and the rooms were very clean. Location was great and we were very pleased! Highly recommend staying here!
公寓位置挺好的，就是楼层有点高，电梯没有用。内部很宽敞，很适合生活，周围餐厅很多，超市也很便利。
Eine sehr schöne Wohnung mitten in Porto. Alles sehr gut fussläufig erreichbar. Die Wohnung ist sehr gut geschnitten, zweckmäßig eingerichtet. Wir haben uns sofort wohl gefühlt.
The property was great. We had everything we needed including a cot and high chair. David was very responsive and proactive which was helpful.

Logement propre et idéalement placé pour tout faire à pied ! 
Nous avons passés un super séjour à Porto !
War alles sehr unkompliziert. Sehr OK, wenn man auf der Durchreise ist.

The actual home looked even better in person. It was very well maintained and so clean. A delight! The co-host & his wife, Amelia are the owners. They welcomed us on our late evening arrival and showed us around the home. They also gave us some welcome gifts (wine, biscuits, cheese and water) and provided recommendations for foods/restaurants and activities to try out. It was truly a lovely experience with them. 
The host, Susana was pleasant and responsive to communication.
The home felt safe and had all the necessary utilities for the bathroom and toilet; laundry; cooking & meals. Access to Porto from the home is good. 
Overall, we had a great stay and would return if we come back to Gaia. Thank you Francisco, Amelia and Susana.

100% recommend. A great apartment in a great location. Very stylish and spacious. Great furniture and fittings with a very well equipped kitchen too. Nuno was a very friendly and welcoming host too, and was always happy to help. We’d definitely stay here again.

Lovely spot! Actually made for workcation conveniently! Has everything u need.. the house caretaker was also super sweet! The host is responsive & working was super chill. Only cons maybe was water pressure a bit slow

Everything was great ! I would have given a 5stars but the only issue was the AC wasnt working properly , on the main room the exaust goes back to the room , so you feel the hot breeze from it . And on the main floor the AC didnt let a lot of cold air. So on a hot humid days it was quite a challenge . But everything else was great , great location , with a 15-20 min walk you get get anywhere so we barely use public transport, the bathroom are clean and with a good pressure shower. We had open windows at night and theres wasn’t too much noise.

Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt in Anabelas Apartment. Die Lage war super, tolle Restaurants und Frühstücks Cafés in der Nähe! Alles gut zu Fuß erreichbar. Das Apartment war super sauber und Anabela war immer super zu erreichen. Wir würden es jedem empfehlen und gerne wieder kommen!

Très beau séjour dans l’appartement. Il est situé tout près du parc Jardin do Morro et du pont Luis. Le couché du soleil depuis le balcon est époustouflant. Je recommande à 100% cet appartement. P.s. nous sommes tout près des nombreuses caves à porto. Merci Sonia !!!

We had such an amazing stay here! There was eight of us and plenty of room for us not to get into each other’s way. Didn’t realize that Netflix wasn’t included. Often hosts will have a guest account so you can enjoy it without your own subscription. But it is a SmartTV so if you have your own Netflix it’s ready to go.
Great place! Great location, very clean, good kitchen. Highly communicative hosts!
Unos grandes anfitriones. El apartamento está genial, te hace sentir en casa. Tiene todas las comodidades y se está muy a gusto. Los anfitriones excepcionales, siempre pendiente y muy amables.

Very comfortable house.
The place is great, 1 minute walk to supermarket and 15 minutes to the beach.
I would love to stay here again!
Super endroit

Helena’s place was a great deal. It was only a few steps away from the metro station. There were some good local restaurants within walking distance. The room was spacious and clean with everything you need. Helena was a super host, easy to communicate, very responsive to our questions and requests. She provided local desserts, wine and soft drinks for us upon our arrival, which was truly appreciated. She also shared with us her recommendations for food and sightseeing. We would love to stay with her again.
Isabel is an exceptional host, and her place is unlike any other I’ve stayed at through AirBnb. It feels like a home. Isabel was incredibly welcoming and I will definitely be coming back.

Fantastic house with three great bedrooms and en-suite bathrooms. The pool and the garden with a BBQ and sun loungers were amazing. Excellent quiet and peaceful town in beautiful surroundings – about half an hour by Uber to downtown Porto. The host was fantastic. Welcomed us upon arrival and constantly made sure we had everything we needed. Definitely a 10 out of 10 experience, and we would love to come back!

Clean and spacious loft flat. 
No air con but fans provided. Excellent location. Andre was helpful throughout with an easy check in and parking a bonus. 
Thanks for a great stay we would love to return!

Todo bien un segundo sin ascensor pero tal como estaba en las fotos con una visita bonita desde salón y la cocina 
Con detalles de agua y vino a la hora de entrada
Super séjour passé à Porto. Petit logement, propre et fonctionnel. Son point fort : son emplacement qui ne peut pas être plus optimale pour visiter la ville. Merci à Victor.

We really enjoyed our stay at the apartment. The location is extremely convenient, easy to walk from to explore the city. The bed was extremely comfortable, apartment beautifully decorated and great shower as well. The parking space was very appreciated as well with our rental car. There is some construction going outside as mentioned in other reviews, but this did not detract from our stay.
Apartamento cómodo, Buena ubicación, a solo 10min a pie de restaurantes para comer comida local y muy rica.
Gut
Great clean place, check in and communication went smoothly
非常優雅的住宿，地點方便，很多景點都能步行到達。

Appartement très bien situé au cœur du centre-ville. Tout est possible à pied. Peut être un peu bruyant mais complètement normal puisqu'il est en plein centre-ville historique. Hôte très réactif et arrangeant pour la remise des clés. Je recommande.

Carla's apartment is wonderfully located. Just a 5 minute walk into the main river area but located in a quiet area of town. Although located next to a church and its bells, the bells only ring between 8am and 8pm so did not impact us.
The apartment has everything you need and has been thoughtfully put together. There are plenty of up to date guide books and an extremely useful leaflet about the apartment.
Carla was very helpful and responsibe throughout our stay and went above and beyond by responding immediately when we had trouble working the door on our first night (user error not the system itself!).
I would highly recommend the apartment for a short stay in Porto and we will definitely return next time.
It’s a perfect place for 2, maybe 3 people. Clean, close to everything, beautiful view of the ocean. Would stay here again.

Hospedagem Maravilhosa! Impecavelmente descrita de acordo com as fotografias do anúncio. Apartamento excelente, equipado para que possamos nos sentir em casa durante a hospedagem. Estive hospedada com minha mãe por 4 noites, rodamos toda a cidade de Porto à pé, pois estávamos super bem localizadas. João estava sempre muito solicito à nos responder e com cordialidade nos recebeu. Certamente retornaremos em breve.

The Airbnb was in a perfect location - right in the heart of the action but still private and quiet. The apartment was very well kept with modern finishes, extremely comfortable beds, and plenty of pillows. 
Isabel was amazing, extremely friendly, and very responsive while providing recommendations in the city. We would definitely inquire about this Airbnb in future visits to Porto!

Nous avons beaucoup apprécié notre séjour à Porto, le logement se trouve proche des lieux touristiques tout en étant dans une rue calme. Le airbnb possède un garage, ce qui est un vrai plus. Logement très fidèle au photos et propre. 
Nous remercions Inès pour sa bonne communication.
I have to say this house is beyond my expectations. Clean, and very beautiful with the taste of simplicity and nature. Location is perfect, and it’s quiet during night.
Nice space, but hard to locate appropriate uber location

Great apartment, more spacious that the photos show! Good distance to some great restaurants and shops but also close enough to go to the main centre.
Clean apartment with everything you need and good communication from the hosts

Die Lage ist super. 
In 2-5 Minuten (zu Fuß) kann man alles unternehmen, einkaufen oder besichtigen und ganz viele Touren unternehmen.
Goooʻooooooooooooood!

The place self is really good and fancy and approachable all over by walk only the problem is that the person who living up stairs walk all night around open the door close the door that noisy for us and also in afternoon as well

Great location, near major tourist sites and great restaurants. The only thing we didn’t like was the hot weather during the days we stayed, although we were aware of that but thought we could handle it. Rogério place is a great option.

Bel appartement propre.
Facile à trouver. Attention aux pavés il faut prévoir de porter les valises pour aller jusque là.
Mais c'est plutôt central et bien localisé. 
À prévoir une petite penderie pour les vêtements dans la chambre
Schöne und sehr zentral gelegene kleine Unterkunft, die für einen kurzen Aufenthalt viel bietet.

Чудовий будинок з неймовірним двором. Знаходитись біля басейну вдень, ввечері на газоні а вночі біля багаття - неймовірна насолода. 
Дуже затишно в середині будинку, ремонт сучасний і комфортний. 
Власники будинку милі і любʼязні.
При нагоді залюбки повернемось сюди ще

A nossa estadia foi simplesmente perfeita! O apartamento está novo, muito bem cuidado e impecavelmente limpo. A localização é excelente, numa zona muito conveniente, com tudo o que é necessário por perto e com a possibilidade de ir a pé até ao centro do Porto. A anfitriã, Rafaela,foi sempre muito simpática, atenciosa e disponível, fazendo-nos sentir muito bem recebidos durante toda a estadia. Sem dúvida, uma excelente escolha para visitar o Porto. Recomendo este apartamento sem hesitar e voltaria a ficar aqui numa próxima visita!
Beautiful, modern apartment in the middle of everything you want to do in Porto! Highly recommend
Place is exactly how it’s described, nice location, and very easy to check in

Very nice place to stay in Porto. Close to city center, had all the necessities we could need. 
Overall it was a very pleasant stay and would definitely recommend it! The host is friendly, responds very fast and gives recommendations.
Thank you for the great time!
We loved our stay! The apartment was clean, beautiful, and in a great location
Nice clean place :)

Arrivée autonome parfaite, particulièrement appréciable pour une arrivée dans la nuit. Literie impeccable, logement bien équipé et terrasse privative spacieuse. Le logement se trouve dans un quartier animé et proche des choses à voir de Porto. Seul bémol : l’insonorisation, avec des bruits de pas assez fréquents provenant de l’appartement du dessus ainsi que les conversations audibles depuis le salon partagé.
Great location within walking distance to everything. Hosts very proactive and responsive. Overall apartment very clean and tidy.

Everything was pretty much exactly as pictured! We had no issues at all and felt comfortable. The onlt thing I’d worry about is if you are a larger individual, the bathroom is pretty small and the shower might be very hard to get into. For a smaller or average sized person, it’s fine though.
A lovly hostel in a great location- the staff is so friendly and it has a super nice backyard to chill in. I really loved it💕

Nos encantó el alojamiento. Estaba súper limpio y ordenado, además de muy buen equipado con todo lo necesario. Es exactamente igual que en las imágenes del anuncio. La ubicación es excepcional para ir nadando a cualquier parte de la ciudad. João fue muy amable y atento y nos mandó una guía de recomendaciones que nos ayudó muchísimo en el viaje. Sin duda repetiría y lo recomendaría😊
Beautiful house, very walkable area, great experience!

Very nice and clean apartment in a good area. 12 minute walk from the metro station and good links to buses and nearby supermarkets and restaurants. The host was excellent and very helpful with their messages.
This place was amazing. Perfect size for two and the view from the balcony was extraordinary. Will book here again when I come back.

Mario’s place was a hidden gem - ideal location and fantastic view! The balcony and view is unreal.. 
Mario was also super kind and nice, and always very responsive. Don’t miss out on this place if you’re in Porto
Great apartment very large space and very clean; only issue was no lift and apartment is on second floor. Overall would recommend staying here.
非常不错的房源，房东很有礼貌
A acomodação é incrível e em uma boa localização, um apartamento bem decorado, aconchegante, a uma curta caminhada de tudo o que precisa.

Thank you Sara for a wonderful stay at the Ribeira Apartment Moments. Your apartment was very cute and exactly like described. Everything that you would want to do in Porto is right at your finger tips! We really appreciated your warm welcome and all of the recommendations in the city. As well, you were very easy to get a hold, you made our stay very enjoyable!!
Todo bien, tal como se describe en el anuncio, lo único a mejorar sería que la llegada sea 100% autonoma

Pedro was very kind and responsive.
His property was modern, clean, spacious and had many amenities available, which was great for a newborn baby.
The two A/C units (living room & bedroom) kept the space nice and cool for the entire stay.

As pictured, clean and Luis is very responsive and super helpful. Was a bit difficult to find with the lockbox in one area then the apartment in another area. I had to get rides to everything so keep in mind it’s a bit farther outside of the main areas in Porto but quiet and comfortable.

*Pros* 
El apartamento tiene todas las facilidades y pasar una cómoda estancia. La limpieza, impecable, así como sábanas y toallas. El aire acondicionado funciona genial , tuvimos unos días de mucho calor y se estaba fenomenal. Para 2 adultos una cama matrimonial , amplio para dejar cosas sin agobios. A disposición una plaza de parking , que da mucha tranquilidad, se puede dejar el coche en zona segura sin necesidad de moverlo ni estar pendiente ,está en un edificio de viviendas privado frente al apartamento, a unos 50 metros, un punto a favor muy a tener en cuenta. Detalle de café y botellitas de agua a disposición.
Alfonso nos recibió con una gran amabilidad y profesionalidad.
*Contra* Está en un edificio de oficinas y despachos, también hay más alojamientos turísticos. El edificio es poco acogedor, ascensor antiguo y pasillos largos y silenciosos. No hay mucho movimiento en el día a día , q puede transmitir inseguridad, comentar que no tuvimos ningún incidente.

This apartment is PHENOMENAL! It is larger and more spacious than the photos show, it is in the center of one of the most exciting riverfront squares in Porto, and the views are amazing. The balcony is massive and it was so cool to be perched high above the square watching city life unfold. The check-in process was once of the easiest that we experienced while in Portugal and the apartment itself is quite nice. The only downside, if there was one, was that the ceiling above the bathtub/shower is slanted and quite low. I'm only 5'8 and I had to crouch while in the shower, which made the bathing process a little less convenient than I'm accustomed to. Don't let that detail stop you, though. This place is a must stay and the location cannot be beat. Porto was my favorite stop on my trip and a big part of that was because of this listing. Stay here!
André e a sua família super antenciosos, espaço exterior incrível. As meninas, Nina e a Tora super meigas e sempre dispostas para umas festinhas. Recomendo bastante este espaço familiar
O apartamento é lindo, bem localizado, todo equipado. Mais bonito ainda do que nas fotos. Camas confortáveis, perto de tudo. Minha familia amou a estadia. Recomendo !

Très chouette nuit chez Bartolo!
Le lieu est superbe, en cours de rénovation mais une bonne partie est déjà rénovée et est faite avec goût !
C'est très calme, les chambres sont très confortables!

The room is cozy, very clean, and offers a nice view. I especially appreciated the desk, it has a great workspace for working remotely. The bathroom was clean and spacious. Anastasia is a great host, very friendly and responsive. The location is perfect: right downstairs you’ll find plenty of great cafes, restaurants, and a supermarket. It’s only a 15-minute walk to the beach, with lots of nice spots to stop by along the way. Highly recommended!

We really loved our stay at Miquels apartment. The location is excellent to visit downtown, to take the metro and still it is a quiet neighbourhood.
Miquel really gave us excellent tips for the weekend and was always on call if needed.
Belle location. Conforme au descriptif. Nous recommandons.

Le logement se situe dans un quartier calme (quelques voitures qui passent mais ce n’est pas dérangeant)! Proche de tout y compris du Douro ainsi que du centre ville! Compter entre 7 et 12 minutes pour rejoindre le Douro ou le centre! Metro à proximité également.

Bella esperienza a porto appartamento pulito e in ordine come da foto, Hubert è molto preciso nelle istruzioni e se hai bisogno risponde in pochissimo tempo. 
Grazie ancora

Die Wohnung liegt super zentral und gut erreichbar an einer Metro Station. Sie ist sehr groß und sauber, einzig und allein ein sichtbarer Schimmelfleck ist uns aufgefallen, der könnte eventuell entfernt werden.
Die Straße kann am Wochenende sehr laut sein.
Alles in Allem eine sehr schöne und einladende Unterkunft, die ich jederzeit wieder buchen würde.

J’en ai fait des airbnb et ce logement fut le plus magnifique, d’une propreté irréprochable vraiment très bien équipé vraiment un appartement magnifique mon fils et moi avons passé un super séjour dans le logement. La cuisine est très fonctionnel le canapé du salon est très confortable je m’y suis endormi et ai passer une bonne nuit, la literie des chambres est impeccable. Vraiment merci pour tout. J’ai adoré et je reviendrais avec plaisir. Hôte très réactif vraiment je vous recommande les yeux fermés❤️
Lovely apartment in a great location! It was well equipped with everything needed and the communication with the host was easy and quick. We had a lovely stay here!
We were very satisfied with our stay and would definitely choose to stay there again if we were to come back!

Die Wohnung liegt sehr gut. Man ist in wenigen Minuten zu Fuß in der Stadt.
Sehr sauber und sehr gemütlich.
Thanks !

Чудові враження від проживання. 
Дякую Олені та Олександру за гостинність.
Апартаменти відповідають опису. 
Чудова локація

The apartment was lovely, especially the heated pool. It’s only 10-15min cab ride to town centre so it’s very convenient. 
Only thing that would improve the experience is to add the directions to the property. As the apartment is on an alley and is not visible from the main road. The uber driver could not find it. 
We added instruction below to uber eats delivery ourselves too as they could not find it. 
“ the apartment is near the bus stop, there is a pale blue wall by it and the apartment is up that alley”
Super séjour chez Elisabete, l'appartement était parfait et Elisabete était très réactive et a répondu à toutes nos questions. Nous recommandons fortement pour un séjour à Porto !
Alles super
Ottimo alloggio, comodo al centro città e alla metro, molto pulito e tranquillo. Dotato di cucina con tutto ciò che può servire a trascorrere un piacevole soggiorno.

C’était parfait 
Merci

Had a lovely stay at this accommodation in Porto! Could not recommend it enough. I enjoyed a peaceful stay in this neighbourhood while also being close enough to the hustle and bustle to enjoy when I pleased, only a 20 minute walk into the city centre. There was plenty to do nearby, I enjoyed two fabulous restaurants in the area: Taberna Cais das Pedras and Soul Senses. The beautiful Jardim do Palacio de Cristal was also only a few minutes walking from the place and was absolutely wonderful, as well as the stadium where you can do a rooftop tour to see 360 views of the city. The place was clean and tidy and had everything I needed, hosts were accomodating and friendly and flexible with the late check in time. Hope to return again to explore more of Porto using this as my base :))

The room has a amazing style and there is a lot of little things that they added to the room that really made the visit feel special, like robes and biscuits for coffee. It is extremely well placed for both shops and the beach and a nice relaxing feel. There was a slight issue with the parking spot being occupied, but was easy enough to find parking nearby.

1 star – Unsafe, unsanitary, and the host refused to help
We had a genuinely awful stay. The shower leaked, there was no shelf for any products, and most alarmingly, we found human feces on the travel crib provided for our 3-month-old. The bed was completely broken — you could feel the springs and it was caving in. When we raised this with the host, the only “solution” offered was to bring foam to place on top of a broken bed. Looking at reviews going back to 2021, this same bed issue has been mentioned repeatedly, meaning the host has known about it and done nothing to fix it in 5 years.
On top of this, the apartment key is the same key used for the building’s main entrance, which is a serious safety concern — anyone with access to the building (other residents, staff, past guests, etc.) also has access to the apartment itself.
When we asked the host for a refund given these conditions, we were given a hard time and refused because we chose not to stay. We were left walking around

Simplesmente um dos melhores apartamentos que já nos hospedamos, agradou a todos nós inclusive, nos pequenos detalhes!
Ao entrarmos, sentimos que realmente fizemos uma excelente escolha. Nos surpreendemos com a limpeza, cuidado e organização, creio que nos fez sentirmos como em casa!
Sem dúvida, retornaremos nas próximas férias , e obrigada pela gentileza e os mimos, nos sentimos Bem Vindos mesmos! Abraço e até breve!

Nice stay at the apartment close to the center of Porto, walkable to central attractions.
Apartment as described, with everything needed for everyday living. Also very quite area during the night, was able to sleep with window opened.
Super nice view from the balcony to the river.
We were greeted by very nice host who explained everything about the apartment and the parking in the garage.
Casa impecável com uma paisagem para o rio magnífica.
Tout en parfait état. Appartement avec tout ce dont vous avez besoin, hôte très professionnel. près du métro et à 10 minutes à pied du centre-ville. Je le recommande vivement. ...
Getting up in the morning and seeing the city from this apartment is very pleasant. We had a great stay.

El apartamento tiene una ubicación relativamente buena: no está del todo céntrico, pero tampoco a desmano. La comunicación con el anfitrión y las indicaciones fueron muy buenas.
Al llegar, nos encontramos con algunos aspectos mejorables, como el ruido de la nevera y de la luz del baño. Aunque se indica que cuenta con secador, sería recomendable sustituirlo, ya que es prácticamente como si no tuviera. También sería conveniente dar una mano de pintura a las paredes y repasar la limpieza en algunas zonas, ya que transmiten cierta sensación de falta de cuidado.
Por último, la última noche nos encontramos con numerosas cucarachas en las escaleras del edificio (alrededor de diez), que continuaban allí a la mañana siguiente. Aunque este problema pueda no depender directamente del apartamento, consideramos importante que se revise.
En general, la estancia fue correcta, pero hay varios aspectos de mantenimiento y limpieza que deberían mejorarse.

Abbiamo soggiornato una settimana in questo appartamento, buona posizione e in una zona tranquilla, facile spostarsi a piedi e molta scelta tra bar e ristoranti nei paraggi.
Unica pecca dell’appartamento è che manca un po’ di carattere, poco arredamento e ci sarebbero dei piccoli dettagli da sistemare, ma niente di vincolante.
Complessivamente però se si cerca una casa con questi requisiti, questa può essere una buona scelta ad un buon prezzo.

Exceptional stay! Maria was an incredible host and provided detailed instructions with photos to make our self-check-in completely seamless! We took advantage of the convenient and affordable parking option, but mostly we used the super convenient subway stop to get around. Never even had to transfer to another line! Highly recommend for anyone visiting Porto! Maria also had a charity box set up for us to leave anything extra we had (in this case, a bag of apples, bottle of shampoo, and some laundry pods) so they would be out to good use! Extremely thoughtful all around.
Great location! We didn’t find it loud at all either - definitely will book again if we return to Porto!
Estancia genial ,mejor de lo que esperábamos, todo limpio y acogedor, la recomiendo muy buen precio

Das Honey House ist eine sehr gemütliche Unterkunft. Alles ist liebevoll eingerichtet und alles, was für den Urlaub benötigt wird, ist vorhanden. 
Ana reagiert super schnell und hilfsbereit auf alle Fragen und hat sich sehr gut um uns gekümmert. 
Der Strand, Restaurants und Einkaufsmöglichkeiten sind gut zu Fuß erreichbar. Mit der Metro kommt man einfach nach Porto.

Nous avons passé un très agréable séjour chez Sonia. Le logement était très propre, spacieux, joliment décoré et parfaitement adapté pour un séjour confortable.
Nous avons également beaucoup apprécié notre totale autonomie pour l’arrivée et le départ grâce au système automatique, très pratique et bien organisé.
Merci beaucoup à Sonia pour son accueil et la qualité du logement. Nous recommandons vivement cette adresse et y reviendrons avec plaisir 😄
Really nice location, as we wanted somewhere quiet & close to the beach but still with access to the centre - Ubers are very cheap and easy to get!
Very nice place and walkable area

the building is in a great location and the room was extremely comfortable, bathroom and kitchen were super clean and I had everything needed for a comfortable stay
highly recommend!

Extremely friendly and informative hosts who were also easy to communicate with! This is a splendid Airbnb in prime city center location and close to Sao Bento train station. Such a high quality apartment that we’d like to return to. Emphasizing this is a high quality, luxurious, smartly designed space with beautiful, thoughtful and convenient details. A real treat to stay at during vacation!
Detailed notes:
* Bed and pillows are very comfortable. I have neck and shoulder issues and slept well. 
* Full kitchen with real, actual utensils and tools. 
* Spacious bathroom with plenty of counter space for toiletries.
* Hair dryer is advanced, like a rocket blowing on one’s head with the high setting
* Dryer and washer in one with actual working dryer!
* If hot water stops working, just reset and ask for instructions. Quick fix. The host has already informed the building of the issue. 
* The TV is so smart.
Wir haben eine Nacht auf dem Camino dort verbracht. Wir wurden super nett empfangen und es war alles da was wir brauchten. Der Innenhof ist total schön.

A lovely and well-appointed apartment in a terrific neighborhood, just a few minutes walk to restaurants, shopping and sites. We felt quite at home over our week-long stay. The bed was super comfortable, the AC strong, the kitchen well appointed with everything we needed to prepare simple meals, and the patio sunny. Eduardo and Elisabete were very responsive, quickly providing answers to our questions and recommending a close by beach. I would definitely return and highly recommend it as a great place to stay.

Firstly, if you are debating going to Porto, don’t hesitate! It’s an absolutely magical city and this is the apartment you want to take it all in. The view is jaw dropping and the apartment is spacious, comfortable, and sparkling clean. An incredible shower! The hosts are sweet, responsive, and helpful. The location is perfect, but be ready for many stairs to get down to the river with amazing views around every corner. I was traveling with my older mother, and we were able to take an uber back up to the cathedral nearby to avoid the climb. The surrounding apartments are under construction, but we had no noise or disruptions so don’t let that stop you from booking. Highly recommend!

Fernanda’s apartment fulfills all your needs. It is spacious, well equipped, has a private garage on site and is located right next to a metro station and a supermarket (though I recommend using Uber as they are ridiculously cheap in Porto).
Fernanda is a really kind person and she was always quick and available to answer any question or doubt we had. I highly recommend her place.
Awesome stay!
Tolle Unterkunft für einen Aufenthalt in Porto.

The apartment and our room was nice and clean. It’s just a few minutes from the city center. On the other side of the street there is a great snack bar full of locals. Grocery stores and Auchan is right around the corner.

Alojamiento muy top!! Todo genial, muy fácil acceso y siempre disponibles para atenderte, aun siendo fin de semana.
Volveré sin duda!!

A really lovely apartment with easy walking access to the centre. The hosts are very helpful and always quick to respond. A great location and easy to get to. The apartment was very clean and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay there.

Nous avons passé un très agréable séjour ! Le logement était conforme à nos attentes et nous avons vraiment apprécié notre passage.
Malgré un petit imprévu durant le séjour, les hôtes ont été très réactifs, disponibles et à l’écoute. Ils ont rapidement fait le nécessaire pour trouver une solution, ce que nous avons beaucoup apprécié.
Merci encore pour votre accueil et votre réactivité. Nous gardons un très bon souvenir de notre séjour et nous recommandons ce logement !
All in all, very good place with convenient parking in the front of it
Great location, clean room, beautiful view, responsive hosts, secure luggage storage for those checking in early/out late - will definitely stay here again in the future!
Alles super !! Gerne wieder

Our stay was very pleasant. The location is really great. You get very quickly to the beach and to the city. There are supermarkets and also restaurants nearby. Gabriela was very friendly and answered super fast. She gave us a lot of helpful tips. The apartment is not very big but completely sufficient for two people. All in all it was a nice stay. Thank you Gabriela!

I booked the apartment at really short notice and Ana and IIan couldn't have been more helpful.
They sorted out our tourist tax and instructions how to get to the apartment were really clear.
When we arrived, the sofa bed had been made, which whilst we didn't need, I thought was really thoughtful. The apartment was spotless, and the bed was super comfortable. The shower.... WOW! The pressure was so good!! We loved the mix of industrial and traditional structure, and wanted for nothing. Location is great, turn right out of the apartment and you're on a beautiful street with restaurants and shops. Turn left and a five minute walk takes you straight to the waterfront with plenty of restaurants.
All in all, we had a great stay and wouldn't hesitate recommending this AirBnB to anyone.
Thanks Ana and co!!
Shelley & Tim
