I had a very pleasant stay in an ideal location for what i was looking for.
The apartment was very clean and had everything i needed to make my stay comfortable.

Appartement grand et très sympathique, décoré avec goût.
Très bonne literie, salle de bain spacieuse. Il manque peut-être un peu d'insonorisation.
Pedro et Hugo sont hyper réactifs et à votre écoute.
Merci.
Super beautiful stay, location is amazing and great value for money. The only thing is with it being so central it can be quite noisy at night.
It was just great, we fell in Love with the flat and the city and would totally come again ☀️

Appartamento pulito, comodo, non lontano dal centro.
Unico difetto l'impossibilità di aprire le finestre... per fortuna la presenza dell'aria condizionata rende comunque l'ambiente piacevole
整体的入住体验非常棒，甚至是我用Airbnb以来最好的一次住宿体验。公寓位置非常便利，进入方便，房东Carolina友好且热情，房间非常干净整洁，打扫的一尘不染，房间的布置温馨且舒适，实际房间要比展示的图片感觉更好。总之这是一次很美好的旅程，如果有机会再次回到波尔图，我一定会再来！
Clean, well-designed apartment in a cool loft building. The location is walkable to a bunch of really good restaurants, bars, and stores.
Alles sehr schön!

Passámos uma semana neste apartamento e adorámos a experiência! Nada supera a vista maravilhosa, a proximidade da praia e a facilidade de ter todo o comércio local mesmo por perto. Foi uma estadia muito agradável e esperamos voltar no próximo ano! Só deixamos uma sugestão: um sofá tornaria o apartamento ainda mais confortável. 😊
schön eingerichtetes, sauberes Zimmer

L’appartement d’Armando est très bien, l’équipement est correct.
Nous y avons passé une bonne semaine
Les salles de bain sont grandes, simplement il manque quelques crochets, pour les serviettes et les vêtements quand on prend une douche.
L’appartement est également excentré si on veut aller à Porto à pied, mais comme on avait une voiture, ça a été.
J’ai un reproche pour le quartier, il vaut mieux ne rien laisser dehors. Nous avons fait la mauvaise expérience d’étendre des serviettes sur un fil à linge, près de l’appartement, et on nous les a volées.
On en a été pour le remplacement de trois serviettes et une sortie de bain.

My husband and I stayed here for a whole month. Our stay was very very pleasant. The apartment itself is very beautiful. The location is close to everywhere!! Get everything you need nearby. 
I won’t mind staying there again in my next visit.

Hôte réactive et disponible 
Je recommande vivement Preciosa
O Alojamento respondeu a todas às expectativas. O anfitrião foi sempre muito prestável. Adoramos tudo, iremos voltar certamente. Recomendo
Die Unterkunft war sehr angenehm und ziemlich zentral gelegen. Super Gastgeber!
Upon booking this place the hosts were super friendly and proactive! The location was perfect (right by the water), there was a beautiful view from the window, and it was well decorated and clean!
볼량시장과 가까운 거리에 있으면서도 조용한 지역이라서 머물기가 아주 좋았습니다. 또한, 호스트의 정확하고 세세한 설명으로 처음 체크인도 아주 원활히 할 수 있었습니다.
A lovely apartment, walkable distance to everything we wanted to see in Porto. We would stay again!
Exceptional hosts. Excellent location and apartment. Extremely comfortable and convenient. Having secured parking was a real bonus

Fuimos unos días con amigos para conocer Oporto, y la verdad que está súper bien el alojamiento. Con respecto a la ubicación esta muy cerca del centro así que pudimos recorrer mucho. Y con respecto al departamento en si, es muy cómodo y tiene todo lo necesario para pasar unos días.
Todo según las fotografías
Recomendo muito, anfitriã muito simpática e lugar acolhedor

The location was amazing, walking distance from lots of restaurants and attractions but was still quiet at night. There was an elevator and aircon which was very useful. My children enjoyed going up and down the stairs a lot although with younger children might need to be careful about falling.

Very convenient 
Generous amenities 
Excellent surroundings

Really nice stay. Loved the aesthetics. Comfortable bed and pillow which is not something I say lightly. Pretty safe neighbourhood for a solo female traveller, just stick to the main well lit streets. Convenient location for most things in the city like train station, getting to the riverfront bottom or to top of the bridge all within a 10-15 min walk. I had a great time and felt really comfortable.
Nuestra segunda estancia en este apartamento y encantada con todos los servicios que tiene,el anfitrión siempre atento y amable
Logement très bien placé pour visiter Porto à pied avec un grand parking très apprécié. André est très réactif et toujours disponible

We loved the apartment - felt very welcoming and stylish! Luiz and his partners always answered quickly and worked with us on arrival time - VERY APPRECIATED!! The location was great and we would definitely recommend!! Thank you Luiz!!
The location can’t be beat. The apartment is lovely, clean, with AC, and a direct view of the Duoro ! Highly recommend and would stay again in a heartbeat.
Easy to find, very clean and comfortable and a great location with cafe and restaurant nearby. Easy walking distance to the airport. Thanks so much.
Awesome property and even better hosts!! Thank you!!

L'alloggio è molto bello, perfetto per una famiglia. Si trova in una posizione ideale per visitare Porto e in una zona ricca di ristoranti e locali. Daniel è un host fantastico a cui vanno i miei più sinceri ringraziamenti. Lo consiglio a tutti.
Heel vriendelijk onthaal, mooie locatie.
We had a lovely 4 days here. Comfortable, clean and ideal for 4 adults. Very close to the beach and local restaurants - And easy affordable uber rides into the centre of Porto.
Hermoso alojamiento ! Cómodo , amplio , con jardín y súper completo !! Volvería !

Adorámos a estadia! A casa é muito agradável, tem tudo o que é necessário para passar uns dias e o espaço exterior é simplesmente fantástico.
Sem dúvida, uma experiência muito positiva e um sítio onde voltaríamos a ficar. Recomendo! 😊

Het appartement is redelijk uniek en verantwoordt enigszins de hogere prijs: veel ruimte, 3 slaapkamers met eigen badkamer, rustig gelegen en toch vlot bereikbaar. 
Onderhoud is echter dringend nodig oa de deur van de achterste slaapkamer sluit niet meer, terras (slecht sluitende buitendeur, geen buitenverlichting, losliggende planken, vuile tuinmeubels) en vochtig binnenklimaat (amper ventilatie, de vele geurverspreiders zijn er niet toevallig).
Just came back from a 4 night stay. Place is beautiful especially the pool area. One thing to note is that it says its heated however it is quite cold still especially coming from us brits.
Eine nette kleine Wohnung mit einer wunderschönen Dachterrasse und Blick Richtung Meer.

From the moment we booked Alfonso was extremely helpful and friendly in his correspondence with us. The house was just as described, spacious, sparklingly clean and very well equipped. Close to the metro there was also a good supermarket closeby. Although we ate out often we found that very handy at times. All in all this cheerful house was the perfect base for what was a most enjoyable holiday break. Highly recommended.

Die Wohnung war schön eingerichtet und hatte alles, was man braucht. Wir haben uns tagsüber sehr wohl gefühlt.
Wir waren von Freitag bis Montag in der Wohnung. Direkt unter der Wohnung befindet sich eine Bar, die sehr laut ist. Wegen der schlechten Isolierung, hört man die Musik und die feiernden Menschen, trotz ANC Kopfhörer, sehr laut. Die Bar hat am Wochenende bis 2 Uhr Nachts geöffnet.
Auch der Balkon ist nur eingeschränkt nutzbar, da die Abluft von der Bar auf den Balkon und in das Zimmer kommt.
Unter der Woche hat die Bar schon etwas früher zu oder ist geschlossen. Da ist das Zimmer super. Am Wochenende allerdings nichts, wenn man selbst nicht feiern geht.

This was perfect for 2 couples traveling together-the 2 apartments worked out well! The host was super friendly and very responsive-met us at the apartments to show us around and even let us drop off our luggage as one of the units was ready. She gave us some great recommendations to explore the area. The location was also excellent-much of the area was walkable. We loved our time in Porto and highly recommend staying here (as long as you don’t have mobility issues-there are stairs!).
Great space and very clean. Great location in Porto, being close to lots of restaurants and activities. The hosts were also very helpful and responded quickly

Such a nice flat, very modern, clean and the balcony was very nice to chill on at night. 
One small thing that bothered us a little, there was one message from David that came across as somewhat rude (I couldn't find an item for a while). It's possible this was a translating error / language barrier so no hard feelings :)
Paulo was fantastic. He provided great recommendations and met us at the accommodation. The loft itself is quiet and peaceful and gorgeous

We enjoyed staying at the apartment. It was new, beautiful and generally well kept, with many appliances. The building is very nice, has an elevator, and we were right in the middle of Porto. The apartment is quite small, but this didn’t bother us, except the 140 cm width bed, that for us was a bit too small. Still highly recommended.

Eine perfekte Unterkunft für eine größere Gruppe! 
Sehr gut zu erreichen, zentral gelegen und mit einigen Cafés und Gaststätten.

We had a wonderful stay in Porto! The space is incredibly comfortable, very spacious, and beautifully decorated with thoughtful touches that reflect the charm of the city. Bárbara was also amazingly accommodating and made sure we had everything we needed. We highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Porto!

Absolutely wonderful stay, great location on the river with stunning balcony views. Everything was advertised as and very clean and spacious flat. Walking distance to the university and 200m from a large supermarket. Good communications with the owner and we would definitely stay again-very highly recommended.

Muy bonita.
Muy cómoda.
La terraza genial.
Salvo los animales de los vecinos, perros y gallos que nos molestaron por las noches, es una zona tranquila y cómoda.
Très bon lieu de séjour pour profiter de la plage

Ein rundum perfekter Aufenthalt! Die Unterkunft war sauber und gut ausgestattet, sodass es uns an nichts gefehlt hat. Alles ist mit viel Liebe zum Detail eingerichtet, wodurch wir uns vom ersten Moment an sehr wohlgefühlt haben.
Wir können die Unterkunft uneingeschränkt weiterempfehlen und würden jederzeit wiederkommen!
The apartment was super clean, in a great location, and the host was very gracious and most accommodating. Highly recommend!
Miguel was a great host, communicative and flexible!
We had a great time! Location, communication, apartment, everything was so good!
What a great place to stay in Porto. We loved it!

Superbe emplacement ! 
Rien à redire sur l'appartement. La communication est fluide. Nous n'avons rencontré aucun problème
Séjour nickel, tout était propre et correspondait à la description.

Dias excelentes, a casa e o sítio perfeitos para dias de paz com a família.
De repetir.

This very spacious three bedroom apartment is located on the main road and tram line into the old city. An easy walk into the old town of Porto and conveniently close to the port wineries. Lots to see and do locally.

Tolle Unterkunft, sehr sauber und genau wie beschrieben. Die Lage ist super und die Kommunikation mit dem Gastgeber war jederzeit freundlich und unkompliziert. Wir haben uns sehr wohlgefühlt und würden jederzeit wiederkommen. Klare Empfehlung!

Cozy apartment with a beautiful view. 
Quite neighborhood but in walking distance to many things including center of Porto (lovely walk by the river) and the beach.
Ana was very friendly and met all our request, which made the stay very easy.
We had a hard time to find the right way into the street with the car as the street is very narrow.

No centro da cidade e perto de tudo, fácil acesso a bons restaurantes, áreas comerciais ou até pequenos almoços mesmo à porta. Recomendo para quem quer ficar no centro da cidade sem sentir o barulho dela.
von metro trindade nur 1min zu fuss. alle sehenswürdigkeiten zu fuss erreichbar mit max 20min fussmarsch

Great place to stay and close to the river and all the action. Easily accessible by car as you can pull up right outside. Pablo was very helpful, allowing us to checkin early when a member of a party injured herself. He also gave us a tip on parking that saved us 25 Euros! 
The welcome basket with local wine, olive oil, coffee and various goodies to eat was a very nice surprise! 
All in all a great experience! Thanks Pablo!

Abbiamo passato 5 giorni in due persone nell'appartamento. E' un appartamento confortevole e ben arredato, dotato di una cucina abbastanza equipaggiata per cucinare, cosa per me importante. E sufficientemente silenzioso e tranquillo per dormire. Si trova a pochi passi dalla stazione metro centrale della città. Molto comodi il locale lavanderia e il balcone esterno. Fabio è un host molto reattivo e gentile. In considerazione del clima, non ho avuto bisogno di accendere dispositivi per rinfrescare o per riscaldare l'ambiente. Unico inconveniente, un cattivo odore che pervade l'appartamento, che ci è stato detto provocato da qualcosa di cucinato dal precedente inquilino. In realtà è un odore persistente che non è mai andato via nonostante abbiamo tenuto quasi sempre le finestre aperte.
We really enjoyed our stay. The apartment was in a great location and had every comfort we needed. It was especially nice to have the balcony. Highly recommended.
Can’t wait to get back again!

Really great, centrally located apartment. Super close to the main bridge to walk to the other side of Porto and steps away from the TimeOut Market. The photos are reflective of the place. It was clean, good bed linen and towels. It is a compact apartment for 4 adults but was just what we needed for the weekend.
Ideal location! The private outdoor space and bright solarium created a cozy home for the stay. Glorious!

The Manor House was the perfect place to stay. It was centrally located. The views were incredible, the apartment large and the rooms were airy and comfortably furnished. The kitchen was newly refurbished and very well equipped. It was wonderful having a large terrace that overlooks the river and Gaia. 
Having a shared (free) washing machine available was also very useful. 
I would recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Porto. We loved it.

Casa muito luminosa, com decoração cuidada até ao pormenor. Cozinha bem equipada e casas de banho com cabines de duche acessíveis . Houve a possibilidade de ter cadeira de banho ,o que facilitou no nosso caso , em que havia pessoas idosas e com deficiência. 
Obtivemos sempre resposta rápida às mensagens que trocámos . E fomos recebidos com “miminho” de Boas -vindas . 
Apetecia poder ficar mais tempo .

Min datter og jeg boede i Balbinas bolig i 7 dage på en ferietur til Porto. Balbinas bolig var hyggelig, behagelig og ren. God placering, tæt på metro og kun få metrostop fra det populære Ribeira-kvarter og centrum. Der var rigtig god kommunikation med Balbina og Daniela, som altid var hjælpsomme og svarede hurtigt. Den bedste anbefaling herfra - vi kommer gerne igen.

Hemos estado una semana en este alojamiento y hemos estado encantados con todo. Está en una zona muy tranquila, pero en unos diez minutos accedes a Oporto. El apartamento es precioso y con muchas comodines. Sin duda, si volvemos a Oporto repetiríamos!! Catherine fue encantadora.

Cozy apartment in a great location! My wife, two little children, and I enjoyed a few nights here while exploring Porto for a second time. It is well-located in Ribeira district, just one street from the Duoro River and near many restaurants and other attractions. The apartment had everything we needed—a hot & cold shower, working A/C, kitchen, WiFi, and ample space. Note the apartment is located on the second floor and there is no elevator, but it is a lovely climb and descent. The host (property management) were welcoming, friendly and responsive. Overall, I’d definitely recommend!
Belle appartement

Perfect stay for a couple of Days in Porto, when you are also looking for some time to chill at the house. With the nearby metro and available taxi you can enter the city centre real quick. Would absolutely recommend
Such a well placed apartment for exploring Porto. Fully equipped and a very responsive and helpful host!

Rui was great at welcoming us in! Left us snacks and beverages which was a fantastic surprise! Beds were so comfortable and place quiet. Parking garage was a plus!! A little bit farther from town area not as walkable at night. Could have been a little bit cleaner but great apartment

Absolutely gorgeous views to wake up and go to sleep to. Beautiful home nestled in a residential area that makes you feel apart of the city. Easy to uber to and from, lot of good restaurants in walking distance as well. Can’t recommend enough!

Mooi appartement midden in de binnenstad met alle 'actracties' in de buurt. Het appartement was schoon. Keuken en badkamer waren compleet. 
De host was erg attent en gaf ons veel tips en reageerde snel op vragen. 
Enige is dat het gehorig was.

Bel appartement en hyper centre de vila nova de GAIA a deux pas des caves et du pont Luiz I ,
très propre et facile d'accès 
je recommande sans hésiter pour une escapade à Porto !

Localização ótima, dá pra conhecer o Porto a pé, saindo do apartamento. Ambientes muito confortáveis. Não tem máquina de lavar. Pra quem está de carro, o estacionamento aos arredores é um pouco complicado, mas não é impossível. Tem um ótimo restaurante com café e refeições logo embaixo do apartamento.

Logement spacieux et confortable. Nous avons reçu de bonnes informations de la part de Vitor. 
Seulement le logement est placé au 1er étage d’un immeuble accolé à une grande avenue très très bruyante (impossible d’ouvrir les fenêtres). Pour la voiture, pas de parking à proximité. 
Pour la propreté, il faudra quelque peu accentué (rideau de douche, chambres, cuisine).

Parfait, une maison saine et propre à notre arrivé. 
Tout est à disposition même pour un bebe. 
Au moindre problème l’hôte répond rapidement. 
J’y retournais les yeux fermés. 👍🏻

A lovely well appointed property close to the heart of the City. Clean and tidy spacious living area without clutter. Excellent kitchen and bathroom facilties and air con in all rooms. En suites looked modern and were spacious allowing room to move. In all an excellent space with great modern facilities.
Perfect location

근처 관광지와 근접하여 좋습니다. 약간 높은 곳에 위치해있어 캐리어를 끌고 다니기에는 힘들것으로 생각되며 우버 볼트를 활용하세요.
수건이 약간 부족하다고 느꼇습니다.

Great spot for discovering Porto. 
Carolina was a great host, very proactive, with lots of advice.
The apartment is great, well locatesld, well equipped.

What a perfect location for your 1st or 10th trip to Porto! Loved the balcony and the interesting design. The loft was fun and added to the apartment’s spacious ness. The soft music and seagull calls floating around were the perfect ambience for an evening glass of port (thanks Serena😊) or a morning cup of coffee. And the washer/dryer was perfect for light packers. Some reviewers comments mentioned the stairs, but these were a pice of cake compared to Porto’s streets. We’re old (😉) and had no issue.

Pedro is a very kind and welcoming host! The apartment was immaculately clean. It was a little hot inside of the apartment since I was visiting during some very hot days but multiple fans were supplied and that helped. I felt very safe while staying here as well and appreciated how close to a main road it was for the sake of Ubers. It’s also walking distance to one of the best bars in town- BOSCO. I’m very happy I chose this location and would stay here again in the future.

Ons verblijf in dit appartementje was perfect. De locatie is een beetje afgelopen van het centrum (ongeveer 20 minuten lopen van de eerste restaurantjes vandaan) maar het ligt vrijwel direct naast de Super Bock Arena. Dit is ideaal voor het bijwonen van evenementen in deze arena, aangezien de ingang nog geen 2 minuten lopen van het appartement vandaan is.
Het appartement zelf is niks bijzonders, een kleine woonkamer en slaapkamer maar prima om met 2 personen een aantal nachten in te verblijven. Zeker een aanrader als je een evenement in de Super Bock Arena hebt! 😊

Ademas de lo reseñado, prolijidad, comodidad, limpieza, intimidad, cuenta con el uso de la cocina, muy bien equipada, y el comedor mas un muy pequeño patio que utilizamos muchísimo. 
Ademas de la rapidez de las respuestas, el anfitrión has sido muy amable y siempre preciso.
Tuvimos la posibilidad de dejar el equipaje en resguardo varias horas antes del check in, lo que nos permitió aprovechar el tiempo para recorrer la ciudad al máximo. 
La ubicación es excelente, tanto por su proximidad al centro histórico, como por tener a pocos metros el acceso a una linea de subte que combina con el excelente sistema de trasporte de Porto, lo que nos permitioir de un lado a otro de la ciudad con facilidad y rapidez.

A fantastic Airbnb! Very well designed and comfortable space, in a great location and walking distance to restaurants, coffee shops and more. Bed was extremely comfortable and host was super communicative. Would definitly reccomend.
We loved staying here and would love to stay here again! Very cool neighbourhood and super chill apartment, perfect with a baby.

El departamento es tal cual se describe en las fotografias y lo mas destacable es la ubicacion, cerca de todo considerando que en Oporto hay que caminar hacia arriba y abajo!!!!
Las prestaciones del depto. cumplen las expectativas y sirven para un alojamiento de algunos dias.
We had a great stay! Was nice to have the pool - and appreciated the fresh towels! Location was great - lots of amazing bars and resturaunts nearby and a short walk down to the river! Thank you :-)
Thank you, Luis! We very much so enjoyed our stay, and wish we could’ve spent more time in Porto. Great location, and we had plenty of space. Good WiFi, Luis provided anything we could’ve needed.
A hospedagem é ótima, a instrução pro check in, especialmente senha da porta poderia seria mais clara, mas a acomodação é boa e espaçosa.
Great apartment with a great location. Perfect for our group
Amazing space and great location. Very spacious and when possible, flexible with timing. Would definitely recommend this to everyone!

very central and convenient
several good restaurants nearby
comfortable bed and good shower
Beautiful property. Fernando made us feel very welcome with all the special touches. Thanks so much for the hospitality. We hope to be back soon!

Super süßes und schickes Apartment. Wir waren eine Woche da und haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Die Lage ist super zentral, direkt an der St. Louis Brücke und nur die Straße runter zum Douro River. Wir würden wiederkommen!

Incredible apartment in unbeatable location. 
We loved everything about this place - don’t hesitate to book if you’re going to Porto, location couldn’t be better, lovely, clean and spacious. Very happy travellers!

The apartment was fabulous! Bedrooms and bathrooms clean and well appointed. The location was right in the heart of the medieval area but very quiet inside the apartment. Daniel met us at the apartment upon arrival and was very responsive during our stay. Would definitely stay there again.
Foi uma experiência linda e especial, conseguimos usufruir de todos os espaços da casa, tivemos dias memoráveis e sentimo-nos realmente em casa.
Great location ,very clean and was exactly like the photos. Would highly recommend.

This was the most perfect place to stay for our three nights in Porto. Easy commute from the airport via the metro. Great transport links to get to all corners of the beautiful city, as well as feeling super safe to walk around the neighbourhood and explore.
Cristina was the most helpful host, providing such clear texts and photos to help us find the apartment and enter. She let us know where everything we would need was in the apartment. Super helpful were her recommendations for things we could find locally and elsewhere in the city....fabulous.
We would not hesitate to come back...our stay was glorious and everything was perfect. We can't thank Cristina enough and as for Porto...wow what an excellent city, we've still so much to discover...it's beautiful and the people are so warm and welcoming.
Tolle Lage, wunderschöner Blick vom Balkon. Mitten im Geschehen.

Nous avons passé un super séjour chez Silvio. Le logement était situé dans un endroit calme et on y trouvait tout ce dont on avait besoin. Il s’agissait de notre premier voyage avec notre bébé et l’appartement était très bien adapté aux enfants. Nous recommandons sans hésiter 🙂

포르투 첫 숙소로 강력히 추천하는!!! 숙소입니다.
Goran의 사랑과 정성이 듬뿍 담긴 포르투 숙소입니다. 유럽 어디에서도 이렇게 좋은 에어비앤비 숙소는 찾기 어려울 것 같아요 ㅠㅠ
그리고 꼭 Goran과의 유익한 대화를 놓치지 마세요!! 포르투 최고의 가이드예요. Goran의 추천대로만 다녀도 포르투 웬만한 건 다 즐길 수 있어요! :) 덕분에 와인 투어도 잘 했고 포르투 해변에서 좋은 추억을 만들었습니다. 아~ Goran 하우스 먼저 갈걸~~~ 너무너무 감사합니다!!! 👍

This apartment would be five stars if you were staying here for 2-3 days. We were here for 10 and found the kitchen tiny, with a few maintenance issues. However, it’s very clean and extremely well located. Mostly quiet. And the host is highly responsive and helpful.
Communication was excellent! Just be aware there’s no A/C 😂
Die Wohnung war sehr sauber und ausreichend eingerichtet. Sehr zentrale Lage, Strand, Restaurant und Geschäfte in der Nähe. Vermieter sehr freundlich und gut zu erreichen.
I would not listed as an luxury unit. The place is small, have to walk 3 flights of stairs with luggage

We spent 2 days at Claudia’s following several days enduro riding and it fulfilled our requirements perfectly. The apartment is clean, well equipped & ideally located for exploring the city & accessing good restaurants. Claudia is a perfect host who is friendly & attentive & responded immediately when contacted therefore I would strongly recommend staying with her & hope to return in the near future we thoroughly enjoyed our stay A++++

Super Hilfreich 
Später Check-In möglich
Sehr vertrauenswürdig
Lovely apartment - especially the roof terrace
The location is great

Had a lovely stay in Porto, the accomodation is up the top of the hill but very close to bars and restaurants. 
I am coeliac so we purchased breakfast for the mornings, we did not realise the fridge was broken so we the food was spoiled. The accommodation was responsive and we were issued an $80AUD refund. 
Besides from that, I would recommend anyone to stay here. Clean tidy and quiet accommodation.
We had a nice stay here! Lovely apartment in the city!

Very relaxing, peaceful stay, very clean everywhere and the pool and outdoor spaces were amazing. 
Great location for Porto, only 20 minutes in a Bolt. Good supermarkets nearby and easy walk to beach and station. Great stay!

We had a wonderful stay at this property. It is spacious and has all the amenities you need. Between 10 adults we particularly liked having lots of bathrooms. The communal space is great for gathering as well. 
The house is within walking distance of the town and there were cafes, bars and restaurants nearby as well. 
Check in and check out were easy. There was regular and clear communication throughout and our host was very responsive.
Thanks for a great stay!
Lovely place, great location, and useful information for a perfect weekend break.
Perfeito
À proximité de tout en plein centre, on peut tout faire à pied, logement, parfait pour dormir
Nous avons passé un très bon séjour à Porto depuis cet hébergement ! ☺️ Mariana était joignable, force de propositions et très agréable !

Très beau logement avec vue sur l’océan. 
Très propre nous avons passé un bon séjour
